articles.title: FurE: Efficient Instance-Specific 3D Fur Reconstruction without Animal-Fur Datasets
articles.content: Realistic and editable animal fur reconstruction from multi-view images is challenging due to fine-scale detail, self-occlusion and obfuscation, and, unlike human hair, the lack of animal-fur datasets. Fur usually covers most of an animal's body, with large inter-species and intra-species variability. We present FurE, an efficient strand-based animal fur reconstruction method that recovers a per-strand, editable groom by optimizing a root-conditioned latent field, decoded into strand geometry via a PCA-based decoder. We reconstruct a defurred animal body using local fur-thickness cues from a surface-constrained Gaussian Frosting representation together with part-based priors. We further show that a PCA-based decoder learned from human-hair strand data can alleviate animal-data scarcity while enabling substantially faster optimization. FurE achieves a 10x speedup in strand training over current SOTA dense per-strand optimization while retaining strand fidelity and generalizing across synthetic and real-world sequences, with quantitative and qualitative validation despite the reduction in training time.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FurE: 高效实例 -- -- 特定实例 -- -- 无动物 -- -- Fur重建
articles.content_zh: 多景图像中真实而可编辑的动物毛皮重建由于细微的细微细节,自闭和模糊等原因而具有挑战性,而与人类发型不同的是,缺乏动物毛皮数据集. 富尔通常会覆盖动物的大部分身体,有较大的物种间和物种内部可变性. FurE是一种高效的动物毛皮再生方法,它通过优化根基条件的潜入场来回收可编辑的新郎,通过基于PCA的解码器来解码成线条几何. 我们重建出一个腐烂的动物身体 利用当地皮毛的分泌提示 从表面紧张的高斯霜 和部分前科。 我们进一步表明,从人-发线数据中吸取的基于五氯苯甲醚的解码器可以缓解动物数据稀缺的问题,同时能够大大加快优化。 FurE在目前SOTA密集的每根弦优化的基础上,实现了10x加速线条培训,同时保留线条忠心并概括合成和现实世界序列,尽管培训时间缩短,但数量和质的验证。

articles.title: PDMD: Projected Distribution Matching Distillation for Video Diffusion Models
articles.content: Modern video diffusion models require tens of denoising evaluations over long spatiotemporal token sequences. Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) reduces the number of function evaluations (NFE) to just a few. However, DMD samples can degrade during training, exhibiting progressive oversaturation and artifacts. We trace this instability to critic errors, which enter successive student updates and accumulate over time. We introduce Projected Distribution Matching Distillation (PDMD) to filter critic errors. PDMD projects out the component of the DMD update parallel to the student-critic endpoint residual. At a fixed noisy query, we prove that this residual is an unbiased estimate of the critic's endpoint error. Under high-dimensional assumptions, this projection removes a constant fraction of critic error while discarding only a vanishing fraction of ideal DMD signal. Empirically, the projection stabilizes training and improves sample quality where DMD degrades and develops unnatural textures. PDMD requires only a one-line code change to DMD, with no extra loss, network, data, model pass, or multi-stage training. With Wan2.1, PDMD achieves a VBench total score of 83.73 at 4 NFE, surpassing matched DMD by 1.03 points. On MiniMax-H3 joint video-audio generation, PDMD achieves a VideoGen-Eval visual total score of 83.17, 0.41 points above the strongest distilled baseline. PDMD also achieves the best performance on all six audio metrics among the compared 4-NFE models. Qualitative comparisons and user studies favor PDMD over the distilled baselines in visual quality, motion, and audio quality. Code and models are available at https://pdmd2026.github.io/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PDMD: 视频传播模式的预计配送配比
articles.content_zh: 现代的视频传播模型需要数十个对长的spatiotemporal符号序列进行去名评价. 分布相匹配分化(DMD)将函数评价(NFE)的数量减少到了很少. 然而,DMD样本可以在训练期间降解,展示出渐进的过度饱和和和文物. 我们追踪到这种不稳定性,以批评错误,这些错误会连续输入学生的最新消息并逐渐积累. 我们引入了预测分配匹配分解(PDMD)来过滤批评者的错误. PDMD将DMD更新部分与学生-批评端点剩余部分平行进行预测. 在一个固定的吵闹的询问中,我们证明这种残余是对评论家端点错误的无偏见估计. 在高维度假设下,这种投影可以去除评论器出错的一成不变分数,而只丢弃了理想的DMD信号中一个消失分数. 从经验上讲,投影稳定了培训,提高了DMD降解并发展出非自然纹理的样本质量. PDMD只要求一行代码更改为DMD,没有额外的损失,网络,数据,模型通过,或多阶段训练. 随着Wan2.1的出道,PDMD在4 NFE的比赛中以83.73分的总分达到V Bench,以1.03分的比分超过了DMD. 在MiniMax-H3联合视频-音频生成上,PDMD实现了VideoGen-Eval视觉总分83.17分,比最强的蒸馏基线高0.41分. PDMD在比较的4-NFE模型中也在所有6个音频度量衡上取得了最佳性能. 定性比较和用户研究有利于PDMD在视觉质量、运动和音频质量方面优于分馏基线。 守则和模型见https://pdmd2026.github.io/。

articles.title: Learning Native Reflection in Unified Models with Interleaved Reinforcement Learning
articles.content: Unified multimodal models can both look at and render images, so in principle they can repair their own generations: diagnose what an image gets wrong, revise it, observe the result, and diagnose again. Whether a revision helps is known only after it is rendered, so the reflection text and the image generation must be learned jointly, over the whole loop. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on reflection trajectories gives a cold start but does not find the high-success repair paths, and naive RL that optimizes only the renderer or only one head leaves most of the gain untapped. We introduce UMM-Reflection, which applies reinforcement learning (RL) to complete reflection trajectories inside one unified model: sibling trajectories share one initial image, so the group-relative advantage compares reflection strategies, and one trajectory-level advantage updates both the reflection tokens and the flow-based revisions, avoiding the combinatorial blow-up of per-round credit assignment. Unlike single-round editing or pipelines with an external critic, credit flows across rounds and to both roles of the same model, and no verifier is needed at inference. On BAGEL, UMM-Reflection improves GenEval by 12.05 points over SFT, and the gains transfer to WISE (+10.97), OneIG-Bench (+3.48), and T2I-CompBench++ (+4.63), none of which is used in training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 学习统一模式中的土著反思与互放强化学习
articles.content_zh: 统一的多模式模型既可以查看,也可以渲染出图像,因此原则上它们可以修复自己的世代:诊断出图像出错之处,修正,观察结果,然后再次诊断. 修正是否只有在提供之后才知道帮助,所以反射文本和图像生成必须共同学习,在整个循环中学习. 在反射轨迹上经过监督的微调(SFT)给出了冷酷的起步,但没有找到高成功的修复路径,天真地RL只优化了渲染器或者只有一个头会留下大部分未开发的收益. 我们引入了UMM-Reflection(UMM-Reflection),它应用了强化学习(RL)来完成一个统一模型内的反射轨迹:sibling Tracements共享一个初始图像,因此集团相对的优势比较了反射策略,一个轨迹级的优势既更新了反射符,又更新了以流量为基础的修改,避免了每轮信用分配的组合式吹出. 与单轮编辑或有外聘评论家参与的管道不同,各轮的信用流动以及同一模式的两种作用,在推论上不需要验证器. 在BAGEL上,UMM-Reflection将GenEval比SFT改进了12.05分,而增益转至WISE(+10.97),OneIG-Bench(+3.48)和T2I-Comp Bench++(+4.63),均没有用于训练.

articles.title: Reliability-Gated Fusion of Consumer Head and Foot IMUs for Lower-Body 3D Pose
articles.content: Sparse inertial pose estimation promises camera-free motion capture from consumer devices, but consumer sensors are unreliable: firmware-fused orientations are biased, mounting varies between sessions, and streams drift or drop out. On a new 35-take single-subject benchmark pairing an earbud head inertial measurement unit (IMU) with two smart-insole foot IMUs (SAM-3D-Body pseudo-ground-truth labels), we show the reliability problem is channel-level: a channel ablation isolates foot acceleration as the most informative input (66.6 mm vs. 79.0 mm head-only) and the firmware-fused foot orientation as the liability that destroys the gain. We therefore let the model learn how much to trust each channel of each stream: one temporal gate per stream per channel block, trained with an auxiliary reliability objective on synthetically corrupted pretraining data. The channel-gated model is the most accurate of our learned fusion arms on clean data (69.4 mm vs. 83.7 static, 86.6 ungated) and under every simulated fault (bias in training; drift, dropout eval-only); its gates suppress the natively biased foot-orientation channels on clean real data without test-time supervision and flag dropout bursts at 0.92-0.999 AUROC. Two contrasts: dropping a channel known a priori to fail is flat across foot faults but collapses when an unanticipated stream fails (head dropout: 92.9 vs. 79.3 mm); and a fine-tuned HMD-Poser is more accurate on clean data (64.4 mm) and nominally under drift, with no significant paired difference under bias or dropout, but a larger worst-case degradation from clean (+16.1 vs. +3.5 mm, single seed). Learning to gate reliability instead of sensor count is the lever for deployable sparse inertial capture. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhilinGuo/reliability-gated-imu-fusion.

articles.title_zh: 低Body 3D 消费者头和脚的可靠性组合 宝斯
articles.content_zh: Sparse惯性提出了来自消费设备的无相机运动捕捉的估计承诺,但消费传感器不可靠:固件喷出的方向有偏颇,不同会场相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相 在一个新的35-摄取单主体基准上,将耳管头惯性测量单元(IMU)与两个智能进取脚 IMU(SAM-3D-Body伪地-真实标签)相配,我们显示可靠性问题在于信道级别:信道衰减隔离脚步加速,作为信息最丰富的输入(66.6毫米对79.0毫米只头)和固件入取脚取向,作为破坏收益的责任. 因此,我们让模型学习如何相信每条流的每个通道:每个流的每个通道块有一个时间门,在合成被腐蚀的预训数据上训练一个辅助可靠性目标. 频道加注模式是我们在清洁数据(69.4毫米对83.7静态,86.6升格)和每个模拟断层(训练中的比斯;漂流,放出只有等值)下所学得的最准确的聚变武器;它的大门压制了在清洁真实数据上本土偏颇的脚指向渠道,没有试验时间监督,停放国旗的频率为0.92-0.999。 两种对比: 投放已知先验失败的通道会平地跨出足道断,但当出乎意料的溪流出故障时会倒塌(头部出故障:92.9对79.3毫米);而微调的HMD-Poser在清洁数据(64.4毫米)上更准确并名义上在漂流下,在偏差或倒出的情况下没有显著的对等差异,而是比清洁更严重的退化(+16.1对+3.5毫米,单一种子). 学会门的可靠性而不是感应器的计数是可部署的稀有惯性捕捉的杠杆. 代码见https://github.com/ZhilinGuo/可靠性-gated-mu-musion。

articles.title: Copy the Same, Distill the Difference: Initializing Linear Vision Transformers
articles.content: Linear Vision Transformers (ViTs) are designed to replace the attention in Softmax ViTs with the linear-complexity attention operator for more efficient token routing, but they require from-scratch pre-training and typically underperform the original Softmax version. How to initialize linear ViTs both efficiently and effectively still remains unclear. In this work, we explicitly ask: given that most foundation ViTs are built on the mainstream Softmax attention, can linear ViTs benefit from their pre-trained weights? Recent works on Attention Transfer show that attention is the effective transferable component between Softmax ViTs, suggesting attention alone suffices for such reuse. However, we find the opposite for Softmax-to-linear transfer. The attention weights are operator-specific: copying them barely helps, and is sometimes even worse than random initialization. Instead, the attention's token routing behavior can be recovered through distillation with a proper loss design, letting linear ViTs reduce the gap and even match Softmax ones. In contrast, the MLP weights, which carry the learned representation, are operator-agnostic: they can be transferred by simple direct copying, which already carries most of the benefit of the pre-trained weights. Thus, copying MLPs can serve as an effective foundation for Softmax-to-linear transfer: paired with the distilled attention, linear ViTs eventually close the remaining gap and even surpass Softmax ones. These findings hold consistently across various linear ViT variants, different model sizes, and diverse datasets. We hope this study deepens the understanding of reusing pre-trained weights across attention operators: copy what stays the same and distill what differs, to recover the benefit across the Softmax-to-linear boundary.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 复制相同, distill the Difference: 初始化线性视野变换器
articles.content_zh: Linear Vision Transformers (ViTs) 被设计为将Softmax ViTs中的注意取而代之的线性-复杂注意操作器,以更高效地进行符号路由,但它们需要从-scratch预训并典型地低于原始Softmax版本. 如何以高效率和高效力地初始化线性维T仍然不清楚。 在这部作品中,我们明确提出:鉴于大多数基础ViT是建立在主流Softmax的注意力上,线性ViT能否从他们事先训练的重量中获益? 最近关于注意力转移的研究表明,注意力是Softmax ViTs之间有效的可转移组件,仅表明注意力就足以使这种再利用。 然而,我们发现Softmax到线性转移是相反的. 注意力分量是操作员特有的:复制它们几乎无济于事,有时甚至比随机初始化更糟糕. 相反地,注意力的符号通路行为可以通过有适当损失设计的蒸馏来恢复,让线性ViTs能缩小缺口,甚至能匹配Softmax. 相形之下,带有所学表现力的MLP权重是操作者-不可知论的:它们可以通过简单的直接复制来转移,它已经携带了预先训练权重的大部分好处. 因此,复制MLPs可以作为Softmax到线性转移的有效基础:与被分馏的注意力对接,线性ViTs最终会关闭所剩的缺口,甚至会超越Softmax. 这些结论始终贯穿于各种线性VIT变体、不同的模型大小和不同的数据集。 我们希望这项研究加深了对重新使用预先训练过的重力的理解,跨越注意力操作者:复制保持不变的重量,并分解不同的重量,以回收跨越Softmax到线性边界的好处。

articles.title: InfiniHand: Streaming World-Space Hand Motion Estimation from Egocentric Video
articles.content: World-space hand motion estimation from egocentric video requires recovering 3D articulated hand geometry while tracking camera egomotion. Existing approaches heavily rely on cascading independent hand pose estimators and SLAM systems, resulting in error accumulation, complex pipelines, and severe computational overhead. To address these limitations, we present InfiniHand, an end-to-end streaming feed-forward framework that jointly estimates MANO parameters, camera trajectories, and hand locations directly from uncalibrated egocentric video. InfiniHand integrates persistent spatiotemporal memory with hand-centered visual features, explicitly coupling camera motion with local hand geometry within a unified architecture. We train InfiniHand in two progressive stages by first learning robust camera-space hand priors and then extending to streaming world-space reconstruction. To support this process, we aggregate a pretraining corpus of approximately 5,000 hours of egocentric data across multiple public datasets. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that InfiniHand outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on in-domain benchmarks, achieving a 21.4% reduction in ARCTIC PA-p compared to ViDiHand while substantially mitigating world-space drift. Furthermore, InfiniHand generalizes robustly to in-the-wild videos and operates at 11.19 FPS, delivering more than twice the throughput of HaWoR.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: InfiniHand: 流出从 Egocentral 视频对世界空间的手动估计
articles.content_zh: 世界-空间手动估计从以自我为中心的视频需要恢复3D分明的手相几何,同时跟踪相机自取自我. 现有方法严重依赖相接而成的独立手构成估计器和SLAM系统,导致误差累积、管道复杂和严重的计算间接费用。 为了解决这些局限性,我们提出了InfiniHand,一个从端到端的流回回馈框架,它共同估算了MANO参数,相机轨迹,以及直接取自于未校正自心的视频的手位置. InfiniHand将持久性相片记忆与以手为中心的视觉特征相融合,在统一的架构内明确将相机运动与局部手几何相接. 我们通过先学习强力相机空间手前传,然后延伸至流出世界空间重建,将InfiniHand训练为两个进步阶段. 为了支持这一进程,我们汇集了一套预先训练教材,该教材涵盖多个公共数据集中大约5 000小时的自我中心数据。 广泛的评价表明,InfiniHand的绩效超过了域内基准的最新基线,与ViDiHand相比,ARCTIC PA-p的减排率为21.4%,同时大幅度地减缓了世界-空间漂移。 此外,InfiniHand还大力普及到全天候的视频,并以11.19 FPS运行,提供HaWOR的两倍多的吞吐量.

articles.title: GeoVerse: World-Consistent Novel View Synthesis in Geometric Latent Space
articles.content: Novel view synthesis from sparse images must reconcile faithful reconstruction of observed regions with plausible completion of unseen content, while maintaining world consistency across viewpoints. Existing geometry-based methods preserve observed scene structure but often struggle to complete unseen regions, whereas video generative models offer rich appearance priors but accumulate inconsistencies during sequential view generation. We propose GeoVerse, a framework that synthesizes world-consistent novel views by performing generation within the geometric latent space of a pretrained 3D foundation model and injecting appearance priors from a video generative model. Specifically, GeoVerse extracts multilevel features from Wan2.2 VACE and injects them into the geometric latent diffusion model via a ControlNet-style adapter, incorporating video-learned appearance priors to enhance structural completion. To enforce cross-view coherence, a global spatial memory continuously aggregates observed and synthesized content, reprojecting target-aligned guidance to anchor subsequent predictions to a shared scene representation. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate improved visual quality and geometric consistency, with a 2.23 dB higher PSNR on DL3DV and 32.4% lower ATE on Mip-NeRF360 compared to GLD.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GeoVerse: 几何后期空间的世界相容小说视图合成
articles.content_zh: 从稀少的图像中合成出小说,必须将观察区域的忠实重建与可能完成的无形内容相协调,同时保持世界各种观点的一致性。 以几何学为基础的现有方法保留了被观测到的场景结构,但往往难以完成看不见的区域,而视频基因模型则提供了丰富的外观前作,但在相继的取景过程中却积累了不一致. 我们提出GeoVerse,这个框架通过在预先训练的3D基础模型的几何潜在空间内表演一代以及从视频基因模型中注入外观的前身来综合世界一致的新观点. 具体而言,GeoVerse从Wan2.2 VACE中提取多层特性,并通过ControlNet式适配器将这些特性注入几何潜扩散模型,并纳入取录视频的外观前科,以提高结构的完成性。 为了实现交叉视野的一致性,一个全球空间内存持续地集聚并合成了内容,将目标相匹配的引导重新投射,将后续的预测定位到共享的场景代表. 各种数据集的广泛实验显示,视觉质量和几何一致性都有所改进,DL3DV上的PSNR值为2.23分贝,而Mip-NERF360上的ATE值为32.4%。

articles.title: FlowAct-R2: Beyond Talking Avatar via Streaming Multimodal References and Proactive Agent Planning
articles.content: We present FlowAct-R2, a framework for interactive humanoid video generation that combines continuous multimodal control with proactive agent planning. Our method consists of two coupled components. First, a Streaming Multimodal Reference Diffusion Transformer adapts the pretrained Seedance 2.0 Mini reference-to-video backbone to accept rolling action prompts, streaming audio, and dynamically updated image, audio, and video references. Video-driven rotary positional embeddings align reference chunks with the generation timeline, while reference-plus-image conditioning and partially noised historical motion frames preserve appearance and avoid accumulated drift. Second, a Proactive Interaction Agent separates pre-online planning from online scheduling and response: it prepares a persona, a long-horizon agenda, and reusable multimodal skills in advance, then autonomously schedules behaviors, responds to audience input, and handles interruptions during a live session. FlowAct-R2 supports real-time 720p generation and hour-scale streaming across entertainment streaming, live shopping, video chatting, and live vlogging.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FlowAct-R2:通过流式多式参考资料和主动代理规划超越空想
articles.content_zh: 我们提出FlowAct-R2,这是交互式人造视频生成的框架,将持续的多式控制与积极主动的代理规划结合起来。 我们的方法包括两个组合部分。 首先, " 流线多式参考 " 扩散变换器调整了预先培训过的 " 种子 " 2.0迷你参考到视频主干线,以接受滚动动作提示、流出音频和动态更新的图像、音频和视频参考。 由视频驱动的回转位置嵌入使参考块与生成时间相配合,而参考-外加-图像配置和部分噪声历史运动框则保持外观并避免累积漂移. 其次,主动互动代理将在线前规划与在线调度和响应区分开来:它预先准备人物,长视野议程,以及可再使用的多模式技能,然后自主安排行为,响应观众输入,并在直播会中处理中断. 流动 Act-R2支持实时720p生成和小时分流跨出娱乐流,直播购物,视频聊天,并进行现场活取.

articles.title: Impact of Patient Orientation in Single- and Multi-View Camera Environments for AI-based Rehabilitation Monitoring
articles.content: Automated quality assessment of rehabilitation exercises relies heavily on accurate human pose estimation from video data. Although numerous RGB-based pose estimation methods have been proposed, the impact of camera placement on detecting clinically relevant movement errors remains insufficiently explored. To address this gap, we introduce REHAB26-ViewAngles, a dataset comprising correct and incorrect rehabilitation exercise executions captured from a wide range of camera angles. Furthermore, we propose a novel separability metric to quantify an algorithm's ability to distinguish between valid and faulty exercise repetitions. Using these tools, we analyze how various RGB-based pose-estimation strategies are suitable for exercise quality assessment under varying camera placements. In particular, we analyze single-camera 2D and 3D pose estimation and four multi-camera strategies: a combination of two orthogonal 2D views, 3D triangulation, weighted 3D fusion, and an AI-based pose-estimation transformer model specifically trained from two synchronized cameras. Our findings reveal that an optimally placed 2D camera can improve the separability by 16.9\,\% over the commonly used $0^\circ$ frontal view and frequently outperforms single-camera 3D estimation, while combining two views can further improve accuracy by up to 13.1\,\%. These results offer practical guidance for deploying rehabilitation monitoring in both home and clinical settings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 单视和多视相机环境中患者定向对AI康复监测的影响
articles.content_zh: 对康复工作进行自动质量评估在很大程度上依赖于从视频数据中准确的人体姿势估计。 尽管提出了许多基于RGB的外观估计方法,但摄像头布置对发现临床相关运动出错的影响仍未得到充分探讨。 为了弥补这一差距,我们采用了REHAB26-ViewAngles,这是一个数据集,包含从各种相机角度记录的正确和不正确的康复行动处决。 此外,我们提出了一个新的可分离性指标,以量化一个算法区分有效与有错的练习重复的能力。 利用这些工具,我们分析各种基于RGB的外观估计策略如何适合在不同的相机布置下进行演练质量评估. 特别是,我们分析单相机2D和3D的平面估计和4个多相机策略:结合两个正向的2D视图,3D三相,加权的3D聚变,以及由两个同步相机专门训练的基于AI的平面估计变压器模型. 我们的研究结果显示,最佳定位的2D相机可以提高16.9\,\\x比常用的0美元circ$前视高分出分出率,并且经常超过单相机3D的估计,同时将两种相机结合起来可以进一步提高准确度,最高可达13.1\,\x. 这些结果为在家庭和临床环境中进行康复监测提供了实际指导。

articles.title: Superquadric Primitive Decomposition of 3D point clouds via Geometric-Aware Inlier Refinement
articles.content: The decomposition of 3D point clouds into interpretable geometric primitives remains a longstanding challenge in Computer Vision and Computer Graphics. Among the available representations, superquadrics offer a compact and expressive model capable of capturing a wide range of shapes. However, their estimation is inherently challenging, as it requires solving a non-linear optimization problem and is particularly sensitive to noise, outliers, and overlapping structures. While robust estimation methods such as RANSAC and its variants achieve strong performance, they rely primarily on spatial proximity and residual-based criteria, often leading to incorrect inlier assignments across adjacent or complex arrangements of primitives. In this work, we introduce a geometric-aware framework for primitive decomposition that explicitly incorporates local surface properties into the fitting process. Specifically, we propose an inlier refinement step formulated as an energy minimization problem and solved via graph-cut optimization. Our formulation integrates geometric priors, such as normal consistency, enabling more reliable inlier selection beyond purely residual-based criteria. The approach naturally applies to both single-model estimation and multi-model decomposition. By leveraging geometric information beyond point-wise residuals, our method reduces erroneous inlier propagation and stabilizes parameter estimation. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets show consistent improvements in geometric accuracy, robustness to noise and outliers, and convergence efficiency compared to state-of-the-art RANSAC-based methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过几何-Aware Inlier 改进三维点云的分解
articles.content_zh: 将3D点云分解为可解释的几何原始体,仍然是计算机视野和计算机图形学中的一个长期挑战. 在现有的表达方式中,超级夸克提供了能捕捉出广泛形状的紧凑和表达模式. 然而,它们的估计本身具有挑战性,因为它需要解决非线性优化问题,并对噪音、外层和重叠结构特别敏感。 虽然RANSAC等强力估计方法及其变体能取得强效性能,但它们主要依靠空间相近性和基于剩余性的标准,往往导致在相邻或复杂的原始物安排之间作出不正确的更严格的分配. 在这项工作中,我们引入了原始分解的几何认识框架,明确将局部地表特性纳入适配过程. 具体地说,我们提出一个更完善的步骤,作为能量最小化问题,并通过图剪优化来解决。 我们的提法综合了几何前科,例如正常的一致性,使选择更可靠,超出了纯粹基于残余的标准。 这种方法自然适用于单模型估计和多模型分解. 通过利用超出分点后残留的几何信息,我们的方法减少了错误的更强传播并稳定了参数估计. 关于合成和真实数据集的实验显示,与最先进的基于RANSAC的方法相比,几何精度、稳健度、噪声和出声率以及汇合效率持续提高。

articles.title: Hard Vision, Easy Vision: What GPT-6 Astra Reveals Across Computer Vision
articles.content: Frontier general-purpose systems are rapidly expanding beyond visual understanding into capabilities traditionally handled by dedicated computer-vision models. As these capabilities expand, a central question for the computer-vision community is how far this reach extends, and what remains hard. We evaluate GPT-6 Astra alongside five frontier general-purpose AI systems across 34 capabilities and 55 benchmarks spanning nine areas of computer vision. We compare their performance with dedicated models and humans where suitable references are available. Astra demonstrates broad visual capability, with substantial gains over other frontier systems in visual and spatial reasoning and several forms of structured prediction. Across the state-of-the-art systems, a consistent pattern emerges. Capabilities involving semantic interpretation, reasoning, and object-centric prediction increasingly approach or reach available reference levels. In contrast, larger gaps remain when tasks require metric geometric accuracy, faithful reconstruction, temporally consistent dense prediction, or specialized fine-grained visual knowledge. Additional reasoning and specialist tools close selected gaps, but their benefits vary across capabilities. These results map a changing landscape of computer vision in which increasingly sophisticated visual tasks are accessible through a general-purpose interface, while precise and fidelity-sensitive perception remains an important frontier.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 硬视线 Easy Vision: What GPT-6 Astra Reveals 横跨计算机视野
articles.content_zh: 前沿通用系统正在迅速扩展,超越视觉理解,发展到传统上由专用计算机视觉模型处理的能力。 随着这些能力的扩大,计算机-视觉界的一个核心问题是,这一覆盖范围能延伸到多远,还有哪些仍然很困难。 我们评价GPT-6 Astra与5个前沿通用AI系统,这些系统具有34个能力和55个基准,涉及9个计算机视野领域。 我们比较他们的性能 与专门的模型 和人类 有合适的参考。 Astra展现出广泛的视觉能力,与其他前沿系统相比,在视觉和空间推理以及几种有条理的预测形式上都取得了巨大进步. 在最先进的系统中,出现了一种一贯的模式。 涉及语义解释、推理和以物体为中心的预测的能力日益接近或达到现有的参考水平。 相比之下,当任务需要度量几何精确度、忠实重建、时间上一致的密集预测或专门精细的视觉知识时,差距仍然较大。 其他推理和专家工具弥补了某些差距,但其好处因能力而异。 这些成果描绘了不断变化的计算机视觉景观,其中越来越复杂的视觉任务可以通过通用界面获得,而准确而忠心的感知仍然是一个重要的前沿.

articles.title: Lagrangian--Hamiltonian Flows for Video Prediction and Image Generation: A Symplectic Perspective
articles.content: We introduce LHFM, a geometric framework for learning image dynamics. Drawing on structures central to classical mechanics, symplectic geometry, and geometric quantization, LHFM represents each image as an exact Lagrangian graph and models its evolution through image-dependent Hamiltonian flows, which yield a transport--source parameterization of image velocities. Our primary application is deterministic video prediction: LHFM-V is a recurrent model that advances frames by integrating predicted transport and source fields, and achieves the lowest reported FLOP count among the compared recurrent models with similar prediction accuracy. The image variant, LHFM-I, shows that the same construction is compatible with flow matching: in a matched experiment, it attains a lower FID than the flow-matching baseline.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 拉格朗吉安-哈米尔通语流用于视频预测和图像生成:一个症状视角
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍LHFM, 一个学习图像动态的几何框架。 LHFM取而代之的是古典力学的核心结构,相声几何和几何化等,它代表了每个图像作为精确的拉格朗日图,并通过依赖图像的汉密尔顿流来模型其演化,这产生了图像速度的可迁移-源参数化. 我们的主要应用是确定性视频预测:LHFM-V是一种经常性模型,通过将预测的运输和源域相结合来推进帧,并在具有类似预测准确性的比较经常性模型中实现所报告的FLOP计数最低. 图像变体LHFM-I显示相同的构造与流量匹配是相容的:在匹配的实验中,它实现了比流量匹配基线更低的FID.

articles.title: Mind the RefGAP: Correcting Reference Attention in Diffusion-Based Visual Editing
articles.content: Reference-guided diffusion editors struggle to faithfully reproduce user-provided references. We identify a potential bottleneck in diffusion editors: many methods provide limited reference-attention allocation. For example, in LoomVideo, edit-region queries assign less than 1% of their attention mass to the reference. We introduce RefGAP, a training-free correction that determines logit-offset magnitudes online at each layer from the reference-attention mass measured during the forward pass. Positive offsets to reference logits strengthen reference usage by edit-region queries, while negative offsets for keep-region queries limit reference-induced changes outside the edit. Two global coefficients control the correction; they are selected once on validation data from four development diffusion editors and held fixed. Across seven diffusion-based image/video editors, RefGAP improves identity fidelity in head swapping and face swapping. RefGAP achieves a fidelity-preservation trade-off comparable to separately tuned constant edit-side biases, without per-approach strength sweeps. Additional experiments on virtual try-on and background replacement evaluate transfer beyond identity editing.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 注意RefGAP:纠正基于传播的视觉编辑中对参考的注意
articles.content_zh: 参考指导的传播编辑者努力忠实地复制用户提供的参考资料。 我们找出传播编辑器中潜在的瓶颈:许多方法提供的参考资料分配有限。 例如,在"LoomVideo"中,编辑-区域查询为引用分配的注意力质量不到1%. 我们引入了RefGAP,这是一种免费的训练校正,它从前行时测量的参考值质量中确定每层在线的对数抵消分量. 引用日志的正偏移通过编辑-区域查询加强引用使用,而保留-区域查询的负偏移则限制编辑外由引用引起的变化. 两个全球系数可以控制校正;它们从四个开发传播编辑器的验证数据中选取一次,并被固定。 通过7个基于传播的图像/视频编辑,RefGAP改进了头部互换和面相互换中的身份忠诚度. FRIGAP实现忠心-保护取舍,与单独调制的恒定编辑-侧偏差相当,不逐一进行强度扫描. 关于虚拟尝试和背景替换的其他实验,评价转移超越了身份编辑.

articles.title: DynaTokens: Teaching Dynamics to Camera-Controlled Video Models at Test Time
articles.content: Video generation must account for two sources of motion, one induced by the observer's camera path and the other caused by scene dynamics. An ideal camera-controlled video model should account for both motions: let users move the camera while evolving the scene dynamics. While current models handle camera-induced motion well in static settings, they struggle for dynamic scenes: objects are static, move incorrectly, or degrade in generation quality. We introduce DynaTokens, a lightweight set of learnable scene-specific tokens that teach dynamics to an existing camera-controlled world model. Our method is motivated by a simple asymmetry between the two sources of motion: whereas camera motion affects the generated view globally, object dynamics are spatially localized. Through cross-attention, DynaTokens trains the learnable tokens from a few example trajectories for a scene while keeping the base model frozen, and enables dynamics under new query camera paths. DynaTokens achieves a better simultaneous dynamics-camera tradeoff on VBench2 and WorldScore evaluations than LoRA, block finetuning, and specialized trainable-layer baselines. Analyses of token attention, ablations, and motion temporality suggest that matching the trainable interface to the structure of the learning target is important for effective adaptation. Project website: https://glab-caltech.github.io/dynatokens/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DynaTokens: 在测试时间向相机控制视频模型教授动态
articles.content_zh: 视频生成必须说明两个运动源,一个是由观察者的相机路径所诱导,另一个是由场景动态所引发. 一个理想的相机控制视频模型应该兼顾这两个动作:让用户在演化场景动态时移动相机. 虽然目前的模型在静态环境下处理相机引起的运动井,但是它们为动态场景而挣扎:物体是静态的,移动不正确,或者在生成质量上会退化. 我们介绍了DynaTokens, 一套轻量级的可学习的场景特异性标志, 教给现有的相机控制的世界模型。 我们的方法的动机是两个运动源之间的简单不对称:相机运动影响全球生成的视野,而物体动力学则在空间上局部化. 通过交叉注意,DynaTokens从几个实例的轨迹中为一个场景训练出可学习的符号,同时使基模型保持了被冻结,并在新的查询相机路径下实现动态. 与LORA相比,DynaTokens在V Bench2和WorldScore评价上实现了更好的同时动态相机取舍,区块微调,专业可训练级基线. 对象征性的注意度,活化度,运动时间性的分析表明,使可训练接口与学习目标的结构相匹配,对于有效的适应非常重要. 项目网站:https://glab-caltech.github.io/dynatokens/ 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-21.

articles.title: FlowTool: Controlling Tool Parameter in Image Retouching via Flow Matching
articles.content: Tool-based image editing (image retouching) is commonly formulated with autoregressive multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that sequentially generate reasoning, tool selections, and parameter values. In this work, we present a novel approach to tool-based image editing by framing the task as a flow matching problem. We introduce FlowTool, a framework that directly models the distribution of high-quality tool parameters conditioned on the input image and user instruction using conditional rectified flow. FlowTool combines a vision-language model backbone for multimodal understanding with a Diffusion Transformer parameter generator that transforms Gaussian noise into an editing plan. We train FlowTool with a two-stage supervised flow-matching curriculum, followed by reward-based post-training. Across MMArt-Bench, FlowTool-Eval, ArtEdit-Bench, and MIT-Adobe5K, FlowTool achieves significantly stronger reference-based performance than specialized MLLM editing agents and proprietary MLLMs, while remaining competitive with proprietary models under reference-free evaluation. Moreover, FlowTool significantly improves inference efficiency, reducing latency by at least $50\times$ while requiring nearly $2\times$ less memory than the compared baselines. These results demonstrate that tool-based image editing can be effectively modeled as conditional generation over structured continuous editing parameters, without autoregressive reasoning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FlowTool: 图像中通过Flow匹配进行回触的控制工具参数
articles.content_zh: 基于工具的图像编辑(image retouching)通常由自旋式多式大语言模型(MLLMs)来制定,这些模型相继生成推理,工具选择和参数值. 在这部作品中,我们提出了一种基于工具的图像编辑的新办法,将任务设定为流量匹配问题. 我们引入了"流程工具"(FlowTool),这个框架直接模拟了以输入图像和用户指令为条件的高质量工具参数的分布,使用有条件的校正流程. 流动 工具结合了用于多模式理解的视觉语言模型主干线和将高斯噪音转化为编辑计划的分散变形器参数生成器. 我们用两个阶段的有监督的流量匹配课程来训练"流出"(FlowToole),然后是基于奖励的后培训. 横跨MMArt-Bench、FlowTool-Eval、ArtEdit-Bench和MIT-Adobe5K、Flow 与专业的MLLM编辑代理和专有的MLLMs相比,工具实现了显著的更强的基于参考的性能,同时仍然与无参考评价的专有模式相竞争. 此外,流动 工具能显著地提高推论效率,将暂时性至少减少50\times$,同时需要的内存比比较基线少了近2\times$. 这些结果表明,基于工具的图像编辑可以有效地被建模为条件生成而不是结构化的连续编辑参数,而无需自旋推理.

articles.title: Many Eyes, One World: Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction from Mixed Cameras
articles.content: Real-world capture is heterogeneous: perspective, fisheye, and $360^\circ$ panoramic images can coexist within a single reconstruction task, yet most feed-forward 3D reconstruction models assume perspective imagery and a uniform input representation. Recent models handling several camera types are either informed of the camera type for each view or reconstruct one image pair at a time. No single-pass method reconstructs mixed-camera tuples containing full panoramas from images alone. We present MEOW, a feed-forward system that jointly reconstructs metric pointmaps and camera poses from one N-view tuple mixing perspective, fisheye and full-panorama images, in a single forward pass from images alone: no calibration, distortion parameters, camera-type labels or poses are supplied for any view. Our guiding design philosophy is to treat heterogeneous-camera reconstruction as a data-adaptation problem rather than an architectural redesign. MEOW retains a perspective-pretrained backbone and learns heterogeneous cameras entirely from a procedural data engine, which renders each scene across a continuous manifold of camera models with exact rays and depth, and certifies covisibility for every camera-sampled training tuple. Trained on synthetic tuples only, MEOW transfers zero-shot to real captures: on heterogeneous 2D3DS tuples it achieves 79.9 mAA@30 against 53.8 for Wid3R given the camera type of every view; on our laser-scanned mixed-camera benchmark it registers every four-view mixed tuple with 79.4 AUC@30. The data engine, benchmark, and complete evaluation pipeline will be released.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Many Eyes, One World: Feed-Forward 3D 从混合相机重建
articles.content_zh: 真实世界的捕捉是多种多样的:视角、鱼眼和360-Circ$全景图像可以在一项单一的重建任务中共存,然而大多数向导的3D重建模型假设视角图像和统一的输入表示。 最近处理多款相机类型的模型要么被告知每个视图的相机类型,要么一次重建一对相机. 没有一种单相通方法可以重建混合相机图案,其中包含仅由图像产生的全全景. 我们提出MEOW,这是一个向导系统,它从一个N-视图的Tuple混合视角、鱼眼和全外观图像中,用一个单从图像中传出的一个单向后传:不为任何视图提供校正、扭曲参数、相机类型的标签或外观。 我们的指导设计理念是将多相相机重建视为数据适应问题,而不是建筑重新设计。 MEOW保留了透视预置主干线,完全从程序数据引擎中学习出多相相机,使每个场景都跨越有精确射线和深度的连续多相机模型,并证明每个相机取样的训练Tuple的可视性. MEOW只接受合成拖拉机的训练,将零射入实际捕获:在多相异的2D3DS拖拉机上,由于每道视线的相机类型,它能达到79.9 mAA@30,而Wid3R则达到53.8;在我们激光扫描的混合相机基准上,它以79.4 AUC@30记录了每道四视混合拖拉机。 将发布数据引擎、基准和完整的评价程序。

articles.title: Verifiable Visual Rewards Transfer from Synthetic Scenes to Natural Prompts
articles.content: Precise instruction following in image generation, such as satisfying object counts and spatial relations, remains an open challenge at least in part because it is learned using unreliable reward models such as object detectors and vision-language models. We introduce Verifiable Visual Rewards (VVR), the first framework for programmatically verifiable image rewards, and show that training on it generalizes to natural prompts. Each VVR task is a scene of geometric objects and relations among them, from which we derive both the prompt and a deterministic verifier, so tasks can be generated in any number and at any chosen complexity. We release VVRBench, with 10,000 tasks over 32 constraint types, and VVRBench-Challenge, with 720 more complex tasks; the strongest model we evaluate---GPT-Image-2.5---solves 21.4% of VVRBench-Challenge. Using VVR scores as rewards for reinforcement learning (RLVVR) raises the accuracy of Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium on VVRBench from 2.8% to 28.3% and demonstrates consistent easy-to-hard generalization. These gains extend to out-of-domain benchmarks, and mixing VVR into existing objectives further improves overall performance and human preference, motivating the adoption of VVR into standard image generation post-training recipes.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 可验证的视觉奖励 从合成场景到自然提示
articles.content_zh: 在图像生成中遵循的精确指示,如满足对象计数和空间关系,至少部分地仍然是一个公开的挑战,因为它是使用不可靠的奖励模型如对象探测器和视觉语言模型来学习的. 我们引入了可验证的视觉奖赏(VVR),这是方案可验证图像奖赏的第一个框架,并显示关于它的培训可以概括为自然提示。 每个VVR任务都是几何对象和它们之间的关系的场景,我们从中得出了即时和决定性的验证符,因此任务可以任意数量和任意选择的复杂性生成. 发布VVRBench,任务超过32个约束类型,VVRBench-Challenge,任务更复杂720个;最强的模型我们评价--GPT-Image-2.5--溶解21.4%的VVRBench-Challenge. 以VVR分数作为强化学习(RLVVR)的奖励,将VVRBench上的稳定分化3.5中分数的精度从2.8%提高到28.3%,并表现出了一贯的易硬通化. 这些收益扩展到领域外基准,将VVR与现有目标相混合,进一步提高了整体性能和人类偏好,促使VVR被采用为标准图像生成后培训配方.

articles.title: RT-Super: Learning Tumor Segmentation from Longitudinal Images and Reports
articles.content: Multi-tumor segmentation is important for early cancer detection and allows radiologists to visualize, verify, and understand AI predictions. However, tumor segmentation masks are expensive, time-consuming, and unavailable for many tumor types in public data. Instead, hospitals have vast, readily available data that can guide segmentation: radiology reports, longitudinal images, and multi-phase images. We use this readily available data to substitute for tumor masks in training AI for tumor segmentation. To this end, we propose a new architecture, RT-Super. It has a teacher network, which analyzes the patient's longitudinal images and reports to create high-quality tumor masks. These masks train a student network, which sees a single image and no report. At inference, when longitudinal images and reports are unavailable, we use the student. RT-Super uses a new CNN-Transformer architecture and novel Consistency Losses that exploit tumor location consistency across longitudinal images. We train RT-Super to segment esophagus, uterus and spleen tumors, which have few or no public masks. Even without training masks, RT-Super can segment these tumors and surpass public AI models. Overall, we demonstrate that learning from longitudinal images, multi-phase images, and reports can overcome mask scarcity and advance multi-cancer detection and segmentation. Code: https://github.com/MrGiovanni/RT-Super
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RT-Super: 从纵向图像和报告中学习肿瘤
articles.content_zh: 多肿瘤分解对于早期的癌症检测很重要,可以使放射科医生可以直观,验证并理解AI预测. 然而,肿瘤分解口罩费用昂贵,耗时多,公共数据中许多类型的肿瘤都找不到. 相反,医院拥有大量现成的数据,可以指导分解:放射学报告、纵向图像和多相图像。 我们利用这个现成的数据 来代替肿瘤口罩 在训练AI的肿瘤分解。 为此,我们提出一个新的架构——RT-Super. 它有一个教师网络,分析患者的纵向图像和报告,以创造出高质量的肿瘤口罩. 这些口罩训练了一个学生网络,它看到一个单一的形象,没有报道. 推论,当没有纵向图像和报告时,我们使用学生。 RT-Super使用新的CNN-Transformer架构和小说"一致性损失"(Consistency Losses),利用纵向图像的肿瘤位置一致性. 我们训练RT-Super来分解食道,子宫和脾脏肿瘤,它们很少或没有公共口罩. 即使没有训练口罩,RT-Super也能分解出这些肿瘤并超越公共AI模型. 总体而言,我们表明,从纵向图像、多相图像和报告中学习,可以克服遮掩的稀缺性并推进多癌症检测和分化。 代码:https://github.com/Mr.Giovanni/RT-Super

articles.title: EvolvingAvatar: Interactive 3D Head Generation That Adapts as Conversations Unfold
articles.content: Interactive 3D head generation requires coordinated speaking and listening motion that responds to an evolving conversation. Existing generators use incoming observations as context but keep their parameters fixed, leaving conversational patterns unused as a learning signal. We introduce EvolvingAvatar, a causal generator that uses test-time training to adapt to user face video and dyadic audio during interaction. Its dyadic context prediction objective provides a self-supervised learning signal from audiovisual context without target motion labels at test time. Persistent fast weights accumulate these updates within each conversation to guide motion generation, while transient jaw adaptation responds to current audiovisual context. Predicted speech activity controls how persistent adaptation guides motion. We also introduce InterHead-Bench, a unified 455.95-hour benchmark built from single-view and dual-view conversation videos. Experiments show improved conversational motion statistics over strong baselines. On the hardest out-of-distribution split, generation improves as conversations unfold, reducing mismatch with recorded user-avatar expression statistics by up to 11.1% from the first interval.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EvolutionAvatar: 交互式 三维头代 这适应为对话
articles.content_zh: 互动的3D头生成需要协调的演讲和倾听动作,以响应不断发展的对话. 已存在的发电机使用入来观测作为上下文,但保持参数固定,使对话模式被作为学习信号而未被使用. 我们引入了EvolvingAvatar,这是一个因果生成器,它使用测试时间训练来适应用户在互动过程中的面相视频和dyadic音频. 它的dyadic上下文预测目标提供了一个自控学习信号,来自视听上下文,测试时没有目标运动标签. 持续的快分量在每次对话中累积这些更新以引导运动生成,而瞬时下巴的适应则响应了当前的视听环境. 预测的语音活动控制了持久性的适应运动。 我们还引入了Interhead-Bench,这是由单视和双视对话视频所建立的统一455.95小时基准. 实验显示,在强基线的基础上,对话运动统计有所改善。 在最困难的分出分出时,生成随着对话的展开而改善,与记录的用户-avatar表达式统计的不匹配率从第一个间隔降低至11.1%。

articles.title: Remote Sensing Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting via Depth Image-Based Rendering
articles.content: Remote sensing novel view synthesis under sparse observations remains challenging due to insufficient geometric constraints and limited cross-view supervision. Existing Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods are prone to overfitting and face challenges of depth ambiguities, missing cross-view information, and insufficient constraints in under-observed regions. To address these challenges, we propose DIBR-GS, a neural Gaussian Splatting framework that exploits Depth Image-Based Rendering (DIBR) to generate pseudo views for cross-view consistency supervision. Specifically, reliable geometric initialization is constructed by aligning monocular depth priors with sparse SfM reconstruction, and cross-view appearance priors are incorporated into neural Gaussian representations to enhance appearance modeling under sparse observations. Furthermore, we introduce a progressive DIBR-based pseudo-view supervision strategy to provide additional geometric and appearance constraints, enabling more complete reconstruction of weakly observed regions. In addition, a height-constrained anchor growth strategy is designed to suppress unreasonable Gaussian expansion. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance over existing approaches when training with only 3 input views. Compared with the previous best-performing method, it improves PSNR by 6.83 dB, with relative gains of 14\% in SSIM and 60\% in LPIPS, while maintaining competitive computational efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/kanehub/DIBR-GS
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过深度图像渲染来进行遥感 Sparse-View 3D高斯平板
articles.content_zh: 由于几何限制不足和交叉视图监督有限,在稀少的观测下进行遥感新视角合成仍然具有挑战性。 现有的神经辐射场(NERF)和3D高斯电镀(3DGS)方法容易过度适应并面临深度模糊,缺少交叉视图信息,观测不足地区制约不足等挑战. 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议DIBR-GS,一个神经高斯电镀框架,利用深度图像渲染(DIBR)生成伪观点来进行交叉视图一致性监督. 具体地说,可靠的几何初始化是通过将单相深度前缀与稀疏的SfM重建相接来构建的,而交叉视图外观前缀被融入到神经高斯表达中,以在稀疏的观测下增强外观模型. 此外,我们采用了基于DIBR的渐进式伪观监督战略,以提供额外的几何和外观限制,从而能够更彻底地重建观察薄弱的区域。 此外,还设计了高压锚增长策略来抑制高斯大陆不合理的扩张. 实验表明,当培训只有3个投入意见时,拟议方法的绩效优于现有方法。 相较于之前的最好表现方法,它改进了PSNR 6.83 dB,在SSIM和LPIPS的相对增益分别为14\%和60\%,同时保持了竞争性的计算效率. 我们的代码见https://github.com/kanehub/DIBR-GS。

articles.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Multi-Turn Image Editing
articles.content: Instruction-based image editing has achieved strong performance in single-turn settings, yet practical editing is often iterative, with each instruction applied to the output of the previous turn. We find that existing editing models degrade rapidly under recursive editing and attribute this failure to a train-test mismatch in the conditioning distribution: models are trained on clean source images but must repeatedly condition on their own imperfect outputs at inference time. To address this, we propose MT-OPSD, an on-policy self-distillation framework that trains the model on self-generated conditioning states with editing supervision from a clean-conditioned teacher, without requiring multi-turn annotations. We further introduce LME-Bench, a benchmark of 100 ten-turn editing sessions for evaluating long-horizon robustness. Experiments across three editing backbones show that MT-OPSD substantially improves long-horizon editing success and reduces multi-turn collapse while largely preserving single-turn editing quality.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多回合图像编辑的自定义
articles.content_zh: 基于指令的图像编辑在单回合设置中取得了强劲的性能,然而实用的编辑经常是迭接的,每个指令都应用于上一个回合的输出. 我们发现,现有的编辑模型在回溯性编辑下会迅速降解,并将这种失败归因于调节分配中的列车测试不匹配:模型是经过清洁源图像培训的,但在推论时必须反复附加其自身不完善输出的条件. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出MT-OPSD(MT-OPSD),这是一个关于政策性的自我消化框架,在自制调制状态上对模型进行训练,由一位有清洁条件的教师进行编辑监督,而不需要多回合说明. 我们进一步采用了LME-Bench,这是100个十轮编辑会议的基准,用于评估长距离稳健性。 跨越三个编辑主干线的实验显示,MT-OPSD大幅度地提高了长视编辑的成功度并减少了多转倒闭,同时在很大程度上保持了单转编辑的质量.

articles.title: Simultaneous Translation between Sign Languages
articles.content: Deaf and hard-of-hearing (DHH) signers cannot converse in real time across different sign languages today: existing sign-to-sign translation systems run offline, requiring the full source clip before any target sign is emitted. Live use cases - e.g. broadcast interpretation and two-way video calls - instead demand simultaneous output, while the source signer is still signing. We present, to our knowledge, the first simultaneous sign-to-sign (S2S) translation system, with two wait-k regimes: test-time wait-k inference applied directly to a full-sentence model, and a trained wait-k model via stochastic multi-path supervision. We further introduce ca-Stream-AL, a computation-aware latency metric for streaming output. Averaged across six S2S directions on both a smaller human-verified test set and a larger synthetic S2S corpus, our streaming system achieves a 38% ca-Stream-AL reduction while staying within a 9% DTW-PA-MPJPE increase and a 2.1 BLEU-4 drop compared to the full-sentence baseline. A word-order case study probes how the streaming model handles word order mismatch between different sign languages - a consequence of simultaneous translation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 同时翻译手语
articles.content_zh: 今天,聋人和听力困难的(DHH)签名者无法实时跨越不同的手语:现有的签名对签名翻译系统会运行出线,在发射任何目标标志之前需要完整的源剪接. 现场使用案例——例如广播口译和双向视频通话——相反要求同时输出,而源签名器仍在签名. 据我们所知,我们提出了第一个同时的签名到签名(S2S)翻译系统,该系统有两个等克制度:测试时间等克推论直接应用到一个完全判决模式;一个经过培训的等克模型通过斯多克多路径监督. 我们进一步引入了ca-Stream-AL,这是用于流出输出的有计算意识的延迟度的度量. 平均在6个S2S方向上,一个较小的经人验证的测试机组和一个较大的合成S2S程序组上,我们的流线系统在保持9%的DTW-PA-MPJPE增长范围内,实现了38%的Ca-Stream-AL下降,与全判刑基线相比,BLEU-4下降2.1个. 一个词序案例研究探究流出模型如何处理不同手语之间的词序不匹配——这是同声翻译的结果.

articles.title: ReSS: Residual-Restoring Sparse Attention for 3D Vision Transformers
articles.content: 3D vision transformers such as VGGT predict camera poses and scene geometry from multi-view images in a single forward pass, but their global attention over all concatenated view tokens dominates computation as the number of views grows. To reduce this cost, SparseVGGT and HeSS sparsify attention at the block level, and both retain blocks with high attention probability. However, we observe that attention probability poorly predicts how much the model's behavior actually changes when a block is removed, and we show that this mismatch is why performance collapses as sparsity increases. In this paper, we propose ReSS (ReSidual-ReStoring Sparse Attention), which recasts block selection from a problem of maximizing the retained attention mass to one of minimizing the drift that sparsification leaves in the residual stream. We introduce a drift score that quantifies how much each block shifts the residual, and, since the drift of a drop set depends on the directions of the contribution vectors rather than on their magnitudes alone, an iterative residual restoration procedure that refines the drop set as a whole. Across three backbones and five datasets, ReSS preserves dense performance better than prior methods at matched sparsity. Two further results support drift as the quantity that governs the cost of sparsification: maximizing drift degrades performance faster than random selection, and plotted against realized drift instead of sparsity, all methods fall approximately onto a single curve. Code is available at https://github.com/libary753/ReSS.

articles.title_zh: ReSS: 三维视野变换器的剩余恢复分解注意
articles.content_zh: VGGT等3D视觉变相器预测相机姿势和场景几何,从多视图图像中取而代之的是单向前传,但是随着视图数量的增加,其全局关注于所有凸起的视图符号上占据了计算优势. 为了降低这一成本,SparseVGGT和HeSS sparers在区块层面将注意力分解出来,两者都保留了高度关注概率的区块. 然而,我们观察到,关注概率差,无法预测当一个块被移除时,模型的行为会实际改变多少,我们显示,这种不匹配是性能随着痉挛增加而崩溃的原因. 在本文中,我们提出ReSS(ReSidual-ReStoring Sparse Region),它将块选择从一个将所保留注意力质量最大化的问题重塑为将溅射在残余溪流所留下的漂移最小化的问题. 我们引入了漂移分数,以量化每个区块将剩余部分转移多少,而且,由于投放物的漂移取决于投放物矢量的方向,而不是仅仅取决于其体积,因此一个迭代地剩余还原程序可以将投放物整体地完善. 在3个主干站和5个数据集中,ReSS比以前在相匹配的相配相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接 还有两项结果支持漂移作为控制斯波化成本的数量:使漂移最大化比随机选择更快地降解性能,并针对已实现的漂移而非斯波化进行规划,所有方法都大约倒入一个单一曲线上. 代码见https://github.com/libary753/ReSS.

articles.title: What Paired Evaluations Reveal under Visual Perturbations
articles.content: Robustness evaluation must examine diverse visual perturbations, while benchmarks cover only some real-world conditions and physical testing is costly. Paired evaluations link clean and perturbed predictions for the same image, capturing changes in correctness, confidence, and acceptance beyond aggregate accuracy. We investigate how this image correspondence supports two needs in robustness evaluation: interpreting paired evaluation results and prioritizing samples for physical testing. To interpret paired evaluation results, we fix both sets of prediction records and vary their correspondence within each class. We prove that classwise correct-correct counts give the same sharp bounds on lost acceptance and mean true-class probability decrease among retained-correct inputs as any feasible five-state refinement. Distinguishing persistent from changed wrong answers can further constrain accepted-error transitions, while shared correspondence can establish policy orderings left unresolved by separate cost intervals. To prioritize samples for physical testing, we retain each image's synthetic responses and rank clean-correct images by their mean true-class probability under corruption. Across 44 classifiers, testing the highest-risk 20% finds 67% and 45% of failures under mild screen and print recaptures, versus 58% and 36% for clean confidence and 60% and 37% for an equal-size natural-transformation average. With both probability averaging and an A3Rank scoring adaptation, the tested corruption set yields higher mean failure recall than the natural-transform set; differences between scores depend on the source and budget. Together, these findings show that the value of correspondence depends on the evaluation objective: classwise counts suffice for specified reliability bounds, while image-specific synthetic responses improve the allocation of physical tests within the evaluated pool.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在视觉扰动下有什么值得评价的
articles.content_zh: 强健性评价必须检查各种视觉扰动,而基准只涵盖一些现实世界的条件,物理测试费用高昂. Paired评价将同一图像的清洁和扰动预测联系起来,记录正确性、信心和接受率的变化,超出总准确度。 我们调查了这种图像对应如何支持强性评价的两个需要:解释配对的评价结果和优先抽样进行物理测试。 为了解释配对的评价结果,我们修复了两套预测记录,并更改了每一类中的对应关系。 我们证明,类正确正确计数给损失的验收提供了同样的锐度界限,并且使保留正确计数输入中真实级概率下降,这与任何可行的五态改进相同。 将持续错误的答案与改变错误的答案区分开来,会进一步限制被接受的-过错的过渡,而共享的函文则会通过单独的成本间隔来建立未解决的政策订单. 为了将样本优先用于物理测试,我们保留了每个图像的合成反应,并以其平均真实级的概率来将干净的正确图像排入腐败下. 在44名分类人员中,对风险最高的20%的测试发现,在温和的屏幕和印刷品回收中,有67%和45%的故障,而清洁置信率分别为58%和36%,同样大小的自然变形率平均为60%和37%。 由于概率平均值和A3Rank评分调整,经测试的腐败组合产生的平均失败率高于自然变换组合;得分之间的差异取决于来源和预算。 这些调查结果共同表明,函证的价值取决于评价目标:分类计数足以满足特定可靠性极限,而图像特异性合成反应则能改善被评价池内物理测试的配置.

articles.title: Less Is More: Genetic Frame Selection for Efficient Novel View Synthesis
articles.content: Feed-forward novel view synthesis reconstructs a scene from many input images in a single forward pass, yet more views do not necessarily improve performance: redundant or poorly chosen frames increase computational cost and may degrade reconstruction quality. We address the problem of selecting, from an already captured sequence, a fixed-size subset of input views that is most informative for reconstructing specified target viewpoints. We propose a render-free view selector that scores candidate frames based on three complementary criteria: target-view coverage, measured against observed frames that stand in for the targets, redundancy with previously selected views, and image sharpness. A lightweight scoring network then selects the most informative frames without rendering, reconstruction, or per-scene optimization at inference time. To train the selector, we distill an expensive offline search procedure in which a genetic algorithm identifies high-quality subsets by directly optimizing reconstruction performance on training scenes. The selector learns to reproduce these choices from geometric and image-level features alone. Across six datasets and multiple input budgets, our method consistently outperforms both geometric and reconstruction-aware view-selection baselines while incurring significantly lower selection costs than reconstruction-based alternatives. Moreover, carefully selected subsets can outperform feed-forward reconstruction from the full input sequence. The learned selector generalizes across diverse reconstruction paradigms (feed-forward, 3D Gaussian Splatting, and NeRF), to object-targeted reconstruction and to a cross-capture setting in which the target views come from a separate acquisition pass. More broadly, our results indicate that explicitly reasoning about target relevance and inter-view redundancy is a fundamental factor in efficient scene reconstruction.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Less Is More: 高效小说视图合成的基因框架选择
articles.content_zh: Feed-forward小说取景合成从单个前传中从许多输入图像中重建出一幕,然而更多的取景不一定能改善性能:冗余或选取不当的帧会提高计算成本并可能降低重建质量. 我们处理从已经捕获的序列中选择一个固定大小的一组输入视图的问题,这些视图对于重建指定的目标观点最有信息性。 我们建议一个自由视图选择器,根据三个补充标准对候选框架进行评分:目标-视图覆盖度,对照标的观测到的框架进行衡量,与先前选定的观点相重复,图像清晰度。 轻量级评分网络然后选择信息最丰富的帧,不进行渲染,重建,也不在推论时间进行人均场景优化. 为了训练选取者,我们提炼出一个昂贵的离线搜索程序,其中基因算法通过直接优化训练场景上的重建性能来识别出高质量的子集. 选取者仅从几何和图像级别特征中学习再现这些选择. 在6个数据集和多个投入预算中,我们的方法始终比几何和对重建有敏感认识的取景基线要好,同时,选择费用大大低于基于重建的替代办法。 此外,仔细挑选的子集可以从完整的输入序列中超越给料前重建. 学会的选取者概括了不同的重建范式(feed-forward, 3D Gaussian Splateting, 和NERF),用于目标明确的重建,以及交叉捕捉的设定,其中目标观点来自单独的获取口令. 更广泛地说,我们的结果表明,明确说明目标的相关性和视线重复性是有效现场重建的一个基本因素。

articles.title: EdgeVLN: Runtime-Aware Deployment Ready Quantized Vision Language Navigation Model
articles.content: Vision-language navigation (VLN) models perform well but target compute-rich platforms, limiting deployment on memory- and power-constrained robotic edge devices. Compression alone does not establish whether a VLN model fits the memory, latency, and energy budgets of an edge platform while preserving navigation behavior. We introduce EdgeVLN, a runtime-aware, deployment-ready quantized VLN model that closes this gap. EdgeVLN combines a quantized StreamVLN model with Latent Trajectory Termination Extractor (LATTE), a lightweight causal transformer that improves real-time stopping by predicting a Stop Action verifier rank. Both execute through our llama.cpp VLN driver, which reconstructs streaming context and prunes memory tokens on-board. We characterize a pretrained StreamVLN backbone across weight quantization from 8 to 2 bits and multiple inference runtimes to identify a feasible operating point. LATTE reuses backbone hidden states within the budget freed by quantization, requiring neither a second vision encoder nor an additional backbone forward pass. We evaluate six backbone precisions and seven candidate stop heads on BF16 and IQ4 NL across all 1,839 R2R VLN-CE val-unseen episodes. We measure success rate (SR) in simulation and latency, energy, and resident memory on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16 GB. LATTE achieves our highest SR, 58.02 percent on the deployed 4-bit model, exceeding the BF16 baseline with only 0.013 s additional latency per navigation step. Four-bit formats achieve nearly identical SR, but step energy varies 36.8 times by execution path. Only IQ4 NL under our VLN driver fits the board, using 11.35 GB resident memory while running 20.8 times faster and using 13.3 times less energy than storage-streamed BF16. INT2 collapses. Runtime selection, memory-token pruning, and quantization are essential for efficient edge deployment.

articles.title_zh: EdgeVLN: 运行时- 预告部署 已准备好量化的视野语言导航模型
articles.content_zh: 视觉语言导航(VLN)模型性能良好但目标计算丰富的平台,限制了对内存和动力受限的机器人边缘设备的部署. 光是压缩并不能确定VLN模型在保存通航行为的同时,是否符合边缘平台的内存,耐用性和能量预算. 我们引入了EdgeVLN, 一个运行时间感知, 部署准备量子化的VLN模型, 缩小了这一差距。 EdgeVLN将一款被量化的StreamVLN模型与Latent Trepjectory External Contractor(LATTE)结合,这是一种轻量级因子变压器,通过预测一站式动作验证器等级来改进实时停止. 两者都通过我们的 lama.cpp VLN 驱动程序执行,它重建了流上上下文并刷出机上存储符. 我们描述一个预先训练的StreamVLN主干线 跨重量从8到2位和多个推论运行时间,以确定一个可行的操作点。 LATTE在预算范围内重新使用通过量化释放的骨干隐藏状态,既不需要第二个视觉编码器,也不需要额外的骨干前行通道. 在BF16和IQ4 NL的所有1 839起R2R VLN-CE val-unseen事件上,我们评价了6起骨干精度和7起候选人截站头. 我们用一款NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16 GB测量模拟和耐用性、能量和常住记忆的成功率(SR)。 LATTE在部署的4位模型上达到了最高的SR,58.02%,超过了BF16基线,每个通航步骤只增加了0.013个通航间隔. 四位格式实现几乎相同的SR,但步能因执行路径而相差36.8倍. 我们的VLN驱动器下方只有IQ4 NL能与板相适应,使用11.35 GB常住内存,同时运行速度快于20.8倍,使用能比存储流BF16少13.3倍. INT2倒闭. 运行时间选择、内存堆积和量化对有效边缘部署至关重要。

articles.title: Revisiting Risky Tackle Detection with Vision Transformers
articles.content: This paper is a Track 2 reproducibility companion to an ICPR 2026 study on risky tackle detection in American football prac- tice videos. The original work fine-tuned a Video Vision Transformer (ViViT) on 733 clips labeled with the SATT-3 rubric. It used focal loss, Taguchi L18 augmentation, and 5-fold cross-validation. It reported risky- class recall of 0.67 and risky-class F1 of 0.59. This companion documents the released artifact and traces those numbers to specific scripts, fold out- puts, and aggregation files. The reproduced headline is run_15. It com- bines Gaussian noise with static brightness decrease and uses no rotation and no flip. Its fold-mean risky recall is 0.667 and its fold-mean risky F1 is 0.588. These values match the published headline after rounding. The ablation shows that brightness is the dominant factor. Its risky-recall main-effect range is 0.055, which is larger than the ranges for rotation, flip, and noise. Without augmentation, ViViT reaches risky recall of 0.545 and does not exceed the C3D baseline of 0.583. The raw clips show iden- tifiable student athletes, so they cannot be redistributed. The artifact provides a public sample for pipeline checks and a controlled route for full-data review.

articles.title_zh: 重新审视用变相器进行风险处理检测
articles.content_zh: 这篇论文是第2轨的可复制性伴作,作为2026年关于美国橄榄球大奖赛(英语:Football prac-tice)视频中风险盖子检测的ICPR研究的配套. 原作对标有"STAT-3"题材的733个片段上的一款视频视觉变形器(ViViT)进行了微调. 它使用了焦丢失,田口L18增强,并有5倍的交叉验证. 它报告说,风险级召回为0.67次,风险级F1为0.59次。 这个伴奏记录了释放的文物 并追踪这些数字到特定的脚本 折叠出 和汇总文件 转载头条为跑_15. 其相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相接相接相相接相接相接相接相接相接相 它的折叠-平均值风险召回为0.667,而它的折叠-平均值风险F1为0.588. 这些值与四舍五入后公布的头条相匹配. 衰减表明亮度是主导因素. 其危险召回的主要影响范围为0.055,大于自转、翻转和噪音的范围。 不增强,ViViT达到0.545的风险召回,并不超过0.583的C3D基线. 生平片段显示为"身份-可选学生运动员",因此不能重新分配. 该文物为管道检查提供了公共样本,并为全面数据审查提供了控制路线。

articles.title: WorldPlay2: Extending Real-Time Interactive World Models in Control and Horizon
articles.content: Interactive world models require responding in real time to versatile controls and maintaining long-horizon consistency. However, modeling heterogeneous controls remains difficult, while explosive contexts and unstable distillation impede achieving both long-horizon consistency and real-time responsiveness. In this paper, we present WorldPlay2, an interactive world model that couples a factorized hybrid control interface with a co-design of compressed memory and stable distillation. 1) Our factorized hybrid control interface integrates frame-aligned action control with structured semantic control that explicitly disentangles scene appearance, character identity, and dynamic semantic events, thereby facilitating effective control learning. 2) To achieve efficient long-horizon modeling, we compress historical contexts into compact memory tokens shared by the autoregressive student and the bidirectional teacher. This design enables clip-wise, memory-conditioned score evaluation instead of jointly processing an entire long rollout, substantially reducing distillation overhead. 3) We further propose Stable Forcing, which initializes the autoregressive student via a few-step strategy and leverages full-rollout replay to preserve the quality of long-horizon rollouts, ensuring robust and stable distillation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the strong generalizability of our model and its superior performance compared to existing methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: WorldPlay2:在控制和地平线上扩展实时互动世界模式
articles.content_zh: 互动的世界模式要求实时应对多功能控制,并保持长距离一致性。 然而,对各种控制进行模型化仍然很困难,而爆炸性背景和不稳定的蒸馏阻碍实现长期一致性和实时反应能力。 在本文中,我们介绍了"WorldPlay2"(WorldPlay2),这是一种互动的世界模型,将混合控制界面与压缩内存和稳定蒸馏的共设计相配. 1) 我们的元素化混合控制接口将帧相通动作控制与结构化的语义控制相融合,明确分解出场景外观,人物身份,和动态语义事件,从而促进了有效的控制学习. 2)为了实现高效的长相模型化,我们把历史背景压缩成由自发性学生和双向教师共享的紧凑记忆符号. 这种设计使得能够进行有剪接条件的内存分数评价,而不是联合处理整个长期推出,从而大大减少了蒸馏管理费。 3)我们进一步提出"稳定堡垒",通过"几步走"战略将自发后退的学生初始化,并发挥全程回放的作用来保持长相出道的质量,确保稳健而稳定的蒸馏. 广泛的实验表明,与现有方法相比,我们的模型具有很强的通俗性及其优异性能。

articles.title: Learning to Reason with Persistent Object States for Video Instance Segmentation
articles.content: Video segmentation models maintain object identities by carrying instance information across frames. Under prolonged occlusion, reappearance, or interactions between similar instances, however, an unreliable update can overwrite a valid history and cause persistent identity drift. We introduce POSReasoner, a trainable, plug-and-play framework that explicitly decides when an observation should change an object's state. Each persistent state records identity, confidence, and absence history. A sparse state-observation graph supports Propose-Verify reasoning: provisional associations are revisited using object history, predicted presence, and competition among identities. The verified decisions determine whether to retain, update, reactivate, or suppress each state, while a learned gate controls the evidence written back to memory. Only verified transitions update the persistent state used in subsequent frames. POSReasoner uses standard video annotations and keeps the base model frozen, enabling integration with diverse VOS and VIS architectures. Experiments across long-term VOS and VIS benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong baselines, with the largest gains under occlusion and object reappearance.

articles.title_zh: 与长期目标国学习视频事件分解的理由
articles.content_zh: 视频分解模型通过跨帧携带实例信息来保持对象身份. 然而,在长期隔离、重新出现或类似情况之间的相互作用下,不可靠的更新可以覆盖一个有效的历史,并造成持续的身份漂移。 我们引入了POSReasoner,一个可被训练,插接和游戏的框架,明确决定一个观测应何时改变对象的状态. 每个持续的国家都记录着身份、信心和缺失的历史。 一个稀少的国家观察图支持Proposition-Verify推理:利用对象历史、预测的存在和身份之间的竞争来重新审视临时联系。 经核实的决定决定是保留,更新,重新激活,还是压制每个状态,而一个有学识的门控制了被写回内存的证据. 只有经过验证的过渡更新了后续框架中使用的持久性状态. POSReasoner使用标准视频说明并保持了基础模型被冻结,使得能够与多种VOS和VIS架构相融合. 跨长期VOS和VIS基准的实验显示,在强基线方面,不断改进,在隔离和物体再现方面收益最大。

articles.title: Look Before You Judge: Training-Free Region Mining for Grounded and Explainable Deepfake Detection
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can explain deepfake verdicts in natural language, but such explanations are not necessarily visually grounded in the visual evidence underlying the prediction. A model may describe plausible artifacts inferred from language priors rather than from image evidence. Existing grounding methods improve visual reliance through decoding or attention interventions, but they generally strengthen grounding over the entire image, making them ill-suited for forensic artifacts that are subtle, spatially localized, and image-dependent. We propose Look Before You Judge, a training-free framework that formulates explainable deepfake detection as a sequential evidence acquisition process. Instead of directly predicting image authenticity from holistic visual reasoning, our framework first identifies image-specific candidate evidence regions by contrasting the MLLM's decoder-to-visual attention between an original image and its Gaussian-blurred counterpart. The identified regions are then inspected individually, and the resulting local evidence is integrated with the global image context before reaching a final verdict. The framework operates without manipulation masks, external forensic models, or parameter updates, making it directly applicable to off-the-shelf MLLMs. Across five open-source MLLMs on TriDF and MMTD-Set, our framework improves detection accuracy by up to 12.8%, reduces CHAIR by up to 33.4% and hallucination rate by up to 21.3%, and outperforms representative training-free decoding and attention methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在你法官面前看看:无训练区采矿以进行地上和可解释的深假探测
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)可以用自然语言解释深假判断,但这种解释不一定以预测背后的视觉证据为视觉依据. 模型可以描述从语言上而不是从图像证据中推断出来的可能文物。 现有的地基方法通过解码或注意力干预改善视觉依赖性,但它们一般会加强整个图像上地基的地基,使其不适合微妙的,空间局部的和图像依赖的法证文物. 我们提议在法官面前看一看,一个无培训框架,将可解释的深假探测作为连续取证过程。 我们的框架不是直接从整体视觉推理中预测图像真实性,而是首先通过对比MLLM的解码器到视觉的注意力来识别图像特定候选证据区域,介于一个原始图像和它的高斯蓝相对应物之间. 然后对已查明的区域进行单独检查,在作出最后裁决之前,将由此产生的当地证据与全球形象结合。 该框架的运作没有操纵口罩,外部法证模型,也没有参数更新,使其直接适用于现成的MLLM. 在TriDF和MMTD-Set上的5个开源MLLMs中,我们的框架提高了检测准确度,最高达12.8%,将CHAIR降低了33.4%,将幻觉率降低了21.3%,并且超过了有代表性的无培训解码和注意方法。

articles.title: AutoRef: Harness Optimization for Agentic Multi-Reference Image Generation
articles.content: Recent image generation models can take multiple reference images as input and combine them into a new image. However, multi-reference image generation remains challenging: models may omit or duplicate subjects from the references, or produce images in which multiple subjects appear unnaturally pasted. Recent work has proposed image generation agents that combine image generation models, reasoning models, and a harness, which is an executable program that specifies how reference images are interpreted, how generation is performed, how outputs are diagnosed, and how the final image is selected. In multi-reference generation, however, references play different roles and outputs must satisfy many criteria at once, such as fidelity to each reference and the naturalness of the whole image, so many parts of the harness could be improved, from how references are processed to how outputs are diagnosed. This makes it hard to predict which changes will improve performance and by how much, and good harnesses difficult to design by hand; indeed, human-written harnesses vary widely in performance. We therefore propose AutoRef, which optimizes the harness automatically while keeping both models frozen: a coding agent iteratively rewrites the harness code. AutoRef separates the tasks whose feedback informs proposals from the tasks used to select candidates, and continues the search from a beam of the top-ranked harnesses on the selection tasks. Using this procedure, we discover AutoRef-Harness, which improves the open-weight FLUX.2 [klein] 4B from 5.72 to 7.37 on held-out four-reference tasks of the MultiBanana benchmark, matching or exceeding proprietary models including Nano Banana Pro and GPT-Image-1.5. Without re-optimization, the same harness also improves results when the generator, number of references, benchmark, evaluator, or reasoning model differs from those used in the search.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 自动参考:代理多参考图像生成的优化
articles.content_zh: 近期的图像生成模型可以取出多幅参考图像作为输入并结合到一个新的图像中. 然而,多引用图像生成仍然具有挑战性:模型可能会从引用中省略或重复主题,或者生成多个主题出现不自然粘贴的图像. 近期的工作提出了将图像生成模型,推理模型,和被带结合起来的图像生成代理,这是一种可执行的程序,它规定了参考图像如何被解释,如何进行生成,如何判断输出,以及最终图像如何被选择. 然而,在多参考生成中,参考物扮演着不同的角色,产出必须同时满足许多标准,如对每个参考物的忠诚度和整个图像的自然性,因此从参考物的处理到对产出的判断,可以改进许多部分. 这使得很难预测哪些变化会提高性能,以及用多少,多少,和多少的好用具都难以手工设计;实际上,人文用具在性能上差异很大. 因此,我们提出AutoRef,它自动地优化了吊带,同时保持了两种模型的冻结:一个编码代理迭代地重写了吊带代码. AutoRef 将反馈建议的任务与用于选择候选人的任务区分开来,并继续从一个横梁中搜索在选择任务上排名最高的绳索. 利用这一程序,我们发现AutoRef-Harness,它改进了开放重量的FLUX.2[克林]4B,从5.72起到7.37起,执行多巴拿基准的四项参考任务,匹配或超过专有模式,包括Nano Banana Pro和GPT-Image-1.5。 如果不重新优化,当生成者、参考数量、基准、评估者或推理模型与搜索中使用的模型不同时,同样的工具也会改进结果。

articles.title: ReVA: A Scene-Centric Dataset Beyond Repetition for Remote Sensing Video Question Answering
articles.content: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable advances in remote sensing. However, existing remote sensing multimodal reasoning benchmarks exhibit two critical limitations: they rely on (i) template-driven questions, which causes repetitive questions; and (ii) static images that fail to capture the inherent temporal nature of drone/UAV videos. This leaves systematic evaluation of remote sensing video reasoning largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce ReVA, a new dataset for remote sensing video question answering, designed to assess spatiotemporal, scene-centric, and reasoning-oriented capabilities of MLLMs. ReVA comprises 2,438 drone videos spanning 18 cities worldwide (580K frames) and 22K high-quality question-answer pairs across 11 challenging QA tasks. We develop a semi-automatic annotation pipeline that leverages Text LLMs and MLLMs for question-answer generation with human verification. We evaluate 23 proprietary and open-source Video LLMs on ReVA, exposing fundamental limitations of current models. These findings position ReVA as a critical benchmark toward better remote sensing video understanding and temporal reasoning capabilities for real-world deployments. Our code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/zyaocoder/ReVA

articles.title_zh: ReVA:用于遥感视频问答的场景-子数据集
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)在遥感方面取得了显著进步。 然而,现有的遥感多模式推理基准显示出两个关键的局限性:它们依赖(一)模板驱动的问题,从而引起重复性的问题;和(二)无法捕捉无人机/无人机视频固有时间性质的静态图像。 这使得对遥感视频推理的系统评价基本上没有得到探讨。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了用于遥感视频问答的新数据集ReVA,旨在评估MLLMs的瞬间、场景和以推理为导向的能力。 ReVA由2,438个无人机视频组成,覆盖了全球18个城市(580K帧),22K个高质量的问答组合,贯穿了11个挑战性QA任务. 我们开发了一个半自动注解管道,利用Text LLMs和MLLMs进行人机验证的问答生成. 我们评价了REVA上的23个专有和开源视频LLM,揭示了目前模型的根本局限性. 这些调查结果将ReVA定位为提高遥感视频理解度和实时部署时间推理能力的关键基准。 我们的代码和数据集可查阅:https://github.com/zyaocoder/ReVA。

articles.title: SolveEdit: Benchmarking Visual Problem Solving in Generative Models
articles.content: Machine intelligence is often evaluated through abstract reasoning problems, yet many real-world problems are visual, such as arranging objects, repairing layouts, or tracing routes. Solving these problems requires understanding a scene, inferring what must change to achieve a goal, and realizing that change without disturbing unrelated content. However, existing benchmarks mainly evaluate perception, generation, or explicitly specified transformations, leaving goal-driven visual problem solving underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce SolveEpIT, a benchmark for visual problem solving through scene transformation. Given an image and a goal, a model must infer a valid transformation from the request, the scene, or a visually expressed rule, then execute it while preserving unrelated content. SoLvEEDrr contains 2,728 cases. Atomic transition contracts specify required and protected conditions, enabling SoLvEScoRE to measure completion and unintended changes without a single reference output. The strongest evaluated model achieves only57.0% SolvEScore. We further introduce SolveEdiT-PLAN, a two-stage visual planner that instantiates the transition before generation. Under matched single-generation evaluation, it improves SoLvEScoRE by 9.1 points on average across three tested generators, including a gain from 57.0% to 71.6% for GPT-Image-2, without modifying the editor.

articles.title_zh: 解决方案编辑:在基因模型中制定视觉问题解决基准
articles.content_zh: 机器智能往往通过抽象推理问题来评价,然而许多现实世界的问题都是视觉问题,比如安排物体,修复布局,或者追踪路线等. 解决这些问题需要了解一个场景,推断必须改变什么才能实现一个目标,并实现这一变化而不令人不安的无关内容。 然而,现有的基准主要评价感知,生成,或明确规定的转化,留下由目标驱动的视觉问题解决不足. 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了SolveEpIT,这是通过场景变换解决视觉问题的基准. 鉴于一个图像和一个目标,一个模型必须推断出从请求,场景,或视觉表达的规则中有效的转变,然后在保留无关内容的同时执行. 苏维埃 Drr包含2,728个病例. 原子过渡合同规定了所需和保护的条件,使SoLvEScore能够在没有单一参考产出的情况下衡量完成情况和意外变化。 最强评价模型仅能实现57.0% SolvEScore. 我们进一步引入了SolveEdiT-PLAN,一个两相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 根据对应的单世代评价,它在三台被测试的发电机中平均提高了9.1分,包括GPT-Image-2的增益从57.0%提高到71.6%而无需修改编辑器.

articles.title: Sprout: Building Dynamic Memory While Reasoning for Agentic Video Understanding
articles.content: Long video understanding relies on video memory to overcome the context limits of multimodal large language models. Existing methods follow a build-then-reasoning pipeline: memory is built offline for the entire video, then reasoned over as a static source. In practice a long video is shared by several questions, and this pipeline is costly at both ends: with few questions, building memory for the whole video costs far more than answering them; with many questions, the memory is never updated, so what is learned while answering questions is lost to the next question. To alleviate these, we introduce Sprout, an agentic framework that builds memory while reasoning: a temporal tree that sprouts detailed nodes as questions are answered. The agent watches the video segment by segment at a low frame rate, stopping when the current question can be answered, remembers each segment as a coarse node of the tree, and revisits key intervals at a higher frame rate to refine the tree with the recovered details. Once a segment is recorded as text, its video input is removed from the context history, while the original video remains reachable through the video tools. The memory tree and prior question--answer records persist across questions, so the memory is online and dynamic: built from the first question onward and updated by every question thereafter. We find that replacing accumulated video inputs with textual memory substantially reduces context usage while maintaining accuracy, with slight improvements in some settings. Across benchmarks on three models, Sprout achieves competitive or improved accuracy relative to representative offline memory methods, with no upfront construction stage and lower context cost per question.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 出品:在为代理视频理解进行理性时构建动态记忆
articles.content_zh: 长时间的视频理解依赖于视频内存来克服多模式大语言模型的背景限制. 现有方法遵循一个构建时合理的管道:内存是整个视频的线下所建,然后作为静态源进行推理. 在实践中,长相的视频被几个问题所分享,而这种管道在两端都是昂贵的:问题不多,构建整个视频的内存成本远比解答成本还要高;由于许多问题,内存从未更新,所以在解答问题的同时学到的东西会输给下个问题. 为了缓解这些,我们引入了斯普鲁特(Sprout),一个在推理的同时建立记忆的代理框架:一个在回答问题时会发出详细节点的时间树. 代理以低帧速率逐段观看视频段,当当前问题能够被回答时会停止,会记得每个段是树的粗节点,会以更高的帧速率重回密钥间隔来用回收的细节来精炼树. 一段被收录为文字后,其视频输入会从上下文历史中去掉,而原视频通过视频工具仍然可以被取出. 内存树和先前的问答记录在各个问题之间一直存在,因此内存是在线和动态的:从第一个问题开始构建,并由其后每个问题更新. 我们发现,用文字内存取代所积累的视频投入,大大减少了上下文的使用,同时保持准确性,有些设置略有改进. 在三个模型的基准中,Sprout相对于有代表性的离线内存方法而言,实现了竞争性或更高的准确性,没有前期建设阶段,每个问题的背景成本也较低.

articles.title: From Scores to Samples: Elastic Forcing for Autoregressive Video Generation
articles.content: Few-step autoregressive video generation commonly relies on Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), requiring a bidirectional diffusion teacher and an online fake-score model. We instead learn the rollout distribution directly from reference videos, eliminating both score models during post-training. Our framework minimizes maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) in frozen self-supervised video representation spaces, using a hybrid Nyström--Monte Carlo estimator to balance approximation bias and sampling variance. Memory-efficient replay and gradient subsampling make this objective practical. Using the same architecture and initialization as Self-Forcing, our 1.3B model improves the VBench Total score from 83.80 to 84.64 while retaining 17 FPS. Removing auxiliary score models also enables 14B post-training on eight H200 GPUs. Beyond distillation, learning from reference videos enables the acquisition of new visual styles, semantic concepts, and spatial priors without a target-specific diffusion teacher.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从分数到样本:自动递归视频生成的弹性强制
articles.content_zh: 很少步骤自相递回式视频生成通常依赖于发行配对分化(DMD),需要双向传播教师和在线假分分数模型. 相反,我们直接从参考视频中学习推广,在培训后取消了两个分数模式。 我们的框架将冷冻自我监督的视频显示空间的最大平均差异(MMD)最小化,使用混合的Nyström-Monte Carlo估计器来平衡近似偏差和采样差异. 内存高效的回放和梯度分样让这个目标变得实用. 使用与"自强"相同的架构和初始化,我们1.3B模式改进了V Bench总分从83.80分提高到84.64分,同时保留了17个FPS. 移除辅助分数模型还允许对8个H200GPU进行14B后训练. 除了蒸馏外,从参考视频中学习还能够获取新的视觉风格,语义概念,和空间前科,而不需要一个针对特定目标的传播老师.

articles.title: AHMAD: Adaptive Hybrid Multi-task Vision Learning with Assisted Distillation for Keypoint Detection
articles.content: Generalist multitasking vision models aim to unify multiple vision tasks within a single framework, enabling more efficient and versatile learning. However, handling diverse vision tasks -- spanning dense and sparse predictions -- remains challenging due to their inherently varying output structures. In this paper, we propose AHMAD, a simple yet effective framework for generalist multitask learning that integrates different key vision tasks: semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, depth estimation, keypoint detection, and object detection. Our approach incorporates these five tasks into a unified structure: a shared encoder-decoder with several lightweight task-specific projectors. Under the multitask learning paradigm, we observed a complementary performance gain, achieving a state-of-the-art PQ of 53.1 and an mIoU of 66.5 for COCO-val panoptic and semantic segmentation, respectively. Additionally, for top-down keypoint detection, which typically incurs high computational overhead due to multiple forward passes, we introduce a knowledge distillation-based method that enables a single forward pass over the entire image, greatly improving efficiency. Ultimately, our model delivers a lightweight yet effective generalist multitask learning framework, demonstrating strong performance across five vision tasks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AHMAD: 适应性混合多任务愿景学习,辅助消化,用于关键点检测
articles.content_zh: 通用的多任务愿景模式旨在将多个愿景任务统一在一个框架内,使学习更加有效和多功能。 然而,处理各种远景任务 -- -- 跨越密集和稀少的预测 -- -- 仍然具有挑战性,因为它们固有的产出结构各不相同。 在本文中,我们提出AHMAD,这是一个简单而有效的通用多任务学习框架,它融合了不同的关键视觉任务:语义分化,实例分化,深度估计,关键点检测,以及物体检测. 我们的方法将这五个任务纳入一个统一的结构:一个共享的编码器-解码器,配有几个轻量级任务特定投影仪. 在多任务学习范式下,我们观察到一个互补的性能增益,分别实现了最先进的PQ53.1和CO-val泛光学和语义分化的mIoU66.5. 此外,自上而下的关键点检测通常由于多次前行通行证而导致高计算费,我们采用一种基于知识的分馏方法,使单一前行能穿过整个图像,大大提高效率。 归根结底,我们的模式提供了轻而易举但有效的多任务学习框架,显示出五项愿景任务的有力业绩。

articles.title: Who Is Left of Whom? Tracing Spatial Evidence and Role Binding in Relative-Position Reasoning
articles.content: High instance-level accuracy can mask inconsistencies in spatial reasoning when objects exchange positions or their roles are reversed in the query. The internal representations supporting relative-position reasoning remain poorly understood. We investigate two complementary components of this process: tracking object locations in the input and representing their query roles. Across three VLMs with visual or textual inputs and their language-model backbones, activation patching reveals a staged progression from early-layer source representations through intermediate-layer query-object representations to late-layer answer states. Targeted interventions further establish causal links along this progression: manipulating source-side representations shifts location information at query-object mentions and ultimately alters relation predictions. Beyond object-location information, we also identify a stable query-side direction associated with the roles of the two objects in the comparison. Steering along directions estimated on synthetic scenes generalizes to natural-image benchmarks, improving accuracy and both forms of paired consistency in most settings without retraining. Our findings reveal complementary components of relational reasoning across visual and textual settings and show how targeted interventions can improve the consistency of models' behavior.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 谁是谁的左翼? 追查空间证据和在相对理由上具有约束力的作用
articles.content_zh: 当物体在查询中交换位置或其作用被倒置时,高实例的精确度可以掩盖空间推理中的不一致. 支持相对立场推理的内部表述仍然不甚了解。 我们调查了这一进程的两个相辅相成的组成部分:追踪输入中的物体位置并代表其查询作用。 通过三个具有视觉或文字输入及其语言模式主干线的VLM,活化补丁揭示出从早期层源表示到中间层查询-对象表示到后层解答状态的阶段性进展. 有针对性的干预措施进一步沿这一进展建立了因果联系:在查询对象提及时操纵源侧表示移位信息,并最终改变关系预测. 除了对象位置信息之外,我们还确定了一个稳定的查询-侧方向,与比较中两个对象的作用相关. 沿着合成场景估计的方向进行指导,概括到自然图像基准,提高准确性,提高大多数情况下两种形式的对接一致性,而不进行再培训。 我们的调查结果揭示了跨视觉和文字环境的关系推理的互补组成部分,并表明有针对性的干预如何能提高模型行为的一致性。

articles.title: Handwritten Text Recognition Lives in the High-Pixel Variance Subspace
articles.content: In self-supervised pretraining for Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR), pixel reconstruction methods outperform contrastive methods, unlike in natural-image classification. We argue that this difference follows from where discriminative signal lies in pixel space: for HTR, it is concentrated in high-variance directions and largely absent from low-variance ones. This predicts that objectives preserving high-variance pixel content will transfer best. We test six SSL methods from three families (pixel-grounded MIM, JEPA, and contrastive) under matched encoder, data, and evaluation protocols on six handwriting benchmarks across five languages.
