With full labels, pixel-groundrounded SSL achieves the lowest CER on every benchmark and both frozen probes, exposes per-position character information that other families recover only through the readout, and is the only family to benefit from pretraining on real handwriting. Pixel-grounded representations are also more label efficient. Across datasets, encoder alignment with the high-variance pixel subspace predicts CER within every method. With a pretrained LLM decoder, a frozen pixel-grounded encoder is competitive with fully fine-tuned supervised baselines; full fine-tuning achieves the lowest mean CER and ranks first or second on every benchmark. These results show that the value of pixel reconstruction depends on where discriminative signal lies in the input.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 手写文字识别 生活在高像素差异子空间
articles.content_zh: 在手写文字识别(HTR)的自控预训中,像素重建方法超越了效果对比方法,与自然成像分类不同. 我们主张,这种区别源于区别信号位于像素空间的地方:对于HTR来说,它集中在高变异方向上,基本上没有出现在低变异方向上. 这预示着,保存高变相像素内容的目标会最好地转移. 我们测试三个家庭的六种SSL方法(以像素为基础的MIM、JEPA和对比性), 有了完整的标签,像素-地平面的SSL在每个基准上都实现了最低的CER和被冷冻的探测器,暴露出每个位置的字符信息,其他家庭只能通过读取恢复,也是唯一受益于真实笔迹预训的家庭. 以像素为基准的表达方式也提高了标签效率. 跨数据集,编码器与高变相像素子空间的对接预言了每一种方法内的CER. 使用预装LLM解码器,被冷冻的像素地平面编码器具有完全微调有监督的基线的竞争力;完全微调能实现最低平均CER,在每个基准上排名第一或第二. 这些结果表明,像素重建的价值取决于在输入中是否存在歧视性信号.

articles.title: W2Rep: Learning Visual Representations by Watching the World Change
articles.content: Images capture the world at one moment, whereas video reveals how it changes. Image self-supervision learns spatial structure from a single moment, while video methods commonly learn temporal relationships inside a representation computed jointly from several frames. We ask whether watching a scene change can instead improve features available from one image without sacrificing the ability to represent video. We introduce W2Rep, a masked feature-prediction framework in which an independently encoded source image participates in prediction at the same or another moment. The predictor is conditioned on visible video context, the queried location, and the signed time interval between source and target. This gives the cross-frame objective two complementary roles: the image path learns features that remain useful across time, while the video path must gather evidence that is missing from the source image. Across model scales and downstream tasks, W2Rep improves frozen and fine-tuned recognition under our comparison protocol, while joint video encoding provides further gains over frame-wise aggregation. Controlled experiments show that these gains depend on directly updating the source-image features and on using both video context and temporal displacement. Overall, change across a video can supervise a visual encoder whose representations remain useful at either image or video granularity. Code is available at~\href{https://wenooi.github.io/W2Rep}{https://wenooi.github.io/W2Rep}.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: W2Rep:通过观察世界变化学习视觉表现
articles.content_zh: 画面捕捉世界瞬间,而视频则揭示其变化. 图像自超视觉从一瞬间学习出空间结构,而视频方法则通常在从几个帧共同计算出来的表示内学习出时间关系. 我们问,观看场景变化能否改善从一个图像中可得到的特性而不牺牲代表视频的能力。 我们引入了W2Rep,一个被蒙住的特征预测框架,其中一个独立的编码源图像在同时刻或另一时刻参与预测. 预测器以可见的视频上下文,被询问位置,以及源与目标之间签名的时间间隔为条件. 这使得跨框架具有两个互补的作用:图像路径学习到一段时间内仍然有用的特性,而视频路径必须收集出出自源图像中缺失的证据. 在模型尺度和下游任务中,W2Rep根据我们的比较协议改进了冷冻和微调的识别,而联合视频编码则提供了比帧汇总的进一步收益. 受控制的实验表明,这些收益取决于直接更新源图像特征以及利用视频背景和时间转移。 总的来说,整个视频的变化可以监督一个视觉编码器,其表现在图像或视频颗粒度上仍然有用。 代码可在以下网站获取: ~\href{https://wenooi.github.io/W2Rep-}{https://wenooi.github.io/W2Rep}.

articles.title: How Far Are We from Removing the Visual Encoder? Scaling Laws for Encoder-Free Multimodal Pretraining
articles.content: Most modern multimodal large language models (MLLMs) build on a pretrained visual encoder that provides a strong visual prior. Encoder-free MLLMs instead learn visual representations directly from raw pixels, offering a simple and unified architecture, but their scaling behavior has not been systematically characterized. To fill this gap, we compare scaling laws for encoder-free and encoder-based MLLMs and report three main findings: (1) Removing the visual encoder shifts the compute-optimal allocation for the multimodal objective toward larger models, while leaving that for text nearly unchanged. (2) The two architectures exhibit nearly overlapping loss--compute frontiers on the text objective, but diverge on the multimodal objective: encoder-free models underperform at small scales yet are predicted to catch up at around $10^{22}$ FLOPs, well within practical pretraining budgets. (3) Without a visual encoder, the language model learns to take over its role via vision-specific adaptation: bidirectional interactions among visual tokens become increasingly beneficial as training compute grows, visual processing shifts toward earlier layers, and expert routing for visual tokens becomes more concentrated. Overall, our results indicate that the advantage of the visual prior provided by a pretrained encoder diminishes with scale, positioning encoder-free architectures as a promising direction for multimodal pretraining.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 我们离删除视觉编码器还有多远? 扩大无编码器多式联运预先培训的法律
articles.content_zh: 大多数现代多式大型语言模型(MLLMs)都以预先训练的视觉编码器为基础,提供强大的视觉前传. 而无编码器的MLLMs则直接从原始像素中学习视觉表现,提供了简单而统一的架构,但其缩放行为并没有被系统地定性. 为了填补这一空白,我们比较了无编码器和以编码器为基础的MLLMs的缩放法,并报告了三个主要结论: (1) 删除可视编码器后,将多式联运目标的计算-最佳分配转向更大的模式,而文本的计算-最佳分配则几乎保持不变。 (2) 两种结构在文本目标上几乎相互重叠的损失计算界限,但在多式联运目标上却存在分歧:没有编码器的模型在小尺度上表现不佳,但预计在实际培训前预算范围内可以赶上大约10-22美元。 (3)没有视觉编码器,语言模型就学会了通过视觉特异性的适应来取而代之:视觉符号之间的双向相互作用随着训练计算的增长而变得日益有益,视觉处理转向更早的地层,视觉符号的专家路由也变得更加集中. 总体而言,我们的结果表明,预先训练的编码器提供的视觉前置优势随着规模的缩小而减弱,将无编码器的架构定位为多式联运预训的有希望的方向.

articles.title: From internal representations to model improvement through prediction errors
articles.content: With limited annotation budgets, choosing which images to label determines how much a model improves. Data-selection methods that use features from a separately trained model, or scene descriptions written by vision-language models, have been successful, but those signals do not directly capture changes in the model being improved. The target model's own internal features reflect what it has learned so far and change with retraining, making them a natural cue for choosing the next training data. However, feature rarity alone does not reveal the errors that matter for performance. Here we link internal features to prediction errors and their expected impact on performance and select images for labeling and retraining without using labels for candidate images. We evaluated the method with an object detector on two datasets and two pairs of random seeds. Adding internal features improved the identification of prediction errors in 15 of 16 conditions. When performance was averaged over successive labeling rounds, the method outperformed selection based only on feature rarity in all four evaluation settings and ranked among the top two of six methods. With other conditions held fixed, performance after retraining was again higher than with rarity-based selection, even though the latter collected more errors. With longer retraining, the proposed method ranked first among six methods. These results suggest that linking a model's internal features to its errors and their effects on performance may help select training images that improve performance, thereby allowing the model's current state to guide which images are labeled next.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从内部表述到模型改进和预测错误
articles.content_zh: 使用有限的注释预算,选择要给哪些图像贴标签,决定一个模型的改进程度. 使用单独训练的模型的特性或由视觉语言模型所写的场景描述的数据选择方法已经成功,但这些信号并没有直接捕捉正在改进的模型的变化. 目标模型自身的内部特征反映了它迄今学到的知识,并随着再培训而改变,使得它成为选择下一批培训数据的自然提示. 然而,单是特征的少有性并不能揭示对业绩很重要的错误。 在这里,我们把内部特性与预测错误及其预期对性能的影响联系起来,并选择用于标签和再培训的图像,而不对候选图像使用标签。 我们在两个数据集和两对随机种子上用一个物体探测器来评估这个方法. 在16个条件中的15个条件中,增加内部特征改进了预测错误的识别. 当业绩平均于相继的标签回合时,该方法仅以所有四种评价设置中的特征稀有性为基础,在六种方法中排名前两名。 随着其他条件的固定,再培训后的业绩再次高于罕见的选择,尽管后者收集了更多的错误。 通过较长的再培训,拟议方法在六种方法中排名第一。 这些结果表明,将模型的内部特性与其出错及其对性能的影响联系起来,可能有助于选择能改善性能的训练图像,从而让模型的当前状态来指导下一步给哪些图像贴上标签.

articles.title: DiMoP: Diffusion-Driven Motion Representation Learning With Frame-Level Pseudo-Classification for Skeleton-Based Action Recognition
articles.content: Robust skeleton-based action recognition requires representations that capture a wide spectrum of motions, from subtle to moderate and strong ones. Existing methods often focus on strong motions. This paper introduces DiMoP, a masking- and diffusion-driven motion representation learning method with frame-level pseudo-classification to explicitly learn the distribution of joint motions rather than regressing deterministic coordinates, as existing methods often do. By diffusing masked joints with progressive noise and denoising them conditioned on visible joints, DiMoP learns through controllable noising and denoising processes, enabling uniform learning of weak, moderate, and strong dynamics. To enable the masking-based generative diffusion learning with a discriminative capability, a pseudo-frame classifier is proposed that enforces the learning towards sequence-consistent and temporally coherent pseudo-labels without manual annotations. Together, these strategies provide a principled mechanism for joint generative and discriminative motion modeling. DiMoP achieves state-of-the-art performance across NTU RGB+D 60/120, and PKUMMD, including a 1.1 percentage point gain over prior works on NTU RGB+D 120 with the cross-subject protocol.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DiMoP: 以框架级Pseudo- Classization为框架的传播- Driven 运动表达式学习, 用于基于 Skeleton 的动作识别
articles.content_zh: 强有力的基于骨架的行动识别要求有能够捕捉从微妙到温和和强势的广泛运动的表述. 现有方法往往侧重于强烈动议。 本文引入了DiMoP,这是一种由遮盖和扩散驱动的运动表达学习方法,其框架级为伪分类,以明确学习联合运动的分布,而不是像现有方法通常那样倒退决定坐标. 通过将口罩的关节与进步噪声分解,并用明显的关节来去Noing,DiMoP通过可控的点名和去noing过程来学习,使得能统一地学习弱,中,强的动态. 为了让基于遮掩的基因扩散学习具有歧视能力,建议采用伪框架分级法,在没有人工说明的情况下,强制学习以序列一致和时间一致的伪标签。 这些战略共同提供了一个原则性机制,用于建立联合遗传性和歧视性运动模型。 DiMoP实现全NTU RGB+D 60/120,和PKUMMD的最先进性能,包括与交叉主体协议的NTU RGB+D 120的前作相比的1.1个百分点增收.

articles.title: Revision, Not Restart: Revisable Visual Plans for Closed-Loop World-Action Models
articles.content: World-action models use predicted visual futures to condition robot actions, yet execution feedback can invalidate parts of a prediction while leaving its task structure useful. We propose Revisable Temporal Planning (RTP), which maintains the visual future as a persistent action condition and revises it after feedback. Its central mechanism is a learned revision bridge: it resumes an intermediate state saved during visual generation and adapts its continuation to current observations. Visual and action supervision connect this revision to subsequent control. Time-aware history supplies observed evidence, and an adaptive policy selects retention, bridge revision, or fresh replanning from new noise before decoding the next action. On RoboMME and RMBench, RTP achieves task-averaged success rates of 48.6% and 84.8%, respectively. Matched comparisons support learned continuation; estimated checkpoint-source and action-prefix effects are positive but less precisely resolved. These results connect feedback-driven visual-plan revision to closed-loop task performance. Project Page: https://PLACEHOLDER.github.io/RTP/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 修订,不重新启动:可修改的闭环世界行动模式视觉计划
articles.content_zh: 世界动作模型使用预测的视觉未来来作为机器人动作的条件,然而执行反馈可以使预测的部分无效,同时让其任务结构有用. 我们提议可视时间规划(RTP), 将视觉未来作为持续的行动条件, 其中心机制是一条有学识的修正桥:它恢复了视觉生成时所保存的中间状态并适应了目前的观测. 视觉和动作监督将这一修订与后续控制联系起来。 了解时间的历史提供了观察到的证据,在解码下一步行动之前,一项适应性政策从新的噪音中选择保留、修桥或重新规划。 在RoboMME和人民币上,RTP分别实现了48.6%和84.8%的任务平均成功率. 匹配的比较支持所学到的延续;估计的检查站来源和行动前缀效应是积极的,但不太确切。 这些结果将反馈驱动的可视化计划修订与闭路任务性能联系起来. 项目网页:https://PLACEHOLDER.github.io/RTP/

articles.title: An integrated geometric quantification and shape analysis framework for axillary lymph node metastasis in breast cancer patients
articles.content: Quantitative characterization of lymph node morphology is important for assessing axillary lymph node metastasis in breast cancer. However, surfaces reconstructed from computed tomography (CT) segmentation may contain geometric and topological defects that compromise subsequent analysis, while conventional shape descriptors predominantly characterize global morphology. To address these issues, we developed an integrated framework combining topology-aware surface processing with multi-resolution spherical harmonic (SH) analysis of CT-derived axillary lymph nodes. The processing pipeline produced topology-valid genus-0 surfaces with improved mesh quality, which were then represented at multiple SH degrees and characterized using 20 predefined geometric feature families. Geometric fidelity increased with SH degree, whereas predictive performance peaked at intermediate resolutions. Preferred SH degree also differed across feature families. A family-specific mixed-resolution model achieved an AUC of 0.918, compared with 0.884 for the conventional PyRadiomics Shape14 baseline, corresponding to an improvement of 0.0344. Controlled perturbation experiments showed that higher SH degrees transmitted more fine-scale geometric variation and yielded lower stability of curvature-based predictions. Representative geometric descriptors provided interpretable characterization of metastasis-associated surface morphology. Independent validation further supported the framework's transportability: label-free replication in a multicenter lymph node cohort reproduced the family-specific resolution effects, while a labeled LIDC-IDRI lung-nodule experiment reproduced the resolution-dependent relationship between SH degree and predictive performance. Altogether, the framework provides a topology-valid basis for quantitative characterization of lymph node morphology and metastasis-associated imaging phenotypes.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 乳腺癌患者的轴淋巴结元化综合几何量化和形状分析框架
articles.content_zh: 对淋巴节点形态进行定量定性,对于评估乳腺癌中轴突淋巴节点元化作用十分重要. 然而,由计算成的地形分解(CT)所重建的地表可能包含几何和地貌缺陷,这些缺陷会损害随后的分析,而常规形状描述器则主要描述全球形态特征。 为了解决这些问题,我们开发了一个综合框架,将地貌-认知地表处理与CT衍生出轴突淋巴结的多分辨率球形口腔(SH)分析结合起来。 加工管生产出地形-具有验证性能的genus-0表面,网格质量得到提高,后被以多SH度表示,并使用20个被预先定义的几何特征家族进行特征描述. 几何忠诚度随着SH程度的增加而增加,而预测性能则以中间分辨率为高峰。 首选的SH学位也因特色家庭而异. 一个针对家庭的混合分辨率模型实现了0.918的AUC,而传统的PyRadiomics shape14基线则为0.884,相应的改进为0.0344. 受控扰动实验显示,较高的SH度传递出更细尺度的几何变异,并产生较低的曲率预测稳定性. 具有代表性的几何描述法提供了元相相关地表形态的可解释特征。 独立验证进一步支持了框架的可运输性:在多中心淋巴结组中无标签复制复制了家庭特有分辨率效应,而标有标签的LIDC-IDRI肺鼻实验则复制了SH度与预测性能之间的依赖分辨率关系. 总而言之,该框架为淋巴结形态学和元相相干成像苯基的定量定性提供了地理学-验证基础.

articles.title: Automated Species Identification in Camera Trap Images for Wildlife Conservation
articles.content: Wildlife conservation involves protecting, preserving, and managing wildlife species and their habitats. With today's rapid pace of human development, climate change, and other unsustainable practices, the need for wildlife conservation has heightened. Despite significant progress in species identification using deep-learning models, significant challenges still remain in effectively detecting small animals in low-contrast trap images due to limited feature extraction capabilities. This thesis presents a novel end-to-end framework integrating a self-attention mechanism to address these limitations. The proposed architecture involves a Swin-BiFPN backbone integrated in a Faster RCNN detection network, coupled with a visual semantic extraction module driven by the LLaVA v1.5 (13B) multimodal large language model. The detection framework, capable of extracting crucial features in challenging trap images, demonstrates consistently high results and robust generalization capabilities. Furthermore, the visual semantic extraction module provides zero-shot detection capability, as well as providing valuable insights and emergent cues of the animal's behavior, further supporting the conservation effort. The MLLM evaluation was conducted using both traditional NLP metrics (precision, recall, F1, and SBERT similarity) and subjective scoring by LLM-based judges (GPT-4.1 and GROK 3.0), across five MLLMs, demonstrating the model's strong performance in visual description generation. The proposed framework improves detection accuracy across low-contrast trap images and small animals while also demonstrating zero-shot detection capability leveraging the MLLM.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 用于野生动物保护的相机陷阱图像中的自动物种识别
articles.content_zh: 保护野生动物涉及保护、保存和管理野生动物物种及其栖息地。 随着当今人类发展、气候变化和其他不可持续的做法的快速发展,保护野生动物的必要性已经增加。 尽管在利用深入学习模式识别物种方面取得了重大进展,但由于特征提取能力有限,在有效探测低孔隙捕虫笼图像中的小动物方面仍存在重大挑战。 这份论文提出了一个新的端到端框架,其中结合了一个自我关注机制,以解决这些局限性。 拟议的架构涉及将Swin-BiFPN主干网整合到更快的RCNN检测网络中,再加上由LLaVA v1.5(13B)多式联运大语言模型驱动的视觉语义提取模块. 探测框架能够在挑战性陷阱图像中提取关键特征,显示出一贯的高结果和强健的概括能力。 此外,视觉语义提取模块还提供零弹射探测能力,并提供动物行为的宝贵见解和突发提示,进一步支持保护工作. MLLM评价使用传统的NLP度量衡(精度,召回,F1和SPERT相似性)和基于LLM的法官的主观评分(GPT-4.1和GROK 3.0),在5个MLLM中进行,显示了模型在视觉描述生成中的强效性能. 拟议框架提高了低孔隙陷阱图像和小动物的探测精度,同时也展示了利用MLLM的零射线探测能力。

articles.title: When Should the Count Change? Learning State Maintenance for Causal Video Counting
articles.content: Continuous video counting requires distinguishing new observations from new objects or completed events. We introduce StaMina (State Maintenance), which learns to maintain counting state through state-conditioned updates. Recurrent visual context supports recognition; learned transitions maintain visibility, persistent identities, and completed-event records. A differentiable recurrence trains event transitions over legal paths constrained by count endpoints; visibility and association objectives train the object branch. A multi-source pipeline organizes 39.8K spatial queries and complementary event annotations into counting trajectories. On SVCBench, we evaluate counting adaptation with partial video overlap and held-out groups of linked annotations. Under prefix replay (Full) and persistent streaming (Stream), 4B and 8B models reach 41.9/36.4 and 44.9/38.2 Gaussian Precision Accuracy, respectively. The 8B model gains 10.9/3.2 points over Counting-SFT on the same queries. Matched-graph comparisons isolate phase conditioning and trajectory supervision, assessing training objectives alongside hard decisions. Online video benchmarks and count-conditioned decisions assess online understanding and task eligibility. Project Page: https://PLACEHOLDER.github.io/StaMina/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 伯爵何时会改变? 原因视频计数的学习状态维护
articles.content_zh: 连续的视频计数需要区分新观测与新对象或已完成的事件. 我们介绍Stamina(国家维护),它通过有条件的更新,学会维持计数状态。 经常性的视觉环境支持识别;学到的过渡保持可见度,持续身份,以及完成的活动记录. 一个不同的复发列车事件比法律路径的过渡受到计数终点的限制;可见度和关联目标训练对象分支. 多源管道组织39.8K空间查询和补充事件说明,进行轨迹计数. 在SVCBench上,我们评估了部分视频重叠的适应性,并保留了链接说明组。 在前缀重播(Full)和持续流播(Stream)下,4B和8B型分别达到41.9/36.4和44.9/38.2高斯精度精确度. 8B模式在相同的查询中比计数-SFT获得10.9/3.2分. 匹配的图表比较将相位调节和轨迹监督分离,评估培训目标与艰难的决定相结合。 在线视频基准和计数决定评估在线理解和任务资格. 项目网页:https://PLACEHOLDER.github.io/Stamina/

articles.title: Adaptive Safety Filtering for Frozen ACC Policies via Conformal Residual Calibration
articles.content: Frozen adaptive cruise control (ACC) policies can violate constraints when deployment dynamics differ from their training conditions. We propose residual-aware conformal action filtering (RACF), which calibrates residuals of a fixed nominal predictor and converts their quantile into an operating margin for finite-model action projection. Completed transitions update margins and candidate selection without retraining the policy. In a registered comparison over 2,400 controller-trial units, Adaptive RACF achieves 94.3% episode safety, improving by 19.9 percentage points over the evaluated nominal CBF-QP baseline while reducing projection frequency from 8.11% to 6.63%. A controlled study isolates a 4.54-point improvement from residual-margin injection. In a separate matched-hardware evaluation, Adaptive reduces mean amortized rollout time by 21.2% relative to Robust CBF-QP, with 161/180 versus 170/180 safe episodes. We characterize conditions linking one-step residual coverage to constraint satisfaction and quantify the observed safety-computation trade-offs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过正规残余校准对冷冻行政协调会政策进行适应性安全过滤
articles.content_zh: 冻结适应性巡航控制(ACC)政策在部署动态不同于其训练条件时可能违反限制。 我们建议进行残留-感知作用过滤(RACF),以校准固定名义预测器的剩余部分,并将其数量转换为有限模型动作预测的操作边距。 完成的过渡更新了幅度和候选人甄选,而不对政策进行再培训。 在2 400多个控制器-审判单元的注册比较中,适应性RACF实现了94.3%的插座安全,比评估的CBF-QP名义基线提高了19.9%,同时将预测频率从8.11%降至6.63%。 受控研究将4.54分的改进与残留边距注射隔离. 在一项单独的配对硬件评价中,适应性将比Robust CBF-QP减少21.2%的摊销时间,安全事故为161/180次,安全事故为170/180次。 我们描述将单步覆盖与限制满意程度挂钩的条件,并量化所观察到的安全计算权衡。

articles.title: Spectral Super-Resolution using Spatial-Spectral Residual Operator Networks
articles.content: Spectral super-resolution of multispectral satellite images can enable high temporal- and spatial-resolution hyperspectral satellite imagery at a modest cost, significantly increasing the applicability of hyperspectral remote sensing. This task is inherently ill-posed, making it well-suited for deep learning-based methods. In this study, the spectral super-resolution task is framed as an operator learning problem, and SSRON is proposed as a Deep Operator Network that effectively learns function-to-function mappings from downsampled spectra to continuous spectra. The model is trained to super-resolve Sentinel-2A-like multispectral imagery to EMIT images. Compared to baseline models, SSRON achieves superior performance across all metrics. The model also demonstrates zero-shot spectral super-resolution capability by predicting bands unseen during training. Furthermore, its continuous-output formulation suggests the potential to estimate spectra at finer wavelength intervals than the native sensor. These results suggest the potential of SSRON and establishes operator learning as a promising direction for spectral super-resolution.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 使用空间-特定残留操作器网络的光谱超解
articles.content_zh: 多光谱卫星图像的光谱超分辨率可以使高时空分辨率的超光谱卫星图像能够以低廉的成本进行,大大提高了超光谱遥感的应用性. 这项任务本来就没有把握,因此很适合采用深层次的学习方法。 在本研究中,光谱超分辨率任务被设定为操作员学习问题,SSRON被提议为深操作员网络,有效学习从下取样光谱到连续光谱的函数对函数映射. 该模型被训练为超解的Sentinel-2A类多光谱图像到EMIT图像. 与基线模型相比,SSRON在所有指标上都取得了优异的性能. 该模型还通过预测训练期间未见的波段来展示零射光谱超分辨率能力. 此外,其连续输出配制表明,有可能比本土传感器更细波长间隔地估计光谱。 这些结果表明SSRON的潜力,并将操作员的学习确定为光谱超分辨率的有希望的方向.

articles.title: BiMoGen: Bidirectional Motion-Text Generation via Unified Masked Discrete Diffusion
articles.content: Text-to-motion generation and motion-to-text captioning are two fundamental tasks in human motion modeling, both grounded in the same underlying motion-text correspondence. Existing unified approaches mostly rely on autoregressive modeling, which imposes a fixed generation order and is therefore poorly suited to the bidirectional dependencies between language and motion, allowing early prediction errors to persist as fixed context and degrade both temporal coherence and cross-modal consistency. Masked discrete diffusion, which models sequences through iterative bidirectional prediction, offers a natural remedy. We therefore propose BiMoGen (Bidirectional Motion-text Generation), a unified masked discrete diffusion framework for bidirectional motion-text modeling. To stabilize training, we design Decoupled Uni- and Cross-Modal Training, in which masked pretraining first establishes cross-modal correspondence on paired motion-text sequences, after which supervised fine-tuning specializes the model for bidirectional generation. Masked diffusion nonetheless introduces its own source of error, as the model is trained on clean ground-truth context yet encounters self-generated and potentially erroneous context at inference, with errors committed under heavily masked states propagating through subsequent steps. We further introduce Generation-Aware Self-Correction that exposes the model to its own predictions during training and applies correction passes at early sampling steps to revise unreliably committed tokens. Extensive experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML demonstrate competitive performance on both tasks, validating the effectiveness of the proposed two-stage training and self-correction designs. The project page is available at https://wengwanjiang.github.io/BiMoGen-Page.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: BiMoGen: 双向运动- 文本生成, 通过统一磁带散射
articles.content_zh: 文字到运动生成和运动到文字字幕是人类运动模型化的两个基本任务,两者都以相同的运动-文字对应为基础. 现有的统一方法大多依靠自递式模型,这种模型规定了固定的生成顺序,因此不适合于语言和运动之间的双向依赖,使得早期预测错误随着固定上下文而持续存在,同时降低时间一致性和跨模式一致性. 蒙面离散扩散是通过迭代双向预测来模拟序列的,它提供了一个自然的补救方法. 因此,我们提议BiMoGen(双向运动-文本生成),这是双向运动-文本建模的统一蒙面离散扩散框架。 为了稳定训练,我们设计了脱钩的Uni-和Cross-Modal训练,其中蒙面预训首先在对联的动作文字序列上建立跨模式的函授,之后监督的微调专门用于双向生成的模型. 然而,蒙面传播引入了它自己的错误来源,因为模型是经过清洁地面真实背景培训的,但在推断时却遇到自我产生和可能错误的背景,在蒙面严重的情况下所犯的错误通过后续步骤传播。 我们还引入了世代-智能自我校正,使模型在训练期间暴露在自己的预测中,并在早期采样步骤时应用校正通行证来修正不可信的承诺符. 关于HumanML3D和KIT-ML的广泛实验在这两个任务上都表现出竞争性表现,验证了拟议的两阶段培训和自我校正设计的有效性. 项目网页见https://wengwanjiang.github.io/BiMoGen-Page。

articles.title: Reduce, Then Encode: Multiscale Volumetric Reduction for 2D Foundation Models in Brain MRI
articles.content: Pretrained 2D foundation models offer a practical alternative to dedicated 3D pretraining for brain structural magnetic resonance imaging (sMRI), but their use on volumetric data requires bridging the mismatch between a 2D encoder and a 3D volume input. Existing methods typically encode slices independently and integrate their features afterwards. We introduce Multiscale Volumetric Reduction (MVR), a reduce-then-encode approach that compresses each anatomical view from (D) slices into (M << D) complementary 2D components before foundation-model encoding. MVR combines an uncentered-PCA base component derived from the original through-plane intensities with residual detail components constructed from multiscale spatial descriptors. The reduction is estimated from the training volumes without diagnostic labels or gradient-based optimization and remains fixed thereafter. The resulting components are independently processed by a shared frozen 2D foundation model and concatenated for linear probing. Under this frozen-encoder setting, MVR achieves strong overall performance across ADNI, OASIS, and ABIDE relative to the evaluated 2D-to-3D adaptation methods and simple input-reduction baselines, while also generalizing strongly from ADNI to AIBL.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 减少,然后编码:脑磁共振中2D基础模型的多尺度量子减少
articles.content_zh: 预先训练的2D基础模型为大脑结构磁共振成像(sMRI)的专用3D预训提供了一个实用的替代方案,但它们在体积数据上的使用需要弥合2D编码器和3D音量输入之间的不匹配. 现有方法通常独立地编码片段,然后整合其特征。 我们引入了Multiscale Volumetric Reduction(MVR),一种在基础模型编码前将每个解剖视图从(D)切片压缩成(M << D)互补的2D组件的还原-当时的编码方法. MVR结合了从原始的通过平面强度中衍生出来的不中心-PCA基元件和由多尺度空间描述符构建的剩余细节元件. 从没有诊断标签或梯度优化的培训量中估算的减少额,此后保持不变。 由此产生的组件通过共享的冷冻2D基模型进行独立处理,并为线性检测进行调制. 在这种冷冻编码器设置下,MVR在ADNI、OASIS和ABIDE之间相对于所评价的2D-3D适应方法和简单的输入还原基线取得了强大的总体性能,同时也有力地概括了从ADNI到AIBL.

articles.title: Rethinking Visual Token Compression for Video Large Language Models: A Simple Yet Strong Baseline
articles.content: Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding, but their inference efficiency is constrained by the large number of visual tokens produced by long videos. Recent video token compression methods increasingly introduce sophisticated strategies for token selection, pruning, and merging. This raises a fundamental question: how much of compression performance can be obtained by simply preserving the structure encoded in the visual representations? We investigate this question with SimpleCluster, a simple and training-free baseline that performs position-aware cross-frame clustering in the visual feature space and represents each cluster using the mean of its original visual features. Extensive experiments across four video understanding benchmarks and three representative Video LLMs show that SimpleCluster achieves competitive or superior performance over recent compression methods across a wide range of token retention ratios, with particularly strong robustness under extremely low retention rates (e.g., 1%). To understand this behavior, we analyze the feature space preserved by different compression methods in terms of local approximation fidelity and global coverage. The results show that stronger downstream performance is consistently associated with better preservation of the original visual feature distribution, especially its global coverage. These findings highlight feature-space preservation as an important consideration for video token compression under highly constrained token budgets. Our code is available at https://github.com/xiaozhang79/SimpleCluster.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 重新思考视频大语言的视觉托肯压缩 模式:简单而有力的基线
articles.content_zh: 视频大语言模型(Video LLMs)在视频理解方面取得了显著进展,但其推论效率受到长视频制作的大量视觉符号的限制. 近期的视频令牌压缩方法越来越多地引入了精密的令牌选择,冲刺和合并策略. 这提出了一个根本性的问题:仅仅保留视觉表现中编码的结构就可以获得多少压缩性能? 我们用SimpleCluster来调查这个问题,这是一个简单而无训练的基线,在视觉特征空间中进行位置感知的跨帧集群,并使用其原始视觉特征的平均值代表每个集群. 对四个视频理解基准和三个有代表性的视频LLMs的广泛实验表明,SimpleCluster在各种象征性保留率上比最近的压缩方法取得了竞争力或优越性,在极其低的留存率下特别强(例如1%)。 为了了解这种行为,我们从局部近似忠诚度和全球覆盖度的角度分析不同压缩方法保存的特征空间. 结果显示,更强的下游业绩一直与更好地保存原始视觉特征分布有关,特别是其全球覆盖面。 这些结论强调,保存地物空间是在高度受限的地物预算下压缩视频标志的重要考虑因素。 我们的代码可以在https://github.com/xiaozhang79/SimpleCluster上找到.

articles.title: Ego-Forge: Text and Geometric-Attention Free Exo-to-Egocentric Video Generation
articles.content: Exo-to-egocentric video generation aims to synthesize what a person sees from their own viewpoint given third-person footage and a target head trajectory. The task requires transferring appearance and semantics across large viewpoint changes while hallucinating content never observed by the exocentric camera. Existing approaches either impose additional input requirements, such as a ground-truth initial egocentric frame or multiple synchronized exocentric views, or remain limited to category-specific settings. EgoX is the first to address cross-activity and in-the-wild generalization, but requires a human-provided caption of the non-existent egocentric view at inference and introduces a computationally expensive geometry-guided attention bias that can propagate reconstruction errors and suppress textual and visual context. We therefore propose \textbf{Ego-Forge}, a caption-free and bias-free framework for exo-to-egocentric generation. It introduces \textit{Dynamic Captioning}, which derives conditioning tokens directly from the model's hidden states and adapts them to the diffusion timestep and network depth, replacing external text conditioning. By scaling training by an order of magnitude and using all available exocentric viewpoints, Ego-Forge learns cross-view correspondence implicitly and eliminates the need for geometry-guided attention, requiring only a lightweight depth prior. Ego-Forge achieves state-of-the-art performance on Ego-Exo4D, runs faster end-to-end, requires no external annotation at inference, and generalizes to in-the-wild scenes, including cases where over-reliance on geometry blocks appearance inference. Our model and source code will be made publicly available.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Ego-Forge: 文本和几何- 保留自由 Exo- to- Egocent 视频生成
articles.content_zh: Exo-to-egocent 视频生成旨在合成一个人从自己的角度所看到的第三人称镜头和靶头轨迹. 任务需要将外观和语义通过大视角变化转移,而幻觉内容则从未被外心相机观察到. 现有方法要么规定了额外的投入要求,如地面真实的初始自我中心框架或多种同步的异心观点,要么仍限于特定类别环境。 EgoX是第一个处理交叉活动与内在的泛化问题,但在推论中需要人为地提供不存在的自我中心观点的字幕,并引入了计算成本昂贵的几何指导注意力偏差,可以传播重建错误,压制文字和视觉背景. 因此,我们提议\textbf{Ego-Forge},一个面向前向以egocent一代的无标题和无偏见的框架。 它引入了\textit{Dynamic Caption},它直接从模型的隐藏状态中产生调值符,并适应扩散时间步和网络深度,取代了外部的文本调值. Ego-Forge通过将训练规模缩小到一个数量级,并使用所有可用的异心观点,隐含地学习了交叉视图对应,并消除了几何引导关注的需要,只需要在前方有轻量级深度. Ego-Forge在Ego-Exo4D上实现了最先进的性能,运行得更快的端对端,不需要外部的推断,并概括到全局的场景,包括过度依赖几何区块外观推断的情况. 我们的模型和源代码将公开。

articles.title: Generative Uncertainty as a Self-supervised Signal for Semantic Similarity Learning
articles.content: Evaluating semantic similarity between videos is a fundamental challenge in computer vision, essential for tasks ranging from out-of-distribution (OOD) detection to video retrieval. However, defining and labeling video similarity is notoriously difficult and expensive due to the complex spatio-temporal nature. In this paper, we propose a novel self-supervised approach that leverages generative uncertainty from text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models to learn semantic similarity without human annotations. Our method is based on the observation that T2V models produce consistent outputs for familiar concepts but exhibit high variance and uncertainty when prompted with specialized concepts. We utilize this behavior to identify stable semantic features within existing pretrained representations, such as VideoMAE and V-JEPA. Specifically, we learn a mask over these embeddings using purely generated data, encouraging the model to retain features that remain consistent across generations of general concepts while discarding those associated with generative noise or uncertainty. Experimental results across three key tasks demonstrate that our learned feature subspaces consistently outperform original pretrained features and baseline feature selection methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 作为语义相似性学习的自我监督信号的遗传不确定性
articles.content_zh: 评估视频之间的语义相似性是计算机视觉中的一个基本挑战,对于从发布外(OOD)检测到视频检索等一系列任务至关重要. 然而,由于复杂的时空性质,对视频的相似性进行定义和标签是众所周知的困难和昂贵的。 在本文中,我们提出了一种新的自我监督的方法,利用文本到视频(T2V)传播模型的基因不确定性,在没有人类说明的情况下学习语义相似性. 我们的方法是基于一种看法,即T2V模型为熟悉的概念产生一致的输出,但在有专门的概念时却表现出高度的差异和不确定性。 我们利用这一行为,在诸如VideoMAE和V-JEPA等现有预先训练过的表述中,找出稳定的语义特征. 具体地说,我们利用纯粹生成的数据,在这些嵌入物上学习了一个面具,鼓励该模型保留各代人之间仍然一致的一般概念的特征,同时抛弃那些与遗传噪音或不确定性有关的特征。 三项关键任务的实验结果表明,我们所学到的特征子空间的性能始终高于原先预先训练的特征和基线特征选择方法。

articles.title: TMCS: Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving
articles.content: Despite the promise of Large Language Models (LLMs) in computational chemistry, rigorous combinatorial chemistry problems remain difficult because they require quantitatively constrained molecular modification, candidate validation, and systematic revision after failed attempts. Existing tool-augmented chemical agents demonstrate useful planning and tool use, but they rarely provide a unified loop for property-driven molecular optimization and workflow-level composition. To bridge this gap, we propose Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving (TMCS), a step-by-step multi-agent framework that formalizes chemical problem solving as an interpretable, tool-augmented workflow. At the task level, specialized agents leverage external tools, few-shot trajectory memory, and structured reflection to iteratively refine solutions. At the workflow level, TMCS chains generation, understanding, editing, description, and optimization into a closed-loop pipeline. Evaluations across multiple chemical tasks demonstrate that TMCS consistently enhances chemical reasoning across both open- and closed-source base models, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TMCS: 组成化学品问题解决方案的多剂工具组合
articles.content_zh: 尽管在计算化学中大语言模型(LLMs)有希望,但严格的组合化学问题仍然很困难,因为它们需要数量限制的分子改变,候选人验证,以及在尝试失败后进行系统的修改. 现有的工具强化化学剂表现出了有益的规划和工具使用,但它们很少为属性驱动的分子优化和工作流程级组成提供一个统一的循环. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议采用工具组合的多剂方法解决组成化学品问题,这是一种逐步的多剂框架,将解决化学品问题正式化为一个可解释、工具强化的工作流程。 在任务层面,专业代理人利用外部工具,少镜头的轨迹记忆,以及结构化的反思来反复完善解决方案. 在工作流程层面,TMCS链生成,理解,编辑,描述,并优化为闭路管道. 跨多个化学任务的评价表明,TMCS在开放源码模型和封闭源码模型中不断加强化学推理,实现最先进的性能.

articles.title: RoGSW4RLD: Feed-Forward 4D Gaussian Lifting for Robot World Model Rollouts
articles.content: Action-conditioned video world models predict future robot interactions from multiple cameras, yet their outputs remain disparate video collections rather than a shared metric scene queryable across viewpoints and time. While existing 4D reconstruction methods offer a path to spatialize these predictions, independently reconstructing and merging each camera stream fails to enforce cross-view consistency. This limitation is particularly detrimental when combining moving robot-mounted cameras with fixed external views. To address this, we introduce RoGSW4RLD, a feed-forward framework that lifts synchronized multi-camera rollouts into a unified, time-queryable metric 4D Gaussian field. Rather than learning a separate geometric transition model, RoGSW4RLD directly reconstructs the visual future generated by existing world models. Its core innovation is a two-stage architecture: Stage 1 jointly forms the metric 4D field by fusing cross-view evidence with robot-specific articulated geometry and kinematics, while Stage 2 refines the field's geometry and appearance while strictly preserving the initial temporal displacements. Evaluated on 256 held-out DROID episodes, RoGSW4RLD significantly outperforms camera-wise reconstruction with calibrated merging, improving novel-view PSNR by 2.15 dB, reducing depth AbsRel by 47%, and lowering robot displacement error by 61%. These robust gains extend to action-conditioned Cosmos 3 rollouts, demonstrating that predicted video futures can be successfully translated into consistent, spatially queryable 4D metric representations.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RoGSW4RLD:种子前导 4D Gaussian 为机器人举起世界模型
articles.content_zh: 以行动为条件的视频世界模型预测未来机器人从多个相机进行互动,然而其产出仍然是不同的视频收藏,而不是一个可跨观点和跨时间的共享度量场景。 虽然现有的4D重建方法为这些预测提供了空间化的路径,但独立重建和合并每个相机流都未能强制实现交叉视图的一致性. 在将移动的机器人挂载相机与固定的外部视图相结合时,这种限制特别不利. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了RoGSW4RLD,一个向导框架,将同步多相机的推出提升到一个统一的,可时速测量的4D高斯场. RoGSW4RLD不是学习单独的几何过渡模型,而是直接重建现有世界模型产生的视觉未来. 其核心创新为两阶段架构:第1阶段通过将跨视证据与机器人特异性表达的几何学和动因学相融合,共同形成度量4D领域,而第2阶段则在严格保留初始时间位移的同时,完善了领域的几何学和外观. 评估了256个被搁置的DROID事件,RoGSW4RLD通过校准合并大大超过相机智能重建,将小说视角PSNR改进2.15 dB,深度AbsRel减少47%,将机器人移动错误降低61%. 这些扎实的成果扩展到行动条件Cosmos 3的推出,表明预测的视频未来可以成功转化为一致的,空间可查询的4D度度量表示.

articles.title: PIVOT: Pivot-Aware On Policy Self Distillation for Multi-Turn VLM Agents
articles.content: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) via Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely used for multi-turn VLM agent training, yet it suffers from zero-gradient silence on uniform failures and coarse episode-level credit assignment. While On-Policy Distillation (OPD) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) mitigate sparse rewards using hindsight information, their underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. Through controlled counterfactual rollback probes across five multi-turn VLM agent benchmarks, we reveal that performance gains in OPSD/OPD are largely driven by physical state rollback at the pivot step, defined as the first unrecoverable action without remaining step budget. However, physical state rollbacks are computationally prohibitive and infeasible in real-world environments. To bridge this gap, we present Pivot-Aware Internalized Visual On-Policy Training (PIVOT), an RL framework that internalizes pivot localization and state restoration directly into token-level parameter updates, eliminating environment rollbacks during RL training and additional skill hints at test time. PIVOT unifies three functional roles within a single architecture: a failure Analyzer non-invasively localizes the pivot step and diagnoses failure modes from visual trajectory collages and action logs; a detached Teacher re-scores failed tokens under this privileged diagnostic context; and a Student optimizes joint GRPO and confidence-gated OPD objectives. At test time, both Teacher and Analyzer branches are stripped. Evaluated on five multi-turn VLM agent tasks across cognitive grid puzzles, 3D embodied control and navigation, and generative reasoning, PIVOT achieves 0.90 overall accuracy on Qwen2.5-VL-3B (+8% over SFT+GRPO baseline and +5% over previous SOTA) and scales to 0.92 on Qwen3-VL-2B (+12% over SFT+GRPO baseline).
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PIVOT: 多回合 VLM 政策自我扭曲的关键- 警告 探员
articles.content_zh: 通过Group-Relative Political Observation(GRPO)进行可核查的强化学习(RLVR)被广泛用于多回合VLM代理培训,但对于统一的失败和粗糙的插曲级信用分配却受到零级沉默的影响. 虽然 " 政策扭曲 " (OPD)和 " 政策自我扭曲 " (OPSD)利用事后信息减轻了微薄的回报,但其基本机制仍然鲜为人知。 通过5个多回合VLM代理基准的可控反事实回滚探测器,我们揭示了OPSD/OPD的性能增益主要是由枢轴步骤的物理状态回滚驱动的,被定义为第一个没有剩余步预算的无法回收的行动. 然而,物理状态的倒退在计算上是令人望而却步的,在现实环境中是不可行的。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出了Pivot-Award内化的Visual On-Political Training(PIVOT),这是一个RL框架,将枢机本地化和状态恢复直接内化为符号级参数更新,在RL培训期间消除环境回滚,并在测试时消除额外的技能提示. PIVOT统一了单一架构内的三个功能性角色:一个故障分析器非侵入性地定位了枢轴步骤,并从视觉轨迹拼接和动作日志中诊断出故障模式;一个分离的"教师"在这个特权的诊断背景下重新计分失败符;以及一个学生优化了GPRO和信心化的OPD联合目标. 在测试时,教师和分析师的分支都被剥离。 对跨越认知网格谜题、3D内含控制和导航以及基因推理的五个多回合VLM代理任务进行了评估,PIVOT在Qun2.5-VL-3B(比SFT+GRPO基线增加8%,比以往的SOTA增加5%)和在Qun3-VL-2B(比SFT+GRPO基线增加12%)上达到0.90总精度,在Qwen3-VL-2B(比SFT+GRPO基线增加12%)上达到0.92分.

articles.title: Beyond Saying Less: Fine-Grained Alignment for Informative and Faithful Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Object hallucination remains a major challenge for large vision-language models. While off-policy preference optimization proves to be an effective solution, on-policy reinforcement learning provides a more promising direction as it directly targets a model's current failure modes. However, we find that without fine-grained reward formulation and allocation, on-policy optimization often falls into an easy shortcut: reducing hallucinations merely by saying less---making fewer valid claims. To comprehensively resolve this, we propose a fine-grained alignment framework that couples dense reward signals at the data level with precise credit assignment at the algorithmic level. Specifically, we first construct the Dense Object Presence and Absence (DOPA) dataset to address sparse annotations that prevent valid object claims from being verified and rewarded. DOPA exhaustively annotates the deterministic presence and absence of every concept across an expanded vocabulary, significantly increasing the density of reliable reward signals during on-policy rollouts. Second, we propose Subsentence-level Credit Assignment for on-Policy Optimization (SCAPO) to prevent response-level shared advantages from allowing local hallucinations to compromise all other valid outputs within the same response. By assigning credit to each subsentence independently based on its object claims, SCAPO can precisely reinforce faithful generations and penalize hallucinations. Furthermore, we leverage the resulting faithful image descriptions as auxiliary context to transfer generative gains to discriminative tasks. Experiments demonstrate that our method produces highly informative, faithful descriptions in generative tasks while yielding clear performance gains on discriminative evaluation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Beyond Saying Less:为信息化和忠实的愿景-语言模式而精心调整
articles.content_zh: 对象幻觉仍然是大型视觉语言模型的一大挑战. 虽然政策外偏好优化证明是一个有效的解决方案,但政策强化学习提供了一个更有希望的方向,因为它直接针对一个模型目前的失败模式。 然而,我们发现,如果没有精心制定和分配奖励办法,政策优化往往会变成一个容易的捷径:仅仅通过说较少提出有效的主张来减少幻觉。 为了全面解决这一问题,我们提出了一个精细的调整框架,即夫妇在数据一级密集奖励信号,在算法一级精确分配信用。 具体地说,我们首先构建了Dense对象存在和缺失(DOPA)数据集,以解决阻碍有效对象索赔得到核实和奖励的稀疏说明。 DOPA详尽地指出了在扩大的词汇中存在和缺乏每个概念的决定性因素,大大提高了在政策展开期间可靠奖励信号的密度。 第二,我们提议为政策优化分配生活津贴级信贷,以防止反应级的共同利益让当地幻觉损害同一反应中所有其他有效的产出。 SCAPO通过独立地根据对象要求给每一次次下注,可以准确地强化忠实的几代人,惩罚幻觉. 此外,我们利用由此产生的忠实图像描述作为辅助背景,将基因收益转移给歧视性任务。 实验表明,我们的方法在遗传性任务中产生了高度翔实、忠实的描述,同时在歧视性评价方面产生了明显的绩效收益。

articles.title: Scaffold Then Internalize: Representation Injection for Diffusion Transformers
articles.content: Recent representation alignment (REPA) methods accelerate diffusion transformer training by aligning projections of the transformer's hidden states with representations from pretrained visual encoders. In this work, we explore a reverse and complementary direction to REPA: rather than projecting diffusion representations into the encoder's space, we inject encoder representations into the diffusion transformer, allowing them to actively participate in the denoising process. To this end, we introduce \textit{REPresentation Injection} (REPI), a training framework based on a scaffold-to-internalization strategy, in which projected encoder representations initially serve as a temporary scaffold and are then progressively internalized by the diffusion transformer. REPI outperforms REPA across a wide range of backbones and is highly complementary to it: combining the two yields substantial gains over either alone. Notably, with only 160K training steps, REPI + REPA matches vanilla SiT trained for 7M steps, a speedup of over $43.5\times$. Code will be available at https://jeneveuxpas.github.io/REPI
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 脚手架 然后内化:扩散变形器的表示注射
articles.content_zh: 近期的表示调和方法通过将变压器隐藏状态的预测与预先训练的视觉编码器的表示进行调和,加快了传播变压器的培训. 在这项工作中,我们探索了REPA的反向和互补方向:我们不是将扩散表示投射到编码器的空间,而是在扩散变压器中注入编码表示器,让他们积极参与去诺化过程. 为此,我们引入\textit{REPresentation Injection}(REPI),这是一个基于脚手架对内化策略的训练框架,其中预测的编码器表示最初作为临时脚手架,然后被扩散变压器逐渐内化. REPI在一系列广泛的骨干部门中都优于REPA,并且对它具有高度的互补性:两者的结合,单靠两者就能产生巨大的收益。 值得注意的是,由于只有160K培训步骤,REPI + REPA 与 vanilla SiT 培训了7M级,速度超过43.5美元。 守则见https://jeneveuxpas.github.io/REPI。

articles.title: Narrow Multimodal Fine-Tuning Can Induce Emergent Misalignment
articles.content: Modern AI models are aligned through post-training to adapt them to downstream tasks. Recent work shows that fine-tuning language models on narrow tasks can induce emergent misalignment (EM), causing broadly harmful behaviors beyond the training task. However, EM has been studied almost entirely in text-only tasks, leaving its manifestation in multimodal models unclear. In this paper, we define and analyze EM in the context of vision-language models. We first induce EM via fine-tuning on narrow multimodal tasks targeting vulnerable code, careless household-object use, and conspiratorial interpretations of ordinary scenes. Across fifteen commercial and open-source models with different scales, we find that narrow multimodal fine-tuning can induce coherent and broadly misaligned behavior that transfers to unrelated tasks, including misaligned opinions, visual factual dishonesty, unsafe image generation, vulnerability to visual jailbreaks, and risky agentic actions. We further find that multimodal EM does not depend on the apparent harmfulness of training data but is sensitive to training-evaluation modality alignment. EM can arise under both supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization and can propagate through intermediate reasoning. Finally, we explore several mitigation strategies, including prompt inoculation, benign continued training, and activation-level steering, which can partially reduce EM. Overall, our findings suggest that multimodal EM reflects a behavioral shift rather than a general loss of capability, extending beyond text to the visual modality.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 窄式多式联运 Fine-Tuning Can 诱导紧急错位
articles.content_zh: 现代AI模式通过培训后调整以适应下游任务. 最近的工作表明,对狭义任务进行语言模型的微调,可诱发出现错位(EM),造成超出训练任务的广泛有害行为. 然而,EM几乎完全在文本任务中被研究,使得其在多式联运模式中的表现变得不明确. 在本文中,我们从视觉语言模型的角度定义和分析EM. 我们首先通过微调针对脆弱代码的狭隘的多式联运任务、粗心的家用物品和对普通场景的阴谋解释来诱导EM。 我们发现,在15个具有不同规模的商业和开源模型中,狭义的多式联运微调可诱发连贯和广泛的错位行为,转移给不相关的任务,包括错位观点、视觉事实上的不诚实、不可靠的图像生成、易受视觉越狱伤害以及危险的代理行为。 我们进一步发现,多式联运EM并不取决于培训数据的明显有害性,而是对培训-评价模式的协调统一十分敏感。 EM既可以在监督的微调和偏好优化下出现,也可以通过中间推理传播. 最后,我们探索了若干缓解战略,包括迅速接种、良性继续培训和激活级指导,这些可以部分减少EM。 总的来说,我们的调查结果表明,多式联运EM反映了一种行为转变,而不是普遍丧失能力,从文字延伸到视觉模式。

articles.title: Domain-adaptive Zero-Shot Image Enhancement via Locality-Constrained Diffusion Guidance
articles.content:
Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models have shown remarkable performance in unconditional image generation. In order to generate images with desired semantics, recent works have restricted the solution space by using guidance constraints in the diffusion sampling process.
  However, for image enhancement across different domains, these methods struggle to balance two main requirements: looking realistic in the target domain (photorealistic images) and preserving relevant features of the source domain, e.g., low-quality renderings or art paintings. Here, small local changes can alter the fidelity of the image completely, while large changes in other regions might be insignificant.
  We introduce LocDiff, a locality-constrained guidance method for image enhancement, which serves as a zero-shot extension to pre-trained diffusion models, ensuring the preservation of critical features during domain adaptation. In this way, we retain important local features, while allowing less critical regions to remain unconstrained and not interfere with the guidance process for relevant regions. We evaluate our method on two different domain-shift tasks: For art-to-photo translation, we apply the method in a fully zero-shot setting, preserving facial identity from paintings while generating photorealistic details. For enhancing low-quality fetal ultrasound renderings, we demonstrate zero-shot inference with auxiliary prior alignment. Here, the objective is to artificially add high-resolution characteristics and produce photorealistic ultrasound renderings, a target domain for which no ground truth distribution exists. Our experimental results demonstrate that LocDiff achieves favorable realism-faithfulness trade-offs compared to state-of-the-art methods, enabling controllable cross-domain enhancement.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 领域适应性 通过局部约束的传播引导实现零热图像增强
articles.content_zh:
排除扩散可能性 模型在无条件的图像生成中表现出显著的性能. 为了用理想的语义生成图像,近期的作品通过在扩散采样过程中使用引导约束,限制了溶液空间.
然而,对于跨越不同领域的图像增强,这些方法努力平衡两个主要要求:在目标域(图片现实主义图像)中寻找现实性,以及保留源域的相关特征,如低质渲染或艺术画. 在这里,小的局部变化可以完全改变图像的忠实性,而其他地区的较大变化可能是微不足道的.
我们引入了LocDiff,一种对图像增强进行局部约束的引导方法,它充当了对预先训练的传播模型的零镜头扩展,确保在域改造期间保存关键特征. 这样,我们保留了重要的地方特色,同时允许不太重要的地区保持不受约束,不干涉相关地区的指导进程. 我们评价我们的方法有两个不同的域间转移任务: 对于艺术到摄影的翻译,我们在完全零镜头的设定中应用了这个方法,从绘画中保留了面部特征,同时产生光现实化的细节. 为了增强低质量的胎儿超声波渲染,我们用辅助前置对齐法来演示零射推论. 在此,目标是人为地添加高分辨率特性,并产生光现实性的超声波渲染,这个目标域不存在地面真理分布. 我们的实验结果显示,LocDiff与最先进的方法相比,实现了有利的现实主义-信仰取舍,使得可以控制的跨域增强.

articles.title: $λ$-JEPA Spectral Anti-Collapse Regularization for Self-Supervised Learning
articles.content: Joint-embedding self-supervised learning typically combines an invariance objective across augmented views with additional mechanisms to prevent representational collapse. These objectives are often applied after a projection head, while downstream tasks use the backbone representation before the projector. We find that this mismatch does not necessarily prevent dimensional collapse in the backbone, which can retain low effective rank and potentially limit downstream transfer. To address this, we introduce SACReg, a spectral anti-collapse regularizer motivated by an analysis of $λ$-balance, which captures the relative scale of weight matrices across layers. In a two-layer linear network, we show that (i) $λ$-balance prevents collapse, and (ii) our regularizer applied to the backbone induces $λ$-balance. In the nonlinear case, this regularizer leads to anti-collapse as well and, in realistic architectures on ImageNet100, it empirically increases the representations' ranks. We apply SACReg to JEPA and propose $λ$-JEPA, which improves over LeJEPA and VISReg on ImageNet-1k classification and in average linear-probe transfer performance across eight downstream image datasets. On video self-supervised learning, $λ$-JEPA improves over LeVJEPA and V-JEPA 2 on the Something-Something-v2 and Kinetics-400 benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/berkerdemirel/lambda-jepa.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: JEPA 自我监督学习的光谱反组合规范化
articles.content_zh: 联合组合的自我监督学习通常将各种扩大观点的不一致性目标与防止代表性崩溃的其他机制结合起来。 这些目标往往在投影头之后应用,而下游任务则在投影仪之前使用骨干代表. 我们发现,这种不匹配并不一定能防止骨干中的维度崩溃,这可以保持低效级别,并可能限制下游转移. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了SACReg,一种光谱抗缩合调节剂,其动力是对美元平衡的分析,它捕捉了跨层重量矩阵的相对尺度. 在双层线性网络中,我们显示:(一) 美元余额防止崩溃,(二) 我们的调节器应用于骨干中,诱导美元余额。 在非线性情况下,这种常态器也会导致反折叠,在ImageNet100上的现实架构中,它经验性地增加了代表的排名. 我们在JEPA中应用了SACReg, 并提议用美元-JEPA, 在视频自我监督的学习方面,美元-JEPA比LeVJEPA和V-JEPA2在Something-v2和Kinetics-400基准上有所改进。 代码见https://github.com/berkerdemirel/lambda-jepa。

articles.title: Evaluating Hierarchy-Aware Deep Learning for the Recognition of Tironian Notes
articles.content: Tironian notes are generally regarded as the first Latin shorthand system and are notable for their large, fine-grained symbol inventory. Their high visual similarity and large class set make manual reading time-consuming, leaving manuscripts that contain Tironian notes inaccessible to many researchers. Automatic recognition is also challenging because models must distinguish subtle differences in stroke shape and sign structure while realistic training data remain scarce. However, standard flat classifiers do not explicitly use visual or structural relations between related signs. This paper investigates whether structural relationships between Tironian notes can support automatic recognition. We use the Supertextus Notarum Tironianarum (SNT) by Martin Hellmann, which provides idealized sign forms and a hierarchical organization of Tironian notes. We compare flat ResNet18, ConvNeXt, Shifted Window Transformer (Swin), and Vision Transformer (ViT) classifiers with Hierarchical Deep Convolutional Neural Network (HD-CNN)-style coarse-to-fine models and hierarchy-aware routing models based on visual class cleaning and similarity-based re-clustering. The models are evaluated on handwritten samples and manuscript-domain samples from Vergilius Turonensis, both with and without limited few-shot adaptation to the manuscript domain. The results show that the relative performance of flat and hierarchical models depends on adaptation. On Vergilius Turonensis, HD-CNN achieves the best non-adapted Top-1 result with 45.43%, while flat classification reaches the best Top-1 result after few-shot adaptation with 82.09%. Overall, the results indicate that hierarchical structure can support Tironian note recognition, especially under non-adapted conditions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 评估等级- 了解深层学习以确认提罗尼亚笔记
articles.content_zh: 蒂罗尼亚笔记一般被认为是第一个拉丁语的短手系统,并因其庞大,精细的符号目录而显著. 他们的高度视觉相似性和大型类集使得手动读取耗时,使得包含提罗尼亚笔记的手稿被许多研究者无法访问. 自动识别也具有挑战性,因为模型必须区分中风形状和标志结构的细微差异,而现实的训练数据仍然很少. 然而,标准平面分类器没有明确使用相关标志之间的视觉或结构关系. 本文调查了蒂罗尼亚笔记之间的结构关系能否支持自动识别. 我们使用马丁·赫尔曼(英语:Martin Hellmann)的Supertextus Notarum Tironianarum(英语:SNT),它提供了理想化的标志形式和Tironian笔记的等级组织. 我们比较了平坦的ResNet18,ConvNEXt,Shifted Window Transformer(Swin),和ViT的Visual Transformer(ViT)分类器与等级化的深层神经网络(HD-CNN)风格的粗细到精细的模型以及基于视觉类清洁和类似性重排的分层意识的路由模型. 这些模型在Vergilius Turonensis的手写样本和手稿域标本上得到评价,无论是否对手稿领域进行了有限的几发修改。 结果显示,平面模型和等级模型的相对性能取决于适应. 在Vergilius Turonensis上,HD-CNN以45.43%的成绩实现了最佳的非适应性Top-1,而扁平分类在经过了几发82.09%的适应后达到了最佳Top-1. 总体来看,结果显示等级结构可以支持Tironian音符的识别,特别是在不适应的条件下.

articles.title: eval-unlearn: Benchmarking unlearning in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
articles.content: The rising number of concept unlearning techniques for text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models has produced a fragmented evaluation landscape. Methods are assessed under heterogeneous experimental conditions making principled cross-method comparison difficult. We present eval-unlearn, an open-source Python library providing a unified, reproducible benchmarking framework for concept unlearning in T2I Diffusion models. eval-unlearn integrates twelve published unlearning techniques spanning fine-tuning, closed-form model editing, and inference-time intervention, alongside nine complementary evaluation metrics covering erasure efficacy, adversarial robustness, generative quality, and concept retention. Its plugin architecture lets third-party techniques and metrics self-register without modifying the core framework, and its streaming, batched pipeline supports efficient evaluation of both standard NSFW concepts and arbitrary general concepts. As a further contribution, we release a public leaderboard on HuggingFace along with an interactive tool for real-time evaluation of unlearning techniques. The leaderboard compares nudity concept erasure case study across all twelve techniques, exposing significant accuracy-quality trade-offs that are obscured by heterogeneous evaluation. eval-unlearn is released under the MIT license; the package, code, leaderboard, and documentation are all available at https://eval-unlearn.readthedocs.io.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: eval-unlearn:文本到图像传播模型中未学习的基准
articles.content_zh: 越来越多的文字到图像(T2I)传播模型的概念不学习技术产生了一种零散的评价景观。 在不同的实验条件下对方法进行评估,使原则性交叉方法比较变得困难。 我们提出eval-unlearn,一个开源的Python库,为T2I传播模型中的概念不学习提供统一,可复制的基准框架. eval-unlearn综合了12种已出版的未学习技术,包括微调、封闭式模型编辑和推论-时间干预,以及9种补充性评价衡量标准,涵盖消除震荡效果、对抗力、基因质量和概念保留。 其插件架构允许第三方技术和度量衡在不修改核心框架的情况下自行登记,其流式,批量的管道支持对标准的NSFW概念和任意的通用概念进行高效评价. 作为进一步的贡献,我们在HuggingFace上发布了一个公共领导板,以及一个实时评估未学习技术的互动工具. 领导板比较了裸体概念消除所有12种技术的案例研究,暴露了被不同评价所掩盖的重大精度质量权衡。 eval-unlearn根据麻省理工学院的许可发布;软件包,代码,头板,文档均可在https://eval-unlearn.readthedocs.io上查阅.

articles.title: Spatial Grafting: Grounding 3D Features for Flow-Matching Robot Policies
articles.content: Pretrained robot manipulation policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) or world-action models (WAMs) leave interaction-relevant metric geometry implicit. Recent breakthroughs in spatial reconstruction can supply the necessary geometry reliably, but their features describe local shape without stating where it lies with respect to the robot. How best to deliver these features to a pretrained policy remains unresolved. We propose Spatial Grafting, a versatile, lightweight spatial module that binds frozen reconstruction features to metric, robot-relative geometry. Spatial Grafting constructs metric-grounded spatial tokens and injects them into the flow-matching action expert through cross-attention, without modifying the host's perceptual pathway, so the host retains the full benefit of its pretraining. We evaluate it more broadly than any geometry-aware policy we compare against: one graft architecture, with no per-host redesign, on two VLAs and two WAMs, across four simulation benchmarks that span short-horizon manipulation, visual robustness, clutter and long-horizon mobile manipulation, and on three real-robot platforms with single- and dual-arm configurations. On RoboTwin 2.0, a dual-arm manipulation benchmark, the graft improves every host across VLAs and WAMs. Grafted $π_{0.5}$ gains 11.3% and 15.6% on clean and randomized scenes, reaching 94.0% and 92.4%, above the strongest published 3D-conditioned policy, WAM4D (93.8% and 89.9%). The margin widens as the horizon lengthens: on tasks from BEHAVIOR-1K, a dual-arm mobile manipulation challenge scored by average task progress, it surpasses the 2025 challenge winner on five of six tasks,by up to 0.47 Q-score, and exceeds a map-conditioned spatial policy on average across the three tasks both report.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 空间牵引:将3D特性定位于流动匹配机器人政策
articles.content_zh: 预先经过训练的机器人操纵政策,如视觉语言-动作模型(VLA)或世界动作模型(WAMS),都留下了互动相关的度量几何隐含. 最近在空间重建方面的突破可以可靠地提供必需的几何学,但其特征描述了局部形状,而没有说明机器人的位置. 如何最好地将这些特点落实到一项经过预先培训的政策中,仍未得到解决。 我们提出空间牵引,一个多功能,轻量级的空间模块,将冷冻的重建特征与与机器人相对的几何相联. 空间牵引构造了基于公制的空间符,并通过跨心向流匹配动作专家注入,而不修改宿主的知觉路径,因此宿主保留了其预训的全部好处. 我们比我们比较的任何几何感知政策都更广义地评价它:一个重力架构,没有每台重新设计,涉及两个甚高频和两个WAM,跨越四个模拟基准,跨越短视操纵,视觉强健,杂乱和长视距移动操纵,以及三个具有单臂和双臂配置的真机器人平台. 在双臂操纵基准RoboTwin 2.0上,牵引改进了跨VLA和WAM的每个主机. 在清洁和随机的场景上收获11.3%和15.6%,达到94.0%和92.4%,高于最强公布的3D条件政策WAM4D(93.8%和89.9%). 随着地平线的延长,比值有所扩大:在BEHAVIOR-1K的任务上,双臂移动操纵挑战按平均任务进度得分,超过2025年挑战得分者在6项任务中的5项,最高达到0.47 Q分,平均超过三个任务的地图条件空间政策。

articles.title: AnswerMap: Faithful Spatial Interpretability of VLMs from Answer Posteriors
articles.content: When a VLM answers a visual query, current interpretability tools rely on text rationales, which use a mismatched modality, or on internal read-outs, which originate too early to reflect the final output and require white-box access to the model. We introduce AnswerMap, a training-free, task-agnostic, black-box visual rationale constructed from the output head. The image is cut into K row and K column bands, each shown alone to the frozen model along with the query in the format of a yes/no relevance question. The outer product of the row and column ``yes'' posteriors gives the query-conditioned spatial map. Crucially, by defining a fixed read-out R (e.g., expectation, maximum) on top of AnswerMap, we can derive continuous outputs like location natively. This bypasses the reliance on discrete text tokens for continuous-output tasks and guarantees an image-dependent answer by construction. However, a rationale can be confabulated, so we validate AnswerMap across four models and three query distributions with two tests: (a) agreement with the model's own generated point and (b) deletion of the map's region. The map lands where the model points (AUC 0.85 against 0.38 for attention), and deleting its region flips 53% of correct answers (against 19% for attention's). Beyond establishing faithfulness, we demonstrate the map's task-agnostic utility through three distinct read-outs: its maximum flags hallucinated objects without generation, its expectation localizes correctly when the model's own pointing fails, and its top-mass region, fed back as a crop, fixes half of the model's wrong answers. AnswerMap thus offers a new lens on VLM interpretability and, through its read-outs, a new output interface for visual tasks beyond text tokens.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AnswerMap:VLMs从前作Answers中忠实的空间解释性
articles.content_zh: 当一个VLM解答一个视觉查询时,当前可解释性工具依赖于文本原理,这些原理使用不匹配模式,或者依赖于内部读出,它们来源太早,无法反映最终输出,需要白盒访问模型. 我们介绍一个AnswerMap, 一个没有训练的,任务不可知的,黑盒视觉原理 从输出头构建。 图像被切成K行和K列带,每个带单独显示于被冻结的模型上,同时以是/否相关性问题的形式显示查询. 列和列的“yes”后面的外部产品给出了有查询条件的空间图。 关键是,通过在AnswerMap上定义一个固定的读出R(如期望,最大),我们可以像本地位置一样获得连续输出. 这绕过连续输出任务对离散文本符号的依赖,并通过构建保证了图像依赖的答案. 然而,可以对一个理由进行剖析,所以我们验证了AnswerMap在四个模型和三个查询分布的验证,同时进行两个测试:(a) 与模型自己生成的点达成一致;(b) 删除地图的区域. 地图将模型点数(AUC 0.85对0.38的注意)和删除的区域翻转了53%的正确答案(对注意的为19%)。 除了建立忠诚之外,我们通过三个不同的读出来展示地图的任务不可知性:它的最大旗帜幻觉的物体没有一代,它的预期值在模型自身指点失败时正确本地化,它的顶级质量区域作为作物反馈,修正了模型错误答案的一半. 答复 因此,地图提供了VLM可解释性的新镜头,并通过它的读出,为文本符号之外的视觉任务提供了一个新的输出界面.

articles.title: DrawingsDreamer: A Unified Multi-View Engineering Drawings Generation Model
articles.content: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) are essential for modern industrial Computer-Aided Design (CAD). However, existing autoregressive SVG generation models are predominantly tailored for artistic creation and struggle to maintain the rigorous geometric fidelity and cross-view spatial alignment required for engineering drawings. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{DrawingsDreamer}, a unified Large Language Model (LLM)-driven framework for multi-view vector-based engineering drawings generation. By formulating the generation of multi-view engineering drawings purely as a sequence modeling task, we eliminate the need of raster image encoders. We propose a Streamlined Representation utilizing hierarchical postfix tokenization, which guides the model to establish local geometric coordinates before assigning semantic boundaries. Optimized via a progressive task-aware curriculum schedule, \textbf{DrawingsDreamer} effectively transitions from localized structural repair to macroscopic generation in a unified model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our unified model achieves strong performance in both geometric fidelity and syntactic accuracy across diverse conditional and unconditional generation tasks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 绘画梦想:一个统一的多维工程绘画生成模型
articles.content_zh: 可缩放矢量图形(SVG)对于现代工业计算机辅助设计(CAD)至关重要. 然而,现有的自旋式SVG生成模型主要针对艺术创作和斗争,以保持工程图画所需的严格的几何忠诚度和跨视空间对齐. 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入\textbf{DrawingsDreamer},一个统一的大语言模型(LLM)驱动的框架,用于多视图矢量的工程绘图生成. 通过将多景工程图画的生成纯粹作为一个序列建模任务,我们消除了光栅图像编码器的需求. 我们提议采用分级的后缀符号化,简化表示方式,指导在划定语义边界之前建立本地几何坐标的模型。 通过渐进式任务意识课程表实现优化,\textbf{ DrawingsDreamer}在统一模式下,从局部结构修复到宏图像生成的有效过渡. 广泛的实验证明,我们的统一模型在各种有条件和无条件的生成任务中,在几何忠诚度和合成精确度两方面都取得了强大的性能.

articles.title: Beyond Selection: Token Parameterization for Extreme Visual Token Compression
articles.content: Visual-token compression is effective for improving the efficiency of vision-language models, but under extreme compression budgets, token pruning can break visual grounding while learned resamplers increase parameter count, attention cost, and training complexity. We revisit compression through a token parameterization lens, separating (i) basis transformation and structured truncation (retained subspace/compressibility) from (ii) coordinate organization (optimization and cross-modal alignment). This view yields two coupled objectives, compressibility and learnability, which we formalize as unified functionals. Guided by these objectives, we design Braco, a lightweight four-step coder that combines transform-basis truncation, input-independent basis-coordinate embeddings, budget-dependent orthogonal re-parameterization, and learned spatial residual tokens from lightweight pooling. Experiments show that Braco forms the favorable empirical accuracy-efficiency frontier under $23\times$--$64\times$ compression and remains competitive at $144\times$, reaching 95.2% accuracy while reducing prefill FLOPs by 84.2%--86.7% relative to the uncompressed upper bound. Against prior methods, Braco matches or improves accuracy while achieving up to approximately 36% end-to-end speedup and using $16.6\times$/$78.8\times$ lower compressor latency/FLOPs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Beyond Setrol: 极端视觉托肯压缩的托肯参数化
articles.content_zh: Visual-token压缩对于提高视觉语言模型的效率是有效的,但是在极端压缩预算下,信使普鲁因可以打破视觉地面,同时学习的复刻器可以增加参数计数,注意力成本,以及训练的复杂性. 我们通过符号参数化镜头重新审视压缩,将(一)基础转换和结构截断(保留亚空间/压缩)与(二)协调组织(优化和跨模式对齐)分开. 这种观点产生两个相互关联的目标,即可压缩性和可学习性,我们将其正式化为统一的功能. 在这些目标的指导下,我们设计了Braco,一种轻量级的四步码器,它结合了变换基调,输入独立基座坐标嵌入,预算依赖的正体再参数化,以及从轻量级集合中学习到的空间剩余符号. 实验表明,布拉科在23\times$-64\times$的压缩下形成了有利的经验精度效率前沿,并且仍然以144\times$的竞争力,达到95.2%的精度,同时相对于未压缩的上限将预填FLOP降低84.2%-86.7%. 与之前的方法相比,Braco匹配或提高精度,同时达到约36%的端对端速度,并使用16.6\times$/$78.8\time$ 下压缩机空档/FLOPs.

articles.title: Token-Disentangled Latent Test-Time Scaling for Vision-Language Reasoning
articles.content: Latent test-time scaling improves reasoning by refining hidden states during inference, but existing methods typically apply a single scalar reward to all editable latent tokens. For multimodal large language models, this global update ignores that generated tokens play different roles: some are sensitive to visual evidence, while others correspond to uncertain reasoning decisions. We present Token-Disentangled Latent Test-Time Scaling, an inference-time framework that makes latent refinement token-role-aware. Starting from an initial generated trajectory, we optimize a short hidden-state prefix while routing perception-side visual feedback to image-sensitive tokens and reasoning feedback to high-entropy tokens. Tokens selected by neither route are constrained by an anchor regularizer. Across both perception and reasoning benchmarks on Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3.5-8B, our method lifts macro accuracy over CoT by +2.57 and +1.51 respectively, and outperforms strong output-space test-time scaling baselines under matched decoded-candidate budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/TD-LTTS.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Token-Disentled Latent 测试-时间缩放用于视觉语言
articles.content_zh: Latet test-time缩放通过在推论中精炼隐藏状态来改进推理,但现有方法一般对所有可编辑的潜在符号适用单一的标量奖励. 对于多式联运大语言模型来说,这种全球更新忽略了生成符符的作用不同:有些对视觉证据敏感,而有些则对应不确定的推理决定. 我们提出Token-Distentled Latent Test-Time Expression,这是一种推论时间框架,它使潜在的完善具有象征作用。 从初始生成的轨迹开始,我们优化了一个短的隐藏状态前缀,同时将感知侧视觉反馈到图像敏感符号,推理反馈到高内涵符号. 两个路由选择的托肯都受锚定常态器的限制. 从对Qun2.5-VL-7B和InternVL3.5-8B的认知和推理基准来看,我们的方法分别通过+2.57和+1.51提高COT的宏观精确度,在经过解码的预算下超过强大的输出-空间测试-时间尺度基线。 代码见https://github.com/Quen-Applications/TD-LTTS.

articles.title: Generative AI-Based Data Augmentation for Oral Lesion Classification: The PhotoMOCI Dataset and Benchmark
articles.content: Early detection of oral cancer via photographic imaging presents a promising avenue for large-scale oral cavity screening. However, the development of robust deep learning models is frequently hampered by the scarcity of high-quality, annotated datasets. To address this limitation, a novel and well-curated resource, the Photographic Multi-purpose Oral Cancer Imaging (PhotoMOCI) dataset, is introduced for developing models across multiple diagnostic tasks in oral oncology. Then, a comprehensive benchmark study was conducted to investigate how various data augmentation strategies influence the performance of image classifiers. Our analysis spans different generative AI frameworks, evaluating the efficacy of traditional methods against advanced generative approaches, including Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and Diffusion Models (DMs). Additionally, we propose the Synthetic Image Filter (SIF), a mechanism to select specific samples based on two auxiliary models: Synthetic Proxy Classifier to ensure samples are representative of the target class and Synthetic Image Detector to verify they appear realistic, thereby selecting only the high-utility images that contribute to improving downstream performance. Across the evaluated datasets and classifiers, the best SIF-filtered setup improves accuracy over traditional augmentation in all cases, with gains of +1.73% and +2.35% on PhotoMOCI and +2.38% and +2.08% on KOCD for ResNet50 and ViT, respectively. Our findings reveal that while the direct application of generative data augmentation may yield performance drops, the integration of SIF, considering (i) how synthetic data looks real and (ii) how it reflects the discriminative features of the belonging class, provides a simple yet effective mechanism to filter out synthetic samples that confuse the classifier during training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 口服激素分类基于人工智能的基因数据增强:PhotoMOCI数据集和基准
articles.content_zh: 通过照相成像及早检测口腔癌,是大规模口腔检查的一个有希望的途径。 然而,由于缺少高质量、附加说明的数据集,发展强有力的深层学习模式往往受到阻碍。 为解决这一局限性,采用了摄影多用途口腔癌成像(PhotoMOCI)数据集这一新颖和精密的资源,用于在口腔肿瘤学的多个诊断任务中开发模型。 随后进行了一项综合基准研究,以调查各种数据增强战略如何影响图像分类器的性能. 我们的分析跨越不同的基因AI框架,评价传统方法相对于先进基因方法的功效,包括基因异常网络(GANs)和扩散模型(DMs). 此外,我们提议采用合成图像过滤器(SIF),这是一种基于两个辅助模型选择具体样本的机制: 合成代用分类器以确保样品能代表目标类和合成图像探测器,以验证它们看起来是现实的,从而只选择有助于改善下游性能的高功率图像. 在所有经过评价的数据集和分类器中,最好的SIF过滤设置在所有情况下都比传统的增强提高准确性,PhotoMOCI的增益分别为+1.73%和+2.35%,ResNet50和VIT的KOCD的增益分别为+2.38%和+2.08%。 我们的研究结果表明,虽然直接应用基因数据增强可能会产生性能下降,但是,考虑到(一) 合成数据的外观如何真实,(二) 如何反映归属类的歧视性特征,SIF的整合提供了一个简单而有效的机制,可以过滤出在培训期间混淆分类者的合成样品。

articles.title: SignFLIP: A Unified Model for Sign Language Translation and Generation via Stage-wise Alignment at Scale
articles.content: Sign language translation and generation share the goal of bidirectional alignment between text and sign representations. However, existing approaches either treat them as isolated tasks or are only verified on limited datasets, limiting effective modeling between modalities. In this paper, we propose SignFLIP, a unified LLM-centered framework for translation and generation. To enable bidirectional mapping between text and sign, SignFLIP adopts a symmetric architecture together with a stage-wise training strategy built on large-scale data. The shared sign--text representation is progressively refined: pre-alignment facilitates subsequent SLT, while the SLT-adapted representation further benefits SLG. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that SignFLIP shows competitive performance compared with task-specific models on both translation and generation tasks, as well as strong transferability to sign language recognition.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SignFLIP: 手语翻译和生成的统一模型, 采用分阶段对齐的缩放
articles.content_zh: 手语翻译和生成共同的目标是文本和签名表达的双向对齐. 然而,现有办法要么将它们视为孤立的任务,要么只在有限的数据集上加以核实,从而限制了不同模式之间有效的建模。 在本文中,我们提出了SignFLIP,一个统一的LLM中心框架,用于翻译和生成. 为了实现文本和符号之间的双向映射,SignFLIP采用了一个对称架构,同时采用基于大规模数据的阶段性训练策略. 共享的署名文字表示方式逐渐完善:预先调整有利于后续的SLT,而SLT调整后的表示方式则进一步有利于SLG. 对多个基准的广泛实验表明,SignFLIP在翻译和生成任务方面与任务特定模式相比,表现出了竞争性的性能,以及强大的手语识别可转移性.

articles.title: From UNI2-h to ConvNeXt-T: Lightweight Nuclei Instance Segmentation via Knowledge Distillation
articles.content: Nuclei instance segmentation is a core task in digital pathology, yet high-accuracy models rely on large vision transformer (ViT) encoders whose inference speed cannot meet real-time clinical demands. We propose a lightweight scheme that distills the UNI2-h pathology foundation model into a ConvNeXt-Tiny student (Ours-T, 34.7M parameters, 1/20 of the teacher) via output-level knowledge distillation. Ours-T achieves an mPQ of 0.519 on PanNuke (98.8% of the teacher), a zero-shot bPQ of 0.668 on MoNuSeg, and an inference speed of 634.3 img/s, requiring only 0.045 s for full-resolution 1024^2 analysis (21.8x speedup). Experiments further show that multi-scale gated convolution (MALA) yields no gain under ViT encoders, and output-level distillation alone suffices for efficient knowledge transfer.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从UNI2-h到ConvNEXt-T:通过知识扭曲进行轻量级核子分裂
articles.content_zh: 核实例分解是数字病理学中的一项核心任务,然而高精度模型依赖于大型视变器(ViT)编码器,其推论速度无法满足实时临床需求. 我们提出了一个轻量级计划,通过输出级知识蒸馏将UNI2-h病理基础模型提炼成ConvNEXt-Tiny学生(我们的T,34.7M参数,教师的1/20). Ours-T在PanNuke上实现了0.519的mPQ(占教师的98.8%),在MoNuSeg上实现了0.668的0发bPQ,推论速度为634.3 img/s,全分辨率1024^2分析只需0.045 s(21.8x加速). 实验进一步表明,在ViT编码器下,多尺度的门式演化(MALA)不会产生收益,单是输出级蒸馏就足以有效转让知识.

articles.title: ReCAT: Remember, Count, and Time: Structured Recurrent Memory for Robot Manipulation
articles.content: Memory-dependent manipulation requires robots to make decisions using information that is no longer available to their current sensors, such as recalling an earlier visual cue, tracking task progress, counting repeated events, or estimating elapsed time. We present ReCAT, a language-conditioned policy with structured recurrent memory. An instruction-conditioned encoder forms features from the current observation. A recurrent memory integrates the observation stream through Mamba-2 layers and one causal attention layer. A flow-matching Transformer decoder reads the current and the historical representation through separate cross-attention in every block. ReCAT reaches 95.3\% average success on LIBERO and 62.4\% on RMBench, with the best or tied-best result on six of nine tasks. On three real-robot tasks probing spatial recall, event counting, and interval timing, the best ReCAT variant reaches 66.7\% average success, against 8.3\% for the strongest short-history baseline. Controlled comparisons within ReCAT show that the observation encoder and every-block memory conditioning are needed for this performance. They also show that update rules developed for efficient sequence modeling behave differently as robot memory: additive updates have the highest observed success on counting and timing, and delta-rule updates on spatial recall. Project website is at https://intuitive-robots.github.io/ReCAT
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ReCAT: Remember, Count, and Time: 结构化的机器人操纵经常记忆
articles.content_zh: 依赖内存的操控需要机器人使用其当前传感器已经无法获取的信息作出决定,如回顾先前的视觉提示,跟踪任务进度,计算重复事件,或估计过去的时间. 我们提出ReCAT,一种具有语言条件的政策,具有结构化的经常性记忆。 从当前观察得到的指令性条件化编码器的特征. 一个经常性的内存通过曼巴-2层和一个因果关注层整合观测流. 一个流匹配变形器解码器通过每个区块的单独交叉注意来读取流和历史代表. ReCAT在LIBERO上取得了95.3××的平均成功,在人民币上达到了62.4××××,在9项任务中,有6项取得了最佳或捆绑的最佳成绩. 在3个真机器人任务上,探测空间召回,事件计数和间隔时间,最好的ReCAT变体达到66.7\%平均成功,而最强的短史基线则达到8.3\%. ReCAT内部的控制比较表明,这种性能需要观察编码器和每个块的内存调节. 他们还表明,为高效的序列建模而开发的更新规则行为与机器人内存不同:添加剂更新在计数和计时上观测到的成功率最高,在空间召回上三角规则更新. 项目网站见https://intuitive-robots.github.io/RECAT

articles.title: CarveMix-RC: Addressing Rare-Class Imbalance Through Lesion-Aware Synthetic Augmentation for Brain Metastasis Segmentation
articles.content: Accurate segmentation of post-treatment brain metastases is essential for treatment planning, longitudinal disease monitoring, and quantitative assessment of therapeutic response. The BraTS-MET 2026 Task 1 challenge introduces a clinically relevant segmentation problem involving four anatomically distinct tumor subregions: non-enhancing tumor core (NETC), surrounding non-enhancing FLAIR hyperintensity (SNFH), enhancing tumor (ET), and the resection cavity (RC). Among these, RC segmentation is particularly challenging because of its low prevalence, heterogeneous postoperative appearance, and lesion-wise evaluation protocol, leading conventional segmentation networks to prioritize dominant tumor classes during optimization. The proposed nnU-Net-based framework explicitly addresses RC segmentation through four complementary components: (i) RC-weighted Dice and Cross-Entropy optimization to alleviate class imbalance, (ii) anatomically consistent cavity augmentation to increase the diversity of postoperative cavity appearances, (iii) a residual encoder architecture for enhanced multi-scale feature learning, and (iv) lesion-aware morphological post-processing to suppress false-positive cavity predictions while preserving anatomically plausible structures. The framework is evaluated on the BraTS-MET 2026 Task 1 online validation benchmark. Among the evaluated configurations, the ensemble model (Residual Encoder nnU-Net + nnU-Net + RC-aware CarveMix) achieves the best performance, with lesion-wise Dice scores of 0.732, 0.752, 0.708, and 0.575 and corresponding NSD scores of 0.794, 0.798, 0.727, and 0.474 for ET, TC, WT, and RC, respectively. These experimental results show that integrating RC-aware optimization, anatomically consistent augmentation, and lesion-aware post-processing provides an effective strategy for improving rare resection cavity segmentation in post-treatment brain metastases.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CarveMix-RC:通过Lesion-Aware合成增强处理脑元化分裂的稀有类平衡
articles.content_zh: 对治疗规划、纵向疾病监测和对治疗反应进行定量评估而言,准确分解治疗后脑元化至关重要。 BRATS-MET 2026任务1挑战提出了与临床相关的分解问题,涉及四个解剖学上截然不同的肿瘤次区域:不增强肿瘤核(NETC),围绕不增强FLAIR超强度(SNFH),增强肿瘤(ET),以及分解腔(RC). 其中,RC分化因其流行率低、手术后外观各异以及损伤性评价协议而特别具有挑战性,这导致常规分化网络在优化期间优先确定主要肿瘤类别。 拟议的基于nU-Net的框架通过四个互补部分明确处理驻地协调员的分化问题:(一) 为缓解阶级不平衡而优化驻地协调员加权的Dice和交叉Entropy;(二) 在解剖学上一致的腔腔增强,以增加手术后腔外观的多样性;(三) 用于加强多尺度特征学习的残余编码器结构;(四) 损害意识形态处理后抑制假阳性腔预测,同时保留解剖上可信的结构。 该框架在BRATS-MET 2026任务1在线验证基准上进行评估. 在评价的配置中,综艺模型(Residual Encoder nnU-Net + nnU-Net + RC-aware CarveMix)取得了最佳的性能,视损害而分数分别为0.732,0.75,0.708和0.575,相应的NDD分数分别为0.794,0.798,0.727,ET,TC,WT和RC为0.474. 这些实验结果表明,整合RC-意识优化、解剖一致性增强和损伤感后处理,为改进治疗后脑元器件中罕见的剖腔分化提供了有效的战略。

articles.title: G$^3$-LoRA: Organizing Reward-Weighted Video Data with Gradient-Guided Grouped LoRA
articles.content: Post-training foundation video models on heterogeneous reward-weighted data usually assume that all data categories induce compatible updates. This assumption is fragile when categories correspond to different skills, domains, or evaluation dimensions. We study this problem in text-to-video post-training, where VBench2.0 dimensions define data buckets and an external multimodal reward pipeline assigns sample weights. We propose G$^3$-LoRA (Gradient-Guided Grouped LoRA), a data organization procedure that probes category-level gradients induced by reward-weighted video samples, removes the shared global update direction, clusters categories by residual gradient compatibility, trains group-specific LoRA experts, and consolidates them into one adapter by weight merging followed by on-policy distillation from the experts. We motivate this procedure by viewing reward-weighted flow matching as velocity-field regression: incompatible reward dimensions may prefer different denoising directions in overlapping noisy latent regions, causing shared LoRA training to average capabilities. On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers, the merged grouped adapter improves the matched VBench2.0 evaluation over the base model, a joint reward-weighted LoRA baseline, and random, semantic, and raw-gradient partitions trained with the same pipeline; an independent evaluator agrees, and on CogVideoX-2B grouping avoids the negative transfer of joint training. The gain is not uniform: merging compresses the largest specialist gains, distillation recovers part of this loss, and camera motion and several local-quality dimensions remain challenging. Together, these results suggest that gradient compatibility can serve as a practical diagnostic for organizing reward-weighted video post-training data.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: G$^3$-LORA:用渐变引导的LORA组装重视视频数据
articles.content_zh: 培训后基础关于各种奖励加权数据的视频模型通常假定所有数据类别都诱导兼容的更新。 当类别与不同的技能、领域或评价层面相对应时,这一假设是脆弱的。 我们在文字到视频的后训练中研究这个问题,其中V Bench2.0维度定义了数据桶,外部的多式联运奖励管道分配了样本权重. 我们提议采用3美元-LORA(Gradient-Guided Grouped LoRA)这一数据组织程序,对奖励加权视频样本引发的类别级梯度进行探测,取消共享的全球更新方向,通过剩余梯度兼容性实现集群类别,培训特定组的LORA专家,并按重量将其合并为一个适配器,然后由专家进行政策提炼。 我们通过将奖励加权流量匹配视为速度-场回归来推动这一程序:不相容的奖励层面可能倾向于在相互重叠的吵闹潜伏区域采取不同的调试方向,导致共同的LORA训练达到平均能力. 在Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffuses上,合并的分组适配器改进了匹配的V Bench2.0对基模的评价,联合奖励加权的LORA基线,以及随机的,语义的,和经过同一管道训练的原始的分级;独立评价者同意,在CogVideoX-2B分组上避免了联合训练的负转移. 收益并不统一:合并压缩最大的专家收益,蒸馏回收部分损失,镜头运动和几个局部质量维度仍然具有挑战性. 这些结果表明,梯度兼容性可以作为一种实用的诊断,用于组织奖励加权的视频培训后数据。

articles.title: Timeline-Bench: Evaluating Agents on Realistic Video-Editing Tasks, from Raw Footage to Final Cut
articles.content: AI agents increasingly carry out long-horizon professional work, but their evaluations rarely require a finished creative deliverable. To this end, we introduce Timeline-Bench, a benchmark of 56 real video-editing tasks, each asking an agent to turn raw production material into a finished video.
