Tasks range from selecting dialog takes and shaping interview footage into a story to cutting commercials from product shots, voiceovers and graphics. Every task provides a brief, source assets, a container and a set of tests. A task is resolved when the output passes every test. The tests check the delivery format, the content and the brief's explicit requirements, and include a quality test calibrated on 2,582 blind judgments by 43 video editors. We evaluate 16 agents that pair frontier models with coding-agent harnesses such as Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode. The best, GPT-6 Astra in Codex with curated editorial guidance, resolves only 15 of the 56 tasks (26.8%), and the average agent resolves 14.0%. Human editors prefer the reference edit in 83.5% of judgments. Most unresolved runs (562 of 771) fail only the quality test: agents perceive footage through stills and transcripts and check their renders for defects, not craft. We release the tasks, verifier and per-run results at https://timelinebench.tensortest.com.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Timeline-Bench: 真实视频编辑任务评价代理, 从原始脚步到最终剪切
articles.content_zh: AI代理越来越多地开展长视野的专业工作,但是他们的评价很少需要完成的创造性交付. 为此,我们引入了Timeline-Bench,这是56项真实视频编辑任务的基准,每个任务都要求一名代理商将原始制作材料转化为完成的视频. 任务范围从选择对话框到将访谈录像制作成故事,到从产品镜头、语音和图形中剪切广告。 每一项任务都提供简要的,源资产,一个容器和一套测试. 每次测试都会通过一个任务。 测试检查投递格式,内容和简报的明确要求,包括由43个视频编辑对2,582个盲判进行质量测试校准. 我们评估了16名特工 将前沿模型 与编码代理 诸如Codex, Claude Code 和OpenCode 等 最佳的GPT-6 Astra在Codex中带有曲解的编辑指导,只解决了56项任务中的15项(26.8%),平均代理解决率为14.0%. 人类编辑更喜欢在83.5%的判决中进行参考编辑. 大多数未解决的运行(771次中的562次)仅未能通过质量测试:特工通过静物和记录誊本看到镜头,并检查其成份是否有缺陷,而不是手工业。 我们在https://timelinebench.tensortest.com发布任务、核查结果和每个运行结果。

articles.title: VideoPhysEdit: Physical Counterfactual Video Editing via Rigid-Body Physical Scene Reconstruction
articles.content: Video editing has advanced substantially in recent years, with methods increasingly accounting for the visual consequences of edits, such as changes to shadows and occlusions. However, the physical consequences of edits, including changes to subsequent motion and interactions, remain less explored. We formulate this problem as physical counterfactual video editing (PCVE), which aims to generate a counterfactual video depicting the resulting motion and interactions given a source video, a physical edit, and its execution frame. PCVE is challenging because it requires understanding scene physics and inferring the downstream motion and interactions induced by a physical intervention, while paired factual and counterfactual data and dedicated evaluation metrics are lacking. We introduce VideoPhysEdit, a new training-free pipeline for PCVE in rigid-body scenes. It makes physical reasoning explicit through a novel physical scene reconstruction method that recovers a scene reproducing the observed motion and interactions under simulation, enabling the pipeline to apply physical edits as interventions and use the resulting trajectories to guide counterfactual video generation. We further construct PCVE-RigidBench, a synthetic benchmark with paired source and counterfactual target videos and physical ground truth, and introduce the Physical Edit Score. VideoPhysEdit achieves substantially higher physical edit accuracy than open-source methods and commercial models while maintaining competitive visual fidelity. Its Physical Edit Score is 0.376, the only positive score among the compared methods. Qualitative comparisons on real videos further show that VideoPhysEdit applies to real-world scenes and better depicts the downstream motion and interactions induced by the edits than the compared methods. Code: https://github.com/Hammour-steak/VideoPhysEdit

articles.title_zh: 视频 物理编辑:通过 Rigid-Body 物理场景重建进行物理反事实视频编辑
articles.content_zh: 近年来,视频编辑工作取得了很大进展,各种方法越来越多地考虑到编辑的视觉后果,如阴影和隐蔽的变化。 然而,编辑的物理后果,包括后来的运动和互动的变化,仍然没有那么深入。 我们把这个问题发展成物理反事实视频编辑(PCVE), 目的是生成一个反事实视频, 描述由此产生的运动和互动, PCVE具有挑战性,因为它需要了解场景物理学,并推断物理干预引起的下游运动和相互作用,同时缺乏对事实和反事实数据的配对和专用的评价指标。 我们介绍VideoPhysEdit, 一个新的免费培训管道 PCVE在僵硬的身体场景。 它通过一种新颖的物理场景重建方法使物理推理明确化,恢复一个场景在模拟中复制所观测到的运动和相互作用,使管道能够应用物理编辑作为干预,并利用由此产生的轨迹来引导反事实视频生成. 我们进一步构建了PCVE-Rigid Bench,这是一个合成基准,包含对等源和反事实目标视频以及物理地面真相,并引入物理编辑分数. 视频 PhysEdit在保持竞争性视觉忠诚的同时,比开源方法和商业模型实现显著更高的物理编辑精度. 它的物理编辑分数为0.376,是比较方法中唯一的正分. 对真实视频的定性比较进一步显示,VideoPhysEdit适用于真实世界的场景,比比较方法更能描绘编辑所引发的下游运动和互动. 代码:https://github.com/Hamour-steak/VideoPhysEdit

articles.title: Style-Driven Data Synthesis and Degradation-Aware Enhancement for Ultrasound Image Restoration
articles.content: Low-cost handheld ultrasound devices can be widely deployed compared to professional hospital ultrasound machines. However, their images suffer from compound degradation that can mislead clinical judgment. Motivated by this observation, mapping handheld low-quality (LQ) to hospital high-quality (HQ) images has been considered a valuable research question. Conventionally, the mapping requires pixel-aligned LQ-HQ pairs. This requirement is unsatisfactory in practical scenarios because real scans at different times are never pixel-aligned. This paper addresses the challenge with a two-stage framework. The first stage generates pixel-aligned LQ-HQ datasets, and the second stage trains an enhancement model that improves LQ images. The first stage trains a cycle-consistent style-transfer model on unaligned real LQ-HQ pairs to learn a HQ-to-LQ model. Then, the model transforms real HQ images into pixel-aligned LQ images. Based on the dataset generated by the first stage, the second stage uses the Dual Degradation-Guided (DDG) Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) method to fine-tune an LQ-to-HQ model based on aligned pairs. In this stage, the model is based on the well known PiSA-SR framework but inserts a degradation-conditioned correction matrix. Experimental results on the USenhance2023 dataset show that the FID metric is improved by 16.7% over the strongest baseline while other metrics indicate that our enhanced outputs are well aligned with the real HQ distribution. The source code of our method is available at https://github.com/Jason0411202/DDG_LoRA.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 用于超声波图像修复的样式驱动数据合成和降解-智能增强
articles.content_zh: 与专业医院超声机相比,低成本的手持超声波设备可以被广泛部署. 然而,他们的图像受到复合降解的影响,这可能会误导临床判断. 基于这一观察,将手持的低质量(LQ)映射到医院的高质量(HQ)图像被认为是一个有价值的研究问题. 常规情况下,绘图需要像素对齐的LQ-HQ对. 这一要求在实际情景中不尽人意,因为不同时期的真正扫描从未像素对齐. 本文件以两个阶段的框架来讨论这一挑战。 第一阶段生成像素对齐的LQ-HQ数据集,第二阶段培训改进LQ图像的增强模型. 第一阶段在不匹配的真LQ-HQ对上进行循环一致的风格转换模型,学习HQ对LQ模型. 随后,该模型将真实的HQ图像转换成像素对齐的LQ图像. 基于第一阶段生成的数据集,第二阶段采用双降解引导(DDG)低Rank适应(LORA)方法,在对齐对齐的基础上对LQ对HQ模型进行微调. 在这一阶段,该模型基于众所周知的PISA-SR框架,但插入一个降解条件的校正矩阵。 USenhance2023数据集的实验结果显示,FID度量比最强基线改进了16.7%,而其他度量度量则表明,我们增强的输出量与总部的实际分布非常一致。 我们方法的源代码见https://github.com/Jason0411202/DDG_LORA.

articles.title: Sol-H3: Recursive Self-Improvement for MiniMax-H3 Inference Acceleration on Sol-Engine across Cloud and Edge
articles.content: Video diffusion models are rapidly scaling and exhibiting enhanced generation capabilities. Among these recent advancements, MiniMax-H3 stands out as a highly capable, production-level open-source model. However, its 33-billion parameters and multi-step iterative denoising process introduce substantial computational overhead. Consequently, their practical production is hindered by generation latency in the cloud deployment like NVIDIA-GB200, alongside strict memory limits that pose further challenges at the edge device like DGX-Spark. To address these diverse hardware bottlenecks from cloud to edge device, we present a full-stack inference pipeline that integrates efficient algorithmic design with optimized operator implementations. Algorithmically, we introduce a cross-resolution two-stage generation scheduler that exploits the step-wise nature of diffusion: early low-resolution steps rapidly establish the global layout, while later high-resolution steps focus refinements of local and perceptual details. These stages are connected by a learned latent-to-latent mapping module, completely eliminating the computationally expensive VAE decode-reencode cycle for resolution transferring cross different resolutions. For operator implementation, we deploy a Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) loop that searches kernel fusions and memory layouts, evaluating latency together with numerical agreement. Together, these optimizations deliver up to 30x end-to-end speedup and 20% lower memory: a 5-second 1344x768 video with audio is generated 3.5x faster than real time on an 8xGB200 node, and in under a minute fully memory-resident on a single DGX Spark.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Sol-H3:对跨云面和边缘的 Sol-Engine 推论进行递减性自我改进
articles.content_zh: 视频传播模式正在迅速扩大规模,并展示增强的生成能力。 在最近这些进步中,MiniMax-H3突出表现为一种能力强,生产级的开源模型. 然而,其330亿个参数和多步骤迭代解密程序带来了大量的计算间接费用。 因此,它们的实际生产受到像NVIDIA-GB200这样的云层部署的生成延迟性以及像DGX-Spark这样的边缘设备面临进一步挑战的严格内存限制的阻碍。 为了解决从云端到边缘设备的这些多种多样的硬件瓶颈,我们提出了一个全层推论管道,将高效的算法设计与优化的操作员执行结合起来. 算法上,我们引入了跨分辨率的两阶段生成调度器,利用扩散的渐进性:早期的低分辨率步骤迅速建立全球布局,而后期的高分辨率步骤则聚焦于对局部和感知细节的完善. 这些阶段通过一个学习到的潜在到相对的映射模块连接起来,完全消除了计算成本昂贵的VAE解码-reencode循环,用于跨不同分辨率的解析. 为了操作员的执行,我们部署一个递归自我改进(RSI)循环,搜索内核聚变和内存布局,与数字协议一起评价纬度. 这些优化加在一起,可以提供高达30x端对端的加速和20%的低内存:一个5秒1344x768带音频的视频在8xGB200节点上生成3.5x比实时快,在一分钟内完全内存-内存在单个DGX Spark上.

articles.title: DF-CBM: Region-Aware Concept Bottleneck Models for Deepfake Detection
articles.content: Deepfake detection methods have become increasingly effective yet most provide limited insight into the evidence behind their predictions. However, in forensic settings users also need to know which manipulation cues support the decision and where they appear. Existing explainability methods only partially address this need since localization-based approaches lack semantic descriptions while language-based explanation methods are only weakly grounded in visual evidence. In this work, we propose DF-CBM, a region-aware concept bottleneck model for explainable deepfake detection. DF-CBM builds a compact vocabulary of manipulation-related concepts from textual artifact annotations and links each concept to plausible facial and boundary regions. It then predicts these concepts from visual features using a concept-specific masked attention mechanism guided by parsed facial masks and the final real/fake decision is made from the predicted concept bottleneck. Our experiments show that DF-CBM outperforms concept-based baselines in concept prediction and deepfake classification while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art black-box detectors. Finally, qualitative results and intervention analyses demonstrate that DF-CBM provides spatially grounded concept evidence and enables counterfactual explanations of how individual manipulation concepts influence the final prediction. Our code is available at: https://github.com/GeorgeTsoumplekas/DF-CBM.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DF- CBM: 深假检测区域- 智能概念 Bottleneck 模型
articles.content_zh: 深假探测方法已变得日益有效,但大多数方法对其预测背后的证据的洞察力有限。 然而,在法证环境中,用户还需要知道哪些操纵提示支持决定以及它们出现在何处。 现有的可解释性方法仅部分地满足了这一需要,因为基于本地化的方法缺乏语义描述,而基于语言的解释方法则仅以视觉证据为薄弱的基础. 在这项工作中,我们提出了DF-CBM,一种区域意识的概念瓶颈模型,用于解释性的深假检测. DF-CBM从文字文物说明中构建了与操纵相关的概念的紧凑词汇,并将每个概念与可信的面部和边界区域联系起来. 然后,它利用一个以解面罩为指南的概念特异性蒙蔽的注意力机制,从视觉特征中预测这些概念,最后真实/假决定由预测的概念瓶颈作出. 我们的实验显示,DF-CBM在概念预测和深假分类方面超越了基于概念的基线,同时仍然与最先进的黑盒探测器具有竞争力. 最后,定性结果和干预分析表明,DF-CBM提供了基于空间的概念证据,能够对个人操纵概念如何影响最终预测作出反事实解释。 我们的代码见https://github.com/GeorgeTsoumplekas/DF-CBM。

articles.title: Advancing Video-Text Pretraining with Multi-View Captions
articles.content: Video-text pretraining has achieved remarkable progress through the scaling of models and datasets, yet the quality of language supervision remains underexplored. Existing web-scale datasets often provide only a single sparse caption per video that fails to capture rich spatiotemporal semantics, while directly using captioning models can generate noisy descriptions. We propose a large-scale multimodal large language model-based supervision generation framework that improves supervision diversity, fidelity, and semantic coverage. Starting from 10 million videos, our approach generates multi-view captions (MVC) through complementary summary and detailed captions, reasoning-based refinement, and semantic positive caption generation. To effectively exploit supervision at different granularities, we further introduce a granularity-aware text representation with separate CLS tokens for summary and detailed views. We pretrain video-text models using the resulting supervision corpus and evaluate them across standard, fine-grained and detailed text-to-video retrieval benchmarks. Our approach consistently improves both zero-shot and fine-tuned performance while using smaller pretraining corpora than existing methods, demonstrating the importance of rich and complementary textual supervision for video-text pretraining. Project page: https://rvandeghen.github.io/mvc/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 推进带多视频字幕的视频文本预训
articles.content_zh: 通过扩大模型和数据集,视频文本预训取得了显著进展,但语言监督的质量仍然没有得到充分利用。 现有的网络尺度数据集往往每个视频只提供单一的零星字幕,无法捕捉丰富的spatiotal语义,同时直接使用字幕模型可以产生吵闹的描述. 我们提出一个大型多式联运大型语言模型监督生成框架,以改善监督的多样性、忠诚性和语义覆盖。 从1 000万个视频开始,我们的方法通过补充摘要和详细标题、基于推理的改进和语义上的正标题生成多视图字幕。 为了有效地利用不同颗粒体的监督,我们进一步引入了颗粒感知文字代表,并配有单独的CLS符号,供摘要和详细观察. 我们利用由此产生的监督手段,预先培训视频文本模型,并对这些模型进行跨标准、精细和详细的文本到视频检索基准的评估。 我们的方法在使用比现有方法更小的预训体型的同时,不断改进零射和微调的性能,显示了视频文本预训中丰富和互补的文字监督的重要性. 项目网页:https://rvandeghen.github.io/mvc/

articles.title: RefineDrive: Reliable Failure-Guided Learning for Vision-Language-Action Driving
articles.content: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving rely heavily on successful expert demonstrations, leaving model-specific failures underexploited. Learning from these failures is hindered by unreliable diagnoses, poorly matched correction targets, and coarse rewards. We propose RefineDrive, a failure-guided post-training framework that learns from self-generated failures through targeted supervision and safety-aware reinforcement learning. Reliable Diagnosis derives structured, verifiable feedback on collisions and drivable-area violations directly from simulator states. Minimum-Correction Target Retrieval searches a clustered human trajectory bank for nearby corrections that satisfy hard-safety constraints in the current scene, prioritizing preservation of the failed prediction's motion pattern. Conditioned on the driving context and failed trajectory, Correction SFT learns to generate the diagnosis followed by the retrieved correction as a training-only auxiliary task. We then apply GRPO with a Safety-Layered Reward that strictly prioritizes hard-safe trajectories, retains continuous safety feedback for both unsafe and hard-safe trajectories, and rewards driving progress only after hard safety is satisfied. At inference, the policy directly predicts trajectories from the driving context without an explicit diagnosis or repair stage. On NAVSIM v1, RefineDrive improves the 4B base SFT policy from 87.7 to 91.7 PDMS. Using the same checkpoint without additional training, RefineDrive achieves 89.4 EPDMS on the original NAVTEST scenes evaluated with NAVSIM v2 extended metrics. Controlled ablations support the benefits of structured diagnosis supervision, retrieved corrections, and safety-layered optimization for direct planning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 完善 " 引导 " :为 " 展望、语言、行动驱动 " 提供可靠的失败指导学习
articles.content_zh: 愿景-语言-行动(VLA)模式的自主驾驶在很大程度上依赖于成功的专家示范,使得模式特有的失败没有得到充分利用。 从这些失败中吸取教训受到不可靠的诊断、不匹配的矫正目标以及粗糙的奖励的阻碍。 我们提议完善培训框架,通过有针对性的监督和安全意识强化学习,从自我产生的失败中吸取教训。 可靠的诊断直接从模拟状态得到关于碰撞和可驾驶区域侵犯情况的有条理、可核查的反馈。 最小校正目标检索搜索一个集成的人类轨迹库,以进行附近的校正,满足当前场景的硬安全限制,优先保存失败预测的运动模式. 以驱动上下文和故障轨迹为条件,校正SFT学习生成诊断,之后被检索的校正作为仅培训的辅助任务. 然后,我们用安全-Layered奖励来实施GPRO, 严格确定硬安全轨迹的优先次序, 对不安全和硬安全轨迹都保持连续的安全反馈, 只有在硬安全得到满足后才能奖励驾驶进步。 推论,该政策直接预测驾驶背景的轨迹,而没有明确的诊断或修复阶段. 在NAVSIM v1上,RefineDrive将4B基础SFT政策从87.7改进为91.7PDMS. FindineDrive在未经额外培训的情况下使用同一检查站,在最初使用NAVSIM v2扩展度量衡评价的NAVTEST场景上实现了89.4 EPDMS. 受控冲洗支持了结构化诊断监督,检索矫正,安全层次优化直接规划的效益.

articles.title: Towards Generalizable 3D Anomaly Detection via Relational Inconsistency Modeling
articles.content: 3D anomaly detection (3DAD) aims to identify defective regions in point cloud data, serving as a critical component in industrial inspection systems. Existing methods are normality-centered -- learning the distribution of normal samples and treating deviations as anomalies -- without explicitly modeling what constitutes a defect. This leads to ambiguous decision boundaries with increased false positives and negatives, particularly in unified and cross-domain settings where diverse normal distributions further blur the boundaries. We propose a relational inconsistency modeling framework that characterizes defects as violations of geometric consistency among neighboring structures. Our approach learns category-agnostic defect cues through pseudo-anomalies designed as controlled relational violations, instantiated by two key modules: Edge-aware Graph Refinement (EGR) for encoding geometric relationships among local regions, and Cluster-Deviation Modeling (CDM) for identifying regions that are relationally incompatible within their structural peer group. Extensive experiments on Anomaly-ShapeNet and Real3D-AD demonstrate consistent improvements over prior state-of-the-art methods in both in-domain and cross-domain settings, validating the effectiveness of learning an explicit, relation-based defect criterion for 3D anomaly detection. Project page: https://visualsciencelab-khu.github.io/GRIM_project/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过互联互不一致性模式实现通用3D异常检测
articles.content_zh: 三维异常探测(3DAD)旨在识别点云数据中的缺陷区域,作为工业检查系统的关键组成部分. 现有方法以常态为中心 -- -- 学习正常样品的分布,并将偏差作为异常处理 -- -- 但没有明确模拟什么构成缺陷。 这导致决策边界模糊不清,虚假正差和负差增加,特别是在统一和跨域环境中,不同的正常分布进一步模糊了边界。 我们提出了一个关系不一致的模型框架,将缺陷定性为邻接结构之间几何一致性的侵犯。 我们的方法通过假异构来学习类别不可知的缺陷提示,这些假异构被设计为可控的关系违规,通过两个关键模块进行即时分析: 边缘感知图 细化(EGR),用于编码局部区域之间的几何关系,以及集群-变异模型(CDM),用于识别其结构对等群内互不相容的区域. 对Anomaly-ShapeNet和Real3D-AD的广泛实验显示,在域内和跨域设置中,与之前最先进的方法相比,都取得了一致的改进,验证了学习一个基于关系的明确的3D异常检测缺陷标准的有效性. 项目网页:https://visualsciencelab-khu.github.io/GRIM_project/.

articles.title: OPIS: An Input-Grounded Benchmark for Multi-Object Memory in Video World Models
articles.content: Video world models must preserve the visual state of the world over time, but existing evaluation protocols often rely on generated histories, video reference, or selected revisit viewpoints that can confound the assessment of a model's true memory capability. To address this, we introduce OPIS, an input-grounded benchmark that strictly anchors the assessment to a fixed set of object instances from the initial observation for evaluating multi-object memory in video world models. The OPIS dataset comprises 500 cases across real-world, embodied-robotic, and game-world domains, providing dense object-level annotations for 12,672 rigid, articulated, and deformable instances. Our object-centric evaluator combines association and explicit visibility reasoning to hierarchically measure Object (O) Presence (P), Identity (I), and Structure (S), utilizing static or dynamic evaluation tracks based on object kinematics. Across eight image-to-video or camera-conditioned world models, our proposed OPIS scores range from 48.65 to 56.01. As the reference inventory grows from less than 20 to more than 40 objects, the Presence, Identity, and Structure scores show an overall decline, with the average Identity score falling from 40.22 to 23.11. The results demonstrate that preserving the particular object instances in the input is considerably harder than generating plausible visual elements.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OPIS: 视频世界模式中多目标记忆输入全方位基准
articles.content_zh: 视频世界模型必须随着时间的推移保持世界的视觉状态,但现有的评价协议往往依赖于生成的历史,视频参考,或选定的重温观点,这些观点可以混淆对模型真实记忆能力的评估. 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了OPIS,这是一个输入基基准,严格地将评估定位到从最初观测到评价视频世界模型中多对象内存的一组固定对象实例. 业务信息系统数据集包括500个案例,涉及现实世界、内含的机器人域和游戏世界域,为12 672个僵硬、清晰和可变形的事例提供了密集的对象级说明。 我们以物体为中心的评价人员将关联和明确的可见度推理结合起来,利用基于物体运动学的静态或动态评价轨道,分级衡量物体(O)存在(P)、身份(I)和结构(S)。 我们拟议的OPIS分数从48.65分到56.01分不等。 随着参考清单从不到20件增加到40件以上,存在、身份和结构分数显示总体下降,平均身份分数从40.22降至23.11。 结果表明,在输入中保留特定对象实例要比产生可信的视觉要素困难得多。

articles.title: LEGAU: Learning Semantic Gaussian Priors for Scalable Category-level Pose Estimation
articles.content: Category-level 6D pose estimation from a single RGB-D observation is inherently under-constrained, since partial visible geometry must be interpreted together with a canonical object structure before a stable pose can be determined. We present LEGAU, a unified framework that jointly predicts NOCS correspondence, object pose and size, and a canonical Semantic Gaussian Field. Rather than treating reconstruction as a detached auxiliary task, LEGAU uses the Gaussian field as a category-conditioned structural prior that participates in multimodal feature fusion and provides global guidance for local pose reasoning. Conditioned on a categorical text embedding, LEGAU processes RGB-D observations through a transformer-based fusion module that integrates visual, geometric, and category-level cues, decoding the NOCS map, pose and size information and the Gaussian-based object representation. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that this coupled pose-shape formulation achieves strong performance in a single-model multi-category setting, with up to 22\% on SOPE and competitive transfer to real-world data. These results highlight the benefit of jointly learning canonical correspondence, object shape, and pose alignment within a unified representation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LEGAU: 可缩放类别课程的学习语义学前科 Pose 估计
articles.content_zh: 6D类从单一的RGB-D观测中作出表层估计,本质上是受限不足的,因为部分可见几何学在确定一个稳定的姿势之前,必须结合一个犬形物体结构来解释. 我们介绍LEGAU,一个共同预测NOCS函证,对象姿势和大小的统一框架,以及一个 canononic Semantic Gaussian Field. LEGAU没有将重建视为一项脱节的辅助任务,而是将高斯场作为参加多式联运特性聚变的一类结构,并为局部姿势推理提供全球指导。 以绝对文本嵌入为条件,LEGAU通过一个基于变压器的聚变模块处理RGB-D观测,该模块集成视觉,几何,和类级提示,解码NOCS地图,姿势和大小信息以及基于高斯的物体表示. 关于合成和现实世界基准的广泛实验表明,这种组合的假形配方在单一模式的多类设置中取得了强大的性能,在SOPE和竞争性向现实世界数据转移方面最多达到22\%。 这些结果凸显了共同学习教条通信,对象形状,并在统一代表范围内形成一致的好处.

articles.title: Mixed-Prior Decision Risk for Open-Set Recognition
articles.content: In open-set recognition (OSR), a probe must either be identified as one of the known gallery classes or rejected as unknown, so three error types coexist: false acceptance, false rejection, and misidentification. An uncertainty score for selective recognition should rank probes by the risk of the decision the system has made. Bayesian gallery-aware models such as Holistic Uncertainty Estimation (HolUE) summarize the posterior over known and unknown classes by Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence components and map them to an uncertainty score with a supervised nonlinear calibrator. We show that the KL summary is not generally monotone in decision risk: linear fusion of the KL components tuned on validation data yields negative filtering quality on several benchmarks. We propose MPRisk, a mixed-prior posterior decision-risk score that keeps the same Bayesian posterior but directly scores the error events associated with the selected decision: false-acceptance, misidentification, and false-rejection risks, plus a non-specificity penalty for rejections, enabled by modeling unknown identities as a continuous component. Four nonnegative weights tuned on a validation set suffice for ranking; no nonlinear supervised model is required. Across nine image, audio, and text benchmarks, MPRisk achieves the best or tied-best Prediction Rejection Ratio at every operating point on the image and audio benchmarks and on most text operating points, with bootstrap-confirmed gains over HolUE on five benchmarks (up to $+0.19$ PRR) at comparable or lower runtime.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 开放式选择权确认的混合优先决定风险
articles.content_zh: 在开放设置识别(OSR)中,探针必须被识别为已知的画廊类之一或被否定为未知,因此三种错误类型共存:虚假接受,虚假拒绝,以及错误的识别. 选择性承认的不确定性分数应根据系统所作决定的风险排序。 贝叶斯画廊-认识模型如Holistic Un确定性估计(HolUE)总结了Kullback-Leibler(KL)分解组件在已知和未知类之上的后期,并将其映射到一个有监督的非线性计算器的不确定分数. 我们显示,KL概要在决策风险中一般不是单调的:根据验证数据对KL组件进行线性聚变,在几个基准上产生负面过滤质量。 我们提出MPRisk,一种混合前置的后置决定风险分数,它保留了同样的贝叶斯后置,但直接对与所选决定相关的错误事件进行评分:错误的接受,错误的识别,以及虚假的拒绝风险,加上对拒绝的非特定性处罚,通过将未知身份建模为连续组件而允许. 4个非负数加权调用一个验证集足以进行排名;不需要非线性监督模型。 在9个图像、音频和文本基准中,MPRisk在图像和音频基准以及大多数文本操作点的每个操作点都达到最佳或带条件的最佳预测拒绝比率,在可比或较低的运行时间,靴子比HolUE在5个基准(最多0.19美元PRR)上得到肯定的收益。

articles.title: JRDB-AVR: An Active Visual Reasoning Benchmark for Embodied Agents in Real-World Environments
articles.content: In complex embodied visual reasoning scenarios, an agent often has only a limited field of view, and the evidence needed to answer a question may be distributed across time, viewpoint, and interacting objects. A model may therefore give a plausible answer without ever observing the relevant object, time, or view that supports it. Current visual reasoning benchmarks largely evaluate passive observations and final answers, overlooking settings that require active reasoning and evidence acquisition. We introduce JRDB-AVR, a benchmark derived from existing real-world JRDB robotics data through a structured question-generation engine that turns this gap into an explicit evaluation: an embodied agentic system receives a visual reasoning question, requests bounded observations by timestamp and viewing angle, and is evaluated on both the final answer and the grounded visual evidence supporting it. The benchmark contains diverse questions over multiple real-world environments involving temporal search, viewpoint selection, and human-oriented compositional reasoning. We also introduce JRDB-AVR-Agent, a reference active reasoning agentic method that maintains an explicit observation-grounded graph-based world model and answers through solving. Experiments reveal a substantial gap between answer accuracy and evidence accuracy in current baselines, showing that current VLMs can produce unsupported correct answers and that active evidence-aware evaluation is necessary for embodied visual reasoning. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/ControlNet/JRDB-AVR.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: JRDB-AVR:真实世界环境中的健美代理积极视觉理性基准
articles.content_zh: 在复杂的包含的视觉推理情景中,代理人往往只有有限的视野,回答一个问题所需的证据可能分布在时间,观点和相互作用的对象之间. 因此,模型可能会给出一个可信的答案,而从未观察到支持模型的相关对象、时间或观点。 目前视觉推理基准主要评价被动观察和最终答案,俯瞰需要主动推理和取证的设置. 我们引入了JRDB-AVR,这是通过结构化的问题生成引擎从现有现实世界JRDB机器人数据中衍生出来的基准,将这一缺口转化为明确的评价:一个体现的代理系统收到一个视觉推理问题,请求通过时间戳和观看角度进行边界观测,并在最终答案和支持它的基础视觉证据上进行评价. 该基准包含涉及时间搜索、观点选择和以人为本的构成推理等多个现实世界环境中的各种问题。 我们还引入了JRDB-AVR-Agent,一种参考活性推理代理方法,它通过解析来保持一个明确的以观测为基础的图表为基础的世界模型和答案. 实验揭示了当前基线中答案准确度和证据准确度之间的巨大差距,表明当前VLM可以产生无根据的正确答案,积极的证据意识评价对于体现的视觉推理是必要的. 代码和基准可查阅https://github.com/ControlNet/JRDB-AVR。

articles.title: Proxy2World: Learning to Generate Worlds From Lightweight Proxies without Seeing Them
articles.content: Lightweight scene proxies let creators control scene layout and motion while leaving room for imagination in appearance, lighting, and visual effects. However, a suitable proxy is not uniquely defined, making paired proxy-video data difficult to construct automatically at scale. We present Proxy2World, a controllable world model that learns these complementary capabilities from ordinary posed RGBD videos, without training on authored proxy-video pairs. The model jointly learns depth-conditioned RGB generation and joint RGBD generation through cross-modal flow matching. Learning both tasks enables proxy-camera hybrid denoising at inference to follow the proxy structure while producing natural, detailed visuals. We further introduce ProxyBench to evaluate this capability across a diverse set of scenes, camera trajectories, and subject motions. Experiments on ProxyBench show that Proxy2World achieves a better balance between structural adherence and visual quality than camera-controlled and geometry-conditioned methods, supported by quantitative metrics, VLM assessments, human evaluations and diverse qualitative results.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 代理2世界:从轻量级代理中学习生成世界 他们
articles.content_zh: 轻量级场景代理让创作者控制场景布局和运动,同时为外观,照明,视觉效果留下想象空间. 然而,一个合适的代用词没有独有的定义,使得配对的代用视频数据难以在尺度上自动构造. 我们介绍的Proxy2World,是一种可控的世界模型,从普通的RGBD视频中学习这些互补能力,没有接受过作者代理-视频配对的培训. 该模型通过跨模式流匹配,共同学习深度条件的RGB生成和联合RGBD生成. 学习这两个任务可以使代理-相机混合解析推论遵循代理结构,同时产生自然,详细的视觉. 我们进一步引入了Proxy Bench来评价这种能力,它涉及不同的场景,相机轨迹,以及主题运动. 在Proxy Bench上的实验显示,Proxy2World比相机控制和几何条件化的方法在结构坚持性和视觉质量之间实现更好的平衡,辅以定量度量衡,VLM评估,人的评价和多样的质量结果.

articles.title: Detection of Adversarial Attacks on Super-Resolvers Using Spectral Features
articles.content: The integration of deep learning models into image preprocessing pipelines such as super-resolution introduces a largely unexplored attack vector for adversaries targeting downstream tasks. To ensure trustworthiness of critical imaging pipelines, we must be able to detect adversarial behavior within preprocessing models. In this paper, we propose a spectral-based detection method for identifying adversarial attacks embedded in super-resolution model weights. More specifically, we use the radially-averaged power spectral density as a discriminative feature to train an extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) detector, demonstrating detectability of model-level threats in super-resolution networks. We further benchmark our detector against magnitude- and phase-based Fourier spectrum detectors, evaluating each method across a range of training and cross-architecture scenarios. Our proposed detector out-performs the comparison detectors in most of these scenarios and indicates that high-frequency features are most informative for detecting AdvSR attacks across SR architectures.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 利用光谱特征侦测对超级解决方案者进行横向攻击
articles.content_zh: 将深层学习模型整合到超分辨率等图像预处理管道中,引入了针对下游任务的对手基本上未探索的攻击矢量. 为了确保关键成像管道的可信赖性,我们必须能够发现预处理模型中的对抗行为. 在本文中,我们提出了一种基于光谱的检测方法,用于识别嵌入在超分辨率模型权重中的对抗攻击. 更具体地说,我们利用射线平均功率光谱密度作为一种区分特征,来训练一种极端梯度增强(XGBooost)探测器,显示了模型级威胁在超分辨率网络中的可探测性. 我们进一步将我们的探测器与基于大小和相位的傅里叶频谱探测器作为基准,在一系列培训和跨结构的假设中评价每一种方法。 我们提议的探测器在大多数这些情景中都超越了比较探测器,并表明高频特性对于检测整个SR架构的AdvSR攻击最具有信息性.

articles.title: Verifying the Linear Representation Hypothesis: How Interpretable Are Vision SAEs?
articles.content: Vision Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have become a popular tool in Mechanistic Interpretability due to their presumed ability to disentangle complex features learned by a model into monosemantic concepts. Despite their growing popularity, evaluating their interpretability remains an active topic of research. The bedrock motivating the adoption of SAEs is the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH), which claims that polysemantic features can be projected onto a (near) orthogonal basis of sparse, human-understandable representations. Yet, most current frameworks evaluate proxies such as the sparsity of SAE features or the coherence of the inferred dictionary, implicitly assuming that these reflect alignment with human perception. In this paper, we provide empirical evidence that measuring the interpretability of SAE concepts is more difficult than these proxies suggest. To this end, we adapt the Autointerpretability Score (AIS) - previously shown to align with human judgments in Natural Language Processing - to vision tasks and validate our approach in a dedicated user study. We evaluate SAE concept quality using both standard metrics and our adapted AIS. We find that established interpretability metrics for SAEs correlate neither with one another nor with AIS, indicating that no single reference-free metric, whether grounded in the LRH or not, is sufficient for verifying the interpretability of vision SAEs. We argue these findings support recent calls for more verifiable, ground-truth-anchored design and evaluation of explanation methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 验证线性表示假说 : 愿景如何解释SAE?
articles.content_zh: 视觉Sparse自动编码器(SAEs)因其假定能够将模型所学到的复杂特征分解成单语义概念而成为机械解释学中流行的工具. 尽管它们越来越受欢迎,但评估它们的可解释性仍然是研究的一个积极议题。 推动采用SAEs的基石是线性表述假说(LRH),该假说声称,多语种特征可以投射到(接近)稀疏、人能理解的正统基础上。 然而,大多数现行框架都评价诸如SAE特征的伸缩性或所推断的词典的一致性等代词,暗含假定这些代词反映了与人类认知的一致性. 在本文中,我们提供了经验证据,证明衡量SAE概念的可解释性比这些代词所暗示的更困难. 为此,我们调整了 " 自动解释分数(AIS) " -- -- 以前在自然语言处理中显示与人类判断一致 -- -- ,使之适用于愿景任务,并在一项专门的用户研究中验证我们的方法。 我们既使用标准衡量标准,又使用我们经过调整的AIS评估SAE概念质量. 我们认为,SAE的既定可解释性衡量尺度彼此之间或与AIS之间都不相关,这表明,任何单一的无参考性衡量尺度,无论是否基于LRH,都不足以核实视觉SAE的可解释性。 我们认为,这些结论支持最近提出的对解释方法进行更可核查、更真实的设计和评估的呼吁。

articles.title: Still There, No Longer Seen: Exposing Compression-Induced Risk in Large Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Visual token compression reduces the inference cost of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). However, aggregate robustness measures do not reveal whether a particular adversarial failure is induced by compression or inherited from the underlying model. We define a compression-specific failure (CSF) as an adversarial input that remains correct under full-token inference but fails after compression, casting compression-induced risk as a paired failure attribution problem. Within a controlled diagnostic cohort, counterfactuals show that retained-set allocation causally changes compressed correctness and reveal a negative association between recovery and representation drift in displaced evidence. Motivated by these findings, we propose CIRA, a Compression-Induced Risk Attack for Large Vision-Language Models. Under a vision-encoder white-box setting, CIRA optimizes image perturbations through encoder-side objectives that manipulate token priorities across candidate compression budgets while preserving displaced evidence. CIRA uses no downstream questions or labels and requires no access to the language model, deployed compressor, or exact compression budget. Across 12 dataset-compressor settings evaluated at four budgets, CIRA achieves a mean CSFR of 20.35% while limiting full-token attack success to 6.92%, with similar behavior on additional LVLM families. A cross-view selection-stabilization defense substantially suppresses CIRA, although Adaptive CIRA partially restores its effectiveness. These results show that compression-specific failures persist under restricted access and support paired evaluation of full-token and compressed inference for attributing risk to visual-token compression.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 仍然在那里,没有更长的目光:在大视野-语言模型中展示压缩风险
articles.content_zh: 视觉符号压缩降低了大型视觉-语言模型(LVLMs)的推论成本. 然而,总体稳健性措施并未揭示某一特定对抗性失败是由压缩引起的还是从基本模型中继承的。 我们把压缩特定失败(CSF)定义为在完全推论下仍然正确的但压缩后失败的对抗性输入,将压缩引发的风险铸成成对的失败归属问题. 在一个受控制的诊断组中,反事实显示,保留设定的分配因果变化压缩了正确性,并揭示了在转移的证据中,恢复与表述漂移之间的负面联系。 基于这些调查结果,我们提议由CIRA作为大型视觉语言模型的抑制诱导风险攻击。 在视觉编码器白盒设置下,CIRA通过编码器侧面目标优化图像扰动,这些目标操纵候选人压缩预算的象征性优先级,同时保存被转移的证据. CIRA不使用下游问题或标签,要求无法访问语言模型,部署压缩器,或精确压缩预算. 在通过四个预算评估的12个数据集-压缩器设置中,CIRA实现了平均20.35%的CSFR,同时将全触控攻击成功率限制在6.92%,对更多LVLM家庭也有类似行为. 交叉视野选择稳定防御在很大程度上压制了CIRA,尽管适应性的CIRA部分恢复了其有效性. 这些结果表明,在限制访问和辅助下,由于将风险归结为可视化压缩,对全托式和压缩式推论进行配对评价,具体压缩故障持续存在。

articles.title: ActionUNet: Improving Robustness of VLA Models with Efficient Multi-scale Fine-tuning
articles.content: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown great promise for robotic manipulation by mapping multi-modal semantics to physical actions. However, this mapping inherently struggles to align these coarse-grained semantics with fine-grained temporal execution. It leaves VLA models with limited generalization and insufficient robustness in cluttered environments. To overcome this issue, we propose ActionUNet, an efficient multi-scale fine-tuning framework that enhances pre-trained VLA models with minimal computational cost. ActionUNet first constructs a lightweight temporal U-Net within the temporal-aligned action feature space to fuse hierarchical structural priors, effectively bridging the scale gap between semantics and temporal executions. Recognizing that multi-scale modeling can disrupt microscopic temporal continuity and cause mechanical oscillations, ActionUNet then employs a conditional SIREN as a continuous action decoder. Equipped with explicit second-order smoothness constraints, this decoder guarantees temporal continuity and reduces high-frequency motion jitter. By smoothing temporal discontinuities from multi-scale fusion, this continuous formulation reduces mechanical execution failures while preserving the base VLA model's generalization and manipulation robustness. Extensive experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks, together with real-world hard evaluations, demonstrate that ActionUNet significantly improves π0.5 success rates by absolute 9.8%, 6.1%, and 11.4%, respectively, while also generalizing to the regression-based OpenVLA-OFT backbone, highlighting its effectiveness and efficiency as a fine-tuning strategy. Code and implementation details are available at https://github.com/Di-Zhu123/ActionUNet.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ActionUNet:以高效的多尺度精细调整改进VLA模型的强性
articles.content_zh: 视觉-语言-行动(VLA)模型通过将多种模式的语义对物理动作进行映射,显示出机器人操纵的巨大希望. 然而,这幅图图在本质上难以使这些粗糙的语义与精细的刻度执行一致. 它使得VLA模型在杂乱的环境中的通俗性有限,强度不足. 为了克服这一问题,我们提议ActionUNet,这是一个高效的多尺度微调框架,可以加强经过预先培训的甚高频模型,计算成本最低。 行动 UNet首先在时间对齐的行动范围内构建一个轻量级的U-Net,其特征是将等级结构前缀引信,有效地弥合语义和时间处决之间的规模差距。 认识到多尺度建模可干扰微缩时间连续性并造成机械振荡, 然后UNet使用有条件的SIREN作为连续动作解码器. 这种解码器配备了明显的二阶光滑性限制,保证了时间连续性,并减少了高频运动焦急. 这种连续配制通过平滑多尺度聚变产生的时间不连续,减少了机械执行故障,同时保持了基础VLA模型的概括性和操纵性. RoboTwin 2.0和LiBERO-Plus基准的广泛实验,加上现实世界的硬评价,表明ActionUNet分别显著提高了0.5成功率的绝对9.8%,6.1%和11.4%,同时也概括到基于回归的OpenVLA-OFT主干线,突出了其作为微调策略的效能和效率. 守则和执行详情见https://github.com/Di-Zhu123/ActionUNet。

articles.title: What Makes World Action Models Generalize? An Empirical Study of Test-Time Future Modeling
articles.content: World action models (WAMs) predict the future alongside actions during \emph{training}. Due to the heavy computation cost of video denoising, whether the future must still be generated during \emph{inference} is disputed: Explicit WAMs denoise it into clean frames along with every action chunk, whereas Latent WAMs discard it entirely for acceleration. We find that latent WAMs, despite matching explicit ones on in-distribution tasks, fail to retain the generalization benefits that originally motivated WAMs. To demonstrate this, we evaluate generalization along three axes: \emph{environmental perturbation}, \emph{data efficiency}, and \emph{task generalization}. Controlled comparisons with a matched backbone, training data, and budget reveal consistent degradation across all three axes when the action expert no longer conditions on future representations. Further analysis shows that the gap arises almost entirely from the first denoising step: the benefit comes from \emph{preparing} the future, not \emph{generating} it. We therefore propose \textbf{Simple-WAM}, which simplifies future modeling into a single forward pass of fully noised video tokens and adapts the training-time noise schedule to this inference behavior. Across simulation and real-world tasks, Simple-WAM achieves the best of both worlds, leading explicit WAMs in generalization performance with efficiency comparable to Latent WAMs. Project Page: \href{https://zrporz.github.io/Simple-WAM-Web/}{\textcolor{panton}{\texttt{https://zrporz.github.io/Simple-WAM-Web}}}
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 是什么使得世界行动模式普遍化? 试验时间未来模型的实证研究
articles.content_zh: 世界行动模式预测未来与\emph{training}期间的行动。 未来是否仍必须在\emph{ inference}期间产生, 明确WAMs将其与每个动作块一起装入清洁框中,而Latent WAMs则将其完全丢弃以加速. 我们发现,潜在的WAM尽管在分配任务上与明确的任务相匹配,但未能保留最初激发的WAM的概括效益. 为了证明这一点, 我们按三个轴来评价概括:\emph{环境扰动},\emph{数据效率}和\emph{任务概括}。 与匹配的主干网、培训数据和预算进行有控制的比较表明,当行动专家不再对未来陈述作条件时,这三个轴心都持续退化。 进一步的分析表明,这一差距几乎完全来自第一个去名步骤:好处来自\emph{ preparing}未来,而不是\emph{生成}它. 因此,我们提出\textbf{Simple-WAM},将未来的模型简化成一个完全噪声的视频符号的单一前传,并调整训练时间噪音表以适应这种推论行为. 在整个模拟和现实世界的任务中,Simple-WAM都实现了两个世界中最优的成绩,在概括化性能上领先于明显的WAM,其效率与Lateent WAM相当. 项目页:\href{https://zrporz.github.io/simple-WAM-Web/\textcolor{panton\textt{https://zrporz.github.io/Simple-WAM-Web}}}}

articles.title: One Sensor, Whole Body - 3D Body Pose from a Single Consumer Earbud IMU
articles.content: Consumer earbuds already stream inertial motion data from the head, one of the most widely worn sensor locations on the body. We ask how much of the 3D body pose a single such head IMU can recover, and whether adding more consumer sensors actually helps. We build a multimodal capture pipeline that records four-view RGB-D video together with an AirPods head IMU and two Striv insole IMUs, synchronize the streams post-hoc, and generate pseudo-ground-truth with SAM 3D Body, yielding a 35-take single-subject benchmark spanning gait, turning, vertical, everyday, and clinically inspired motions. Adapting two recurrent model families (IMUPoser and MobilePoser), we show that one head IMU recovers lower-body pose at 79.0 mm rigid-MPJPE and per-foot ground contact at 0.809 macro-F1, and that a causal variant retains most of this accuracy at streaming latency. In paired per-take significance tests across both families, adding the consumer foot IMUs never significantly improves pose and significantly degrades it in two of four model-split combinations; a mounting-bias probe and feet-only ablation identify insole orientation quality, not foot placement, as the mechanism. Extending the output to a 20-joint full-body skeleton maps the boundary: gross distal-arm motion is partially recoverable from the head alone, proximal upper-body pose is not, and staged fine-tuning recovers the leg accuracy that naive joint training sacrifices to multi-task dilution. For learned pose from consumer wearables, sensor reliability, not sensor count, is the binding constraint here. For the devices tested, the earbud is its sweet spot. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhilinGuo/one-sensor-whole-body.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 一个传感器,全机 - 3D 单一消费者耳蜗的肉馅
articles.content_zh: 消费者的耳机已经从头部流出惯性运动数据,是身体上磨损最广的传感器位置之一. 我们询问3D机体中 有多少能形成一个这样的头 IMU可以恢复, 以及添加更多的消费者传感器 是否真的有用。 我们搭建了一条多模式的捕获管道,将四视RGB-D视频与一个AirPods头IMU和两个Striv Insole IMU一起录制,同步串流后hoc,并与SAM 3D生成伪地面真实性 身体,产生一个35个单主体的基准 跨越步态,转弯,垂直,日常和临床启发的运动。 适应两个反复出现的模型家族(IMUPoser和MobilePoser),我们显示,一个头部IMU恢复下体姿势为79.0毫米刚性-MPJPE,每英尺地面接触为0.809个宏-F1,一个因果变体在流延性时保留了这一精度的大部分. 在对两个家庭进行成对的每个意义测试中,加上消费脚的IMU从未显著改善姿势,在四个模型分裂组合中的两个组合中显著降解;一个嵌入比亚斯探测器和只脚的衰竭识别出单脚定向质量,而不是脚的放置,作为机理. 将输出扩展为20联全体骨架图 边界: 毛散-臂运动单从头部部分可回收,近缘上体姿势不回收,并进行精细调整恢复腿部精度,即天真联合训练牺牲对多任务稀释. 对于消费者可穿戴的学习到的姿势,传感器的可靠性,而不是传感器的计数,是这里的束缚. 对于测试过的装置来说,耳罩是它的甜点. 代码见https://github.com/ZhilinGuo/one-senor-wall-body。

articles.title: SPIDER: Multi-Layer Semantic Token Pruning and Adaptive Sub-Layer Skipping in Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.content: Multimodal Large Language Models face significant efficiency challenges that stem from two distinct yet coupled sources: data redundancy and computational redundancy. While most methods focus on data redundancy by pruning visual tokens from the output of the visual encoder or computing redundancy in LLM decoders using blockwise importance, the finer-grained inter-layer representation shifts and the distribution differences within the layers themselves have not been fully explored. In this work, we comprehensively investigate this dual-level inefficiency. We posit that intermediate layer tokens from vision encoders should be considered for effective visual token pruning, as semantic focus shifts across layers, with middle-layer tokens capturing more detailed object-centric information that deeper layers may abstract away. Furthermore, we reveal the differential contributions of Attention and FFNs across distinct LLM decoder layers. Building upon these discoveries, we propose \textbf{SPIDER}, a training-free framework that integrates multi-layer \underline{\textbf{S}}emantic visual token \underline{\textbf{P}}run\underline{\textbf{I}}ng with an a\underline{\textbf{D}}aptive sub-lay\underline{\textbf{ER}} skipping mechanism. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that SPIDER consistently maintains strong performance across various MLLM architectures and reduction ratios. For instance, on LLaVA-NeXT-7B, SPIDER reduces FLOPs by $79\%$ while maintaining 96$\%$ of the baseline performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 天基信息平台:多语言语义类 Token 冲洗和适应性次 Layer 跳过多模式大语言模型
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型面临着重大的效率挑战,这些挑战来自两个不同但又相互结合的来源:数据冗余和计算冗余。 虽然大多数方法都注重通过从LLM解码器的可视编码器输出中推开可视化符号或计算冗余而使用块形重要性的数据冗余,但细纹层间代表值变化以及层内本身的分布差异尚未得到充分探索. 在这项工作中,我们全面调查这种双重效率低下的现象。 我们假设,视觉编码器的中间层符号应该被考虑为有效的可视化符号推敲,因为语义焦点会跨层移动,中间层的符号捕捉到更细的以物体为中心的信息,而更深层可能抽象掉. 此外,我们揭示了不同LLM解码层的注意力和FFN的不同贡献。 基于这些发现,我们提议\ textbf{ SPIDER},一个将多层\ underline\ textbf{ S}}emantic 视觉符号集成的无培训框架 \ underline\ textbf{ P\\ run\ underline\ textbf{ i} 带有 a\ underline\ textbf{ D\ aptive sub-lay\ underline\ textbf{ ER} 跳过机制 。 实验性评价表明,天基信息平台始终保持各种多边 LLM架构和减少比率方面的良好业绩。 例如,在LLaVA-NEXT-7B上,天基信息平台在保持基线绩效的96美元的同时,将FLOP减少79美元。

articles.title: Inspector: Conversational and Lightweight Analyzer of Analog Circuit Layouts Using LLM and CNNs
articles.content: The integration of artificial intelligence into computer-aided design frameworks has sparked a shift in the design of analog integrated circuits (ICs), transitioning the field from using manual and algorithmic-based solutions to adopting automated and intelligent paradigms. In this scenario, the GDSII file represents the industry-standard database containing the ultimate and most accurate source of information of the analog circuit, encapsulating the complex physical geometries and parasitic realities that define tape out performance. This paper proposes a novel framework that combines fine-tuned LLMs and CNNs to analyze GDSII files of analog circuits, enabling a conversational interface between the tool and the designers. Experimental results using thousands of analog designs across four realistic tasks demonstrate that the proposed solution outperforms state-of-the-art general-purpose massive VLMs by a significant margin (up to 81%), thus providing a lightweight solution to the problem of GDSII analysis.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 检查器:使用LLM和CNN的模拟电路布局的谈话和轻量级分析器
articles.content_zh: 人工智能融入计算机辅助设计框架,引发了模拟集成电路(ICs)设计的转变,从使用人工和算法解决方案向采用自动化和智能范式过渡. 在这种情景下,GDSII文件代表了包含模拟电路最终和最准确的信息来源的行业标准数据库,封装了定义磁带退出性能的复杂的物理几何和寄生现实. 本文提出了一个新颖的框架,将微调的LLMs和CNN集成在一起,分析模拟电路的GDSII文件,使工具与设计者之间能够对话界面. 使用数千个模拟设计的实验结果涉及四个现实任务,这些实验结果表明,拟议的溶液的性能大大超过最先进的通用大规模VLM(高达81%),从而为GDSII分析问题提供了轻量级解决方案。

articles.title: Just MLPs: Efficient Visual State Reconstruction for Multimodal Language Models
articles.content: Long visual token sequences often account for a substantial fraction of the computational overhead in multimodal large language models~(MLLMs). Existing approaches reduce this cost by pruning redundant visual tokens, but permanently discard visual evidence that may become useful in subsequent layers. We instead ask whether all visual tokens can be preserved while reducing the cost of repeatedly evolving the representations through the Transformer. To answer this question, we perform low-rank interventions on visual-to-text information flow. We find that, after visual-to-text attention is blocked, restoring only a few directions recovers most of the lost accuracy, suggesting the relevant visual influence is concentrated in a low-dimensional subspace. We further observe strong predictability in layer-specific visual states: lightweight MLPs approximate them with high cosine similarity and low reconstruction error. Motivated by these findings, we propose $δ$-Vision, which replaces repeated Transformer evolution of visual tokens with lightweight low-rank adapters that construct layer-wise visual memories while preserving all visual tokens for text retrieval. Across image and video benchmarks, $δ$-Vision achieves higher accuracy than visual token pruning baselines at comparable or lower computation, while delivering competitive inference efficiency without discarding visual tokens.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Just MLPs:多式联运模式高效视觉国家重建
articles.content_zh: 长视符号序列往往占多式联运大语言模型中计算间接费用的相当一部分~(MLLMs). 现有方法通过挖掘多余的视觉符号来降低这一成本,但永久丢弃可能在随后的层中变得有用的视觉证据. 相反,我们问是否可以保留所有视觉标志,同时减少通过变形器反复演变表述的成本。 为了回答这个问题,我们在视觉到文字的信息流方面做了低级的干预. 我们发现,在视觉到文字的注意力被阻断后,只有几个方向恢复了大部分丢失的精度,说明相关的视觉影响集中在一个低维的子空间. 我们进一步观察到层特异性的视觉状态具有很强的可预测性:轻量级的MLP与高余弦相似度和低重建误差相近. 基于这些发现,我们提议了$_$-Vision,它用轻量级低档适配器取代视觉符号的反复变形器演化,这些适配器在为文本检索而保留所有视觉符号的同时,构造出层位的视觉记忆. 在整个图像和视频基准中,$ $-Vision在可比或较低的计算中比可视化符号计算基线的精确度更高,同时在不丢弃可视化符号的情况下提供竞争性推论效率。

articles.title: Adjoint Guidance Flow: Amortized Critic Guidance for VLA Policies
articles.content: Flow-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are typically trained by behavior cloning and thus do not explicitly optimize long-term task return. Critic guidance steers generation toward higher-value actions, but existing methods differentiate the critic through a one-step surrogate of the sampler and back-propagate a critic ensemble at every flow step. In contrast, here we propose Adjoint Guidance Flow (AGF), which amortizes trajectory-aware critic guidance into a lightweight guidance network while preserving the pretrained VLA policy. Specifically, we formulate critic-guided flow generation as a deterministic optimal control problem, whose optimal guidance is a costate that carries the terminal critic gradient back through the remaining flow, and regress the guidance network onto this costate while keeping both the VLA and critic frozen. This design provides favorable memory and throughput scaling during training, and inference needs one guidance-network forward pass per step, without the critic ensemble, back-propagation, or adjoint computation. Across LIBERO, RoboCasa, and LIBERO-Pro, AGF consistently improves pretrained VLAs, remains competitive with critic-guidance and policy-fine-tuning baselines, and is the most robust method when a single guidance strength is deployed across tasks. Compared with QGF, AGF runs $3.6\times$ faster per guidance step with $7.0\times$ fewer parameters, with comparable and even better performance, showing that critic guidance can be trajectory-aware and lightweight.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 联合指导流程:对《维也纳条约法公约》政策的过度批评指导
articles.content_zh: 基于流程的Vision-Language-Action(VLA)政策通常通过行为克隆进行训练,因此没有明确优化长期任务回报. 批评指导引导生成转向高值动作,但现有方法通过对采样器的一步代位来区分批评者,并在每一流程步骤中背向评论者组合. 与此相对照,我们在此提议联合指导流程(AGF),将有轨迹感的批评者指导分期摊还到轻量级指导网络中,同时保留预先训练的VLA政策. 具体地说,我们把批评者引导的流量生成作为一个决定性的最佳控制问题,其最佳的引导是将终端评论者梯度带回剩余流量的计算成本,并将引导网络倒退到这个计算成本上,同时将VLA和批评者都冻结。 这种设计在训练期间提供了有利的内存和吞吐量的缩放,推论每步需要一个导线-网络前传,没有评论者综艺,反传播,或联合计算. 在整个LIBERO、RoboCasa和LIBERO-Pro,AGF不断改进经过预先培训的VLA,在批评指导和政策精细调整基线方面仍然具有竞争力,并且是跨任务部署单一指导力量时最有力的方法。 与QGF相比,AGF运行每个制导步骤的3.6\times$更快,参数减少7.0\times$,具有可比甚至更好的性能,表明批评者制导可以有轨迹意识和轻量级.

articles.title: Resolution as a First-Class Decision: Task-Conditioned Routing for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.content: The inference efficiency of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is severely constrained by massive visual token sequences induced by high-resolution inputs, with computational cost scaling quadratically. Existing approaches primarily focus on downstream token compression, while overlooking a fundamental upstream inefficiency: input resolution is treated as a static, task-agnostic hyperparameter. We propose Task-Conditioned Resolution Routing (TCRR), which formulates visual compression as a task-conditioned decision and employs a lightweight cross-modal router that conditions backbone visual representations on textual semantics via feature-wise modulation and cross-attention to predict the minimal sufficient compression level per query. To support this, we curate a dataset of 500k samples across 12 task categories, labeled via a teacher-oracle pipeline to approximate Pareto-optimal compression scales. Extensive experiments across diverse architectures show that TCRR achieves a superior efficiency frontier, specifically reducing visual FLOPs by 40.9% and latency by 53.7% on Qwen3-VL-8B while preserving competitive performance. Further analysis of scaling behavior confirms that dynamically routing visual compression enables optimal resource allocation without modifying the MLLM backbone.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 决议作为第一级决定:为高效多式联运大型语文模式规定任务
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)的推论效率受到高分辨率输入诱导的大规模视觉符号序列的严重制约,计算成本四倍缩放. 现有方法主要侧重于下游符号压缩,而忽略了一种基本的上游低效率:输入分辨率被视为静态的,任务不可知的超参数. 我们提议采用 " 任务规定 " (TCRRR),将视觉压缩作为任务规定的决定,并使用轻量级的跨模式路由器,通过特异性调制和交叉意向,在文字语义上设定主线视觉表达条件,以预测每个查询的最低压缩水平。 为了支持这一点,我们整理了一个由500千个样本组成的数据集,涉及12个任务类别,通过教师-先知管道贴上标签,大致显示Pareto-优化压缩尺度。 跨越不同建筑的广泛实验表明,TCRR实现了优越的效率前沿,具体来说,在Qune3-VL-8B上,视觉FLOP减少了40.9%,耐久性减少了53.7%,同时保持了竞争性能. 对缩放行为的进一步分析证实,动态的路由视觉压缩能够实现最佳的资源分配,而不修改MLLM主干线.

articles.title: TaoTex: Boosting Texture Detail Fidelity for Native 3D Material Generation
articles.content: Recent 3D generation models can produce accurate geometries while still struggling to reconstruct detailed textures. We propose a diffusion-based native 3D material generation model TaoTex, which faithfully recovers intricate textures through tailored strategies and improvements. First, we develop a data construction agent to create high-frequency textured 3D assets to bridge the data gap in public datasets. Training with these data significantly enhances the ability of TaoTex to recover challenging details such as text and patterns. Second, we design a multi-level feature fusion (MLFF) module to adaptively integrate local and global features of the conditional input, providing more complete texture cues for the diffusion model and thereby enhancing reconstruction fidelity. To alleviate VAE reconstruction errors, we adopt a latent-to-pixel space loss transition, further improving the pixel-level details and generation quality. Finally, we scale TaoTex to multi-view inputs by incorporating learnable viewpoint embeddings, achieving accurate and consistent material reconstruction across views. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing approaches in preserving texture details in both single- and multi-view settings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TaoTex: 为本地三维材料生成促进纹理细节
articles.content_zh: 最近的3D生成模型可以产生准确的几何图案,同时仍然在努力重建详细的纹理. 我们提出一种基于扩散的本地立体材料生成模型TaoTex,通过量身定制的战略和改进,忠实地恢复复杂的纹理。 一,开发数据构建代理 打造高频文本化3D资产 弥补公共数据集数据空白. 使用这些数据的培训大大提高了TaoTex恢复文本和模式等具有挑战性的细节的能力. 第二,我们设计了一个多层次的特性聚变模块,以适应性地整合有条件输入的局部和全球特征,为扩散模型提供更完整的纹理提示,从而增强重建忠心. 为了缓解VAE重建错误,我们采用了潜在到像素空间损失的过渡,进一步改善像素级的细节和生成质量. 最后,我们通过纳入可学习的观点嵌入,实现准确和一致的跨观点物质重建,将TaoTex扩大到多视图输入。 广泛的实验表明,我们的方法在保存单视图和多视图环境的纹理细节方面大大超过现有方法。

articles.title: Telescopic Language Models
articles.content: One deployed language model must often serve many compute budgets, yet serving each budget still means a separate training or compression run per point. We train a Telescopic Language Model (TLM) to be that continuum: a nested-capacity Transformer supervised by stochastic prefix supervision with a full anchor. At every step, one randomly truncated prefix of the capacity axis is trained against the full next-token target, alongside one full-capacity pass, so the trained artifact is a valid language model at every depth. Two forward-backward passes per step, no architectural change, nothing extra at inference. Fixed-exit suites such as Matryoshka Language Model Suites (MLMS) occupy one point in this design space, and the point has a cost: supervising only a few fixed exits leaves the nested model at chance level everywhere else (perplexity 10^2-10^5 in our baselines). On a 200M proxy suite (20B FineWeb-Edu tokens, identical data stream for all methods), a single TLM run is a valid language model at every one of its twenty layer prefixes, in perplexity and on perplexity-sensitive downstream tasks, reducing the area under the quality-budget curve by 43-44% relative to the fixed-exit suites while matching them at full capacity, at ~12% lower GPU cost per run. The prefix sampling density is a dial: concentrating it on a few depths recovers fixed-exit quality there at the price of the continuum, so the operating points become a training-time choice rather than an architectural one. These results indicate that the training objective, not the nesting itself, is what makes a model elastic.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 望远镜语言模型
articles.content_zh: 一个部署的语文模式必须经常为许多计算预算服务,但为每个预算服务仍然意味着每个点进行单独的培训或压缩。 我们训练一种望远镜语言模型来做这种连续体:一个由全主锚结构前缀监督的嵌入容量变形器。 在每一个步骤上,一个随机切换的能力轴前缀被训练对接下一个完全的托肯目标,同时训练一个全容量的传球,因此训练出来的文物在每个深度都是有效的语言模型. 每一步有两个后退的通道,没有建筑改变,没有附加推断. Matryoshka语言模型Suites(MLMS)等固定出舱套件在这个设计空间中占据了1分,这一点有一定成本:仅监督少数固定出舱将嵌入式模型置于其他任何地方的概率水平(我们的基线中的复杂度为10^2-10^5). 在200M代理套件(20B FineWeb-Edu acidents,所有方法都相同数据流)上,一个单一的TLM运行是其20层前缀中每个部分的有效语言模型,在复杂度和对复杂度敏感的下游任务上,相对于固定出舱套件相比,质量预算曲线下的面积减少43-44%,同时在满载能力下匹配,每跑的GPU成本降低~12%. 前缀采样密度为拨号:将其集中在几个深度上,以连续体的价格恢复那里的固定出厂质量,所以操作点成为训练时间的选择,而不是建筑的选择. 这些结果表明,训练目标,而不是筑巢本身,是使模型具有弹性的因素。

articles.title: Retrieving Biblical Intertextual References in Karen Blixen's Seven Gothic Tales
articles.content: Identifying intertextual references is central to literary scholarship, but computationally difficult when source material is transformed through paraphrase, allusion, historical language, and translation. We investigate this problem through biblical intertextuality in Karen Blixen's Seven Gothic Tales. Drawing on the commentary to a critical edition, we construct a benchmark of 189 annotated references and evaluate retrieval against all 31,170 verses of historically plausible Danish Old and New Testament translations. We compare TF-IDF and BM25 with multilingual and Danish sentence encoders, examine the effect of linguistic normalization, and fine-tune a Danish encoder using hard negatives and five-fold cross-validation. We analyze performance across automatically derived lexical-overlap strata representing quotations, paraphrases, and allusions. Linguistically normalized BM25 provides a strong zero-shot baseline, attaining an overall R@10 of 0.365 and retrieving every quotation within its ten highest-ranked verses. The best zero-shot dense model achieves a comparable overall score of 0.360 while performing better on allusions. Fine-tuning DFM-large raises its overall R@10 from 0.265 to 0.508 and more than doubles its performance on allusions, from 0.138 to 0.339. However, evaluation against editorial annotations alone understates the model's scholarly usefulness: a literary scholar judged seven of 30 selected rank-one predictions counted as false positives to be meaningful additional references. These findings show both the potential and the epistemic limits of computational intertextual retrieval. Rather than treating scholarly annotations as exhaustive or model outputs as discoveries, we propose retrieval models as heuristic co-readers that recover documented references and generate candidates for expert-led close reading.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 检索卡伦·布利肯的七大哥特故事中的圣经间参考文献
articles.content_zh: 识别文本间引用是文学奖学金的核心,但当源材料通过代词,缩写,历史语言和翻译转换时,计算困难. 我们通过卡伦·布利肯的"七大哥特故事"中的圣经互通来调查这个问题. 根据对批判版的评论,我们构建了189个注解参考基准,并对照历史上可信的丹麦旧约和新约译本的所有31 170个诗句评估检索情况。 我们比较TF-IDF和BM25与多语种和丹麦语的句子编码器,研究语言正常化的效果,并用硬底和五倍交叉验证来微调丹麦语的编码器. 我们分析的是自动产生的语法重叠层的性能, 代表引文、参数和暗示。 语言规范化的BM25提供了一个强大的零射线基线,总的R@10达到0.365,并检索其10个排位最高的诗节中的每一个引文。 最佳的零射致密型号实现了0.360的可比整体分数,同时在暗示上表现较好. 微调DFM大调将其总体R@10从0.265提高到0.508,并在含意上将其性能翻一番以上,从0.138提高到0.339. 然而,仅根据编辑说明进行的评价低估了模型的学术效用:一位文学学者判断,30个选定的一级预测中,有7个被算作虚假的阳性是有意义的补充参考。 这些调查结果表明计算文本间检索的潜力和认识极限。 我们不把学术说明视为详尽无遗或示范产出作为发现,而是提议将检索模型作为热力共读器,收回有记录的参考文献,并为专家领导的密切阅读提供候选人。

articles.title: Scaling Long-Form Story Generation via Narrative State Tracking
articles.content: LLMs have demonstrated strong capabilities in creative writing. However, scaling them to full-length novels remains challenging, as maintaining narrative consistency becomes increasingly difficult. Existing story-generation methods typically focus on stories of up to about ten thousand words, leaving their ability to scale to full-length novels underexplored. In this work, we introduce Narrative State Tracking Agent (NstAgent), a training-free agentic framework that allows LLMs to track a structured narrative state including characters, past events and future requirements. We extend an existing benchmark to compare narrative consistency across lengths, and use it together with a writing-quality benchmark to systematically evaluate stories ranging from 10K to 100K words. We show that NstAgent achieves better narrative consistency and writing quality as stories grow longer, and neither of them degrades noticeably as length increases, suggesting that it provides an effective approach to scaling story generation toward full-length novels.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过叙述式国家跟踪扩展长格式故事生成
articles.content_zh: 法学硕士在创造性写作方面表现出了强大的能力。 然而,将其推广到全长小说仍然具有挑战性,因为保持叙事一致性越来越困难. 现有的故事生成方法一般侧重于多达约一万字的故事,而其规模化的能力则被低估为全长小说. 在这项工作中,我们介绍了叙述性国家跟踪代理(NstAgent),这是一个无培训代理框架,它允许LLMs跟踪一个结构化的叙述性状态,包括人物,过去的事件和未来的要求. 我们扩展了一个现有的基准,以比较不同长度的叙述一致性,并连同一个写作质量的基准,系统地评价从10K到100K字的故事。 我们显示NstAgent随着故事的长篇增长,实现了更好的叙事一致性和写作质量,两个故事都没有随着长度的增大而明显退化,这表明它提供了一个有效的方法,将故事生成扩展到全长小说.

articles.title: How to Loop MoE: Flatten the Experts, Untie the Attention
articles.content: Looped Transformers reuse one block of layers several times: by spending extra computation they push a model of fixed size further, and so use its parameters more fully; while sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models activate only a few of many experts for each token. Looped MoE bridges these two design philosophies and gives MoE models new potential for better expert usage, but it raises a question: how to loop a MoE? We answer it with Foil. With the expert parameters and the expert compute per token held fixed, Foil (1) flattens the experts, halving the expert layers, doubling the experts per layer and doubling the passes, so that every routing decision chooses from a larger pool, and (2) unties the attention, giving each pass its own attention parameters while the experts and routers stay shared. Experiments show that Foil clearly outperforms the unflattened looped baseline: at 20B tokens every Foil model has lower pretraining loss than the baseline; at 100B tokens the loss improves monotonically with the degree of flattening, the most flattened Foil ending 0.012 nat below the baseline at equal parameters and compute, with downstream accuracy on par or better; untying the attention also yields more balanced and more confident routing at equal shape. Our ablations analyse why Foil works and turn the findings into design guidance for looped MoE: the returns of looping and of widening the expert layers amplify each other, routing confidence tracks healthy expert use better than load balance, and a sparse looped MoE should therefore use more experts per layer and more passes. Code and configurations are available at https://github.com/SR-A-W/how-to-loop-moe.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 如何循环 MoE: 平整专家,解开注意力
articles.content_zh: 循环变压器多次重复使用一层:通过额外计算,它们将固定大小的模型推得更远,因此更充分地使用其参数;而稀有的混合专家模型则只激活了众多专家中的少数,用于每个符号. 循环的MOE连接了这两种设计哲学,并给MOE模型提供了更好的专家使用的新潜力,但它提出了一个问题:如何循环一个MOE? 我们用Foil来回答 随着专家参数和专家计算每件信物固定,Foil (1)将专家平分,专家层减半,每层专家翻一番,通行证翻一番,使每个路由决定都从更大的池中选择,(2)解开注意力,让每个专家在专家和路由器保持共享时,各自通过自己的关注参数. 实验显示,Foil明显优于未膨胀的循环基线:在20B令牌上,每个Foil模型的预训损失比基线低;在100B令牌上,损失单调改善,平整程度,最平整的Foil以等参数和计算结果低于基线0.012纳特,下游精度在平方或更好;不附带注意也产生更平衡和更自信的等形状的路由. 我们分析Foil工作的原因, 将结果变成环化部的设计指南: 环化和拓宽专家层的回报相互放大, 路径信任轨迹健康的专家使用优于负载平衡, 代码和配置见https://github.com/SR-A-W/how-to-loop-moe。

articles.title: Towards Communication-Efficient Social Intelligence in Language Agents
articles.content: Socially intelligent language agents must negotiate, coordinate, and resolve conflicting preferences while respecting the time and attention of both participants. Balancing these demands is challenging because agents must convey enough to address a partner's constraints and advance their goals without adding words that do not help the interaction. In this paper, we propose Teacher-Assisted Communication Training (TACT) to improve social goal attainment while reducing communication cost, making interactions with agents more productive and less demanding. We first characterize communication efficiency in terms of action strategy and expression, whose effects extend beyond the current utterance to the partner's response and subsequent exchanges. We design TACT to revise student-generated actions, test the revisions through partner responses, and distill useful feedback into the student. An expression specialist removes unnecessary detail while preserving the intended action, while a strategy specialist proposes alternatives that may better address the partner's constraints. To determine which revision helps, TACT samples a partner response for each candidate and selects a teacher reference by balancing local goal support against action-token cost. That reference guides on-policy distillation on the student's own generation prefixes, allowing the student to act independently at deployment. We evaluate TACT on SOTOPIA and AgentSense. On SOTOPIA, it achieves the highest Goal among the evaluated methods on All and Hard while using substantially fewer target tokens than SFT+SDPO. On AgentSense, it improves goal success over the initial student while reducing target tokens and interaction messages.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 争取语言代理人的交流和有效社会情报
articles.content_zh: 具有社会智慧的语言代理人必须谈判、协调和解决相互冲突的偏好,同时尊重两个参与者的时间和注意力。 平衡这些需求具有挑战性,因为代理人必须充分传达,以解决合作伙伴的制约因素,推进其目标,而不增加无助于互动的词语。 在本文中,我们提议教师辅助通信培训,以提高社会目标的实现,同时降低通信成本,使与代理人的互动更具生产力,降低要求。 我们首先从行动战略和表达角度来描述通信效率,其影响超越了目前对伙伴的反应和随后的交流的表达。 我们设计TACT来修改学生产生的行动,通过合作伙伴的回应来测试修改,并将有用的反馈反馈给学生. 一名表达专家在保留预定行动的同时删除不必要的细节,而一名战略专家则提出其他办法,以更好地解决伙伴的制约因素。 为了确定哪些修订有帮助,TACT对每个候选人的合作伙伴反应进行了抽样,并通过平衡当地目标支持与行动成本来选择教师参考。 该参考指南对学生自己的一代前缀进行了政策提炼,使学生能够在部署时独立行动。 我们对SOTOPIA和SENSENSE的TACT进行评估. 在SOTOPIA上,它实现了All and Hard评价方法中的最高目标,同时使用的目标符号比SFT+SDPO少得多。 在AgentSense上,它比初学者提高了目标成功率,同时减少了目标符号和交互消息.

articles.title: Improving Test-Time Scaling with Adaptive Looped Transformers
articles.content: Looped transformers have demonstrated promising parameter efficiency by reusing layers for latent computation. Prior studies compare looped and non-looped models at matched parameters or per-token FLOPs. However, to the best of our knowledge, whether looping improves test-time scaling as outputs grow longer remains underexplored. Through post-training looped transformers, we study the accuracy-compute slope, measured as the accuracy gain per doubling of test-time decoding FLOPs. We find that existing looped transformers often yield steeper slopes than their non-looped baseline, yet underperform it at matched compute. While fixed-depth looping spends extra iterations on every token, our analysis shows that many tokens do not benefit from extra iterations. We therefore propose TaH2, which enables the model to focus extra iterations on the tokens that benefit from looping. It jointly post-trains the backbone and an iteration decider through lookahead depth supervision, which uses online labels indicating whether further iteration improves the prediction. TaH2 improves both the efficiency and attainable accuracy of test-time scaling. On challenging AIME benchmarks, TaH2 improves the accuracy-compute slope by 53% (2.74 vs. 1.79) over the non-looped baseline, exceeding the baseline's peak accuracy by about 3.4 points at matched test-time compute. As the maximum iteration depth increases, existing looped models largely plateau, while TaH2's gain over the non-looped baseline continues to grow from +2.8 points at depth 2 to +3.9 points at depth 8. Our code is available at https://github.com/thu-nics/TaH.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 使用可适应循环变换器改进试验时间放大
articles.content_zh: 循环式变压器通过再利用地层进行潜在计算,显示出有希望的参数效率。 先前的研究比较了相匹配参数或每托起的FLOP的循环模型和非螺旋模型. 然而,据我们所知,随着产出增长较长,循环是否改善了试验时间的扩大,仍然没有得到充分利用。 通过训练后回转变压器,我们研究精度计算坡度,以每双倍试验时间解码FLOP的精度增益来计量. 我们发现,现有的环绕式变压器往往产生比其非铁轨基线更陡峭的坡度,但在相匹配计算时却表现不佳. 虽然固定的回旋会花费额外的迭代在每一个代号上,但我们的分析表明,许多代号不会从再迭得到好处. 因此,我们提议采用TaH2,使模型能够把额外迭代的焦点集中在从循环中受益的代号上。 它通过望头深度监督将主干线和迭代决定器连接起来,使用在线标签表示再迭是否改善了预测. TaH2提高了测试时间缩放的效率和可达到的准确性. 在挑战AIME基准时,TaH2将精度计算坡度提高了53%(2.74对1.79),超过了非用铁基准,在匹配的试验时间计算时,超过基准峰值精度约3.4分. 随着最大迭接深度的增大,已存在的环绕模型基本处于高原状态,而TaH2在非铁轨基线上的收益继续从深度2的+2.8点增长到深度8的+3.9点. 我们的代码见https://github.com/thu-nics/TaH。

articles.title: Shockingly Simple Self-retrospection Improves Agentic Models Without RL
articles.content: People learn not only by repeating successful actions, but also by recounting and explaining their experiences, revising their understanding to guide future behavior. Can a language-model agent improve its future actions by training only on explanations of its own experience? We investigate this question by studying Retrospection-Only Fine-Tuning (ROFT), a minimal online procedure designed to isolate the effect of explanation-only training on subsequent behavior. The agent attempts a task, observes available feedback, generates a retrospective explanation, and is fine-tuned with a next-token prediction loss on the explanation tokens alone. The procedure uses neither an external teacher nor a reward-based policy update. In software-engineering experiments with Qwen3.5-4B, ROFT is trained on problems with mixed successful and unsuccessful base-model attempts. On held-out SWE-bench Verified and Pro, it reaches 49.2% and 26.8% solve rates after 20 updates without using a verifier, compared with GRPO's 48.0% and 25.3% after 40 updates in the evaluated runs, and makes faster early progress in training time and sampled attempts. It also learns to solve individual tasks on which all 64 sampled base-model attempts failed, showing that learning can begin without any initially successful trajectories. Behavioral analyses find that ROFT indirectly assigns credit to actions, encouraging good actions and discouraging incorrect ones. Moreover, prompting retrospections to emphasize more direct solutions yields shorter subsequent attempts even without an explicit length penalty. Together, these findings show that learning to explain can also improve learning to do, establishing self-generated retrospections as useful training targets and motivating further study of explanation-to-action transfer.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 令人震惊的简单自我回顾改进了无RL的代理模型
articles.content_zh: 人们不仅通过重复成功的行动来学习,而且还通过叙述和解释他们的经验来学习,修改他们的理解来指导未来的行为. 一个语言模式代理人能否通过只就自身经验的解释进行培训来改进其今后的行动? 我们通过研究回想-只有精细的通灵(ROFT)来调查这个问题,这是一条最低限度的在线程序,旨在隔离只有解释的训练对后续行为的影响. 代理试图完成一项任务,观察可获得的反馈,产生回溯性解释,并且仅用解释符上下接的预测损失进行微调. 该程序既不使用外部教师,也不使用基于奖励的政策更新。 在使用Quen3.5-4B的软件工程实验中,ROFT接受了关于混合成功和不成功的基础模型尝试的问题的培训. 在被搁置的SWE-bench验证和Pro上,在20次更新后,未使用验证器就达到了49.2%和26.8%的解析率,而GRPO的48.0%和在40次更新后的25.3%在经过评估的运行中,在培训时间和抽样尝试中取得了更快的早期进展。 它还学习解决所有64个抽样的基建模型尝试都失败的单个任务,表明学习可以在没有任何最初成功的轨迹的情况下开始. 行为分析发现,ROFT间接地将功劳归于行动,鼓励好的行动并阻止错误的行动. 此外,促使人们回顾,强调更直接的解决办法,即使没有明确的期限处罚,也会缩短其后的尝试。 这些调查结果共同表明,学习解释也可以改进学习做的工作,将自我产生的回顾作为有用的培训目标,并激励进一步研究解释到行动转移。

articles.title: Harness Learning Enables Generalizable Test-Time Adaptation
articles.content: A language-model agent is jointly defined by its model and its harness, the executable program that organizes model calls, tool use, and information flow. Because different tasks call for different ways of organizing these operations, the harness needs to be adapted using feedback from the task at hand. We introduce harness learning, which trains a proposer model to revise a solver's harness using execution feedback. We formulate this process as meta-learning over executable programs, with harness revisions playing the role of weight updates in gradient-based adaptation. We train the proposer with reinforcement learning, using the task performance of revised harnesses as the reward. At test time, the proposer uses feedback from successive executions on a new task to refine the harness, without performing any parameter-space update. Experiments on reasoning and multi-hop question answering show that harness learning improves revision quality and that the ability to adapt at test time transfers to unseen tasks. Policies trained on individual revisions can continue improving harnesses over multiple rounds, while the benefits of training on revision sequences vary across settings. These findings suggest a path towards continually learning agents that turn accumulated experience into generalizable improvements.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 策略学习启用通用 试验时间适应
articles.content_zh: 语言-模型代理由它的模型和它的取用,组织模型调用,工具使用和信息流的可执行程序共同定义. 由于不同的任务要求以不同的方式组织这些操作,需要利用手头任务反馈来调整这种操纵. 我们引入了“拉带学习”,它训练一个提议者模型,利用执行反馈来修正“解决者”的拉带。 我们把这一进程发展成为元学习,而不是可执行方案,利用修订在以梯度为基础的适应中起到重量更新的作用。 我们通过强化学习来训练求婚者,利用订正后的工作表现作为奖励。 在测试时,提议者使用相继被处决的反馈,对新任务进行精炼,而无需进行任何参数-空间更新. 关于推理和多跳问题回答的实验表明,利用学习可以提高修订质量,在测试时能够适应隐形任务. 个别修订培训的政策可以继续通过多轮培训改进,而修订序列培训的好处则因环境而异。 这些调查结果表明,要向不断学习的代理人走出一条道路,把所积累的经验变成普遍的改进。

articles.title: Reinforcing Agentic Creativity in Scientific Ideation with Night Science
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) excel at structured, verifiable tasks, but their low-entropy bias can produce homogeneous and predictable outputs, limiting their utility for open-ended scientific ideation. Effective discovery, however, spans a broader creative spectrum: from structured day science to loosely structured, serendipitous night science that reaches ideas beyond those typically considered. We introduce AI Night-Scientist, an agentic framework that uses reinforcement learning to teach models when and how to depart from predictable reasoning. Grounded in cognitive science, we model creativity along three axes: action (what to do and how creatively), process (when to explore versus exploit), and outcome (the novelty and usefulness of the resulting idea). We use these axes to train models with GRPO, exposing them to varying degrees and forms of creativity throughout training. This produces substantially more diverse scientific proposals, expanding the range of research directions by 27.8% and contribution types by 14.9% over the base model. It also improves predicted citation impact by up to 32.0 percentage points and originality by 66.2 points. These gains cannot be reproduced by simply increasing decoding temperature; instead, we find that semantic guidance specifying what kind of creativity to pursue is critical. Overall, our results suggest that creativity is a learnable, multi-level ability that can be shaped to help researchers reach ideas beyond those typically explored by LLMs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 以夜科学加强科学创意
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)在结构化,可核查的任务上表现优异,但其低通向性偏差可以产生同质和可预期的输出,限制了其对开放式科学思想的用能. 然而,有效的发现涵盖更广泛的创造性范围:从结构化的日间科学到结构松散的、隐蔽的夜科学,其影响范围超出了通常考虑的范围。 我们介绍AI Night-Scientist,这是一个代理框架,利用强化学习来教导模型何时以及如何偏离可预测的推理. 基于认知科学,我们按照三个轴心来模拟创造力:行动(做什么和如何创造性),过程(何时去探索与开发)和结果(由此产生的思想的新颖性和实用性). 我们用这些轴线用GRPO来训练模型,在整个训练中以不同程度和形式暴露出他们的创造力. 这产生了更加多样化的科学建议,使研究方向的范围比基准模型扩大了27.8%,贡献类型扩大了14.9%。 它还将预测的引用影响提高了32.0个百分点并增加了66.2个百分点。 这些成果不能仅仅通过增加解码温度来复制;相反,我们认为,语义指导规定要追求何种创造性是至关重要的。 总体而言,我们的结果表明,创造力是一种可学习的多层次能力,可以塑造这种能力,帮助研究人员超越通常由LLMs探索的想法。

articles.title: Rethinking Personalized Generation: Test-Time Alignment via Factorized Ranking Models
articles.content: Aligning large language models (LLMs) to diverse user preferences is fundamentally hindered by standard alignment paradigms that optimize for monolithic users. In this work, empirical studies are first used to reveal the existence of a massive, untapped performance headroom for personalized generation through test-time alignment. We demonstrate that personalized generation is uniquely suited for test-time scaling methods like Best-of-N (BoN) because it can be viewed primarily as a candidate matching problem rather than a generator capability bottleneck. While reward models could in principle exploit this headroom, they are poorly calibrated for personalization, and their billion-parameter scale makes scoring large candidate pools prohibitively expensive. To overcome this limitation, we propose a parameter-efficient framework utilizing million-parameter scale multi-layer perceptron (MLP) ranking models. Our personalized ranking model directly reuses the internal embeddings of the base generator with minimal overhead. By scaling train-time data to provide fine-grained personalized preferences, this million-parameter ranking model accurately scores large candidate pools and can seamlessly guide generation to reduce the cost of materializing N candidates. Extensive experiments on nine datasets spanning three personalized generation settings show that our personalized ranking model effectively exploits the discovered headroom, outperforming billion-parameter generalist reward models on every dataset, with under 0.4% of their parameters and four orders of magnitude lower scoring latency.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 反思个性化 生成:通过因数分级模型进行测试-时间对齐
articles.content_zh: 将大型语言模型(LLM)与多样化的用户偏好相配合,从根本上阻碍了对单一用户进行优化的标准对接范式. 在这项工作中,经验研究首先用来揭示存在一个大型的,尚未开发的性能主室,通过测试时间对接实现个性化生成. 我们证明,个性化一代特别适合像Best-Of-N(BON)这样的测试时间缩放方法,因为它可以主要被视为一个候选匹配问题,而不是发电机能力瓶颈. 虽然奖励模式原则上可以利用这个头室,但是这些模式对个性化的校准差,其10亿参数的尺度使得大候选人池的评分过于昂贵。 为了克服这一限制,我们建议采用一个参数效率高的框架,利用百万参数尺度的多层能见度(MLP)排名模型。 我们的个性化排位模型直接再利用底部发电机的内部嵌入物,其顶部最低. 通过缩放列车时间数据来提供精细的个性化偏好,这个百万参数的排名模型准确评分了大候选人池,可以无缝地指导生成,以降低实现N候选人的成本. 跨越三个个性化世代设置的9个数据集的广泛实验表明,我们的个性化排名模型有效地利用了被发现的头室,在每一个数据集上表现优于十亿参数的通论奖赏模型,其参数的0.4%以下,分数的分数有四个分级更低.

articles.title: QuanReview: Offline, Auditable Reconciliation of Human and LLM Span Annotations
articles.content: Structured span annotations, such as quantities with their units, uncertainty modifiers, and event classes, are expensive to create and hard to keep trustworthy once language models enter the loop. We present QuanReview, an open-source system for auditing and correcting such annotation layers. QuanReview aligns two annotation streams over the same documents at character level, resolves unambiguous cases by an explicit and logged policy, and routes candidate conflicts to a browser-based adjudication interface where reviewers accept either side, build field-level hybrids, or flag items for re-annotation. A campaign manager assigns documents to multiple annotators with configurable redundancy, computes agreement at document and span level, auto-merges unanimous documents, and exports the corrected layer in the original file format, so that it can replace the original annotation files directly. Applied to a 4,457-record humanitarian benchmark and an LLM extraction stream, the system fully auto-merged 8% of documents, applied automatic policy decisions to a further 1,513 records, and concentrated human attention on 3,131 candidate conflicts, a mean of 5.4 per reviewed document.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 量检:离线,人与LLM的可审计调和
articles.content_zh: 结构化的跨度说明,如带有单位的数量,不确定性修饰符,以及事件类等,在语言模型进入回路后创建成本昂贵并难以保持可信赖性. 我们提出QuanReview,一种开源系统,用于审计和纠正这种注释层。 QuanReview在字符级别上对相同文件进行两个注释流的对接,通过明确和登录的政策解决了不明确的案件,并将候选冲突引导到一个基于浏览器的判断界面,由审查者接受任何一方,构建实地级别的混合体,或标出重新注释的项目. 竞选管理者将文件指派给多个可配置冗余的注释员,在文档和跨层计算协议,自动合并一致的文档,并用原始文件格式导出被更正的层,以便直接替换原始注释文件. 该系统采用4 457个记录的人道主义基准和LLM提取流程,将8%的文件完全自动合并,对另外1 513个记录适用自动政策决定,将人的注意力集中在3 131个候选冲突上,每个审查文件平均5.4个。

articles.title: Tracing the Evolution of Oracle Bone Characters Across Three Millennia
articles.content: Of the approximately 4,500 Oracle Bone Inscription (OBI) characters discovered from the Shang dynasty, only about 1,600 have been deciphered. Many computational approaches compare OBI with glyphs from one historical period at a time. However, during the evolution of Chinese characters, significant structural or semantic changes often occur in uncertain dynasties. A single-period reference may be insufficient when relevant forms change substantially between observed eras. Therefore, we propose the \textbf{Manifold-based Script Evolution Framework (MSEF)}, a framework that models the evolution series (OBI, Bronze, Seal, Clerical, Regular) of Chinese characters as the continual evolution of a manifold space. MSEF represents each character as an era-specific manifold point and learns continuous inter-era transition rules via Neural Ordinary Differential Equations. Both manifold space and transition dynamics can be trained end-to-end through character evolution pairs across any two eras.

articles.title_zh: 追踪三千年来甲骨文字符的演变
