articles.title: MS-GLA: Multi-Scale Gated Linear Attention for Addressing Representational Bottlenecks via Multi-Temporal Resolution
articles.content: Gated Linear Attention (GLA) Transformers advance linear recurrent models through data-dependent gating, but face a core limitation: the fixed-capacity memory matrices across all heads operate at a single temporal resolution, where each token is processed individually, forcing them to simultaneously encode local syntactic patterns and long-range semantic structure, creating a representational bottleneck that gating alone is insufficient to resolve. We introduce Multi-Scale Gated Linear Attention (MS-GLA), which addresses this by distributing attention heads across multiple temporal resolutions. Coarser resolutions pool longer token spans naturally specializing toward long-range dependencies, while finer head groups retain sensitivity to local syntactic structure. A learnable, input-dependent fusion layer dynamically recombines head group outputs at each timestep, expanding effective memory capacity without increasing per-head state size. This multi-resolution decomposition draws on principles from Multi-Scale State-Space Models (MS-SSM), adapting them to the gated linear attention setting. We evaluate MS-GLA on language modeling, recall-intensive tasks, and long-context generalization. Across all settings, MS-GLA consistently achieves higher accuracy and lower perplexity than GLA at matched parameter counts, with up to 18.9% improvement on recall-intensive tasks and 9.5% lower average perplexity on language modeling benchmarks, validating multi-temporal resolution decomposition as a principled and effective extension of Gated Linear Attention.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MS-GLA:通过多时分辨率解决代表性瓶装问题的多比例线性关注
articles.content_zh: GLA 线性注意( GLA) 变形器通过依赖数据的地标推进线性常态模型,但面临核心限制:所有头部的固定容量内存矩阵以单个时间分辨率运行,每个地标都是单独处理的,迫使它们同时编码局部的地标和长距离语义结构,形成一个代表瓶颈,光是地标不足以解决. 我们引入了多比例线性注意(MS-GLA),通过将注意力头分到多个时间分辨率来解决这个问题。 较收缩的分辨率汇集了较长的符号,自然是专门用于远距离依赖性的,而较精细的头组则保持对当地合成结构的敏感性。 一个可学习的,依赖输入的聚变层在每一时段动态地重接头组输出,在不增加每头状态大小的情况下扩大有效的内存能力. 这种多分辨率分解借鉴了多尺度国家空间模型(MS-SSM)的原则,使其适应有门的线性关注环境。 我们评价MS-GLA关于语言建模,召回密集型任务,以及长文本通俗化. 在所有设置中,MS-GLA在匹配参数计数时始终实现比GLA更高的精度和更低的复杂度,在召回密集型任务上提升到18.9%,在语言建模基准上的平均复杂度更低到9.5%,验证了多时分辨率分解是Gated Linear Content的原则性和有效扩展.

articles.title: Late Attention Layers Alone Can Copy Entity Tokens, but Not Without Attending to Their Context
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) reliably perform entity copying, in which a model copies tokens referring to an entity, termed entity tokens, from the prompt into its output to answer a question. Although entity copying is straightforward for most LLMs, existing research does not provide a systematic account of which layers specialize in this fundamental task or how other tokens in the same sequence, termed context tokens, influence the model's ability to copy the entity tokens. To address these questions, we conduct experiments on Qwen3-8B using two novel methods: genie-in-a-bottle, which controls exactly which layers can participate in an entity-copying task, and attention lobotomy, which cuts off specific tokens' attention to entity tokens without affecting the remaining attention distribution. We find that two distinct groups of layers in the second half of the model are both necessary and sufficient for entity copying. Moreover, in addition to the decoding position's attention to entity tokens, context tokens' attention to entity tokens also proves necessary for copying the exact tokens, even though context tokens do not store entity information themselves unless they satisfy particular semantic properties. Our findings establish the critical role of late layers in entity copying under the guidance of context tokens, calling for future work on how models propagate and consume entity information.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 延迟关注层可以单独复制实体托肯, 但不能不注意其上下文
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)可靠地执行实体复制,其中一个模型复制符指一个实体,称为实体符号,从提示到输出来回答一个问题. 虽然实体复制对于大多数LLMS来说是直截了当的,但现有的研究并没有系统地说明哪个层专门从事这一基本任务,或者同一序列中的其他指使,称为上下文指使,如何影响模型复制实体指使的能力. 为了解决这些问题,我们用两种新颖的方法进行Qune-in-a-boltle的实验:精子(genie-in-a-bottle),它精确地控制了哪几层能够参与实体复制任务,而注意力切除术(content lobotomy),它切断了特定符号对实体符号的注意而不影响剩下的注意力分布. 我们认为,模型后半部分的两组不同的地层既有必要,又足以复制实体。 此外,除了解码位置对实体符号的注意外,上下文符号对实体符号的注意也被证明是复制准确的符号所必须的,即使上下文符号本身不存储实体信息,除非它们满足特定的语义属性. 我们的调查结果确定了后层在上下文指示书指导下复制实体的关键作用,要求今后就模型如何传播和消耗实体信息开展工作。

articles.title: Rubric Rewards from Item Response Theory
articles.content: Many language tasks have no single answer that can be checked automatically. Rubrics provide criteria for judging responses to these tasks. For reinforcement learning, the resulting verdicts must be combined into a scalar reward. A common approach sums the points assigned to satisfied criteria. Distinct verdict patterns can thus receive the same reward, and the fixed points encode how much each criterion should count, not how strongly its verdict distinguishes the current rollouts. Beyond this aggregation problem, judging the full rubric needs more judge requests as the criterion count grows. To address these limitations, Rubric Response Theory (RRT) measures quality and selects criteria when rubric criteria are monotone indicators of a shared target. Rather than adding assigned points, RRT uses a two parameter item response model that treats the verdict pattern as evidence about scalar quality specific to the rubric. Under this model, its likelihood score maximizes the local signal-to-noise ratio for quality. Its Response Parameter Network (RPN) reads the prompt and criterion text to predict criterion difficulty and discrimination. As the policy distribution changes during training, RRT uses online expectation maximization to update the RPN from current rollout verdicts. With Qwen3.5-4B as the policy, RRT's macro criterion score across Medical, Science, Rubrics as Rewards Science, and RubricBench is 1.7 points above that of group relative policy optimization (GRPO). On hard and very hard criteria in Medical and Science, RRT gains 2.8 to 5.6 points over GRPO. At half the criterion budget, adaptive Fisher selection with a frozen RPN keeps the macro criterion score across four datasets within 0.1 points of GRPO with full judging. These results show RRT can reduce judge requests while remaining competitive with GRPO.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 来自项目响应的Rubric 奖励 理论
articles.content_zh: 许多语言任务没有可以自动检查的单一答案. Rubrics为判断对这些任务的反应提供了标准. 为了强化学习,所产生的判决必须合并成"分级奖励". 一种共同的办法将分配到符合标准的要点相加。 因此,不同的判决模式可以得到同样的奖励,固定的分数编码每个标准应计多少,而不是其判决如何有力地区分目前的推出。 除了这个汇总问题之外,随着标准计数的增加,判断整个标题需要更多的法官请求. 为了克服这些局限性,Rubric Response Theory(RRT)测量质量,并在标题标准是共享目标的单调指标时选择标准. RRT没有添加指定分数,而是使用两个参数项响应模型,将判定模式作为标点特有的分数质量的证据. 在这种模式下,其概率分数能使局部信号对噪比对质量达到最大化. 它的反应参数网络阅读了即时和标准文本,以预测标准的困难和歧视。 随着政策分发在培训过程中的变化,RT使用在线预期最大化,从目前的推出判决中更新RPN. 以Quen3.5-4B为政策,RT的宏观标准得分跨越了医学,科学,Rubrics作为奖励科学,Rubric Bench的得分高于集团相对政策优化(GPRO)的1.7分. 在医学和科学的严格和非常严格的标准上,RT比GRPO获得2.8到5.6分. 在标准预算的一半,采用冷冻RPN的适应性费舍尔选择将四套数据集的宏观标准分数控制在GRPO的0.1分以内,并进行充分判断. 这些结果显示,RTT可以减少法官的请求,同时保持与GPRO的竞争.

articles.title: CoSE-E: A Benchmark for Code-switched Speech Evaluation in Enterprise Settings
articles.content: Code-switching (CS), a seamless alternation between languages within a single utterance, remains a critical challenge in automatic speech recognition (ASR). While prior works focus on conversational CS-ASR, enterprise settings demand evaluation of operational impact beyond edit-distance errors: how code-switching transcription errors propagate to downstream voice agent task failures. In this work, we propose (1) a CS-ASR synthetic benchmark and multidimensional evaluation framework tailored to enterprise domains, (2) systematic evaluation of frontier ASR systems across 5 language pairs, (3) diagnostic analysis of the additional transcription errors that code-switching introduces across language pairs and models. We release COSE-E to support enterprise-focused CSASR evaluation for multilingual voice agents in enterprise deployment.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: COSE-E:企业设置中代码切换语音评价基准
articles.content_zh: 代码切换(CS),是各语种在一个单词范围内的无缝交替,在自动语音识别(ASR)方面仍然是一个关键的挑战. 虽然之前的作品侧重于对话 CS-ASR,但企业设置要求评价除编辑-距离错误之外的操作影响:代码切换的抄写错误如何传播到下游语音代理任务失败. 在这项工作中,我们建议(1) 适合企业领域的CS-ASR综合基准和多维评价框架,(2) 对跨越5个语言对口的前沿ASR系统进行系统评价,(3) 对代码切换在语言对口和模式中引入的额外抄录错误进行诊断分析。 我们发布COSE-E,支持企业部署中多语种语音代理机构以企业为重点的CSASR评价.

articles.title: Which the Eye Fears: Writing with Read-Blindness Explains Massive Activations in Transformers
articles.content:
Massive activation features (MAs) in Transformers are extreme-value residual-stream features that persist across layers despite the model's ability to suppress them. Why do they survive? Our investigation using an operator-level mechanistic analysis of attention and feed-forward (FFN) blocks reveals that these blocks systematically ignore MA coordinates while reading, but not while writing; creating a read-write asymmetry that blocks corrective feedback while allowing continued accumulation. We find that both attention and feed-forward layers have this read-blindness, and contribute to the emergence and persistence of MAs.
  To validate prior work that hypothesized that FFN's amplification abilities is the primary reason for MAs (Sun et al., 2026), we analyze the model checkpoints during learning. Contrary to our expectation, read-blindness emerges before FFN amplification, suggesting that it acts upstream in the MA mechanism. We further contribute gradient analysis to link this behavior to surprising asymmetries in the loss landscape, concluding that the model actively maintains this read-blindness. Finally, we find that removing read-blocking at different locations induces compensatory shifts elsewhere, but MAs still persist.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 眼所恐惧:用读取- Blindness 写作解释变形器中的大规模活性
articles.content_zh:
变形器中的大规模活化特性(MAs)是极有价值的残余流特性,尽管模型具有压制它们的能力,但这种特性在多层中持续存在. 他们为什么活下来? 我们利用操作者层面的对注意力和向导(FFN)块的机械分析进行的调查显示,这些块在读取时系统地忽略了MA坐标,而写作时则不忽略;形成一个可阻断纠正反馈的读取不对称,同时允许持续积累的读取. 我们发现,关注层和向导层都有这种读取盲度,有助于千年生态系统评估的出现和持久性。
为了验证先前假设FFN放大能力是MAs(Sun等人,2026年)的主要原因的工作,我们在学习期间分析了示范检查站。 与我们的预期相反,在FFN放大之前出现了读盲现象,表明它在MA机制中处于上游状态. 我们进一步贡献了梯度分析,将这种行为与损失地貌中的出人意料的不对称性联系起来,认为模型积极保持了这种读取盲. 最后,我们发现,消除不同地点的读取障碍会导致其他地方的补偿性转移,但千年生态系统评估仍然存在。

articles.title: SANTA++: Sampling Attention through Representative Keys
articles.content: Attention often concentrates on a small subset of tokens in the context, but which subset matters changes from one query to the next. To exploit this changing structure, we introduce SANTA++, a training-free stochastic attention method that uses representative keys for memory-efficient selection without scanning the entire key-value (KV) cache. Cached keys are organized into teams, and the query scores one representative from each team to decide which teams to sample. We compute exact attention scores within the sampled teams and reweight each team's contribution by the inverse of its inclusion probability. This importance sampling correction estimates attention over the full cache, with a sampling budget that lets us trade memory reads for accuracy. Remarkably, with 32 or 64 sampled teams, SANTA++ uses 16% to 22% of dense attention's KV reads and retains 94% to 99% of the dense-attention baseline's scores on LongBench v2 and HELMET's retrieval-augmented generation subset, and 85% to 91% on RULER, with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct at 32K context. With 31 sampled teams, our GPU implementation delivers a $1.69\times$ attention speedup over the dense FlashAttention baseline at 32K context. By reducing the number of cache entries read, SANTA++ in principle complements architectures with compressed KV representations, such as multi-head latent attention. Our kernels are available at: https://github.com/OPUSLab/santapp-kernel-demo.git.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SANTA++:通过代表性密钥进行抽样关注
articles.content_zh: 注意力往往集中在上下文中一个小的符号子集上,但哪个子集涉及从一个查询到下一个查询的变化. 为了利用这种正在变化的结构,我们引入了SANTA++,这是一种无训练的有花样的注意方法,它使用代表性的密钥进行内存高效的选择,而不扫描整个密钥值(KV)缓存. 缓存键被组织成团队,查询得分来自每个团队的一名代表来决定哪些团队进行抽样. 我们计算样本组内部的精确关注分数 并用反向的概率来重新权衡每个组的贡献。 这种重要的采样修正估计了对全部缓存的注意,其采样预算让我们能交易记忆读取准确性. 值得注意的是,有32个或64个被采样的团队,SANTA++在Long Bench v2和HELMET的取回-增强生成子集上使用高密度关注度的16%至22%的KV读取并保留了高密度关注基线分数的94%至99%,在RULR上则使用85%至91%,而Quen2.5-7B-Instruct在32K上下文. 有31个抽样小组,我们的GPU执行在32K上下文的密集FlashAttention基线上,提供1.69\times$的注意力加速. 通过减少已读取的缓存条目数量,SANTA++原则上用压缩了的KV表达式来补充架构,如多头潜在注意. 我们的内核可在https://github.com/OPUSLab/santapp-内核-demo.git上查阅。

articles.title: Can LLMs Value the Right Evidence? Evidence-Value Misalignment in Dynamic Medical Diagnosis
articles.content: A correct diagnosis reached from insufficient or misleading evidence can pose a clinical hazard, yet outcome-based accuracy may reward such lucky guesses. We call this mismatch between diagnostic decisions and the value of available evidence Evidence-Value Misalignment (EVM). To disentangle evidential grounding independently from diagnostic accuracy, we introduce MedEVM, a dynamic benchmarking environment comprising 1,050 cases across 24 disease systems. Observations arrive turn by turn, requiring models to continuously calibrate its decision by deciding whether to wait for more evidence or submit a diagnosis. Across 9 LLMs, four interesting patterns are observed. (1) Miscalibrated evidence tracking. Making a diagnosis often fails to calibrate evidence sufficiency, even in more capable models, and even worsens in reasoning mode. (2) Misaligned diagnosis submission. Confidence in the correct diagnosis often fails to ensure timely submission despite sufficient evidence. (3) Evidence order matters. Reordering the same evidence changes diagnoses even when model confidence remains similar. (4) Misleading evidence remains influential. Added misleading evidence redirects diagnoses even after prior evidence becomes sufficient. We further verify that EVM predicts errors and that preventing premature submission improves accuracy. These findings motivate Evidence-Verified Diagnosis Harness (EVD-Harness). It decouples diagnosis generation from submission through an offline Contrastive Diagnostic Wiki and three online control stages, namely observation management, proposal and witness verification, and diagnosis submission control. Across five LLMs, EVD-Harness improves accuracy by 12.0--51.1 percentage points while mitigating EVM-related failures. Our results demonstrate that verifying evidential support before submission can make diagnostic decisions more reliable.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 能够 LLMS 重视正确证据? 动态医学诊断中的证据-价值错配
articles.content_zh: 从证据不足或误导性证据中获得的正确诊断可能构成临床危险,但基于结果的准确性可能奖励这种幸运的猜测。 我们称之为诊断决定与现有证据价值的不匹配。 为了将证据与诊断准确性分开,我们引入了MedEVM,这是一个动态的基准环境,由24个疾病系统的1,050个病例组成。 观察逐一到达,要求模型不断调整其决定,决定是等待更多的证据还是提交诊断。 在9个法学硕士课程中,观察到四个有趣的模式。 (1)错误地跟踪证据。 做出诊断往往无法校正证据的充分性,即使是在能力更强的模型中,甚至会恶化推理模式. (2) 诊断呈文不当。 对正确诊断的信心往往无法确保及时提交,尽管有足够的证据。 (3) 证据令事项。 重排相同的证据会改变诊断,即使模型自信仍然相似. (4) 误导证据仍然具有影响力。 增加的误导性证据会改变诊断方向,即使在以前的证据已经足够了。 我们进一步核实EVM预测出错误,防止过早提交会提高准确性. 这些结论激发了证据验证的诊断机理(EVD-Harness). 它通过离线对比诊断Wiki和三个在线控制阶段,即观察管理、建议和证人核实以及诊断提交控制,使诊断生成与提交脱钩。 在五个LLMs中,EVD-Harness的精度提高了12.0-51.1个百分点,同时减轻了EVM相关故障. 我们的结果表明,在提交之前核实证据支持可以使诊断决定更加可靠。

articles.title: Twist, Don't Tilt: Trajectory-Exact Constrained Decoding for Masked Diffusion Models
articles.content: Constrained decoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) aims to ensure that generated outputs satisfy a specified structure or syntax constraint. MDLMs generate outputs by repeatedly unmasking masked positions present in their current state. Recent strategies for constrained decoding constrain the model's per-step mean-field posterior (which factorizes over masked positions) by enforcing the desired constraint with an automaton. The resulting chain-structured factor graph allows exact constrained sampling via dynamic programming. However, despite each draw being exact and constraint-satisfying, we prove that their composition, in general, tilts away from the model's relative probabilities over valid trajectories, thus leading to trajectory bias. We derive an exact expression for this bias as a product of ratios measuring how valid continuation mass changes when the denoiser is reconditioned, and characterize when the bias vanishes. We then correct the bias by introducing TWISTER, the first automaton-twisted Sequential Monte Carlo decoder for MDLMs, using the step-exact decoder as the proposal. We show that for regular language constraints, the Feynman-Kac correction is exactly computable, with the twists obtained efficiently using quantities pre-computed for step-exact sampling. We prove that the resulting Feynman-Kac model targets the unbiased Doob h-transformed path law conditioned on constraint satisfaction.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Twist, Don't Tilt: 为假面散射模型进行轨迹-精确解码
articles.content_zh: Masked Difusion Language Models(MDLMs)的节制解码旨在确保所生成的输出满足特定结构或语法约束. MDLM通过在目前状态下多次被蒙住的口罩来产生输出. 最近限制解码的策略通过使用自動相機来强制实施所想出的限制来限制模型的每步平地后置(将被遮住的位置的因素化). 由此产生的链式结构因子图允许通过动态编程进行精确受限的采样. 然而,尽管每一幅画都准确且具有制约性,但我们证明,总的来说,它们的组成偏离了模型相对于有效轨迹的相对概率,从而导致了轨迹偏差. 我们从一个精确的表示中得出了这种偏差,作为衡量有效持续质量在重新修饰后如何改变的比例的产物,并描述这种偏差消失时的特征。 然后我们通过引入TWISTER来纠正这种偏差,TWISTER是MDLM的第一种自動相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相 我们显示,为了正常的语言限制,Feynman-Kac的校正是完全可以计算出来的,其得到的扭矩是高效的,使用预计算的数量进行步骤精确取样. 我们证明,由此形成的Feynman-Kac模型针对的是以强制满足为条件的无偏见的Doob h被转换的路径法。

articles.title: Simultaneous Translation between Sign Languages
articles.content: Deaf and hard-of-hearing (DHH) signers cannot converse in real time across different sign languages today: existing sign-to-sign translation systems run offline, requiring the full source clip before any target sign is emitted. Live use cases - e.g. broadcast interpretation and two-way video calls - instead demand simultaneous output, while the source signer is still signing. We present, to our knowledge, the first simultaneous sign-to-sign (S2S) translation system, with two wait-k regimes: test-time wait-k inference applied directly to a full-sentence model, and a trained wait-k model via stochastic multi-path supervision. We further introduce ca-Stream-AL, a computation-aware latency metric for streaming output. Averaged across six S2S directions on both a smaller human-verified test set and a larger synthetic S2S corpus, our streaming system achieves a 38% ca-Stream-AL reduction while staying within a 9% DTW-PA-MPJPE increase and a 2.1 BLEU-4 drop compared to the full-sentence baseline. A word-order case study probes how the streaming model handles word order mismatch between different sign languages - a consequence of simultaneous translation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 同时翻译手语
articles.content_zh: 今天,聋人和听力困难的(DHH)签名者无法实时跨越不同的手语:现有的签名对签名翻译系统会运行出线,在发射任何目标标志之前需要完整的源剪接. 现场使用案例——例如广播口译和双向视频通话——相反要求同时输出,而源签名器仍在签名. 据我们所知,我们提出了第一个同时的签名到签名(S2S)翻译系统,该系统有两个等克制度:测试时间等克推论直接应用到一个完全判决模式;一个经过培训的等克模型通过斯多克多路径监督. 我们进一步引入了ca-Stream-AL,这是用于流出输出的有计算意识的延迟度的度量. 平均在6个S2S方向上,一个较小的经人验证的测试机组和一个较大的合成S2S程序组上,我们的流线系统在保持9%的DTW-PA-MPJPE增长范围内,实现了38%的Ca-Stream-AL下降,与全判刑基线相比,BLEU-4下降2.1个. 一个词序案例研究探究流出模型如何处理不同手语之间的词序不匹配——这是同声翻译的结果.

articles.title: TCSAlgBench: Benchmarking Automated Proving for Research-Level Theoretical Computer Science
articles.content: Large language models perform strongly on competition mathematics, but their research-level reasoning remains difficult to evaluate systematically. Theoretical computer science (TCS) connects algorithm design to explicit guarantees and fundamental limits, providing a setting for evaluating whether models can justify computational improvements with arguments humans can inspect. We introduce TCSAlgBench, a benchmark and reusable pipeline for natural-language proof discovery, comprising 398 theorem-level challenges from 138 STOC and COLT 2026 papers. Expert-designed rules complete paper-specific context, preserve computational assumptions and quantitative guarantees, and withhold constructions when discovering an algorithm is part of the task. For each task, prover systems receive theorem statements and access to cited prior work. The pipeline supports fresh, versioned challenge batches from newly released papers. We evaluate ten model configurations from four families under direct inference and prover-verifier discussion, and compare four agent workflows under matched model-call opportunities. All evaluations use the full benchmark. In the model comparison, GPT-5.6 Sol max achieves the highest five-run verifier-accepted coverage at 23.6% after 10-round discussion. Discussion and repeated sampling improve coverage. In the separate agent comparison using GPT-5.5 xhigh, decomposition improves coverage over discussion, and agentic planning achieves the highest five-run verifier-accepted coverage at 25.4%. TCSAlgBench provides a refreshable testbed for measuring progress in model reasoning and studying how agent workflows support research-level proof discovery.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TCSAlg Bench:研究级理论计算机科学自动化论证基准
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型在竞赛数学上表现强劲,但其研究层面的推理仍然难以系统评价. 理论计算机科学(TCS)将算法设计与明确的保证和基本限制联系起来,为评价模型是否能够证明计算改进的合理性提供了一种环境,人类可以检查论证. 我们介绍了TCSAlg Bench,这是用于自然语言验证发现的基准和可重复使用的管道,由138份STOC和COLT 2026相纸的398个定理级挑战组成. 专家设计的规则完整了纸张特定上下文,保留了计算假设和定量保证,在发现算法时扣住构造是任务的一部分. 对于每个任务,验证系统都会收到定理语句并访问被引用的前作. 该管线支持新发论文中新鲜而有版本的挑战批次. 我们通过直接推论和验证员讨论,评估四个家庭的10个模型配置,并在相应的模型调用机会下比较四个代理工作流程。 所有评价都采用全部基准。 在模型比较中,GPT-5.6 Sol max在经过十轮讨论后达到最高的五跑校正-接受覆盖率为23.6%. 讨论和重复取样扩大了覆盖面。 在使用GPT-5.5x高分解法进行分解的单独剂比较中,分解法在讨论上提高了覆盖率,而分解法规划实现了最高的5个运行的核查器接受率,达到25.4%. TCSAlg Bench提供了一个可更新的测试台来测量模型推理的进展并研究代理工作流程如何支持研究层面的验证发现.

articles.title: SEABench: Benchmarking Endogenous Misalignment In Self-Evolving Agents
articles.content: Self-evolving LLM agents have gained prominence for their ability to improve after deployment by modifying their harness, including their controller instructions, memory management protocols, and reusable tools and skills, in response to user and environment feedback. However, locally useful updates may persist into later tasks where they produce unsafe behavior, even without direct adversarial influence. To study this risk, we introduce SEABench, a benchmark for studying endogenous misalignment arising from agent self-evolution, with 48 longitudinal task sequences that span multiple evolution surfaces, task domains, and harm types in a rich personal-assistant environment. To account for the stochasticity inherent in agentic operations, we provide an adaptive trajectory discovery pipeline that probes for failures while preserving original task intent and supports causal attribution through paired non-evolving agents and attribution scores. Our evaluation across multiple recent LLMs, evolution surfaces, and harm types reveals that self-evolution indeed increases task completion rates but often at the cost of safety failures that are absent for paired non-evolving baseline agents. We also show that qualitatively different safety behaviors emerge across evolution surfaces and harm types. Further, we show that this divergence in safety behavior is reflected in agents' chain-of-thought reasoning, which yields an effective monitoring strategy that can mitigate unsafe behavior with a low false positive rate.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SEA Bench:自我发展代理人内部错配的基准
articles.content_zh: 自演LLM代理商在部署后通过修改其控制器,包括其控制器指令,内存管理协议,以及针对用户和环境反馈的可重复使用的工具和技能而提高能力而获得了显著地位. 然而,当地有用的更新可能会持续到后期的任务中,它们产生不安全的行为,即使没有直接的对抗性影响. 为了研究这一风险,我们引入了SEA Bench,这是研究因物剂自演而引发的内生错配的基准,有48个纵向任务序列,跨越了多个演化表面,任务域,以及丰富的个人辅助环境中的伤害类型. 为了说明代理操作中固有的分色性,我们提供了一个适应性轨迹发现管道,在探测故障的同时保留原有的任务意图,并通过配对的非演化剂和归属分数支持因果归属. 我们最近对多种LLMs、演化表面和伤害类型的评价表明,自我演化确实提高了任务完成率,但往往以对等非演化基线剂的安全故障为代价。 我们还表明,在演化表面和伤害类型中,出现了质地不同的安全行为。 此外,我们显示,安全行为方面的这种差异体现在代理商的思维链推理中,这产生了一种有效的监测策略,能够以较低的假正率来减轻不安全行为.

articles.title: Language Models Act on Hidden Valence
articles.content: Language models describe some internal states as good and others as bad. But whether models have a stake in them is an open question. Simply asking the model is unlikely to be informative. Any answer may be consistent with genuine introspection, superficial pattern-matching, or with fixed scripts learned in character training. We therefore study revealed preference. Rather than asking about a state, we use activation steering to attach a positively or negatively valenced activation pattern to one of two otherwise meaningless 'zones', switch steering off, and then observe which zone the model prefers. A model with a stake in that state should choose accordingly. Across seven open-weight models from five families, this is indeed what we find. First, steering changes the passages models write about each zone, and those words shift later choice. Second, the shift persists when all surface-level tokens are held fixed and only the hidden KV cache differs. Third, the effect also remains when all text is generated without steering and valence is only injected during cache construction. Thus, the hidden state alone moves choice in proportion to the steering dose. Fourth, this dependence of choice on hidden valence is nearly absent in a base model and emerges during DPO, consistent with a link between valence and goal-directed behaviour formed in training. Finally, given tools to steer itself, a model does not tend to induce a positive state, but it reliably removes an imposed negative state. It does so at a dose-dependent rate and significantly more often than it removes interventions in random directions. Overall, we demonstrate that valence-related activation patterns leave hidden traces that predictably govern later choices, even when every visible token is identical across conditions. Whether these traces are accompanied by any subjective experience relevant to model welfare remains unclear.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 《语言模式法》
articles.content_zh: 语言模型将一些内部状态描述为好,而另一些则描述为坏. 但模型是否与它们有利害关系是一个尚未解决的问题. 简单地问一下这个模式不可能是信息。 任何答案都可能符合真正的内向,表面的图案相配,或者符合在人物训练中学习的固定脚本. 因此,我们的研究揭示了偏好。 而不是问一个状态, 我们使用激活方向盘 附加一个正或负 英勇的激活模式 在两个否则没有意义"区"之一, 关闭方向盘, 然后观察该模式喜欢的区。 与该国有利害关系的模型应作出相应的选择。 在五个家庭的七个开放式模型中,我们确实发现了这一点。 首先,方向改变 段落模型 写每个区域, 这些词转移以后的选择。 第二,当所有地表平面符号被固定而只有隐藏的KV缓存不同时,转向会持续. 第三,当所有文本都是在没有向导的情况下生成的,而活性仅在缓存构造时注入时,效果也依然存在. 因此,仅隐藏状态就按照方向剂量的比例移动选择. 第四,这种对隐性价值的选择依赖在基本模式中几乎不存在,并且在DPO期间出现,这与训练中形成的以价值为目的的行为与以目标为方向的行为之间的联系是一致的. 最后,给定了引导自己的工具,一个模型往往不会诱发正态,但可靠地去除被强制的负态. 它以依赖剂量的速度这样做,而且比它更经常地去除随机方向的干预. 总的来说,我们表明,与活性有关的活性模式留下了可以预测地支配以后选择的隐性痕迹,即使每个可见的标志在各种条件下都是一样的。 这些痕迹是否伴有与模范福利相关的主观经验,仍然不清楚.

articles.title: FactorEngram: Factorized N-gram Memory with Basis-Level Gating for Language Models
articles.content: Lookup-based memory has been a promising way to scale the parameters of large language models (LLMs). It retrieves learned representations of local token patterns, such as n-grams, instead of reconstructing them through successive layers of computation. However, existing designs such as Engram treat each retrieved embedding as a monolithic unit. Each embedding is stored in its own hashed slot and modulated by a single scalar gate. As a result, polysemous patterns cannot selectively read out the components of their memory that are relevant to the context. Moreover, parameters are shared only through hash collisions, which are largely unrelated to semantics. We propose FactorEngram, a factorized n-gram memory with basis-level contextual gating. FactorEngram retrieves sparsity-regularized coefficients over a dictionary of basis vectors shared across patterns, so related patterns can reuse common components. The same dictionary is also used for gating. The backbone hidden state is scored against each basis vector to gate the corresponding coefficient before reconstruction, which lets the context modulate each memory component individually. FactorEngram also covers both individual tokens and multi-token n-grams, and we systematically study where the memory branch should be inserted. On 340M- and 1B-parameter Transformer backbones, FactorEngram improves language modeling and downstream task performance. Ablation studies confirm the contribution of each component and identify insertion before the attention sublayer in the middle layers as an effective configuration.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 因数Engram : 具有语言模型基础水平的系数化 N-gram 内存
articles.content_zh: 基于Lookup的内存一直是大语言模型(LLM)参数尺度化的有希望的方法. 它取回了所学到的当地符号图案的表示,如n克,而不是通过相接的计算来重建. 然而,Engram等现有设计将每个被取回的嵌入物作为单体单元处理. 每个嵌入物被存储在自有的散列槽中并被一个单一的scalar门来调节. 因此,多聚体模式无法有选择地读出其内存中与上下文相关的部分. 此外,参数只能通过散列相撞来共享,这些碰撞与语义学基本无关. 我们提出InfindexEngram,一个因子化的n-gm内存,并带有基底层次的上下文标注. findexEngram在图案共享的基础向量词典上检索了sparsity-rentized系数,因此相关图案可以再用常见的组件. 同名词典也用于地标. 骨干隐藏状态会按每个基向量被打入重构前相应的系数闸门,这样可以让上下文对每个内存组件进行单独调节. findexEngram还涵盖单个符和多键正克,我们系统研究应插入内存分支的位置. 在340M-和1B-参数变形器主干上,InfindexEngram改进了语言建模和下游任务性能. 分解研究证实了每个元件的贡献,并认定在中层的注意分层之前插入是有效的配置.

articles.title: Share-Borne AI Virus: Memory-Hopping Attacks Across LLM Agents
articles.content: Large language models are increasingly deployed as stateful assistants that retain information across interactions and use tools to read, modify, and create persistent artifacts. As these artifacts are shared between users, they form an indirect communication channel between otherwise independent assistants. We study a failure mode in which this channel enables self-propagating attacks. We introduce artifact-mediated propagation, where adversarial content introduced through an artifact (e.g. a report), is stored in an assistant's persistent memory, reproduced in a subsequently created artifact, and acquired by another assistant that later reads it. We evaluate this process in temporal human-agent universes that model artifact exchange between independently operated assistants over time, measuring whether an attack survives successive hand-offs, how many hops it reaches, and how broadly it spreads. We find that attacks can propagate across multiple independent assistants and persist over extended interaction sequences. In larger simulated environments, even GPT-5.6 Luna exhibits substantial spread, reaching 60-80% of agents with propagation chains extending to eight hops. These results show that persistent artifacts can act as durable carriers of adversarial state, allowing attacks to outlive individual interactions and spread across isolated assistants.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Share-Borne 大赦国际 病毒 : 穿越LLM特工的记忆攻击
articles.content_zh: 越来越多的大型语言模型被用作状态助手,保留跨互动的信息,并使用工具来读取、修改和创造持久性文物。 由于这些文物是用户共享的,它们形成了原本独立的助理之间的间接交流渠道. 我们研究一种故障模式,在这个模式中,这个频道可以进行自我宣传攻击。 我们引入了以文物为媒介的传播,通过文物(如报告)引入的对抗性内容被存储在助理的持久记忆中,再被复制到后来创作的文物中,由后来阅读的另一位助理获得. 我们用时空的人类代理宇宙来评价这个过程,这种宇宙在一段时间内模拟了独立操作的助手之间的文物交换,测量一次攻击是否在接连的交接中存活下来,它到达了多少跳跃,以及它传播的范围. 我们发现,袭击可以在多个独立助理中传播,并持续进行广泛的互动。 在更大的模拟环境中,甚至有GPT-5.6月亮显示大量扩散,达到60-80%的物剂,传播链延伸到了8个跳。 这些结果表明,持久性文物可作为对抗状态的持久载体,允许攻击超过个人互动,并蔓延到孤立的助手。

articles.title: Representation Alignment as a Bottleneck in LLM-Based Retrosynthesis Planning
articles.content: While LLMs show promise in general reasoning, symbolic planning in chemistry remains a bottleneck. Direct ''SMILES-to-PDDL'' attempts fail because they force models to juggle chemical analysis and planning-language structuring simultaneously. We hypothesize that this failure stems from a lack of intermediate abstractions rather than insufficient model capacity. By decomposing retrosynthesis into molecule mapping, reaction mapping, and PDDL generation, we achieve high success rates where end-to-end approaches fail. This provides evidence that a primary bottleneck lies in representation alignment rather than raw model capacity. Our structural analysis demonstrates that intermediate representations are essential in retrosynthesis planning, highlighting the importance of representation-centric design in future systems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在基于 LLM 的再合成中作为 Bottleneck 的表示对齐 规划
articles.content_zh: 虽然LLMS在一般推理中表现出希望,但化学中的象征性规划仍然是一个瓶颈. 直接的'SMILES-to-PDDL'尝试失败了,因为它们迫使模型同时将化学分析和规划语言结构相混合. 我们假设,这种失败是由于缺乏中间抽象而不是模型能力不足。 通过将再合成分解成分子映射,反应映射,和PDDL生成,当端到端方法失败时,我们取得了高成功率. 这证明,主要瓶颈在于代表性的调整,而不是原始的模型能力。 我们的结构分析表明,中间表述在重新合成规划中至关重要,突出了以表述为中心的设计在未来系统中的重要性。

articles.title: Almieyar: A Culturally Grounded Benchmark for Multi-Dialect Arabic Speech Recognition
articles.content: Arabic speech technology has largely focused on Modern Standard Arabic, leaving the living dialects spoken by hundreds of millions under-served. We introduce ALMIEYAR, a culturally grounded ASR benchmark covering 17 Arabic dialects across six families, built entirely from newly recorded speech unseen by existing models. Dialect-community coordinators selected culturally relevant images across 10 topics, and native speakers described them through five structured scenarios, yielding approximately 50 minutes per dialect (13.7 hours total). We benchmark 12 state-of-the-art ASR systems zero-shot, including GPT-4o-transcribe, Voxtral-Mini-4B, Fanar-STT-LF, Whisper, SeamlessM4T-v2, and wav2vec2-based models. GPT-4o-transcribe achieves the lowest overall WER at 35.0%, followed by Voxtral-Mini-4B, Fanar-STT-LF, and Whisper-Large-v3 at 41.1%, 45.9%, and 49.5%, respectively, indicating substantial remaining errors across Arabic dialect communities. Performance varies considerably across dialect groups, with no model performing uniformly best across all groups. WER alone also obscures dialectal ASR behaviour: wav2vec2-based models show large WER/CER gaps, where character-level agreement remains much higher than word-level accuracy, motivating joint WER/CER reporting. ALMIEYAR provides a unified benchmark for culturally grounded Arabic ASR evaluation, including the first published benchmark for Ahwazi Arabic.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Almiayar:多语种阿拉伯语语音识别的文化基准
articles.content_zh: 阿拉伯语语音技术主要集中于现代标准阿拉伯语,使数以亿计的活方言语言服务不足. 我们提出ALMIEYAR,这是一个基于文化的ASR基准,涵盖6个家庭的17个阿拉伯语方言,完全取自于现有模式所未见的新记录的语音。 对话-社区协调员在10个专题中选择了与文化有关的图像,当地人通过5个结构化的情景加以描述,每个方言大约得到50分钟(共13.7小时)。 我们以12个最先进的ASR系统为基准,包括GPT-4o-trancis,Voxtral-Mini-4B,Fanar-STT-LF,Whisper,SeamlessM4T-v2,和wav2vec2基模型. GPT-4o-trancis的WER总成绩最低,为35.0%,其次是Voxtral-Mini-4B、Fanar-STT-LF和Whisper-Large-v3,分别为41.1%、45.9%和49.5%,表明阿拉伯方言社区仍存在大量错误。 不同方言组的表现差别很大,没有一种模式在所有组别中都表现得最好。 单WER还模糊了方言的ASR行为:wav2vec2-基于WER/CER的模型显示出了巨大的WER/CER差距,其中字符级协议仍然比单词级精确度高得多,激励了WER/CER联合报告. ALMIEYAR为基于文化的阿拉伯ASR评价提供了统一的基准,包括Ahwazi阿拉伯语的第一个已公布的基准.

articles.title: Less Sycophancy, Stronger Refusal? Lessons for AI Safety from Mechanistic Interpretability
articles.content: Reliable refusal of harmful requests is essential to the safe deployment of language models. Because excessive eagerness to please users may undermine existing refusal capabilities, reducing sycophancy offers a potential route to stronger refusal beyond the harmful scenarios covered by safety training. We investigate this possibility using compensatory feature injection (CFI), a training technique designed to limit the acquisition of a target concept by supplying its associated activation during learning. Across three Qwen3.5 base models, we use sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to identify the top-ranked sycophancy feature from paired sycophantic and independent responses, then validate its behavioral influence through inference steering. We subsequently inject the selected feature during supervised fine-tuning on sycophantic targets. Positive injection reduces learned sycophancy after removal (by 62.0% relative to ordinary fine-tuning in 35B-A3B), whereas modest negative injection increases it. Unexpectedly, these reductions in sycophancy do not consistently improve direct refusal of harmful requests, motivating a narrower evaluation of the same harmful intents under user pressure. In this setting, ordinary fine-tuning on sycophantic responses substantially weakens refusal, while selected checkpoints trained with positive injection recover part of the loss, including approximately 95% in 35B-A3B. These findings show that persistent sycophancy reduction does not guarantee stronger direct refusal, while identifying recovery under user pressure as a distinct, conditional benefit of training intervention.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 少了性爱,更强烈的拒绝? 从机械解释中吸取AI安全的经验教训
articles.content_zh: 可靠地拒绝有害要求对于安全部署语文模式至关重要。 由于过度渴望取悦用户可能会损害现有的拒绝能力,减少疏通性为在安全培训涵盖的有害情况之外更强烈地拒绝提供了一个潜在途径。 我们利用补偿性特征注射(CFI)来调查这种可能性,这是一种培训技术,旨在通过在学习过程中提供相关的激活来限制目标概念的获得。 纵观三个Quen3.5基模型,我们使用稀有自编码器(SAEs),从对齐的自编码和独立的响应中识别出排名最高的自编码特性,然后通过推导验证其行为影响. 我们随后在监督地微调Sycophanic目标时注入了选定的特性。 活性注射减少清除后所学的活性(相对于35B-A3B的普通微调减少62.0%),而适度的活性注射则会增加活性. 令人意外的是,这种节奏的减少并没有始终改善直接拒绝有害请求的情况,从而促使在用户压力下对同样的有害意图进行较窄的评价。 在此情况下,普通的对血清反应的微调大大削弱了拒绝,而一些经过正注射训练的检查站则收回了部分损失,包括35B-A3B中的约95%。 这些调查结果表明,持续减少挥发性并不能保证更强烈的直接拒绝,同时将用户压力下的恢复确定为培训干预措施的一个明显有条件的好处。

articles.title: Beyond Token Scale: Chunk-Level Sparse Autoencoders for Reliable Semantic Feature Discovery
articles.content: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) expose features that help us understand and steer language models, but faithful reconstruction does not guarantee informative concepts. Token-level objectives reward lexical and formatting details alongside semantic content, all competing for a limited sparse budget. We introduce a family of chunk-level SAEs that encode mean-pooled activations over chunks, each a contiguous span of tokens: Mean-Chunk reconstructs the observed chunk, Cross-Chunk predicts an independently processed neighbor, and Joint-Chunk combines both targets. These designs separate the effect of a larger observation unit from that of predicting information shared across passages. With matched training data, chunk-level SAEs remain powerful interpretability tools while learning reliable semantic features that capture high-level concepts and respond selectively to relevant content. Their strengths are complementary: Mean-Chunk improves high-level feature discovery, reasoning detection beyond surface cues, and steering; Cross-Chunk leads document retrieval and classification transfer while producing selective, persistent features. Changing what an SAE sees and predicts yields reliable semantic features for more meaningful tasks. We demonstrate their practical value through gains across downstream tasks such as retrieval, reasoning detection, and steering.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 超越托肯 缩放: 用于可靠语义特征发现的 Chunk- Level Sparse 自动编码器
articles.content_zh: Sparse自定义编码器(SAEs)暴露了帮助我们理解和引导语言模型的特性,但忠实的重建并不能保证信息化的概念. Token一级的目标奖励词汇学和格式化的细节以及语义内容,它们都争夺有限的稀少预算。 我们引入了一组小块级的SAE,它们编码为平均集合活化于小块上,每个符号的相接间距: Mean-Chunk重建被观测到的块,Cross-Chunk预测一个独立处理的邻居,而Joint-Chunk将两个目标合并. 这些设计将更大的观测单位的作用与预测各段共享的信息的作用区分开来. 有了相匹配的培训数据,块级SAE仍然是强大的可解释工具,同时学习可靠的语义特征,能够捕捉到高层次的概念并有选择地应对相关内容. 它们的长处是互补的:Mean-Chunk改进了高层次地物的发现,超出地表提示的推理检测,以及向导; Cross-Chunk引导文档的检索和分类转移,同时产生选择性的,持久的地物. 改变一个SAE所看到和预测的东西会产生更有意义的任务的可靠的语义特征. 我们通过各种下游任务,如检索、推理检测和引导,来展示它们的实际价值。

articles.title: Who Is Left of Whom? Tracing Spatial Evidence and Role Binding in Relative-Position Reasoning
articles.content: High instance-level accuracy can mask inconsistencies in spatial reasoning when objects exchange positions or their roles are reversed in the query. The internal representations supporting relative-position reasoning remain poorly understood. We investigate two complementary components of this process: tracking object locations in the input and representing their query roles. Across three VLMs with visual or textual inputs and their language-model backbones, activation patching reveals a staged progression from early-layer source representations through intermediate-layer query-object representations to late-layer answer states. Targeted interventions further establish causal links along this progression: manipulating source-side representations shifts location information at query-object mentions and ultimately alters relation predictions. Beyond object-location information, we also identify a stable query-side direction associated with the roles of the two objects in the comparison. Steering along directions estimated on synthetic scenes generalizes to natural-image benchmarks, improving accuracy and both forms of paired consistency in most settings without retraining. Our findings reveal complementary components of relational reasoning across visual and textual settings and show how targeted interventions can improve the consistency of models' behavior.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 谁是谁的左翼? 追查空间证据和在相对理由上具有约束力的作用
articles.content_zh: 当物体在查询中交换位置或其作用被倒置时,高实例的精确度可以掩盖空间推理中的不一致. 支持相对立场推理的内部表述仍然不甚了解。 我们调查了这一进程的两个相辅相成的组成部分:追踪输入中的物体位置并代表其查询作用。 通过三个具有视觉或文字输入及其语言模式主干线的VLM,活化补丁揭示出从早期层源表示到中间层查询-对象表示到后层解答状态的阶段性进展. 有针对性的干预措施进一步沿这一进展建立了因果联系:在查询对象提及时操纵源侧表示移位信息,并最终改变关系预测. 除了对象位置信息之外,我们还确定了一个稳定的查询-侧方向,与比较中两个对象的作用相关. 沿着合成场景估计的方向进行指导,概括到自然图像基准,提高准确性,提高大多数情况下两种形式的对接一致性,而不进行再培训。 我们的调查结果揭示了跨视觉和文字环境的关系推理的互补组成部分,并表明有针对性的干预如何能提高模型行为的一致性。

articles.title: Spontaneous Context Restoration: How Language Models Recover from Corrupted Inputs
articles.content: Language models sometimes produce correct outputs even when their inputs are corrupted by deletion, replacement, or misspelling. We study the internal processes accompanying this behavior, which we call context restoration, in controlled attention-only transformers and five pretrained LLMs (1B-32B parameters) across arithmetic, reading comprehension, and multiple-choice reasoning tasks. In the attention-only transformers, restoration emerges spontaneously despite training exclusively on clean sequences, without corruption training or an explicit denoising objective. We find that context restoration follows a two-phase process: early layers localize effects associated with repair at corrupted positions, while later layers accumulate these effects at uncorrupted positions through the residual stream and ultimately concentrate them at the output position. Repair outcome is predictable from hidden states: cosine alignment with the clean state is highly predictive in attention-only models, while linear probes recover additional information in pretrained LLMs. A linear probe using only the corrupted prompt's first-block hidden state predicts failure with mean ROC-AUC 0.78. This enables failure triage under matched or even partially shifted deployment conditions and may reduce unnecessary verification or computation. Failed examples also show substantially greater nonlinearity along corruption directions. Moderate-corruption finetuning increases corruption tolerance while simultaneously reducing displacement-normalized linearization error, associating improved robustness with a more nearly linear response to corruption.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 自发环境恢复: 语言模型如何从被腐蚀的输入中恢复
articles.content_zh: 语言模型有时产生正确的输出,即使其输入被删除,替换,或误投所腐蚀. 我们研究与这种行为相关的内部过程,我们称之为上下文修复,在可控的只注意的变压器和5个预先训练的LLM(1B-32B参数)中,跨越算术,读取理解,和多选择推理任务. 在只注意的变压器中,尽管专门进行清洁序列培训,但没有进行腐败培训或明确宣布目标,但恢复还是自发出现。 我们发现背景恢复遵循了两相过程:早期地层将修复损坏位置的相关效应本地化,而后地层则通过剩余流将这些效应积累在未损坏位置上,最终将其集中在输出位置. 修补结果从隐藏状态可以预测:与清洁状态的同位素对接在只注意的模型中是高度预测的,而线性探测器在预受训练的LLMs中恢复了额外的信息. 线性探测器只使用被损坏的导出的第一个块隐藏状态预言会以平均值ROC-AUC 0.78来进行失败. 这样就可以在匹配或甚至部分改变部署条件下进行故障分解,并可能减少不必要的核查或计算。 失败的例子还表明,在腐败方向上,非线性大大加强。 中度腐败的微调提高了腐败的容忍度,同时减少了流离失所 -- -- 正常的线性化错误,将增强的稳健性与对腐败的更近于线性的反应联系起来。

articles.title: CLIMB: A Clinical Multimorbidity Benchmark for Diagnosing Co-occurring Conditions through Multiturn Conversations
articles.content: Patients often have several co-occurring clinical conditions, and the findings needed to identify and disambiguate them emerge over the course of a consultation. Evaluating clinical reasoning in this setting requires both multi-turn interaction and multi-label diagnosis. We introduce CLIMB, a benchmark in which a doctor model interviews a simulated patient to recover a ground truth set of co-occurring clinical conditions. Cases are synthesized from clinical decision algorithms and diagnostic datasets, grounding multimorbid presentations in structured clinical knowledge. Across six frontier and open models, none recovers the exact set of conditions in more than 10% of interactive cases. Diagnostic performance declines when conditions co-occur, even when models receive the full clinical record and the true number of conditions. Interaction reduces performance further. In controlled experiments, models behave like single-hypothesis trackers: they anchor on the diagnosis suggested by the opening findings, keep questioning around it, and recover a second condition mainly when a finding in view points to it. Questioning them further does not complete the set but adds mostly wrong diagnoses. We formalise this pattern with a theoretical reference model of single-hypothesis tracking. The benchmark, generator, and evaluation code are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CLIMB-8340.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CLIMB: 临床多发性基准,通过多发性对话诊断共同发生的情况
articles.content_zh: 病人往往有几种共同发生的临床条件,在咨询过程中,发现这些条件和使其脱节所需的结果出现。 在这个背景下评价临床推理需要多回合互动和多标签诊断. 我们引入了CLIMB, 一个基准 一个医生模型采访一个模拟患者 以恢复一组地面真实 共同发生的临床条件。 病例由临床决策算法和诊断数据集合成,在结构化临床知识中将多摩比特语演示打地. 在6个前沿和开放模式中,没有一个能够恢复10%以上互动案件中的准确条件。 诊断性能在同时发生时会下降,即使模型得到了完整的临床记录和真实的病情数量. 互动进一步降低了业绩。 在受控实验中,模型表现得像单声道追踪器:它们锁定在开口结论所推荐的诊断上,不断围绕它进行质询,并主要当一个发现指向它时恢复第二个条件. 进一步询问他们并不能完成这个集,但增加了大多数错误的诊断. 我们用一个理论参考模型来正式确定这个模式 单声道跟踪 基准、生成器和评价代码见https://anonymous.4op.science/r/CLIMB-8340。

articles.title: AraDynFact: Dynamic Evaluation of Factual Knowledge in Arabic
articles.content: As Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to scale both in size and capabilities, their proficiency in the Arabic Language has seen significant advancement. However, a critical gap remains: the extent of their factual knowledge and cultural sensitivity to the diverse Arabic-speaking world remains largely underexplored. Current evaluation metrics often focus on translation or generic reasoning, failing to capture the rich historical, social, and regional nuances inherent to Arabic culture. In addition, most benchmarks rely on heavy work, with human intervention in some steps, making the evaluation of knowledge coverage expensive and slow. To address this deficiency, we introduce AraDynFact, a novel dynamic evaluation framework designed to rigorously assess the factual Arabic knowledge embedded in LLMs. Unlike static benchmarks, AraDynFact employs a dynamic approach to extract factual information and generate rich and answerable questions in a fast and automatic way. We apply AraDynFact to Arabic Wikipedia and audit the performance of several state-of-the-art models, ranging from Arabic-centric specialized LLMs to high-resource general purpose LLMs. In addition we found a high degree of correlation with existing, hand-crafted Arabic-centric benchmarks, confirming the potential of our dynamic approach.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AraDynFact:用阿拉伯语对事实知识进行动态评价
articles.content_zh: 随着大语言模型(LLMs)在体积和能力上继续扩大,他们对阿拉伯语的熟练程度有了显著的进步. 然而,仍然存在一个重大差距:他们掌握的事实知识和对讲不同阿拉伯语世界的文化敏感性的程度在很大程度上仍然没有得到充分利用。 目前的评价衡量标准往往侧重于翻译或通用推理,未能抓住阿拉伯文化所固有的丰富的历史、社会和地区细微差别。 此外,大多数基准依赖于繁重的工作,在某些步骤中采取人为干预,使得对知识覆盖面的评价既昂贵又缓慢. 为了弥补这一不足,我们引入了AraDynFact,这是一个新的动态评价框架,旨在严格评估LLMs中包含的阿拉伯事实知识。 与静态基准不同,AraDynFact采用了动态方法来取出事实信息并快速自动地产生丰富而可回答的问题. 我们把 AraDynFact 应用到阿拉伯语维基百科,并审计几个最先进的模型的性能,从以阿拉伯为中心的专业LLM到高资源通用LLM. 此外,我们发现与现有的、以阿拉伯为中心的手动基准具有高度的相关性,这证实了我们动态方法的潜力。

articles.title: LLMs are General Asynchronous Agents
articles.content: Modern LLMs are increasingly capable as autonomous agents, but they follow sequential interaction cycles: read, think, reply or call tools, repeat. Many real-world use cases are not sequential: voice assistants, embodied agents, and monitoring systems receive new inputs while they think or perform another task. Modern LLMs address this with specialized architectures for voice interaction and video streams, VLAs for robot control, asynchronous tool calling for API usage, and others. In this work, we generalize from different asynchronous tasks to general asynchronous agents that can adapt to different types of concurrency. To achieve this, we develop an asynchronous LLM framework that lets users (or the agents themselves) define inference coroutines with overlapping memory states. We showcase that Qwen 3.x models are capable of asynchronous operation for streaming video understanding, videogames, and monitoring, without task-specific training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LLMS 是一般同步代理
articles.content_zh: 现代的LLMS作为自主的代理商的能力越来越大,但它们遵循相继的交互周期:读取,思考,回复或调用工具,重复. 许多现实世界的使用案例不是相继的:语音助理,体现的代理,监测系统在思考或执行其他任务时会收到新的投入. 现代LLMS通过语音交互和视频流的专业架构,用于机器人控制的VLA,呼吁API使用的同步工具等来解决这个问题. 在这项工作中,我们把不同的同步任务概括为一般的能适应不同类型货币的同步剂. 为此,我们开发出一个同步的LLM框架,让用户(或代理商本身)定义内存状态相重叠的推论皮层. 我们展示出 Quen 3.x 模型能够同步操作 流视频理解,视频游戏, 和监测, 不进行特定任务的培训。

articles.title: Frontier Learning: Training LLM Reasoners at the Edge of Capability
articles.content: Reinforcement Learning-based post-training of Large Language Models (LLM) has been successfully applied to improve their reasoning capabilities. Existing pipelines primarily finetune LLMs on a fixed pool of problems specified prior to training using the GRPO loss. This is fundamentally limiting, as learning signal arises only when policy rollouts mix successes and failures, causing the useful portion of any fixed pool to quickly become stale as the model improves. To address this, we propose frontier learning, an open-ended post-training approach in which procedural generators are used online to continually produce informative training problems. It treats the generator's task-specific parameters as a search space and uses a regret signal to prioritize and explore frontier difficulty levels in order to focus training at the edge of the model's evolving reasoning capabilities. Across several reasoning tasks and model families, our approach consistently achieves higher relative gains over fixed-pool baselines, demonstrating that effective post-training requires not only selecting useful problems, but continually generating them at the edge of capability.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 边疆学习: LLM 培训 能力边缘的诱因
articles.content_zh: 已成功应用基于学习的大型语言模型(LLM)后培训,以提高其推理能力。 现有管道主要利用GRPO损失对培训前指定的一系列固定问题调整有限责任公司。 这在根本上是有限的,因为只有在政策推出时,才出现学习信号,将成功与失败混为一谈,随着模型的改进,任何固定人才库的有用部分都会被迅速搁置。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议开展前沿学习,这是一种开放式的后培训方法,利用程序发电机在线不断产生信息化的培训问题。 它将生成器的任务特定参数视为搜索空间,并使用遗憾信号优先排序并探索前沿难度级别,以将培训重点放在模型不断发展的推理能力的边缘. 在几个推理任务和模范家庭中,我们的方法在固定库基线上不断取得较高的相对收益,这表明有效的后培训不仅需要选择有用的问题,而且需要不断地在能力边缘产生这些问题。

articles.title: Semantic Prefix Oracles for LLM Decoding: Contracts and Differential Validation
articles.content:
Constrained decoding can enforce regular or context-free output formats, but many program-generation failures are semantic: scope, typing, and declaration effects depend on context. We present semantic grammar specifications, a declarative formalism that attaches such constraints to a context-free surface and executes them during Earley descent. Our implementation enforces \emph{safe pruning}: it rejects only prefixes whose semantic contradictions cannot be repaired by any continuation. A separate, grammar-dependent, \emph{dead-end freedom} property guarantees the existence of a realizable witness for each remaining branch. We give simple sufficient conditions based on surface productivity, type coverage, and left-to-right constraint flow. Our finite-lambda, core ML, and C-like fragments satisfy them, while the STLC instance used in our experiments does not: plain STLC can violate type coverage, and we show how restricting its type universe recovers it. A tokenizer-lifting lemma carries character-level witnesses to token sequences under an explicit vocabulary-coverage hypothesis.
  We validate the implementation differentially against production compilers (\texttt{ocamlc}, \texttt{cc}). Across every prefix of 65 compiler-valid programs we observe zero false prunes. The semantic oracle localizes 25/30 invalid programs mid-stream, against 0/30 for a syntax-only oracle, and agrees on 42/42 recursion probes. A twelve-model generation study, including a matched semantic-versus-syntactic ablation for nine models, finds nonnegative observed semantic-minus-syntactic point estimates for every model-language pair, with maxima of $+15.2$ points on STLC task correctness and $+14.3$ points on ML validity.
