articles.title: Self-Adapting Group of Experts for Multi-Agent Reasoning
articles.content: Multi-agent systems bring together language model agents with different roles to propose, review, and refine solutions. Each agent's response depends on its model's capabilities, the reasoning strategy defined by its system prompt, and the information in its input context. Existing frameworks often adapt communication by changing this context while leaving individual prompts fixed, even when a problem calls for different skills. We study whether agents' initial responses can identify a strategy better suited to the current problem and guide its transfer to other agents. To address this, we introduce SAGE (Self-Adapting Group of Experts), a training-free framework that uses answer agreement, prefix consistency, and reciprocal peer review to select a strategy donor. SAGE transfers the selected donor's reasoning strategy to the other agents while preserving their original roles. This transfer uses only the agents' original system prompts, without access to the problem or generated solutions. After strategy adaptation, agents exchange responses through a dynamic, sparse directed acyclic graph that routes information from higher-scoring agents to lower-scoring agents. Experiments across multiple agent backbones and reasoning benchmarks show that SAGE achieves higher average accuracy than the evaluated baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/atifquamar07/sage.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多代理推理专家组
articles.content_zh: 多代理系统汇集了具有不同作用的语言模型代理商来提出,审查和完善解决方案. 每个代理的反应取决于其模型的能力,其系统即时确定的推理策略,以及输入语境中的信息. 现有框架往往通过改变这种环境来调整沟通,同时使个人的提示固定下来,即使一个问题需要不同的技能。 我们研究代理人的初步反应是否能够确定一种更适合当前问题的战略,并指导其向其他代理人转移。 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了SAGE(自适应专家组),这是一个无培训框架,使用答案协议、前缀一致性和对等同行评审来选择战略捐助方。 SAGE将选定的捐赠者的推理策略转移给其他代理商,同时保留其原始角色. 这种传输只使用代理的原始系统提示,不能访问问题或生成解决方案. 适应策略后,代理商通过动态的,稀疏的定向环流图来交换响应,将信息从高分代理商传递到低分代理商. 跨越多种物剂骨干和推理基准的实验表明,SAGE的平均精度高于被评价的基线. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/atifquamar07/sage上查阅。

articles.title: AwarenessBench: Assessing Cognitive Capabilities of Language Models
articles.content: As language models (LMs) exhibit increasingly consciousness-like behaviors, evaluating their cognitive abilities becomes essential. We introduce AwarenessBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for assessing the cognitive abilities of LMs in four dimensions: metacognition, self-awareness, social awareness, and situational awareness, covering 15 cognitive functions and 14,381 samples. Evaluating 18 state-of-the-art LMs, we find that all consistently surpass random baselines, with more advanced models performing better. We further compare LMs with human performance across three demographic groups, where the best-performing model surpasses human averages overall, but most still fall markedly short in metacognition and self-awareness. Finally, we show that awareness is a distinct capability: progress in language modeling or reasoning does not necessarily translate into improved cognition.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Bench: 评估语言模型的认知能力
articles.content_zh: 随着语言模型(LMs)日益展现出类似意识的行为,评价其认知能力变得至关重要. 我们提出认识奔驰,这是在四个方面评估LMs认知能力的第一个全面基准:元认知、自我意识、社会意识和情况意识,涵盖15个认知功能和14 381个样本。 在评估18个最新LMs时,我们发现,它们都始终超过随机基线,更先进的模型表现更好。 我们进一步比较了三个人口组别中的低效率和人类表现,在这三个人口组别中,表现最好的模式总体上超过了人类平均水平,但大多数在认识和自我认识方面仍然明显不足。 最后,我们表明,认识是一种独特的能力:语言建模或推理方面的进展不一定转化为认识的提高。

articles.title: TRACE: Single-Pass Decoding-Trace Risk Localization for Generation Calibration
articles.content: Reliable confidence estimation is essential for large language model deployment. However, answer-level calibration remains challenging because generation errors are often localized: a response may be fluent and high-probability overall while still failing at a critical number, entity, or factual claim. Existing estimators compress token probabilities, sequence likelihoods, entropy, or beam statistics into a global score, which can dilute such local risk signals. We propose TRACE, a single-pass, decoded-answer-preserving confidence estimator that treats decoding-time uncertainty as a trajectory through three steps: (i) recording token-level surprisal and predictive entropy during decoding, (ii) applying local risk operators to preserve uncertainty spikes, and (iii) converting localized trace risk into answer-level confidence. TRACE produces a label-free risk score, while TRACE+ calibrates trace-only features into probabilities using a held-out split, without extra generations or external verifiers. We evaluate four tasks against 19 calibration baselines, and TRACE+ reduces Brier from 0.149 to 0.137 and improves AUROC from 0.758 to 0.792 over the strongest likelihood baseline. Across seven LLMs, TRACE+ improves over the best non-TRACE baseline pool from 0.136 to 0.120 Brier and from 0.764 to 0.817 AUROC. Results show that localizing decoding-time risk provides a general approach to calibration.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TRACE:用于生成校正的单纸面解码-跟踪风险定位
articles.content_zh: 可靠的信心估计对于大型语文模型的部署至关重要。 然而,答案一级的校准仍然具有挑战性,因为生成错误常常是局部的:反应可能流利和高概率,而关键数目、实体或事实主张仍然失败。 现有的估计器将符号概率,序列概率,py或束统计压缩成一个全球分数,这可以稀释这种局部风险信号. 我们提议采用TRACE,即一个单一通道的解码解答-保留信心估计器,通过三个步骤将解码时间的不确定性视为轨迹:(一) 在解码过程中记录象征性水平的超额和预测性演算,(二) 应用当地风险操作员来保持不确定性的高峰,(三) 将局部的微量风险转化为解码水平的信心。 TRACE产生无标签风险分数,而TRACE+则使用悬浮分数将仅微量特征校准为概率,没有额外的代数或外部验证器. 我们对照19个校准基线评估了4项任务,TRACE+将Brier从0.149减少到0.137,并将AUROC从0.758提高到0.792,比最强概率基线。 TRACE+从0.136到0.120Brier,从0.764到0.817AUROC,在7个LLM中比最佳的非TRACE基线库有所改善。 结果显示,将解码时间风险本地化提供了校准的一般方法。

articles.title: Multilinguality in Hybrid Attention LLMs
articles.content: In response to the growing demand for long sequences in agentic and reasoning use cases, many state-of-the-art LLMs combine multiple variants of attention to mitigate the quadratic complexity of traditional softmax attention. These hybrid attention LLMs aim to balance the strengths and limitations of full attention and alternatives based on recurrence. This work presents a first study of how hybrid attention impacts the multilinguality of LLMs. Beyond the impact on long sequences in poorly tokenized languages, our study is motivated by the possibility that the inductive biases of the recurrent state alter linguistic processing. Our interpretability analysis confirms this, showing that cross-lingual representations in hybrid models develop in patterns tied to the ordering of recurrent and full-attention layers. Across diverse models, we notably observe a pronounced spike in cross-lingual alignment around the first full-attention layer. These findings lead us to question the conventional ordering of attention layers. In distillation experiments on multilingual data, all alternative layer orderings outperform the standard throughout training, learning up to 2.5X faster. These stark, replicable results prompt our theory that multilingual models would benefit from starting with a full-attention layer rather than recurrent layers.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 混合注意力的多重性
articles.content_zh: 针对代理和推理案例对长序列日益增长的需求,许多最先进的LLMS结合了多种关注的变体,以缓解传统软马克思关注的四极复杂性. 这些混合关注的LLMS旨在平衡充分关注的长处和局限以及基于重复的替代方法. 这项工作首次研究了混合关注如何影响法学硕士的多语性。 除了对语言符号化程度低的长序列的影响外,我们的研究还受到反复出现的状态的诱导偏差改变语言处理的可能性的推动。 我们的可解释性分析证实了这一点,表明混合模型中的跨语言表达方式与反复和全心全意层的顺序挂钩。 在各种模式中,我们特别看到,第一全注意层周围的跨语言对齐明显激增。 这些调查结果使我们质疑传统的关注层次顺序。 在多语种数据的蒸馏实验中,所有替代层的订单都超过了整个训练的标准,学习速度可达2.5X. 这些严酷、可复制的成果促使我们提出一个理论,即从全心全意的层次开始,而不是从重复的层次开始,多语种模式将是有益的。

articles.title: How Well Can LLMs Simulate Real Learner Evaluations of Educational Feedback?
articles.content: While recent studies have explored human behavior and preference simulation using large language models (LLMs), it remains unclear how well LLMs can simulate subjective evaluations from real learners in educational settings. We investigate this question using real learner evaluation data on feedback for high-school biology questions at both the group and individual levels. We compare performance with and without learner-specific information, such as personality traits and evaluation examples, across six models. Our results show that LLMs still have a limited ability to simulate learner evaluations. Providing learner profiles and examples improves score calibration and individual-level simulation, but more often fails to improve group-level consistency. These findings highlight the need to investigate which learner information and adaptation strategies are effective for learner preference simulation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LLMS如何模拟真正的学习者对教育反馈的评价?
articles.content_zh: 虽然最近的研究已经用大型语言模型(LLMs)探索了人类的行为和偏好模拟,但LLMs在教育环境中能够模拟真实学习者主观评价的程度仍然不清楚. 我们利用真正的学习者评价数据来调查这个问题,这些数据涉及在群体和个人两级对高中生物问题的反馈。 我们比较表现与不与学习者相关的信息,例如人格特征和评价实例,涉及六个模式。 我们的结果表明,法学硕士课程模拟学习者评价的能力有限。 提供学习者简介和实例可以改善分数校准和个人层面的模拟,但更常见的情况是未能提高群体层面的一致性. 这些结论突出表明,有必要调查哪些学习者的信息和适应战略对学习者的偏好模拟有效。

articles.title: Deep Learning Methods in Neuroscience: From Modeling Molecular Mechanisms to Classifying States of Consciousness
articles.content: A critical analysis of contemporary approaches to the study of conscious states. The review focuses on methods of classification, clustering, modeling of brain states under anesthesia and identification of measurable neurobiological characteristics of brain function. A comparative analysis was conducted in the following three major areas: automatic detection of states of consciousness using neural networks based on EEG and fMRI data; modeling of the structural-functional dynamics of the brain under the effects of anesthetics; and detection of neurophysiological indicators which correlate with the level of consciousness. The obtained conclusions demonstrate the growing effectiveness of deep neural models in the classification and prediction of brain states and the analysis of dynamic structural-functional connectivity. Nonetheless, significant limitations were also identified, including the limited interpretability of the models, the lack of standardized metrics, and the problem of the specificity of consciousness markers. Our findings support the need for developing hybrid, generalizible, physiologically grounded architectures. Furthermore, such approaches may improve the translational potential of computational models in clinical neuroscience. Diverse methods of machine and computational modeling have demonstrated their effectiveness in tasks of automatic clustering and classification of brain states, the development of multilevel models and the identification of connectivity patterns correlated with levels of consciousness. A larger-scale analysis and a larger dataset, as well as the implementation of model interpretability approaches are required for the practical application of the analyzed models. The models based on EEG and LFP are the most promising for clinical application due to their availability and the possibility of real-time monitoring.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 神经科学的深层学习方法:从模拟分子机制到意识国家的分类
articles.content_zh: 对当代研究有意识国家的方法进行批判性分析. 审查的重点是麻醉下大脑状态的分类,集群,建模的方法,以及识别大脑功能的可测量神经生物学特征. 在以下三个主要领域进行了比较分析:利用基于EEG和fMRI数据的神经网络自动检测意识状态;在麻醉作用下模拟大脑的结构-功能动态;检测神经生理指标,这些指标与意识水平相关。 获得的结论表明,深层神经模型在大脑状态的分类和预测以及对动态结构-功能连接的分析中越来越有效. 尽管如此,也发现了一些重大的局限性,包括模型的可解释性有限,缺乏标准化的衡量标准,以及意识标记的特殊性问题。 我们的调查结果支持需要发展混合的、普遍的、以生理为基础的结构。 此外,这些方法可以提高临床神经科学中计算模型的翻译潜力。 机器和计算模型的多种方法在自动集成和分类大脑状态、开发多层次模型和确定与意识水平有关的连接模式等任务中都显示出其有效性。 为了实际应用所分析的模型,需要进行更大的分析和更大的数据集,以及采用模型可解释性方法。 基于EEG和LFP的模型,由于其可用性和实时监测的可能性,是临床应用最有希望的.

articles.title: From Input to Output: A Flexible Agent for Dual-End Interpretation of Sparse Autoencoder Features
articles.content: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are an important tool for mechanistic interpretability, but interpreting their many features remains challenging. Existing methods characterize input-side activation patterns and output-side intervention effects, yet often leave their functional connection implicit, while input-side evidence collection typically relies on costly large-corpus scans. We introduce functional interpretation, which characterizes an SAE feature as a mapping from its activating input semantics to its output effects under intervention, and present Dual-End Agentic Feature Interpretation (DAFI), an agent that actively gathers evidence and refines input-side, output-side, and functional interpretations through component-specific feedback. Its short-context token probing enables on-demand activation evidence collection without a full corpus scan. On GemmaScope, DAFI improves Input score by 13.1 percentage points over SAGE and Output score by 38.9 points over Token Change, while being substantially more token-efficient than a general-purpose coding agent. Skills distilled from successful refinements raise the held-out joint pass rate from 58.0% to 92.0% and improve both interpretation quality and efficiency when transferred to a new model-SAE setting. Across features with reliable endpoint interpretations, 70.7% exhibit non-equivalent input and output semantics. On AxBench, DAFI also improves steering-feature selection over output-score filtering. Code is available at https://github.com/THUAIS-Lab/DAFI.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从输入到输出: Sparse 自动编码器特性双端解释的灵活代理
articles.content_zh: Sparse自动编码器(SAEs)是机械解释的重要工具,但解释其许多特性仍然具有挑战性. 现有方法定性为输入侧激活模式和输出侧干预效应,但往往会让其功能连接隐含,而输入侧证据收集通常依赖于昂贵的大公司扫描. 我们引入了功能解释,将SAE特征定性为从激活输入语义到干预下输出效果的映射,并提出了双端代理特性解释(DAFI),它通过特定组件反馈,积极收集证据并完善输入侧,输出侧,功能解释. 它的短文符号检测可以进行点播激活证据的收集,而无需进行全方位扫描. 在GemmaScope上,DAFI将输入分数比SAGE提高13.1个百分点,将输出分数比Token Change提高38.9个百分点,同时与通用编码代理相比,象征性效率要高得多. 成功改进后产生的技能,将停产联合合格率从58.0%提高到92.0%,并在转而采用新的模式-高级中等教育时,提高口译质量和效率。 具有可靠端点解释的特征,70.7%显示非等效输入和输出语义. 在Ax Bench上,DAFI还比输出分数过滤改进了方向特性选择. 代码见https://github.com/THUAIS-Lab/DAFI。

articles.title: Do Coding Agents Reuse Existing Code or Reinvent the Wheel?
articles.content: Coding agents are increasingly deployed for iterative development on real repositories, yet existing evaluation barely answers a basic question: \emph{do coding agents reuse existing code or reinvent the wheel?} The question matters: every duplicated implementation is a fix applied twice and agents produce code far faster than humans can audit, so redundancy accumulates unsupervised. Thus, we present \textbf{RepoReuse}, a multi-turn benchmark for auditing code reuse in real repositories, where requirements are revealed turn by turn and the workspace accumulates across turns. It is built by a fully automated pipeline combining AST-based dependency graphs, guided evidence collection, and execution-verified task synthesis, and scales readily to new repositories. Beyond pass rates, we measure the reuse rate together with recall and cross-turn structural redundancy. An audit over 3{,}000 turns shows that agents progressively stop exploring relevant repository code, reuse their own history less even when it is fully in the workspace, and leave duplicated logic in 50.8\% of task chains by turn~5---all while pass rates barely move. Such deficiencies are invisible to pass rates, underscoring the need to evaluate code generation beyond functional correctness.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 编码代理是重用现有的代码还是重新发明轮子?
articles.content_zh: 编码剂越来越多地用于在真实寄存器上进行迭代开发,然而现有的评价却几乎无法回答一个基本问题:\emph{do编码剂重新使用已有的编码或重塑轮子?} 问题事项:每一次重复执行都是两次应用的固定,代理生成的代码远快于人类可以审计,因此冗余积累无监督. 因此,我们提出\textbf{ repoReuse},这是在真实存储库中审计代码再利用的多回合基准,其中要求逐次披露,工作空间跨回合累积。 它由一个完全自动化的管道建造,将基于AST的依赖性图表、指导性证据收集、执行核实任务综合以及易于到新储存库的尺度结合起来。 除了通过率之外,我们还衡量再利用率以及召回率和跨转结构冗余率。 一次对 3{,} 000 转弯的审计显示, 代理商逐渐停止探索相关的寄存器代码, 重新使用自己的历史, 即使它完全处于工作空间, 并且通过转弯~ 5 - - - - - - - - 将重复的逻辑留在50.8 的链条中, 而通过率几乎没有移动 。 这种缺陷对于通过率来说是看不见的,突出表明除了功能正确性外,还需要评价代码生成.

articles.title: Jailbreaks for Black-Box Uncertainty Quantification in Large Reasoning Models
articles.content: While Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) excel at complex reasoning, alignment through reinforcement learning often induces systemic overconfidence. In production environments, where logits may be unavailable, robust black-box uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for trustworthiness and safety. Focusing on question-answering for LRMs, we show that existing black-box methods, such as paraphrase-based self-consistency and confidence verbalization, offer little to no improvement over simple repeated sampling, suggesting that alignment suppresses useful output variability. We introduce prompt-level relaxation operators that broaden the model's effective output distribution by approximating the effect of an optimal policy obtained with a stronger KL-regularization parameter, hence closer to the reference model. Theoretically, we demonstrate that relaxation improves calibration. We propose Jailbreak for Uncertainty (J4U), a jailbreak-derived technique for UQ that empirically reproduces the behavioral signatures predicted by our relaxation theory. Across 3 datasets and 4 LRMs, including a closed-source production model, J4U's improvement over repeated sampling achieves statistical significance in up to 6 times more LRM-dataset-metric settings than the strongest black-box UQ state-of-the-art baseline we evaluate, with average ECE reductions up to 5 times larger. These results provide a practical tool for UQ in black-box LRM deployment.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在大理由模型中对黑盒进行不确定量化的监禁
articles.content_zh: 虽然 " 大理性模型 " (LRMs)优于复杂的推理,但通过强化学习进行校正往往会引起系统性的过度自信。 在生产环境中,如果没有对数,强有力的黑箱不确定性量化对于可信度和安全性至关重要。 专注于对LRM的回答,我们显示,现有的黑盒方法,例如以语句为基础的自我一致性和信心的口头化,比简单的重复采样没有什么好改进的,说明对齐抑制了有用的输出变异性. 我们引入了即时放松操作器,通过近似于以更强的KL规范化参数获得的最佳政策的效果来扩大模型的有效输出分布,从而更接近参考模型. 从理论上讲,我们证明放松可以提高校准。 我们提议为不确定性而破狱(J4U),这是UQ的一种越狱技术,在经验上复制了我们放松理论预测的行为特征. 在所有3个数据集和4个LRM中,包括一个封闭源码生产模型,J4U的改进比重复采样在LRM数据集计量设置上达到统计意义,比我们评价的最强黑箱UQ最新基线多6倍,平均欧洲经委会削减量最多5倍。 这些结果为黑盒LRM部署中的UQ提供了一个实用工具.

articles.title: MemoReason: Evaluating the Effect of Parametric Memory on Contextual Reasoning in LLMs
articles.content: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on reasoning benchmarks, but it remains unclear whether this reflects genuine contextual reasoning or reliance on facts memorized in their parameters. We investigate this by distinguishing two possibilities: a broad \textit{memorization bias}, where familiar content improves reasoning performance, and the \textit{Strong Parametric Shortcut Hypothesis}, where models skip reasoning entirely and recall stored answers. To test these effects, we introduce \textbf{MemoReason}, a human-curated benchmark that pairs factual reasoning tasks with structurally identical \fictitiousterm{} versions where real entities like people, companies, or dates are systematically replaced by \fictitiousterm{} ones of the same type. This \scorerevision{preserves task structure and specified reasoning operations} while varying the familiarity of the context, allowing controlled measurement of how the parametric memory affects reasoning. \revision{Our evaluation of recent LLMs reveals consistent and statistically significant performance drops of up to 15.7\% in the fictitious setting, demonstrating a clear memorization bias.} However, a targeted analysis of \revision{questions failed in the fictitious setting} shows that models rarely respond with the corresponding factual answer, indicating that direct parametric shortcuts are not the dominant failure mode. These findings suggest that parametric memory influences reasoning through mechanisms more complex than simple factual recall. \textbf{MemoReason} provides a controlled framework for studying these mechanisms and for extending paired factual-fictitious{} evaluation to broader reasoning settings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 记忆: 评价参数内存对LLMS中背景原因的影响
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)在推理基准上表现良好,但目前还不清楚这是否反映了真实的背景推理,还是依赖于在其参数中记住的事实. 我们通过区分两种可能性来研究这个问题:一种是广义的\textit{memorization prison},即熟悉的内容可以提高推理性能;另一种是\textit{Strong参数快捷键假说},即模型完全跳过推理并召回存储的答案。 为了测试这些效果,我们引入了\textbf{MemoReason},一个人定基准,将事实推理任务与结构相同的\fititionalterm}版本结合起来,其中像人、公司或日期这样的实体被同类型的\fititionalterm}系统取代。 此\ scorerevision{ 保留任务结构和指定的推理操作} 同时改变上下文的熟悉度, 允许对参数内存如何影响推理进行有控制的测量 。 修改{ 我们最近对法学硕士的评价显示,在假构的环境下,持续和统计上显著的绩效下降高达15.7+%,显示出明显的记忆偏差。 } 然而,对\revision{问题在虚构设置中失败}的定向分析表明,模型很少用相应的事实答案来回应,表明直接的参数快捷方式不是主导失败模式. 这些调查结果表明,参数记忆通过比简单的事实召回更复杂的机制影响推理. \ textbf{MemoReason} 提供了一个控制框架, 用于研究这些机制, 并将配对的事实- 假象评价扩展到更广泛的推理环境 。

articles.title: Epistemic Policy Divergence in Multi-Turn LLM Contamination: A Protocol-Gradient Investigation
articles.content: Large language models process conversation history as unverified context: false premises injected into prior turns can be adopted as fact, a failure mode we term session-level contamination. We introduce five contamination protocols arranged along a source-authority gradient, isolating distinct failure mechanisms while holding the false premise constant, and evaluate GPT-5.4 Mini, Gemini-3.1 Flash-Lite, and GLM-4.5-Air across ten knowledge domains at temperature zero (22,500 turns), using a dual-track automated judge validated against a human gold standard (Cohen's \k{appa} = 0.901). GPT-5.4 Mini showed zero adoptions across all 500 sessions, a content-independent policy at the session level; token-level probing shows the underlying margin, while large, is finite. Gemini-3.1 Flash-Lite followed a steep authority gradient: 0.1% adoption for self-attributed falsehoods, 23.5% for user-cited sources, 68.2% for system-injected authority, and 94.0% under instruction override. GLM-4.5-Air showed a shallower gradient (15.8% vs 84.2%), a 68-percentage-point dissociation confirming that authority deference and instruction compliance are distinct mechanisms within one architecture. Recovery also diverged: GLM recovered in 94.5% of affected sessions, whereas 26.1% of affected Gemini sessions never did, rising to 40.0% under instruction override. Conversation history is an untrusted attack surface requiring provenance-aware system design; the complete framework is released as an open-source benchmark.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多曲线 LLM 中的政策差异 污染:一项议定书分层调查
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型处理对话历史作为未经验证的上下文:注入前转弯的假前提可以被采用为事实,这种失败模式我们称会话层污染. 我们采用按源授权梯度排列的5项污染协议,在保持假前提不变的同时隔离明显的故障机制,并在零温(22,500转)下对10个知识域的GPT-5.4 Mini、双子座3.1 Flash-Lite和GLM-4.5-Air进行评价,使用根据人类金本位标准(Cohen's\k{appa}=0.901)验证的双轨自动判官。 GPT-5.4 Mini在所有500届会议中都显示零通过,这是会议一级的一项内容独立的政策;象征性的探测显示基本差值虽然大,但有限。 双子座-3.1闪光灯遵循一个陡峭的权威梯度: 6.1%的自发假象被采纳,23.5%的用户引用来源被采纳,68.2%的系统注入当局被采纳,94.0%的指令被推翻。 GLM-4.5-Air显示的是更浅的梯度(15.8%对84.2%),68个百分点的离合率证实权威的服从和指令的遵守是同一架构中独特的机制。 恢复情况也存在差异:94.5%的受影响会议恢复了性别成份,而26.1%的受影响双子座会议从未恢复,在教学中上升至40.0%。 对话史是一个不信任的攻击表面,需要来源意识系统设计;完整的框架作为开源基准发布.

articles.title: Decide, Don't Generate: Competitive Dimensional ABSA with Jev's Typed Decisions
articles.content: Aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) has largely turned to text generation. We show that competitive dimensional ABSA does not need it. Using Jev, a frozen model that answers typed questions with rubric scores, label probabilities, and yes/no judgments, we decompose all three tasks of SemEval-2026 Task III Track A into such decisions and align them with the annotation scheme through 488 coefficients fitted on CPU, with no text generation and no backbone tuning. On valence-arousal regression over ten corpora in six languages, the system reaches 1.0645 RMSE, the lowest aggregate error of any participating system. On triplet and quadruplet extraction, it reaches 52.09 and 44.06 continuous F1, above fine-tuned Llama-3.3-70B and GPT-OSS-120B baselines. Analyses and ablations show where the accuracy comes from: supervised calibration roughly halves the raw regression error, exact valence-arousal would add only 4.5 F1 to extraction, and the learned combination of span-boundary evidence, not any single signal, carries the extraction systems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 决定,不要产生:竞争性的ABSA 与Jev的打字决定
articles.content_zh: 基于视角的情绪分析(ABSA)已基本转向文本生成. 我们显示,竞争性的维度ABSA不需要它。 使用冷冻模型 Jev 解析了 SemEval-2026 Technology III 的所有三项任务。 音轨 A在此类决定中,通过安装在CPU上的488个系数,使其与注解计划一致,不产生文本,不进行主干调. 在六种语言的值-振荡回归时,系统达到1.0645 RMSE,这是任何参与系统的最小总误差. 在三胞胎和四胞胎提取时,它达到52.09和44.06连续F1,高于微调的Llama-3.3-70B和GPT-OSS-120B基线。 分析和模拟显示准确性来自何方:有监督的校准大约将原始回归误差减半,精确的Valence-arousal只为提取增加4.5 F1,所学的跨边界证据组合,而不是任何单一信号,都带有提取系统.

articles.title: EvoIn: Bridging Evolution and Internalization for Agent Fine-Tuning
articles.content: Recent work has explored improving agents by jointly evolving their harnesses and models, but often takes a ''potpourri'' approach that bundles together new tools, new decision-making procedures, and model adaptation to the evolved harness under a single notion of agent improvement. In this paper, we instead investigate how agents can improve their decision-making procedures. In particular, we propose EvoIn, an agent fine-tuning framework that bridges evolution and internalization. EvoIn first analyzes agent execution traces to evolve and validate new decision-making procedures by temporarily instantiating them in the harness. The validated procedures guide the agent to generate improved reasoning traces. These traces are then rewritten into self-contained reasoning traces, removing explicit references to harness instructions while expressing the induced decision logic as the model's own reasoning. Finally, EvoIn fine-tunes the model on the rewritten traces, internalizing these procedures so that the improved decision-making persists without the evolved harness at inference time. We evaluate EvoIn on diverse benchmarks and find that it consistently enables agents to learn stronger decision-making procedures, raising the pass rate by 10.9 points in-domain and by 9.2 points out-of-domain. Results further show that the internalized decision procedures generalize to unseen tasks. Case studies show that agents can learn to decide how to solve a task before solving it, for example by checking a document's length to choose between reading it in full and searching it. EvoIn is also broadly applicable, showing consistent improvements on another model family.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: EvoIn: 代理精细化的桥梁进化和内化
articles.content_zh: 近期的工作通过联合发展其利用手段和模式来探索改进代理人,但往往采取“potpourri”方法,将新工具、新的决策程序以及模型调整用于一种单一的改进代理人概念下演化的利用。 在本文中,我们调查代理人如何改进其决策程序。 我们特别提议埃沃因,这是一个连接进化和内化的代理人微调框架. EvoIn首先分析特工执行的痕迹,通过临时即兴操作来演化和验证新的决策程序. 经验证的程序指导代理人产生更好的推理痕迹. 这些痕迹随后被重写成自成一体的推理痕迹,删除了利用指令的明确引用,同时将诱导的决定逻辑表达为模型自己的推理. 终于 EvoIn对重写痕迹上的模型进行了微调,将这些程序内部化,以便改进后的决策在推论时间没有进化的利用的情况下持续进行. 我们评价EvoIn的各种基准,发现它始终使代理商能够学习更强有力的决策程序,使通过率在域内提高了10.9个百分点,在域外提高了9.2个百分点。 结果进一步表明,内部化的决定程序将一般化为看不见的任务。 案例研究显示,代理商可以在解决之前学习决定如何解决一个任务,例如通过检查文档的长度来选择在全读和搜索之间. EvoIn也广泛适用,显示出对另一个模范家庭的持续改善.

articles.title: Measuring Collapse and Correction in Homogeneous-Panel LLM Debate
articles.content: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) debate is often evaluated by whether final answers improve, but movement is not necessarily improvement: the same discussion can rescue an initially wrong majority or destroy an initially correct one. Standard final-accuracy evaluations conflate these opposing mechanisms. We introduce an auditable protocol for homogeneous debate on multiple-choice questions (MCQs) that records each run as a transition ledger over collapse, correction, onset, and signed intervention utility. On 6,925 MMLU-Pro debates, the protocol identifies 253 collapses and a parallel correction ledger that changes how interventions should be judged. Replay experiments reveal the central tradeoff: a leave-one-model-out probe-gated freeze prevents 29 collapses but loses 108 corrections under equal weights, so collapse prevention alone can recommend the wrong policy. A compact pre-debate 8-probe screen is a triage signal: its unadjusted family-level association with conditional-collapse risk is high (G=7, Spearman rho=0.893, exact two-sided p=0.0123), but initial-majority accuracy is a close comparator (rho=0.821; family partial rho=0.767, p=0.0877), so we do not treat it as calibrated or capability-adjusted prediction. Round-level traces localize many collapses to the first debate round, where early disagreement can precede both harmful cascades and useful recovery. We release replayable schemas, coders, audits, cost cards, and zero-API rebuild scripts so future model-scaffold rows can be compared under the same denominators and signed utility ledger.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 同源LLM的碰撞和校正 辩论
articles.content_zh: 多代理大语言模型(LLM)辩论往往通过最终答案是否改进来评价,但运动并不一定是改进的:同样的讨论可以挽救最初错误的多数或者摧毁最初正确的多数. 标准的最后准确性评价将这些对立机制混为一谈。 我们推出一个可审计的协议,用于对多个选择问题进行相同辩论(MCQs),将每个问题记录为一个过渡分类账,以克服崩溃、纠正、启动和签名的干预工具。 在6,925 MMLU-Pro的辩论中,协议确定了253个崩溃和一个平行的更正分类账,这些分类账改变了如何判断干预措施。 重播实验揭示了中心取舍:一个留置式的一模一样的探针冻结可以防止29次倒塌,但在同等重量下损失了108次改正,因此仅防倒塌就可以建议错误的政策. 紧凑的预辩论8-概率显示屏是一个分解信号:其无调整的家族层面与有条件的碰撞风险关联度很高(G=7,斯皮尔曼rho=0.893,精确的双侧p=0.0123),但初始多数精度是接近的参照度(rho=0.821;家族部分rho=0.767,p=0.0877),所以我们不把它视为校准或能力调整的预测. 回合级的痕迹将许多塌陷地方化到第一轮辩论,在第一轮辩论中,早期的分歧既可以先于有害的级联,也可以是有用的恢复. 我们发布可重复播放的计数器,编码器,审计,成本卡,以及零API重建脚本,这样未来的模型-脚手架行可以在相同的分母和签名的效用分类账下进行比较.

articles.title: When Words Speak Louder than Images: Towards Understanding Language Bias in Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Despite substantial progress across downstream applications, vision-language models (VLMs) remain susceptible to language bias, often prioritizing linguistic cues over visual evidence and consequently producing incorrect predictions. Prior studies have proposed various approaches to understanding and mitigating language bias in VLMs, yet their findings often conflict due to the difficulty of tracing how language bias propagates within black-box VLMs. Building on the word completion task, we trace how language bias propagates through VLM inference by (1) proposing a diagnostic framework that decomposes the inference process into four distinct yet interdependent stages to trace the propagation of language bias; and (2) examining how two key factors underlying language bias, i.e., linguistic priors and cross-modal coverage, evolve across these stages and ultimately give rise to incorrect predictions. The linguistic prior captures the strength of statistical bias induced by the language model component of a VLM and represents the origin of language bias, whereas cross-modal coverage measures the extent to which linguistic cues cover the visual content. By decomposing inference into four stages and characterizing the interplay between linguistic priors and cross-modal coverage across these stages, we propose a systematic framework for tracing the propagation of language bias throughout the inference process; and uncover the underlying mechanism of language bias by revealing the interplay between linguistic priors and cross-modal coverage.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当言语比图像大声:在视觉语言模型中理解语言偏见
articles.content_zh: 尽管在下游应用中取得了很大进展,但视觉语言模型仍然容易受到语言偏见的影响,往往将语言提示置于视觉证据之上,从而产生不正确的预测。 先前的研究提出了理解和减轻VLM语言偏差的各种方法,但是由于难以追踪语言偏差如何在黑盒VLM中传播,其发现往往有冲突. 在完成单词任务的基础上,我们通过VLM推论跟踪语言偏差是如何传播的:(1) 提出一个诊断框架,将推论过程分解为四个不同但相互依存的阶段,以跟踪语言偏差的传播;(2) 审查语言偏差背后的两个关键因素,即语言学前科和跨模式覆盖,如何在这些阶段演变,并最终导致不正确的预测。 语言学前期抓住了由VLM语言模型组成部分引起的统计偏差的强度,代表了语言偏差的起源,而跨模式覆盖则衡量语言暗示覆盖视觉内容的程度. 通过将推论分为四个阶段,并描述语言学前科和跨模式覆盖之间的相互作用,我们建议建立一个系统框架,以追踪在整个推论过程中语言偏差的传播情况;通过揭示语言学前科和跨模式覆盖之间的相互作用,揭示语言偏差的基本机制。

articles.title: Rubric-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Personalization
articles.content: LLM personalization aims to generate responses aligned with individual users' preferences and needs. User-specific rubrics make these expectations explicit, providing direct supervision on what a satisfactory answer should cover. Existing rubric-guided approaches, however, exploit such guidance only at a coarse granularity, either by using rubrics to supervise the prediction of relevant aspects for subsequent generation or by reducing aspect coverage to a single response-level reward for reinforcement learning. This leaves a gap between specifying what a personalized answer should contain and teaching the model how to generate it. To bridge this gap, we propose GRASP, a rubric-aware on-policy self-distillation framework for LLM personalization that turns user-specific rubric aspects into fine-grained, token-level supervision. Specifically, GRASP pairs a rubric-free student with a rubric-informed teacher that additionally receives the target user-specific rubrics. By aligning their next-token distributions along on-policy trajectories generated by the student, GRASP transfers the teacher's rubric-conditioned guidance into the student, translating user-specific semantic requirements into dense token-level supervision. Since rubric-informed teachers can still produce inadequate supervision, we further introduce Rubric-based Teacher Validation (RTV), which retains only instances where the teacher sufficiently covers the target aspects, improving both supervision quality and training efficiency. Experiments on the LaMP-QA benchmark for personalized question answering demonstrate that GRASP achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple backbones, supporting the effectiveness of rubric-guided token-level supervision for personalization. To ensure reproducibility, our code is available at https://github.com/SnowCharmQ/GRASP.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Rubric-Aware LLM 个性化的自控
articles.content_zh: LLM个性化旨在生成与个人用户的偏好和需求相一致的响应. 用户特有的标题明确了这些期望,直接监督满意的答案应涵盖哪些内容。 但是,现有的标题制导方法只在粗粒性时才利用这种制导方法,要么使用标题来监督对相关方面的预测,供以后生成,要么将侧面覆盖范围缩小到加强学习的单一响应级奖励。 这就在具体说明一个个性化的答案应该包含什么和教导模型如何生成之间留下了空白. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出巨猿生存方案,这是一个关于LLM个性化的具有政策意识的自我消化框架,它将用户特有的主题方面转化为精细的、象征性的监督。 具体地说,巨猿生存方案将一名无标记的学生与一名有标记知识的教师配对,后者额外接收目标用户专用的标记。 GRASP通过根据学生生成的政策轨迹调整其下接的语义分布,将教师的标语化指导转移到学生身上,将用户特有的语义要求转化为密集的符号级监督. 由于基于名义知识的教师仍能产生不充分的监督,我们进一步采用了基于Rubric的教师鉴定(RTV),这只保留了教师充分涵盖目标方面的情况,提高了监督质量和培训效率。 关于个性化问答的LAMP-QA基准的实验表明,巨猿生存方案实现了跨越多个骨干骨干的最先进的性能,支持了robrique-guide-sorder-level监管个人化的有效性. 为确保可复制,我们的代码可在https://github.com/SnowCharmQ/GRASP上查阅。

articles.title: SCBO: Semantically Coherent Batching and Ordering for LLM-Based Social Surveys
articles.content: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a scalable way to simulate survey respondents using demographic profiles and observed reference responses. However, the conventional approach of predicting one question per prompt repeatedly encodes the same context, limits each target to a narrow set of reference responses, and prevents later predictions from using information in earlier answers. Predicting multiple questions in one prompt can reduce these costs, share a broader pool of references, and let later predictions build on earlier ones. This requires forming coherent batches, selecting shared references, and ordering questions and references effectively. We propose Semantically Coherent Batching and Ordering (SCBO), a training-free framework that addresses these challenges. SCBO first uses an LLM to extract compact semantic representations from survey items and filter out template noise. It then groups related questions into batches and builds a shared reference bank using target-specific retrieval and centroid-based completion. Finally, it orders target questions from easy to hard and arranges references according to their semantic alignment with those questions. Experiments on four large-scale survey datasets and four LLMs show that SCBO substantially reduces token consumption and inference time while generally improving prediction accuracy over a non-batched baseline. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SCBO-41D8.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SCBO: 以LLM为基础的社会调查的语义协调鞭打和订购
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)提供了一种可扩展的方法,利用人口概况和观察到的参考答复模拟调查答卷人。 然而,每秒预测一个问题的常规方法反复编码相同的上下文,将每个目标限制在狭义的一组参考答复,并阻止以后的预测在早期的答案中使用信息. 在一个瞬间预测多个问题可以减少这些费用,分享更广泛的参考文献,以后的预测可以借鉴先前的预测。 这就需要形成一致的批次,选择共同的参考文献,并有效地排列问题和参考文献。 我们提议从语义上讲,协调划线和秩序(SCBO),这是应对这些挑战的无培训框架。 SCBO首先使用LLM从调查项目中提取紧凑的语义表述,并过滤出模板噪声. 然后,它将相关问题分为几批,并使用特定目标检索和基于人造机器人的完成,建立一个共享的参考库。 最后,它命令目标问题从容易到难的问题,并根据与这些问题的语义一致安排参考。 对四个大规模调查数据集和四个LLMs的实验表明,SCBO大大减少了象征性的消耗和推论时间,同时总体上提高了对非争辩基线的预测准确性. 编码见https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SCBO-41D8。

articles.title: SignFLIP: A Unified Model for Sign Language Translation and Generation via Stage-wise Alignment at Scale
articles.content: Sign language translation and generation share the goal of bidirectional alignment between text and sign representations. However, existing approaches either treat them as isolated tasks or are only verified on limited datasets, limiting effective modeling between modalities. In this paper, we propose SignFLIP, a unified LLM-centered framework for translation and generation. To enable bidirectional mapping between text and sign, SignFLIP adopts a symmetric architecture together with a stage-wise training strategy built on large-scale data. The shared sign--text representation is progressively refined: pre-alignment facilitates subsequent SLT, while the SLT-adapted representation further benefits SLG. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that SignFLIP shows competitive performance compared with task-specific models on both translation and generation tasks, as well as strong transferability to sign language recognition.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SignFLIP: 手语翻译和生成的统一模型, 采用分阶段对齐的缩放
articles.content_zh: 手语翻译和生成共同的目标是文本和签名表达的双向对齐. 然而,现有办法要么将它们视为孤立的任务,要么只在有限的数据集上加以核实,从而限制了不同模式之间有效的建模。 在本文中,我们提出了SignFLIP,一个统一的LLM中心框架,用于翻译和生成. 为了实现文本和符号之间的双向映射,SignFLIP采用了一个对称架构,同时采用基于大规模数据的阶段性训练策略. 共享的署名文字表示方式逐渐完善:预先调整有利于后续的SLT,而SLT调整后的表示方式则进一步有利于SLG. 对多个基准的广泛实验表明,SignFLIP在翻译和生成任务方面与任务特定模式相比,表现出了竞争性的性能,以及强大的手语识别可转移性.

articles.title: TANGO: Watermarking Masked Diffusion Language Models in Token Pairs
articles.content: Masked-diffusion language models fill in masked positions in parallel and in no fixed order. Most practical text watermarks assume left-to-right generation. They key each token to the tokens before it, and in a diffusion model those tokens may still be masked. A fixed green list needs no such context, but it favors the same tokens at every position, so these tokens appear more often in watermarked text. An attacker who compares token frequencies in watermarked and unwatermarked text can recover the list and forge text that the provider's own detector accepts. We present TANGO, a watermark for masked-diffusion language models that keys each new token to a nearby token that is already unmasked. A secret key splits the vocabulary into color classes, and TANGO biases the new token toward a color determined by the key and the nearby token's color. The watermark is therefore embedded in pairs of tokens. Because the favored color changes from position to position, token frequencies stay much closer to those of unwatermarked text than under a fixed green list. Detection needs only the text and the key, and it does not assume any unmasking order. On two masked-diffusion models, TANGO detects nearly all unedited watermarked texts and most edited ones, and frequency attacks that forge the fixed green list fail against it.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TANGO: Token Pairs的水印扩散语言模型
articles.content_zh: 蒙面扩散语言模型以平行,无固定顺序填补蒙面位置. 大多数实用的文字水印假设是左对右生成. 他们把每个符号按在它之前的符号上,在扩散模型中,这些符号仍然可能被蒙上面具. 固定的绿色列表不需要这样的上下文,但它在每一个位置上都倾向于相同的符号,因此这些符号更经常出现在水印文字中. 攻击者在标注水和未标注水的文字中比较符号频率,可以收回列表并伪造提供者自己探测器接受的文字. 我们介绍TANGO, 一个用于遮掩扩散语言模型的水印, 一个秘密密钥将词汇分成颜色类, TANGO将新符号偏向于由密钥和附近符号颜色决定的颜色. 水印因此嵌入成对符. 由于偏好的颜色从位置变化到位置,与固定的绿色列表相比,符号频率与未标注文字的频率保持远近. 侦测只需要文本和密钥,它并不假定任何解密的顺序. 在两个蒙面扩散模型上,TANGO检测到几乎所有未经编辑的标有水印的文本和大多数经过编辑的文本,伪造固定绿名单的频率攻击失败.

articles.title: Understanding On-Policy Distillation: A Mechanistic Interpretability Perspective via Sparse Crosscoders
articles.content: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a widely adopted post-training technique for LLM reasoning. It is commonly believed to transfer knowledge from a stronger teacher, yet what OPD actually distills into the student's internal representations remains unclear. We study this question with sparse crosscoders, which learn one feature dictionary shared by the student before and after OPD and the teacher. Standard crosscoder analyses, however, identify model-specific features but cannot tell how a model's use of its features changes, since all models are encoded into one set of feature activations. We therefore propose the swap readout, which reads each student checkpoint's feature activations on its own, measuring how training changes the student's use of each feature, even for checkpoints unseen by the crosscoder. Across three OPD settings, we find that OPD neither creates features nor passes on the teacher's own, and leaves the firing rates of over 98% of the student's frequently used features within 20%. We further examine the SFT warm-up on the teacher's rollouts that commonly precedes OPD and makes it more effective. Rather than adding features, the warm-up reweights the shared ones in two ways. First, it already raises and lowers many of the features that OPD later raises and lowers, doing part of OPD's work in advance. Second, it changes features that OPD alone would not, notably those for conversation format, reasoning style, and mathematical notation, and these changes persist through OPD. Imposing this reweighting on a directly distilled student's features, without changing its weights, brings its accuracy close to that of the warmed-up student, whereas the same change on shuffled features does not. Together, these findings suggest that OPD reweights existing features rather than acquiring new ones: the student learns from the teacher how to use the features they already share.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过 Sparse 交叉编码器理解政策扭曲:一种机械化可解释性视角
articles.content_zh: 政策蒸馏(OPD)是LLM推理的一种广泛采用的训练后技术. 人们通常认为,从更强的教师那里转移知识,然而,OPD实际上将哪些内容提炼成学生的内部表述,仍然不清楚。 我们用稀疏的交叉编码器来研究这个问题,它学习了一个由学生在OPD和老师前后共享的特征词典. 然而,标准交叉编码器分析确定了模型特有的特征,但无法分辨一个模型对其特征的用途是如何变化的,因为所有模型都被编码成一组特征激活. 因此,我们提议进行互换读取,该读取每个学生检查站的功能激活,衡量培训如何改变学生对每个功能的使用,即使是交叉编码器看不见的检查站。 校对:Soup 我们进一步审查通常在OPD之前推出的SFT热身,使其更加有效。 与其增加特征,热身则以两种方式重新对共享的特征进行加权. 首先,它已经提高和降低了OPD后来提高和降低的许多特征,提前完成了OPD的部分工作. 其次,它改变的是OPD本身不会有的特征,尤其是对话格式,推理风格,以及数学符号等,这些变化通过OPD持续存在. 将这种重量加在直接蒸馏的学生特征上,而不改变其重量,使得其准确度接近于热身学生的精度,而对洗涤特征的相同变化则不然. 这些调查结果表明,OPD重新权衡现有特征而不是获得新的特征:学生从老师那里学习如何使用他们已经共享的特征.

articles.title: From Normative Frameworks to Alignment Data: Constructing and Evaluating SFT and Preference Data
articles.content: Aligning language models with a specified normative framework requires translating abstract principles into concrete examples and preference signals from which models can learn. We present an expert-driven methodology for constructing such alignment data and apply it to a normative framework grounded in Islamic ethical, theological, and jurisprudential traditions. Over approximately one year, seven domain experts systematically probed language models to identify alignment deficiencies, curated desired responses, and constructed preference pairs from model outputs and expert judgments. The resulting Arabic-English datasets contain approximately 2.8K supervised fine-tuning (SFT) examples and 5.4K preference pairs spanning a broad range of normative domains. We evaluate the datasets through controlled post-training experiments comparing a Baseline model with models incorporating the curated SFT data alone and both the SFT and preference data. In blind expert evaluation on 150 separately constructed prompts, the model trained with the curated SFT data was preferred over the Baseline in 51.3% of assessor judgments, compared with 14.4% in the opposite direction (p < .001 at the prompt level). Adding the preference data resulted in a smaller difference, with the model trained with both datasets preferred over the SFT model in 28.0% of judgments versus 20.9% in the opposite direction; this difference was not statistically significant at the prompt level (p = .166). Standard Arabic and English benchmarks show no broad degradation in general-purpose capabilities. These results demonstrate how expert-defined normative principles can be systematically operationalized into alignment data and evaluated through controlled model training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从规范框架到对齐数据:构建和评价SFT和优先数据
articles.content_zh: 将语言模型与特定规范框架相协调,需要将抽象原则转化为具体的例子和偏好信号,模型可以从中学习. 我们提出了一种专家驱动的方法,用以构建这种统一数据,并将其应用于基于伊斯兰道德、神学和法学传统的规范框架。 在大约一年的时间里,7名域专家系统地探索了语言模型,以查明校对缺陷,整理了所希望的反应,并根据模型产出和专家判断构建了偏好对。 由此产生的阿拉伯文-英文数据集包含大约2.8K监督微调(SFT)实例和5.4K偏好对,跨越广泛的规范领域。 我们通过有控制的训练后试验来评价数据集,将基线模型与只包含SFT数据以及SFT和偏好数据的模型进行比较。 在对150个单独构造的提示器进行盲目专家评价时,在51.3%的评估员判决中,以经过整理的SFT数据培训的模型比基线更受青睐,而相反方向的模型为14.4%(即时水平为 < 001页)。 添加偏好数据导致差异较小,在28.0%的判断中,两个数据集都比SFT模型好,而相反方向为20.9%;这种差异在迅速水平上在统计上并不显著(p=1.66)。 标准的阿拉伯语和英语基准表明,普通用途能力没有普遍退化。 这些结果表明,如何将专家界定的规范原则系统地应用到统一数据中,并通过控制模式培训进行评估。

articles.title: 5W1H+Which: Context-Valid Semantic Indexing with Progressive Ontology Binding
articles.content: Transforming raw data into queryable knowledge requires both early extraction of reusable information and explicit types, relations, and applicability conditions for particular tasks. If indexing selects content too early around a single business schema, later tasks may be unable to use information that was omitted. If the index retains only open-ended text, however, rule-based reasoning lacks checkable premises. We propose 5W1H+Which, a semantic indexing design that separates content extraction from ontology binding. The 5W1H questions organize source-grounded content units; Which points to versioned ontology elements and records mapping relations, scope, and validation status. Time, location, system environment, and participant roles are not merely retrieval labels: together, they constrain the contexts in which facts, bindings, and rules apply. Unbound content remains searchable, while bound content enters a formal reasoning path only after premise checks. The method further distinguishes business valid time, system knowledge time, and operational traces, and uses dependency records to support binding revalidation and the maintenance of derived conclusions. A worked example of migration from an on-premises server to a cloud environment illustrates the different treatment of world-state changes, ontology-version changes, and changes in rule applicability. We formulate three groups of falsifiable hypotheses concerning cross-task evidence coverage, control of contextual misuse, and incremental update cost. The planned evaluation includes a strong typed fact-graph baseline with the same evidence, temporal information, and budget, to test whether benefits arise from 5W1H organization, deferred binding, or additional information and engineering effort. The contribution is a testable indexing mechanism, not a claim to a new universal ontology or a demonstrated performance advantage.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 5W1H+Whhich:用累进本体法绑定的语义索引
articles.content_zh: 将原始数据转化为可查询知识,既需要及早提取可重复使用的信息,也需要明确的类型、关系和特定任务的适用条件。 如果索引在单个商业计划周围选择内容太早,以后的任务可能无法使用被省略的信息. 但是,如果索引只保留开放式文本,则基于规则的推理缺乏可核查的前提。 我们提出5W1H+Which,一种语义索引设计,将内容提取与肿瘤约束区分开来. 5W1H问题组织基于源的内容单位;其中指版本的本体元素和记录映射关系,范围和验证状态. 时间、地点、系统环境和参与者角色不仅仅是检索标签:它们共同限制了适用事实、约束和规则的背景。 不受约束的内容仍然可以搜索,而受约束的内容只有在进行前提检查后才进入正式的推理路径. 这种方法进一步区分了业务有效时间,系统知识时间,以及操作痕迹,并使用依赖性记录支持约束性再验证和维护衍生结论. 一个从presises服务器迁移到云环境的范例说明了对世界状态变化,本体论-版本变化以及规则适用性变化的不同处理. 我们制定了三组可伪造的假设,涉及跨任务证据范围、控制背景滥用和增加更新费用。 计划进行的评价包括一个有相同证据、时间信息和预算的强效实景基线,以检验5W1H组织、推迟约束、或额外信息和工程工作是否带来好处。 这种贡献是一种可验证的索引机制,而不是声称具有新的普遍本体学或明显的性能优势。

articles.title: A mechanistic study of language model introspection
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) can sometimes report perturbations to their internal activations---even when the input provides no evidence that an intervention occurred. How do models detect and localize such internal changes? We study this question using a controlled task that keeps the input text fixed. We either inject a concept vector into the hidden state at one of ten token positions or apply no intervention. The model is asked to identify the perturbed position or report that no intervention occurred. Across three model families, we identify two small groups of attention heads with distinct roles in introspective reporting. Middle-layer gate heads influence whether the model reports a change, while router heads in a later layer help select the position to report. Interventions on gate heads can suppress position reports even when router heads supply location information. We further examine why reporting accuracy varies across concepts. Concept vectors that are localized more accurately produce stronger attention-score and output responses in gate heads, which is associated with better alignment of the induced key and value changes in their QK and OV computations. Together, these findings identify attention-head mechanisms supporting introspective detection and localization.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语言模型内观的机械学研究
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)有时可以向内部激活报告扰动——即使输入没有提供发生干预的证据. 模型如何检测和定位这种内部变化? 我们用一个控制的任务来研究这个问题,这个任务使输入文本保持固定. 我们要么在10个象征性位置之一向隐藏状态注入一个概念矢量,要么不采取任何干预措施。 要求该模型确定令人不安的位置或报告没有进行干预。 在三个模范家庭,我们发现两个小群的注意力头目,在内向报告中发挥不同的作用。 中层门头会影响模型是否报告变化,而路由器头在后层帮助选择要报告的位置. 即使路由器头提供位置信息,门头上的干预也可以压制位置报告. 我们进一步审查为什么报告准确性因概念而异。 更准确本地化的概念矢量在门头产生更强的注意分数和输出响应,这与其QK和OV计算中诱导的密钥和值变化的更好对齐有关. 这些结论共同确定了支持内向检测和本地化的注意点机制。

articles.title: When Confidence Rises Too Early: Detecting Shortcut Reasoning via Premature Answer Commitment
articles.content: The reasoning trajectory of a Large Language Model (LLM) is often treated as a verbalized description of its internal reasoning. However, such trajectories can be unfaithful: a model may rely on shortcuts to reach an answer and then post-rationalize the decision with a seemingly coherent chain of thought. Detecting this shortcut reasoning is challenging because existing monitors and verifiers mainly inspect textual traces or final outcomes, rather than how the model's belief in its answer develops during generation. We introduce ConfLens, a framework that tracks the evolution of confidence in the final answer throughout reasoning. Across three shortcut reasoning settings, we observe a common pattern of premature confidence, where shortcut samples become highly confident in the final answer at early reasoning stages. Existing confidence estimation methods, however, show limited generalizability, reliability, or efficiency for detecting this behavior. We therefore propose the Distributional Answer Commitment Score (DACS), a distributional confidence estimator that measures the entropy of the model's probability distribution over answer commitment at each reasoning step. DACS captures how concentrated the model's answer belief is without requiring ground-truth answers or task-specific verifiers. We further convert ConfLens detection results into interpretable signals for reward models to reduce their preference for shortcut reasoning. Experiments on mathematical and code reasoning tasks show that ConfLens with DACS improves shortcut reasoning detection by over 4.3% F1 compared with strong baselines and reduces the mismatch between faithfulness and correctness in reward model preferences.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 当信心上升太早时:通过过早回答承诺发现快捷键
articles.content_zh: 一个大语言模型(LLM)的推理轨迹往往被视为对其内部推理的口头描述. 然而,这种轨迹可能是不忠的:一个模型可能依靠捷径来达到一个答案,然后用一个看似连贯的思想链来对决定进行再合理化. 检测这种捷径推理具有挑战性,因为现有的显示器和核查器主要检查文字痕迹或最终结果,而不是模型在生成过程中对答案的信念如何发展. 我们引入了ConfLens,这个框架跟踪了对最终答案的信心在整个推理过程中的演变. 通过三个快捷推理设置,我们观察到一种不成熟信心的共同模式,即快捷抽样在早期推理阶段对最终答案具有高度信心. 然而,现有的信心估计方法显示,在检测这种行为方面,普遍性、可靠性或效率有限。 因此,我们提议采用分配式回答承诺计分(DACS),即一个分配式信心估计器,在每一推理步骤中,衡量模型概率分配相对于回答承诺的内涵。 DACS捕捉到模型的答案信念是如何集中的,而不需要地面真实答案或特定任务验证器. 我们进一步将ConfLens检测结果转换为可解释的信号,用于奖励模型,以减少他们对快捷推理的偏好. 关于数学和代码推理任务的实验表明,与强基线相比,ConfLens与DACS改进了4.3%以上的快捷推理检测,并减少了奖励模式偏好中的忠诚度和正确度之间的不匹配.

articles.title: Echoes of Deeds: Moral History Can Shape and Steer LLM Behavioral Choices
articles.content: Evaluations of Large Language Models (LLMs) morality typically consider decisions in isolation, thus overlooking whether an individual's unrelated prior conduct influences the model's subsequent choices. This leaves open the question of whether, and to what extent, moral history shapes LLM decisional behaviors. Prior work on human moral decision-making shows that past behavior can influence subsequent moral choices. Building on this observation, we investigate whether analogous effects emerge in LLMs in two complementary ways: at the behavioral level, through the model's observable responses, and at the representation level, through its latent internal representations. We introduce MoralLedger, a framework for studying how an actor's moral history shapes actions for LLMs' behaviors under a fixed decision context. At the behavioral level, we find that prior moral histories systematically alter subsequent choices as a function of their valence and intensity. At the internal representation level, these histories induce a linearly recoverable direction in the residual stream that generalizes to held-out examples. Intervening along this direction on neutral-history prompts produces two-sided intensity-dependent changes in subsequent choices, with effects that are stronger than those induced by prompting alone or by favorable-nonmoral direction. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration that a latent representation of an actor's prior moral conduct can provide signed inference-time control over a moral decision. Our MoralLedger extends moral evaluation beyond static dilemmas, establishing moral history as both a source of behavioral sensitivity and a causal target for auditing and controlling moral behavior in LLMs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 行为回声:道德历史可以塑造和引导LLM行为选择
articles.content_zh: 对大语言模型(LLMs)道德的评价通常会孤立地考虑决定,从而忽略个人无关的前行为是否影响模型随后的选择. 这使得道德史是否以及在多大程度上塑造了LLM决策行为的问题没有定论. 以前对人类道德决策的研究表明,过去的行为可以影响后来的道德选择. 基于这一看法,我们调查法学硕士是否以两种互补方式出现类似效果:在行为层面,通过模型的可观察反应;在代表层面,通过潜在的内部表述。 我们引入了道德莱德格(MoralLedger),这是一个研究一个演员的道德史如何在固定的决策背景下塑造LLM的行为的架构. 在行为层面,我们发现,先前的道德史系统地改变了后来的选择,因为它的活力和强度。 在内部代表一级,这些历史在剩余流中诱导了线性可恢复的方向,概括到搁置的例子。 沿着这个方向干涉中性历史的提示,在以后的选择中会产生两面性强度依赖的变化,其影响比单独引发或不道德导向引发的影响更强. 据我们所知,这是第一个证明,一个行为者先前的道德行为的潜在表现能够对道德决定进行签名的推断时间控制。 我们的道德编辑将道德评价扩展到了静态的两难境地之外,将道德史确立为行为敏感性的来源和在LLMs中审计和控制道德行为的因果目标.

articles.title: VEX-Bench: Benchmarking Verification Complexity of LLM-Generated Misinformation
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) have made misinformation inexpensive to produce but not to verify, creating a growing asymmetry in the information ecosystem. Under tight time, labor, and budget constraints, media organizations, platforms, and fact-checkers rely on screening to prioritize which content to verify. We introduce VEX-Bench, a unified benchmark for evaluating the verification complexity of LLM-generated misinformation, as perceived during screening, across models and generation methods. Verification complexity is assessed along multiple dimensions derived from journalistic and fact-checking practices, capturing checkability, harm potential, source credibility signals, imposter legitimacy, and expected verification effort. We define the VEX score as an integrated measure combining elicitation yield and verification complexity to quantify how generated content consumes limited verification capacity. We construct a benchmark spanning two misinformation categories, 6 high-stakes domains, and 60 real-world topics, and evaluate 7 frontier LLMs and 7 generation methods, yielding 5{,}880 articles. We employ an LLM-as-judge for scalable evaluation and validate it using content-analysis methodology, including ordinal Krippendorff $α$ for inter-annotator reliability, complemented by fact-checking agents for verification. Our findings show that no single method dominates all dimensions, underscoring the need for multi-dimensional evaluation. LLMs can generate high-VEX misinformation at 3$\times$ to 169$\times$ lower cost than agent-based verification. Such content is often prioritized during screening, consuming scarce verification resources and introducing a systematic risk of misallocation in resource-constrained verification systems. The code is publicly available in our \href{https://github.com/HanxunH/VEX-Bench}{GitHub repository}.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VEX-Bench:LLM-Gened misnecification的核查复杂性基准
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型使错误信息价格低廉,无法产生,但无法核实,造成信息生态系统日益不对称。 在紧张的时间、劳动和预算限制下,媒体组织、平台和事实检查员依靠筛选来确定哪些内容需要核实。 我们采用VEX-Bench这一统一基准,用于评估在筛选过程中、在模型和生成方法中发现的LLM产生的错误信息的核查复杂性。 核查的复杂性是根据新闻和事实检查做法产生的多个层面来评估的,这些做法包括:核查可核查性、损害潜力、来源可信度信号、冒名顶替的合法性以及预期的核查努力。 我们把VEX分数定义为一种综合措施,结合了诱导结果和核查的复杂性,以量化生成的内容如何消耗有限的核查能力。 我们构建了一个涵盖两个错误信息类别的基准,6个高考领域和60个现实世界专题,并评价7个前沿法学硕士和7个生成方法,产生5{,}880篇文章。 我们聘请一个LLM即时法官进行可扩展评价,并使用内容分析方法加以验证,包括说明人之间的可靠性的正则Krippendorff $α美元,并辅之以核查的实况调查代理人。 我们的调查结果表明,没有一种单一的方法支配所有层面,这突出表明需要进行多层面评价。 LLMS可以产生高VEX错误信息,比基于代理的核查费用低3美元\时间到169美元\时间. 在筛选过程中,这类内容往往得到优先考虑,消耗了稀缺的核查资源,并给受资源限制的核查系统带来了系统化的不当分配风险。 该代码在我们\href{https://github.com/HanxunH/VEX-Bench}{GitHub仓库}中公开发布.

articles.title: WebPageBench: Event-Level Verification and Controlled UI-Variant Generation for Web Agents
articles.content: We present WebPageBench, an open framework for evaluating web agents in which every task is verified from the interface's own event log. Six instrumented mock sites with brand identifiers removed (a marketplace, a bookstore, a grocery service, rail ticketing, hotel search and a document cabinet) emit typed events with parameters as a user or an agent acts. A task declares the events it requires, and success is decided by matching them, with no judge model and no scraping of rendered pages. The same instrumentation supports controlled UI variation: one configuration switch re-renders a task through a different implementation of a single control while the prompt and the success conditions stay completely identical, so sensitivity to interface form can be measured under a fixed task specification. The WebPageBench release consists of three components: 152 tasks, divided into 65 canonical scenarios and 87 control variants across light/dark UI-modes; a common runner evaluated with six browser/DOM harness configurations and five screenshot-only GUI-agent families; and a public leaderboard of 24 model-harness pairs. On the public 152-task leaderboard the gap between what agents declare finished and what the log confirms reaches 41 points (one configuration declares every task finished and satisfies the conditions on 59%).
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: WebPage Bench: 事件级验证和控制的网络代理的UI - Variant生成
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍WebPage Bench,一个用于评价网络代理的开放框架,其中从界面自己的事件日志中验证每一项任务. 六个带有品牌标识的仪器模拟网站(一个市场、一个书店、一个杂货店、一个铁路售票、酒店搜索和一个文件柜)以用户或代理行为的方式发出带有参数的事件。 一项任务宣布它所需要的事件,而成功则通过匹配它们来决定,没有法官模型,也不会刮掉已提供的页面。 相同的仪器支持受控UI变异:一个配置切换器通过不同执行单个控件而重新交付一个任务,同时即时和成功条件保持完全相同,因此对界面形态的敏感性可以在固定的任务规格下进行测量. WebPage Bench发行由三个部分组成:152项任务,分为65个犬形假想和87个控制变体,跨越光/暗的UI-modes;一个普通的跑者,以6个浏览器/DOM的吊带配置和5个只截图的GUI代理家庭来评价;以及24个模型harness配对的公共领导板. 在公共的152任务领导板上,哪些代理人宣布已完成,哪些日志确认达到41点(一个配置宣布每项任务完成,满足59%的条件)之间的差距。

articles.title: The Right Lesson at the Right Step: Deriving Control Updates for Self-Evolving Agents
articles.content: Self-evolving agents improve future behavior by reusing past experience, typically as global prompts, memories, or reflections. Yet these mechanisms rarely control where experience takes effect. In long tool-use workflows, the same lesson may correct one decision but distract another, making experience reuse a problem of localized control rather than memory alone. We introduce EvoCUE (Evolution through Control Updates from Evidence), a framework for learning reusable control-program updates from completed agent executions. EvoCUE represents the agent as an explicit state-machine controller, whose nodes perform model or tool calls and whose edges define where control passes next. This makes the workflow editable at precise locations, so each learned update can specify what to add, where it acts, and when it applies. From completed trajectories, EvoCUE uses residual goals and observed execution traces to propose localized instruction or skill edits. Each candidate is evaluated at the point where it would act by resuming the parent and edited controllers from the same checkpoint and comparing their final outcomes. Accepted edits are compiled with applicability rules, confirmed on held-out tasks, and inherited by later executions. We evaluate EvoCUE on long tool-use environments where learned conventions must reach the right execution step. From a minimal AppWorld controller without benchmark-specific onboarding instructions, EvoCUE learns the missing task-completion convention and substantially improves success on Test-Normal and Test-Challenge. On PAST-Bench office workflows, EvoCUE transfers organizational requirements from prior episodes to later tasks, improving task-execution quality. These results show that self-evolving agents should place experience inside the control flow, rather than only store it as text.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 右阶下的右阶课:自演代理的衍生控制更新
articles.content_zh: 自我演化剂通过重用过去的经验来改善未来的行为,一般作为全球的提示,记忆,或反射. 然而,这些机制很少能控制经验的产生。 在漫长的工具使用工作流程中,同样的教训可能纠正一个决定,但分散另一个决定的注意力,使经验再利用成为局部控制而非仅内存的问题. 我们引入了EvoCUE(通过证据更新控制演变),这是一个从已完成的代理人处决中学习可重复使用的控制程序更新的框架。 EvoCUE作为明确的状态机器控制器代表代理,其节点执行模型或工具调用,其边缘则定义了控制在下一个位置. 这使得工作流程可以在准确的地点进行编辑,因此每次学到的更新都可以指定添加什么,它在哪里行动,何时应用. EvoCUE从完成的轨迹中,使用剩余目标及观察到的执行痕迹,提出本地化的指令或技能编辑. 对每个候选人的评价是在它采取行动时,通过将母和编辑控制员从同一个检查站恢复,并比较其最后结果。 接受的编辑是按适用规则汇编的,在被搁置的任务上得到确认,并由后来的处决继承。 我们评价EvoCUE关于长期的工具使用环境,在这种环境中,学到的公约必须达到正确的执行步骤。 EvoCUE从一个没有特定基准登机指令的最小AppWorld控制器中学习了缺少的任务完成常规,并大大改善了测试-正常和测试-挑战的成功. 关于PAST-Bench办公室工作流程,EvoCUE将组织要求从前几集转移到后几集任务,提高了任务执行质量. 这些结果显示,自我演化剂应该将经验置于控制流内部,而不是仅仅作为文本存储.

articles.title: Nürnberg NLP at ChildSafeAds 2026: Structurally Dissimilar Voter Ensembles under Four Levels of Data Access
articles.content: We describe the Nürnberg NLP system for ChildSafeAds 2026. The shared task asks what a monitoring system for commercial content in child-facing YouTube videos can achieve at a given level of data access. We answer with per-subtask ensembles of nine voters, organised into three branches that differ in backbone, adaptation method and class scope. Selection rests on channel-disjoint cross-validation, with the development set as a transfer check. The system wins two of the three subtasks. Its product-category score (ST2, 0.8243) and its compliance-flag score (ST3, 0.6530) are the best of the 22 final entries, and it places third on the task mean (0.7079). We further compare four access levels and report the cost at test-set scale.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 纽伦堡NLP at ChildSafeAds 2026: 结构上的分歧 选民集合 数据存取四级以下
articles.content_zh: 我们描述了纽伦堡2026年儿童安全协会的NLP系统。 共同任务问到,在某一数据访问水平上,儿童视频中商业内容的监测系统能够实现何种目标。 我们以9名选民的每个小任务组合来回答问题,分成三个分支,在骨干、适应方法和阶级范围方面各不相同。 选择依赖于频道-脱节交叉验证,开发设定为传输检查. 系统赢得了三个子任务中的两个. 其产品类别分数(ST2,0.8243)和遵义旗分数(ST3,0.6530)是22个最终入围的最好成绩,在任务平均分(0.7079)上排名第三. 我们进一步比较了四个准入级别,并按试验定式报告费用。

articles.title: ORPG: Reconciling Multiple Reward Objectives through Objective-wise Policy Gradients
articles.content: Multi-reward policy optimization requires a joint update that reflects both the learning signals and the intended relationships among objectives. We introduce Objective-wise Reconciled Policy Gradient (ORPG), which constructs a separate clipped policy objective for each reward and reconciles the resulting gradients into one policy update. For compatible gradients, a cosine-dependent interpolation coordinates their contributions through a partially normalized reference while preserving the norm of their sum. We characterize this update as the unique solution of a spherical directional compromise. For conflicting gradients, projection follows the task's priorities. We evaluate the same compatible rule in helpfulness--safety alignment and correctness--cost optimization for mathematical reasoning. ORPG substantially improves average Useful and Harmless scores over the strongest external baseline on each axis. In mathematics, it achieves the highest average full-budget accuracy and three-budget hypervolume among the compared methods, with more accurate and shorter responses than the initial policy. Component comparisons and training dynamics show the larger contribution of compatible coordination and a complementary benefit from conflict handling. These results support gradient reconciliation for objectives with equal standing and for objectives with an explicit priority.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ORPG:通过客观政策梯度调和多重回报目标
articles.content_zh: 多奖政策优化需要联合更新,既反映学习信号,又反映目标之间预期的关系。 我们引入了客观协调的逐步政策(ORPG),它为每项奖励构建了单独的剪切政策目标,并将由此产生的梯度调和为一项政策更新。 对于兼容的梯度,一个余弦依赖插值通过部分正常化的参考来协调它们的贡献,同时保持它们总和的规范. 我们把这个更新描述为球形方向妥协的独特解决方案. 对于相互冲突的梯度,预测遵循任务的优先次序。 我们评价相同的兼容规则 在帮助 - 安全协调 和正确 - 成本优化 为数学推理。 ORPG大大改善了每个轴线上最强外部基线的平均有用和无害分数。 在数学方面,它实现了比较方法中平均最高的全预算精确度和三预算超量,比最初的政策更准确,更短的答复. 构成部分比较和培训动态显示,兼容性协调的贡献更大,冲突处理可带来互补效益。 这些成果有助于实现具有同等地位的目标以及具有明确优先地位的目标的梯度调和。

articles.title: See it, Say it, Sorted: Mechanistic Diagnosis and Parameter-Space Mitigation of Emergent Misalignment in LLMs
articles.content: Safety-aligned LLMs can exhibit emergent misalignment (EM): narrow domain adaptation unexpectedly triggers catastrophic safety failures across unrelated domains. Prior static analyses leave training dynamics unmapped, while existing defenses rely on heuristics that degrade utility. We present a dynamic, second-order geometric study of EM. Tracking training trajectories reveals that directional Hessian curvature concentrates sharply on semantic pivot tokens. Grassmannian projections show that, in most settings, harmful-safe gap widens mainly because safe-gradient overlap declines. Leveraging these insights, we introduce a parameter-level Geometric Mitigation Framework that orthogonally projects empirical harmful gradient subspace out of parameter updates. On Qwen2.5-14B-IT, our defense suppresses free-generation EM by up to 80.0%; across the other three of four open-weight instruction-based model families (3B--20B), where single-layer behavioral EM is already near zero, teacher-forced evaluation shows same harmful subspace controls the conditional support of frozen EM responses. Crucially, these diagnostics unmask the illusion of behavioral safety: the same subspace remains measurable and steerable in models where behavioral EM is near zero. Code: https://github.com/WeiqiaoQUE/mechanistic-emergent-misalignment.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 看吧,说吧,排序了: 机械诊断和LLMs中紧急错配的参数空间缓解
articles.content_zh: 安全结合的LLMS可以显示出现错配(EM):狭义域的适应意外触发了无关域的灾难性安全故障. 先前的静态分析使得训练动力学没有被映射出来,而现有的防御则依赖于降低效用的热力学. 我们提出了EM的动态二阶几何研究. 跟踪训练轨迹显示,定向的黑森曲率 尖锐地集中在语义支点上。 Grassmannian的预测表明,在大多数情况下,有害-安全差距扩大主要是因为安全级重叠减少。 利用这些洞察力,我们引入了一个参数级的几何减缓框架,它正统地将实验性有害梯度子空间从参数更新中导出. 在Quen2.5-14B-IT上,我们的防御压制自由生成EM最高可达80.0%;在另外四个开放量级教学模式家庭(3B-20B)中,单层行为EM已经接近零,教师强制评价显示同样有害的子空间控制了冻结的EM响应的有条件支持. 关键的是,这些诊断解析了行为安全的假象:在行为EM接近零的模型中,同一个子空间仍然可以测量和引导. 代码:https://github.com/WeiqiaoQUE/机械-emergent-misalignment. 中国植物物种信息数据库.

articles.title: Semantic Uncertainty Quantification Needs Factual Equivalence
articles.content: Semantic uncertainty quantification for large language models rests on a common template: sample several answers, measure how much they agree, and treat disagreement as uncertainty. We first formalize this template as two separate roles: an operator that compares two answers, and an aggregator that combines all pairwise comparisons into a scalar. Existing methods differ almost entirely in how they aggregate, while taking the operator off the shelf, typically an NLI model or a generic sentence encoder. We show that this reliance on off-the-shelf operators is the primary bottleneck of semantic UQ: they do not accurately measure factual equivalence of multiple answers to the same question. We resolve this with a deliberately simple recipe: a single encoder trained contrastively to isolate the targeted fact, utilizing synthetic data generated by an LLM and dataset both disjoint from all evaluation settings. Integrating the resulting operator into existing methods improves performance on 120 of 126 evaluation settings (95%) spanning 18 model dataset combinations across language and vision-language models. The best variant reaches 0.76 mean AUROC against 0.68 for the strongest baseline, while replacing the quadratic cross-encoder comparisons of entailment-based operators with one encoder pass per answer. The uniformity of the improvement supports the view that the operator, not the aggregator, is the limiting factor. The same operator also improves single generation token-level estimators: the norm it assigns to each token measures how much that token bears on the answer, and reweighting token log-likelihoods accordingly sharpens the estimate.

articles.title_zh: 语义上不确定的量化 需要事实等同性
articles.content_zh: 对大语言模型的语义不确定性量化依赖于一个共同的模板:抽样几个答案,衡量他们同意多少,将分歧视为不确定性. 我们首先将这个模板正式化为两个独立的角色:一个是比较两个答案的操作员,另一个是将所有对等比较合并成平面的集合器. 现有方法在如何聚合方面几乎完全不同,同时将操作员从货架上取出,典型的是NLI模型或通用句式编码器. 我们显示,这种对现成操作者的依赖是语义UQ的主要瓶颈:它们没有准确衡量对同一问题的多个答案的事实等同性. 我们用一种刻意简单的方法解决这个问题:一个单一的编码器经过了对比性的培训,以隔离目标事实,利用LLM生成的合成数据和数据集,两者都与所有评价环境脱节。 在126个评价设置中,有120个(95%)跨越了18个不同语言和视觉语言模式的模型数据集组合,将由此产生的操作员纳入现有方法提高了业绩。 最佳变体达到0.76AUROC相对于最强基线的0.68AUROC,同时用每个回答一个编码器的通口取代了对内含操作器的四相编码器比较. 改进的统一性支持一种观点,即操作者而不是聚合者是限制因素。 同一操作员还改进了单生成符级估计器:它给每个符级测量器分配的规范,该符级在答案上所承受的分量,重新加权的符级日志相会相应使估计更清晰.

articles.title: Neural Language Models Learn the Contextual Distributions of Dependency Structures: a statistical learning theory to compositionality
articles.content: It is unclear how Neural Language Models (NLMs) acquire the structural meaning encoded by grammatical structures that is independent of lexical semantics. We propose a statistical learning process in which learned dependency structures themselves become new distributional units for subsequent statistical learning. Under this account, once a dependency structure is acquired, the model tracks its contextual distributions. These contextual features reflect the semantic properties of a composite structure. To test this hypothesis, we design a synthetic grammar in which each grammatical structure has distinct contextual distributions that cannot be recovered from the distributional statistics of their component tokens alone. We train a series of BERT-style masked language models on this grammar and examine their developmental trajectory. The results show that models can successfully learn the contextual distributions of composite dependency structures even though they cannot be inferred from token statistics alone. Developmental analysis further reveals a clear developmental trajectory. The learning of the dependency relations that define a grammatical structure consistently precedes the learning of its contextual features. These findings suggest that statistical learning in NLMs is not merely the accumulation of token co-occurrence statistics, but a process in which learned dependency structures become new units of distributional learning. We argue that this process provides a statistical-learning account of how NLMs solve the compositionality problem in language. Finally, we discuss the possibility that this statistical learning process provides an explanatory theory on how language cognition could emerge from pure distributional statistics.

articles.title_zh: 神经语言模型 学习依赖结构的背景分布:统计学习理论到组成
articles.content_zh: 神经语言模型(NLMs)如何获得由语法结构所编码的结构意义,这种结构独立于词典语义学,尚不清楚. 我们建议开展统计学习进程,使学习的依赖结构本身成为随后统计学习的新的分配单位。 在该账户下,一旦获得附属结构,模型将跟踪其背景分布。 这些背景特征反映了复合结构的语义性质. 为了测试这个假说,我们设计了一个合成语法,在这个语法结构中,每个语法结构都有不同的上下文分布,不能仅从其组成部分符的分布统计中恢复. 我们在这个语法上训练一系列BERT风格的蒙面语言模型,并检查其发展轨迹. 结果显示,模型可以成功地学习复合依赖结构的背景分布,尽管不能仅从象征性统计中推断出来。 发展分析进一步揭示了明确的发展轨迹。 了解界定语法结构的依赖关系,始终先于了解其背景特征。 这些调查结果表明,在非正规教育中进行统计学习不仅仅是象征性的共发统计数据的积累,而是一个学习的依赖结构成为分配学习新单元的过程。 我们争辩说,这一进程提供了一个统计学习的叙述,说明NLM如何解决语言的构成问题。 最后,我们讨论了这种统计学习过程能否提供一种解释性理论,说明语言认知如何从纯分布统计中产生。

articles.title: Don't Forget! Decomposing the Training Dynamics of Memorization in Language Models
articles.content: Memorization has been proposed as a mechanism to explain how language models fit the tail of their training distributions, but its training dynamics are not understood well. In this work, we take a fine-grained look at memorization by decomposing the loss trajectory of memorized sequences over training and model parameters. Across the Pythia family, we study memorization of duplicated training sequences (recitation) and rare ones (recollection). We find that memorization in both cases is characterized by sequence-level gradient alignment, though recitation suffers from misalignment with other training influences which causes forgetting, explaining the necessity for higher duplication of these examples. We further show that the lower model layers are the most involved in memorization and forgetting. Predicting memorization, our decomposition improves over a cross-entropy baseline, especially in larger models and early in training. Intervening on a small set of highly influential parameters we are able to ablate memorization in the final model. Together, these findings advance our understanding of how memorization develops during training and offer insights for predicting and intervening on it.

articles.title_zh: 别忘了! 解析语言模型记忆培训动态
articles.content_zh: 已提出将记忆作为解释语言模型如何适合其培训分布的尾声的一种机制,但其培训动态没有得到很好的理解. 在这部作品中,我们通过分解记忆序列在训练和模型参数上的丢失轨迹,对记忆进行精细的审视. 在整个Pythia家族中,我们研究重复的训练序列(引用)和罕见的序列(回忆)的记忆. 我们发现,在这两种情况下,记忆的特点是序列级梯度调整,尽管背诵与其他培训影响不一致,导致人们忘记,并解释有必要增加这些实例的重复。 我们进一步显示,下层模型层是参与记忆和遗忘最多的. 我们的分解预想会比跨度基线有所改进,特别是在更大的模型和早期的训练中。 介入一小组非常有影响力的参数,我们能够在最终模型中减轻记忆. 这些调查结果共同增进了我们对培训期间记忆发展方式的理解,并为预测和干预提供了深刻见解。

articles.title: Sample What You Say: Aligning Language Models to Sample the Distributions They State
articles.content: Language models are increasingly used to sample from a specified distribution, for instance, to simulate survey respondents or generate synthetic data. Instruction-tuned models can state such a distribution correctly and still fail to sample from it. Prompting and changes to decoding reduce this mismatch only partly, which motivates training with policy optimization. Group relative policy optimization (GRPO) is a natural fit for this problem because it already samples a group of rollouts per prompt, and the group's empirical distribution can be compared with the target. However, scoring the group as a whole gives every rollout the same reward. Group-relative centering then sets all advantages to zero, and the model receives no learning signal. To give each rollout its own signal, we introduce the witness advantage, a per-rollout advantage derived from maximum mean discrepancy (MMD). It trains a model to match a target distribution over a finite set of outcomes. The MMD between the model's distribution and the target has a witness function that measures how over- or under-produced each outcome is. Each rollout's advantage estimates the negative witness at its outcome, so a rollout is rewarded for an outcome the group under-produces and penalized for one it over-produces. The witness advantage is computed in closed form from the group's outcome counts, and we use it as the reward in GRPO. On unseen target distributions, training with the witness advantage substantially reduces the total variation distance to the target while largely preserving the model's general capabilities.

articles.title_zh: 样板你说的: 将语言模型与分布图样对齐 他们说
articles.content_zh: 语言模型越来越多地用于取自特定分布的样本,例如模拟调查答卷人或生成合成数据。 指令调制的模型可以正确表述这样的分布,仍然无法从中取出样本. 催化和修改去编解码只会部分地减少这种不匹配现象,这激励了政策优化培训。 集团相对政策优化(GRPO)自然适合这个问题,因为它已经对每个即时推出的一组进行抽样,并且该组的经验分布可以与目标进行比较. 然而,整个团体的评分给每个推出者都给予同样的奖励. 群相中心再将所有优势设置为零,而模型则不接收学习信号. 为了给每个推出自己的信号,我们引入了证人的优势,即从最大正差(MMD)得到的每推出一次的优势. 它训练一种模式,以匹配一组有限结果的目标分布。 模型的分布与目标之间的MMD具有一个目击功能,可以测量每个结果的多产或少产程度. 每一次推出的优势都估计了负面的目击结果,因此推出的结果会得到奖励,因为该团体的产量不足,而且对其产量过大者将受到惩罚。 证人的优势是从小组的结果计数中 以封闭的形式计算出来的 我们把它作为GRPO的奖励 在未见的目标分布上,具有证人优势的培训会大大减少与目标的总变异距离,同时在很大程度上保留模型的一般能力.
